question_text:
A company collects data for temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure in cities across multiple continents.
The average volume of data that the company collects from each site daily is 500 GB. Each site has a high-speed Internet connection.
The company wants to aggregate the data from all these global sites as quickly as possible in a single Amazon S3 bucket. The solution must minimize operational complexity.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
这些站点具有快速链接，因此无需物理运输——所需的是加快数据通过互联网上传到单个存储桶的速度。S3传输加速将数据路由到最近的边缘位置，然后通过AWS骨干网络传输到存储桶，且分块上传并行化了大文件的传输。这通过存储桶上的一个开关即可配置——操作复杂性几乎为零。
选项 B：该方法可行，但会增加额外的存储桶、复制规则以及源对象的清理工作：对于相同的结果，操作复杂性明显更高。
选项 C：每日运输Snowball设备与"尽可能快速"的要求相矛盾：交付需要数天时间，而链接本身已经很快。
选项 D：实例、卷、快照以及在另一个区域的恢复是所列选项中最复杂且最昂贵的，数据最终仍需存入S3。

options.text: Turn on S3 Transfer Acceleration on the destination S3 bucket. Use multipart uploads to directly upload site data to the destination S3 bucket.
Upload the data from each site to an S3 bucket in the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket. Then remove the data from the origin S3 bucket.
Schedule AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device jobs daily to transfer data from each site to the closest Region. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication to copy objects to the destination S3 bucket.

Upload the data from each site to an Amazon EC2 instance in the closest Region. Store the data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. At regular intervals, take an EBS snapshot and copy it to the Region that contains the destination S3 bucket. Restore the EBS volume in that Region.

question_text:
A company needs the ability to analyze the log files of its proprietary application. The logs are stored in JSON format in an Amazon S3 bucket. Queries will be simple and will run on-demand. A solutions architect needs to perform the analysis with minimal changes to the existing architecture.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
explanation_en:
数据已经存在于 S3 中，查询简单且按需运行。Amazon Athena 直接从存储桶读取对象，理解 JSON 格式，并按扫描字节数计费——无需集群，无需数据加载，也无需更改架构。
选项 A：将整个数据量加载到 Redshift 意味着需要一个独立的数据存储、一个加载管道以及一个始终运行的集群。
选项 B：日志已经存在于 S3 中，将其移动到 CloudWatch Logs 是架构变更且存储成本更高。
选项 D：一个 Glue 目录加上一个临时的 EMR 集群可以解决该任务，但它们需要配置并且需要支付节点费用，而一个单一服务就足够了。

options.text: Use Amazon Redshift to load all the content into one place and run the SQL queries as needed.
Use Amazon CloudWatch Logs to store the logs. Run SQL queries as needed from the Amazon CloudWatch console.
Use Amazon Athena directly with Amazon S3 to run the queries as needed.
Use AWS Glue to catalog the logs. Use a transient Apache Spark cluster on Amazon EMR to run the SQL queries as needed.

question_text:
A company uses AWS Organizations to manage multiple AWS accounts for different departments. The management account has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains project reports. The company wants to limit access to this S3 bucket to only users of accounts within the organization in AWS Organizations.
Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
explanation_en:
该公司需要允许组织内的任何人访问，而无需每次添加新账户时都重新编写策略。这正是 aws:PrincipalOrgID 全局条件键的作用：桶策略指定组织 ID（o-xxxx），只有当调用主体属于该组织内的某个账户时，请求才会成功。添加一个账户后访问会自动生效；移除账户后访问也会自动消失。无需枚举或维护，因此操作开销最小。
选项 B：aws:PrincipalOrgPaths 限制对特定组织单元（OU）的访问，并需要枚举 OU 路径且在组织重组时持续维护。然而，本任务是允许整个组织的访问。
选项 C：通过监控组织事件然后更新策略，是一种自研的账户列表同步机制：存在代码、延迟以及出错风险，而一个现成的条件键已经存在。
选项 D：对用户添加标签意味着必须在每个账户中手动应用和移除这些标签。组织成员身份会自动检查。

options.text: Add the aws PrincipalOrgID global condition key with a reference to the organization ID to the S3 bucket policy.
Create an organizational unit (OU) for each department. Add the aws:PrincipalOrgPaths global condition key to the S3 bucket policy.
Use AWS CloudTrail to monitor the CreateAccount, InviteAccountToOrganization, LeaveOrganization, and RemoveAccountFromOrganization events. Update the S3 bucket policy accordingly.
Tag each user that needs access to the S3 bucket. Add the aws:PrincipalTag global condition key to the S3 bucket policy.

question_text:
An application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a VPC. The application processes logs that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. The EC2 instance needs to access the S3 bucket without connectivity to the internet.
Which solution will provide private network connectivity to Amazon S3?
explanation_en:
从 VPC 到 S3 的私有连接由网关端点提供：将指向服务前缀列表的路由添加到子网的路由表中，对桶的请求将在 AWS 网络内传输，而不会流向互联网。端点本身没有费用。
选项 B：将日志流式传输到 CloudWatch Logs 再进行导出，是日志处理方式的重新设计，而非网络解决方案，访问 S3 仍然需要路由。
选项 C：实例角色授予访问权限，但路由保持不变：没有端点的情况下，流量仍会经过互联网。
选项 D：通过 API Gateway 实现对 S3 的私有访问是不存在的：该机制并不如此工作。

options.text: Create a gateway VPC endpoint to the S3 bucket.
Stream the logs to Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Export the logs to the S3 bucket.
Create an instance profile on Amazon EC2 to allow S3 access.
Create an Amazon API Gateway API with a private link to access the S3 endpoint.

question_text:
A company is hosting a web application on AWS using a single Amazon EC2 instance that stores user-uploaded documents in an Amazon EBS volume. For better scalability and availability, the company duplicated the architecture and created a second EC2 instance and EBS volume in another Availability Zone, placing both behind an Application Load Balancer. After completing this change, users reported that, each time they refreshed the website, they could see one subset of their documents or the other, but never all of the documents at the same time.
What should a solutions architect propose to ensure users see all of their documents at once?
explanation_en:
该症状有一个简单的解释：一个 EBS 卷只附加到单个实例上，因此每台机器都有自己的文档集合，负载均衡器根据请求落在哪台机器上显示其中一个集合。所需的是一个可以同时被两台机器访问的共享存储——通过 NFS 在所有可用区的所有实例上挂载 Amazon EFS。现有的文件被复制到 EFS 上，应用程序开始在此处写入，用户无论请求到达哪台实例，都能看到完整的文件列表。
选项 A：一次性的复制仅在复制的那一刻同步卷：下一个上传的文档仍将只存在于一台机器上。
选项 B：将用户固定到"他们的"服务器没有帮助：单个用户的文档已经分散在两个卷上，如果该服务器失效，对其文件的访问将丢失。
选项 D：负载均衡器会将请求发送到恰好一台目标服务器。它无法将请求拆分并拼接响应。

options.text: Copy the data so both EBS volumes contain all the documents
Configure the Application Load Balancer to direct a user to the server with the documents
Copy the data from both EBS volumes to Amazon EFS. Modify the application to save new documents to Amazon EFS
Configure the Application Load Balancer to send the request to both servers. Return each document from the correct server

question_text:
A company uses NFS to store large video files in on-premises network attached storage. Each video file ranges in size from 1 MB to 500 GB. The total storage is 70 TB and is no longer growing. The company decides to migrate the video files to Amazon S3. The company must migrate the video files as soon as possible while using the least possible network bandwidth.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
两个约束条件适用：尽可能快速地迁移，并尽可能减少网络带宽的使用。第二个条件直接排除了任何网络传输，因此 70 TB 的数据是离线传输的——通过 AWS Snowball Edge 设备（约 80 TB 的可用容量，即单个订单）。数据被本地复制到设备上，设备被运回 AWS，数据最终进入 S3。一个有用的估算规则：1 Gbps ≈ 每天 10 TB，因此如果通过网络传输 70 TB，即使拥有完全免费的千兆连接，也需要一周时间，而本场景并非如此。
选项 A：通过 CLI 进行复制会使用公司的互联网连接：完全违反了最小化带宽使用的诉求。
选项 C：S3 File Gateway 是为持续的混合访问设计的，而不是一次性迁移，且数据仍然会通过该网络进行传输。
选项 D：Direct Connect 需要数月时间才能设置完成，且数据仍然会通过该链路传输。它不符合一次性‘尽可能快速’传输 70 TB 的需求。

options.text: Create an S3 bucket. Create an IAM role that has permissions to write to the S3 bucket. Use the AWS CLI to copy all files locally to the S3 bucket.

Create an AWS Snowball Edge job. Receive a Snowball Edge device on premises. Use the Snowball Edge client to transfer data to the device. Return the device so that AWS can import the data into Amazon S3.

Deploy an S3 File Gateway on premises. Create a public service endpoint to connect to the S3 File Gateway. Create an S3 bucket. Create a new NFS file share on the S3 File Gateway. Point the new file share to the S3 bucket. Transfer the data from the existing NFS file share to the S3 File Gateway.

Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection between the on-premises network and AWS. Deploy an S3 File Gateway on premises. Create a public virtual interface (VIF) to connect to the S3 File Gateway. Create an S3 bucket. Create a new NFS file share on the S3 File Gateway. Point the new file share to the S3 bucket. Transfer the data from the existing NFS file share to the S3 File Gateway.

question_text:
A company has an application that ingests incoming messages. Dozens of other applications and microservices then quickly consume these messages. The number of messages varies drastically and sometimes increases suddenly to 100,000 each second. The company wants to decouple the solution and increase scalability.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
数十个独立的应用程序消耗消息，每个都需要自己的副本。一个 SNS 主题将消息分发给所有订阅者，而每个消费者对应的 SQS 队列可以平滑处理每秒高达十万条消息的峰值，并允许每个消费者以自己的节奏进行处理。这是经典的广播模式。
选项 A：Kinesis Data Analytics 通过查询处理数据流；它不会为数十个独立的消费者存储消息。
选项 B：根据 CPU 负载扩展实例无法将生产者与消费者解耦，也无法应对突发的流量峰值。
选项 C：单个 Kinesis 分片每秒的记录限制约为一千条，远低于十万条，且中间表增加了复杂性而无实际益处。

options.text: Persist the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics. Configure the consumer applications to read and process the messages.
Deploy the ingestion application on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to scale the number of EC2 instances based on CPU metrics.

Write the messages to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams with a single shard. Use an AWS Lambda function to preprocess messages and store them in Amazon DynamoDB. Configure the consumer applications to read from DynamoDB to process the messages.

Publish the messages to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SOS) subscriptions. Configure the consumer applications to process the messages from the queues.

question_text:
A company is migrating a distributed application to AWS. The application serves variable workloads. The legacy platform consists of a primary server that coordinates jobs across multiple compute nodes. The company wants to modernize the application with a solution that maximizes resiliency and scalability.
How should a solutions architect design the architecture to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
作业协调器是一个瓶颈且是单点故障。作业被放入一个 SQS 队列中，计算节点运行在自动扩展组中，该组的大小由队列长度驱动。这样系统能够响应实际的工作量，并且能够抵御任何节点的故障。
选项 A：定时扩展无法响应需求中明确指出的可变负载。
选项 C：CloudTrail 记录 API 调用，无法作为作业的目标，且保留主服务器仍存在单点故障。
选项 D：EventBridge 路由事件但不持有作业队列，且主服务器仍存在于设计中。

options.text: Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling to use scheduled scaling.

Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a destination for the jobs. Implement the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the size of the queue.

Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure AWS CloudTrail as a destination for the jobs. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the primary server.

Implement the primary server and the compute nodes with Amazon EC2 instances that are managed in an Auto Scaling group. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) as a destination for the jobs. Configure EC2 Auto Scaling based on the load on the compute nodes.

question_text:
A company is running an SMB file server in its data center. The file server stores large files that are accessed frequently for the first few days after the files are created. After 7 days the files are rarely accessed.
The total data size is increasing and is close to the company's total storage capacity. A solutions architect must increase the company's available storage space without losing low-latency access to the most recently accessed files. The solutions architect must also provide file lifecycle management to avoid future storage issues.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
有三个需求：增加存储空间，保持对最近访问文件的低延迟，以及实现生命周期管理。Amazon S3 File Gateway 为本地客户端提供 SMB 共享，将数据存储在 S3 中，并将最近使用的文件保留在本地缓存中——因此新数据具有低延迟。一个生命周期规则在七天后将对象过渡到 S3 Glacier Deep Archive，这解决了成本和数据量的增长问题。
选项 A：DataSync 复制数据，但不会让本地应用程序透明地访问已迁移的数据，且本身不管理生命周期。
选项 C：FSx for Windows File Server 提供存储空间和 SMB 协议，但属于全额付费的文件存储，且没有自动过渡到更便宜的归档存储类。
选项 D：在每台用户计算机上部署一个工具意味着需要改变工作流程并放弃熟悉的网络共享，且 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval 对相同需求而言比 Deep Archive 更昂贵。

options.text: Use AWS DataSync to copy data that is older than 7 days from the SMB file server to AWS.
Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway to extend the company's storage space. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 7 days.
Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system to extend the company's storage space.
Install a utility on each user's computer to access Amazon S3. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the data to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 7 days.

question_text:
A company is building an ecommerce web application on AWS. The application sends information about new orders to an Amazon API Gateway REST API to process. The company wants to ensure that orders are processed in the order that they are received.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
只有 SQS FIFO 队列能够保证订单处理的顺序：它在消息组内保持序列，并保证精确一次处理。API Gateway 将订单放入这样的队列中，而 Lambda 函数从中读取并按顺序处理订单。
选项 A：SNS 无法保证消息的交付顺序：消息可以以任意顺序到达订阅者。
选项 C：在处理一个订单时阻塞所有请求会破坏应用程序的吞吐量。
选项 D：标准 SQS 队列基于尽力而为的顺序处理，但允许重新排序：它不提供严格的序列化。

options.text: Use an API Gateway integration to publish a message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the application receives an order. Subscribe an AWS Lambda function to the topic to perform processing.

Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue when the application receives an order. Configure the SQS FIFO queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.
Use an API Gateway authorizer to block any requests while the application processes an order.

Use an API Gateway integration to send a message to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue when the application receives an order. Configure the SQS standard queue to invoke an AWS Lambda function for processing.

question_text:
A company has an application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon Aurora database. The EC2 instances connect to the database by using user names and passwords that are stored locally in a file. The company wants to minimize the operational overhead of credential management.
What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this goal?
explanation_en:
密码存储在实例上的一个文件中，这意味着有人必须将其分发、在每台机器上更改，并确保它不会随着镜像泄露。AWS Secrets Manager消除了所有这些问题：密钥使用KMS密钥进行加密存储，应用程序通过实例角色的身份经由API获取该密钥，内置的轮换功能会同时在Aurora数据库和密钥本身中更改密码，使用针对支持数据库的现成函数。无需编写任何代码——因此实现了"最小化操作开销"。与Parameter Store的关键区别在于：只有Secrets Manager内置了轮换功能。
选项 B：Parameter Store可以将密码存储为SecureString，但它没有内置的自动轮换功能——无法通过勾选框开启；你需要编写并维护自己的函数。
选项 C：加密存储桶中的文件仍然是同一个文件：数据库中的密码和对象中的密码仍然需要手动更改或通过你自己的代码进行更改。
选项 D：加密的EBS卷仅在静态数据存储时提供保护，但并未解决凭证管理中的任何问题：没有轮换功能，且文件现在存在于每台实例上。

options.text: Use AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation.
Use AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on automatic rotation.

Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store objects that are encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Migrate the credential file to the S3 bucket. Point the application to the S3 bucket.

Create an encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for each EC2 instance. Attach the new EBS volume to each EC2 instance. Migrate the credential file to the new EBS volume. Point the application to the new EBS volume.

question_text:
A global company hosts its web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB).
The web application has static data and dynamic data. The company stores its static data in an Amazon S3 bucket.
The company wants to improve performance and reduce latency for the static data and dynamic data. The company is using its own domain name registered with Amazon Route 53.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
同一服务能够加速静态和动态内容：CloudFront 可以拥有多个源，并通过基于路径的行为路由请求——静态文件从 S3 存储桶中提供，动态请求则被代理到负载均衡器。动态内容的性能提升并非来自缓存，而是来自 TLS 在最近的边缘位置被终止，之后请求通过 AWS 核心网络传输。Route 53 使用别名记录将公司的域名指向该分发配置。
选项 B：全球加速器不支持 S3 作为端点：它仅与 ALB、NLB、EC2 和弹性 IP 地址兼容。此设计不可行。
选项 C：在 CloudFront 前面添加一个加速器没有意义：两个服务已经提供了全球网络，且该设计会增加复杂性而无任何好处。
选项 D：为静态和动态内容使用两个独立域名会增加应用的复杂性，且 S3 仍不能作为全球加速器的端点。

options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the S3 bucket and the ALB as origins. Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the CloudFront distribution.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that has the S3 bucket as an endpoint Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the CloudFront distribution.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the S3 bucket as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that has the ALB and the CloudFront distribution as endpoints. Create a custom domain name that points to the accelerator DNS name. Use the custom domain name as an endpoint for the web application.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that has the ALB as an origin. Create an AWS Global Accelerator standard accelerator that has the S3 bucket as an endpoint. Create two domain names. Point one domain name to the CloudFront DNS name for dynamic content. Point the other domain name to the accelerator DNS name for static content. Use the domain names as endpoints for the web application.

question_text:
A company performs monthly maintenance on its AWS infrastructure. During these maintenance activities, the company needs to rotate the credentials for its Amazon RDS for MySQL databases across multiple AWS Regions.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
两个要求：需要在多个区域使用相同的凭据，并且这些凭据必须按照预定时间表进行轮换，同时最小化手动操作。Secrets Manager 恰好提供了这两种机制：多区域密钥复制会将密钥的副本保留在所需区域，并在主密钥发生变化时自动更新副本；而针对 RDS 的内置轮换功能则会使用预构建的 AWS 函数按计划更改密码。每个区域的应用程序读取本地副本，无需跨区域调用，从而避免了延迟。
选项 B：Systems Manager Parameter Store 既不支持跨区域参数复制，也不支持内置轮换。这两种机制都需要从头开始自行构建。
选项 C：一个存储在桶中的文件加上一个由 EventBridge 触发的自定义函数，意味着需要自行编写代码来实现 Secrets Manager 配置设置中的功能，且没有现成的跨区域复制功能。
选项 D：采用多区域 KMS 密钥、DynamoDB 全局表以及自定义轮换函数的设计是可行的，但涉及三个服务和一个手动构建的过程，而不是单一配置。

options.text: Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Secrets Manager. Use multi-Region secret replication for the required Regions. Configure Secrets Manager to rotate the secrets on a schedule.

Store the credentials as secrets in AWS Systems Manager by creating a secure string parameter. Use multi- Region secret replication for the required Regions. Configure Systems Manager to rotate the secrets on a schedule.

Store the credentials in an Amazon S3 bucket that has server-side encryption (SSE) enabled. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to invoke an AWS Lambda function to rotate the credentials.

Encrypt the credentials as secrets by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) multi-Region customer managed keys. Store the secrets in an Amazon DynamoDB global table. Use an AWS Lambda function to retrieve the secrets from DynamoDB. Use the RDS API to rotate the secrets.

question_text:
A company runs an ecommerce application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The Auto Scaling group scales based on CPU utilization metrics. The ecommerce application stores the transaction data in a MySQL 8.0 database that is hosted on a large EC2 instance.
The database's performance degrades quickly as application load increases. The application handles more read requests than write transactions. The company wants a solution that will automatically scale the database to meet the demand of unpredictable read workloads while maintaining high availability.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
读取操作显著多于写入操作，负载不可预测，并且需要高可用性。Aurora MySQL 与现有数据库兼容，跨多个可用区部署，并能通过 Aurora 自动伸缩根据负载自动添加和移除读副本。应用程序无需修改任何查询即可切换到读端点。
选项 A：Redshift 是用于在大规模数据集上执行复杂查询的分析数据仓库，不是在线商店的事务型数据库，且单节点无法提供高可用性。
选项 B：单可用区配置与高可用性要求相矛盾，且 RDS 读副本不会根据负载自动添加。
选项 D：Memcached 是一种缓存，不具备数据持久化和复制功能；它不是数据库，且 Spot 实例不适合用于数据存储。

options.text: Use Amazon Redshift with a single node for leader and compute functionality.
Use Amazon RDS with a Single-AZ deployment Configure Amazon RDS to add reader instances in a different Availability Zone.
Use Amazon Aurora with a Multi-AZ deployment. Configure Aurora Auto Scaling with Aurora Replicas.
Use Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached with EC2 Spot Instances.

question_text:
A company recently migrated to AWS and wants to implement a solution to protect the traffic that flows in and out of the production VPC. The company had an inspection server in its on-premises data center. The inspection server performed specific operations such as traffic flow inspection and traffic filtering. The company wants to have the same functionalities in the AWS Cloud.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
本地检查服务器执行了两件事：检查流量并过滤流量。在 AWS 中，这对应于 AWS Network Firewall —— 一个受管理的、基于状态的 VPC 级防火墙，支持与 Suricata 兼容的规则、域名过滤和深度协议检查。它部署在专用子网中，VPC 流量会路由到其端点。区别在于：Network Firewall 过滤流量，WAF 保护 HTTP 应用程序，Firewall Manager 在多个账户中集中管理策略，而 GuardDuty 仅进行检测。
选项 A：GuardDuty 分析日志并报告可疑活动。它不会阻止任何内容，也不会过滤流量。
选项 B：Traffic Mirroring 将流量复制到分析器，但单独使用时它不会过滤或阻止任何内容——它是一个可观测性工具。
选项 D：Firewall Manager 在多个账户中管理 WAF、Shield 和 Network Firewall 策略，但它本身不执行检查：它需要底层服务，即 Network Firewall。

options.text: Use Amazon GuardDuty for traffic inspection and traffic filtering in the production VPC.
Use Traffic Mirroring to mirror traffic from the production VPC for traffic inspection and filtering.
Use AWS Network Firewall to create the required rules for traffic inspection and traffic filtering for the production VPC.
Use AWS Firewall Manager to create the required rules for traffic inspection and traffic filtering for the production VPC.

question_text:
A company hosts a data lake on AWS. The data lake consists of data in Amazon S3 and Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The company needs a reporting solution that provides data visualization and includes all the data sources within the data lake. Only the company's management team should have full access to all the visualizations. The rest of the company should have only limited access.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
所需的是跨多个数据源（S3 和 RDS）的可视化，并实现访问隔离：管理用户拥有完全访问权限，其他人则拥有受限访问权限。Amazon QuickSight 通过 Athena 连接 S3，直接连接 RDS，发布的仪表板共享给 QuickSight 自身的用户和组——该服务拥有自己的用户和组模型。这正是正确选项与相似选项之间的关键区别：仪表板无法共享给 IAM 角色。
选项 A：QuickSight 仪表板发布给 QuickSight 用户和组，而不是 IAM 角色。角色控制服务对数据源的访问，而不是控制仪表板的可见性。
选项 C：Glue 作业生成报告文件，但这不是交互式可视化，且通过存储桶策略实现的访问控制比仪表板级别的权限更粗粒度。
选项 D：Athena 联邦查询解决了数据访问问题，但它仍然生成表和文件，而不是可视化。无法满足对仪表板的需求。

options.text: Create an analysis in Amazon QuickSight. Connect all the data sources and create new datasets. Publish dashboards to visualize the data. Share the dashboards with the appropriate IAM roles.
Create an analysis in Amazon QuickSight. Connect all the data sources and create new datasets. Publish dashboards to visualize the data. Share the dashboards with the appropriate users and groups.

Create an AWS Glue table and crawler for the data in Amazon S3. Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to produce reports. Publish the reports to Amazon S3. Use S3 bucket policies to limit access to the reports.

Create an AWS Glue table and crawler for the data in Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena Federated Query to access data within Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. Generate reports by using Amazon Athena. Publish the reports to Amazon S3. Use S3 bucket policies to limit access to the reports.

question_text:
A company is implementing a new business application. The application runs on two Amazon EC2 instances and uses an Amazon S3 bucket for document storage. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the EC2 instances can access the S3 bucket.
What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
一个 EC2 实例只能通过一个方式获得权限——即通过附加到实例上的 IAM 角色（技术上是通过实例配置文件）。应用程序从实例元数据中获取临时凭证，它们会自动刷新，且密钥永远不会保存在文件或环境变量中。策略则附加到角色，而不是实例；组仅用于用户。
选项 B：一个策略无法附加到实例上：策略附加到用户、组和角色。实例获得一个角色，而该角色又携带策略。
选项 C：一个 IAM 组是用户容器。实例无法附加到其中。
选项 D：一个 IAM 用户是为个人或外部系统提供的长期凭证。用户无法附加到实例上，且将密钥保存在磁盘上是一种反模式。

options.text: Create an IAM role that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the role to the EC2 instances.
Create an IAM policy that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the policy to the EC2 instances.
Create an IAM group that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the group to the EC2 instances.
Create an IAM user that grants access to the S3 bucket. Attach the user account to the EC2 instances.

question_text:
An application development team is designing a microservice that will convert large images to smaller, compressed images. When a user uploads an image through the web interface, the microservice should store the image in an Amazon S3 bucket, process and compress the image with an AWS Lambda function, and store the image in its compressed form in a different S3 bucket.
A solutions architect needs to design a solution that uses durable, stateless components to process the images automatically.
Which combination of actions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
需要具备持久性和无状态的组件。S3 在上传时通过通知将消息放入 SQS 队列中，因此文件信息得以可靠存储，并在发生故障时仍能保持（A）。该队列作为 Lambda 函数的调用源，消息在成功处理后会被删除；若处理失败，则会返回队列并进行重试（B）。
选项 C：函数内存中的文本文件在执行环境消失的同时也会消失，且函数本身没有内置方式来轮询该存储桶。
选项 D：一个带有日志文件的 EC2 实例会增加状态和基础设施的维护工作。
选项 E：发送给应用程序所有者的邮件是一种通知个人的行为，而不是自动化图像处理。

options.text: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure the S3 bucket to send a notification to the SQS queue when an image is uploaded to the S3 bucket.
Configure the Lambda function to use the Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the invocation source. When the SQS message is successfully processed, delete the message in the queue.

Configure the Lambda function to monitor the S3 bucket for new uploads. When an uploaded image is detected, write the file name to a text file in memory and use the text file to keep track of the images that were processed.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to monitor an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. When items are added to the queue, log the file name in a text file on the EC2 instance and invoke the Lambda function.

Configure an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) event to monitor the S3 bucket. When an image is uploaded, send an alert to an Amazon ample Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic with the application owner's email address for further processing.

question_text:
A company has a three-tier web application that is deployed on AWS. The web servers are deployed in a public subnet in a VPC. The application servers and database servers are deployed in private subnets in the same VPC.
The company has deployed a third-party virtual firewall appliance from AWS Marketplace in an inspection VPC.
The appliance is configured with an IP interface that can accept IP packets.
A solutions architect needs to integrate the web application with the appliance to inspect all traffic to the application before the traffic reaches the web server.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
第三方检测设备在IP层接收数据包——AWS恰好为此场景提供了专用服务。网关负载均衡器部署在检测VPC中，位于设备前端，并在应用程序的VPC中创建一个网关负载均衡器端点：流量被路由到该端点，通过GENEVE透明地传递给设备，然后原路返回。源地址被保留，负载均衡器负责对设备进行扩展和健康检查——操作开销极小。
选项 A：一个网络负载均衡器在第4层运行，并更改连接的目标：它无法提供对完整流量的透明检测，且数据包的返回路径必须手动构建。
选项 B：一个应用负载均衡器解析HTTP并自身终止连接，而设备期望的是原始IP数据包。
选项 C：传输网关用于连接网络，但单独使用时无法将流量转发到检测设备，或在多个设备实例之间进行负载均衡。路由必须手动维护。

options.text: Create a Network Load Balancer in the public subnet of the application's VPC to route the traffic to the appliance for packet inspection.
Create an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet of the application's VPC to route the traffic to the appliance for packet inspection.
Deploy a transit gateway in the inspection VPConfigure route tables to route the incoming packets through the transit gateway.
Deploy a Gateway Load Balancer in the inspection VPC. Create a Gateway Load Balancer endpoint to receive the incoming packets and forward the packets to the appliance.

question_text:
A company wants to improve its ability to clone large amounts of production data into a test environment in the same AWS Region. The data is stored in Amazon EC2 instances on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. Modifications to the cloned data must not affect the production environment. The software that accesses this data requires consistently high I/O performance.
A solutions architect needs to minimize the time that is required to clone the production data into the test environment.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
一个从快照恢复的卷在块首次被访问时从 S3 懒加载，因此通常较慢。快照恢复功能消除了这种行为：启用该功能后，从快照创建的卷在创建时即可提供完整性能。因此流程是：创建一个快照，启用该功能，从该快照创建新卷，并将其附加到测试实例上——该副本是独立的，从第一秒起即可实现高性能。
选项 A：一个快照无法恢复到实例存储：实例的本地磁盘不是从 EBS 快照创建的。
选项 B：多挂载将同一个卷连接到多个实例，这意味着测试环境会写入生产数据——直接违反了要求。
选项 C：通过手动初始化卷，逐个读取每个块耗时很长，而时间正是需要最小化的因素。表述也重新排列了步骤。

options.text: Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Restore the snapshots onto EC2 instance store volumes in the test environment.

Configure the production EBS volumes to use the EBS Multi-Attach feature. Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Attach the production EBS volumes to the EC2 instances in the test environment.

Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Create and initialize new EBS volumes. Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2 instances in the test environment before restoring the volumes from the production EBS snapshots.

Take EBS snapshots of the production EBS volumes. Turn on the EBS fast snapshot restore feature on the EBS snapshots. Restore the snapshots into new EBS volumes. Attach the new EBS volumes to EC2 instances in the test environment.

question_text:
An ecommerce company wants to launch a one-deal-a-day website on AWS. Each day will feature exactly one product on sale for a period of 24 hours. The company wants to be able to handle millions of requests each hour with millisecond latency during peak hours.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
每小时数百万次请求、毫秒级响应时间以及极低的操作开销表明采用无服务器架构。静态内容存储在 S3 中，并通过 CloudFront 在边缘位置进行缓存，动态调用由 API Gateway 和 Lambda 处理，订单数据存储在 DynamoDB 中，响应时间仅为个位数毫秒。系统可自动扩展，无需管理任何服务器。
选项 A：一个完全静态的网站无法处理购买操作，将订单数据存储在 S3 中是不可行的：需要事务处理和快速基于键的访问。
选项 B：一组实例、两个负载均衡器和一个 RDS 数据库代表了最高的操作开销，并且需要手动配置高峰时段的扩展。
选项 C：一个 EKS 集群意味着需要管理节点和自动扩展设置，而 RDS 在高峰负载下仍存在瓶颈。

options.text: Use Amazon S3 to host the full website in different S3 buckets. Add Amazon CloudFront distributions. Set the S3 buckets as origins for the distributions. Store the order data in Amazon S3.

Deploy the full website on Amazon EC2 instances that run in Auto Scaling groups across multiple Availability Zones. Add an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to distribute the website traffic. Add another ALB for the backend APIs. Store the data in Amazon RDS for MySQL.

Migrate the full application to run in containers. Host the containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use the Kubernetes Cluster Autoscaler to increase and decrease the number of pods to process bursts in traffic. Store the data in Amazon RDS for MySQL.

Use an Amazon S3 bucket to host the website's static content. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Set the S3 bucket as the origin. Use Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda functions for the backend APIs. Store the data in Amazon DynamoDB.

question_text:
A solutions architect is using Amazon S3 to design the storage architecture of a new digital media application. The media files must be resilient to the loss of an Availability Zone. Some files are accessed frequently while other files are rarely accessed in an unpredictable pattern. The solutions architect must minimize the costs of storing and retrieving the media files.
Which storage option meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
两个要求在这里相互配合。"对可用区丢失具有韧性" 排除了任何存在于单一可用区中的存储类，即单可用区标准存储（One Zone-IA）。"访问模式不可预测" 排除了那些对检索收费的存储类：如果你无法预知文件何时会被需要，那么每次未预料到的访问都会为标准存储类（IA）产生费用。这仅剩下 S3 智能分层存储（S3 Intelligent-Tiering）：它会根据实际访问情况自动在不同层级之间移动对象，不收取检索费用，并且在三个可用区中存储副本。考试经验法则："不可预测的访问模式" 几乎总是指向智能分层存储。
选项 A：S3 标准存储可以抵御单个可用区的丢失，但它无法解决另一个问题：对于很少被访问的文件，你仍需支付全额费用。这未能满足降低成本的要求。
选项 C：标准-IA 存储成本更低，但它对每吉字节的检索收取费用，并且会收取至少30天的存储费用。在访问模式不可预测的情况下，这些费用很容易抵消节省的成本。
选项 D：单可用区-IA 将数据存储在单一可用区中。该选项完全不符合第一个要求——即能够抵御可用区丢失。

options.text: S3 Standard
S3 Intelligent-Tiering
S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA)
S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA)

question_text:
A company is storing backup files by using Amazon S3 Standard storage. The files are accessed frequently for 1 month. However, the files are not accessed after 1 month. The company must keep the files indefinitely.
Which storage solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
这里的访问模式是明确已知的：使用一个月后，文件将不再被读取，但必须永久保留。当模式已知时，显式生命周期规则是成本最低的选择，目标存储类别根据所需的检索速度来选择——而题目中完全未提及检索速度的要求。因此，最便宜的归档层级，S3 Glacier Deep Archive，是最佳选择：每 terabyte 每月约一美元，相比标准存储的二十美元。与 第 126 题 相比，在后者中部分数据必须始终保持即时可访问，因此答案会有所不同。
选项 A：Intelligent-Tiering 每月收取每个对象的监控费用，并根据实际访问情况移动数据。当访问计划已知时，这会带来额外成本和额外的不确定性，相比简单的生命周期规则而言。
选项 C：Standard-IA 的成本大约比 Deep Archive 高一个数量级。它适用于数据仍需被读取且需要即时访问的情况，但在此场景中，文件在第一个月之后完全不再被访问。
选项 D：One Zone-IA 比 Standard-IA 更便宜，但仍远高于 Deep Archive，而且它仅在单个可用区存储一份副本——对于无限期备份而言，这是一个糟糕的权衡。

options.text: Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically migrate objects.
Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 month.
Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 1 month.
Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition objects from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 1 month.

question_text:
A company observes an increase in Amazon EC2 costs in its most recent bill. The billing team notices unwanted vertical scaling of instance types for a couple of EC2 instances. A solutions architect needs to create a graph comparing the last 2 months of EC2 costs and perform an in-depth analysis to identify the root cause of the vertical scaling.
How should the solutions architect generate the information with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
需要一个两个月的图表和根本原因分析，且投入最少。成本探索器（Cost Explorer）原生提供了这两项功能：按时间段提供现成的图表，支持按服务、实例类型、标签、账户和区域进行过滤和分组，以及每日和每小时的粒度。无需导出或构建任何内容。服务边界：成本探索器用于交互式成本分析，预算（Budgets）用于设置阈值和告警，成本使用报告（CUR）提供原始数据以供自定义分析。
选项 A：AWS Budgets 跟踪阈值，并在超过时发出通知。它不是用于分析成本增加原因的工具。
选项 C：账单仪表板（Billing dashboard）显示汇总总值，但不支持按实例类型进行灵活过滤，也无法在所需细节层级上进行周期对周期的比较。
选项 D：CUR、S3 和 QuickSight 的组合提供了最大灵活性，但需要设置导出、目录和仪表板。对于一次性分析而言，这都是不必要的工作。

options.text: Use AWS Budgets to create a budget report and compare EC2 costs based on instance types.
Use Cost Explorer's granular filtering feature to perform an in-depth analysis of EC2 costs based on instance types.
Use graphs from the AWS Billing and Cost Management dashboard to compare EC2 costs based on instance types for the last 2 months.
Use AWS Cost and Usage Reports to create a report and send it to an Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon QuickSight with Amazon S3 as a source to generate an interactive graph based on instance types.

question_text:
A company is designing an application. The application uses an AWS Lambda function to receive information through Amazon API Gateway and to store the information in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database.
During the proof-of-concept stage, the company has to increase the Lambda quotas significantly to handle the high volumes of data that the company needs to load into the database. A solutions architect must recommend a new design to improve scalability and minimize the configuration effort.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
问题在于，在流量激增期间，同时执行的函数调用数量达到了配额限制，而数据库无法跟上写入操作。正确的解决方案是使用队列将数据摄入与写入解耦：一个函数接收数据并将消息放入 SQS，另一个函数从队列中读取消息并以可控的速率写入数据库。队列可以吸收流量峰值，不会丢失任何数据，且几乎不需要配置。
选项 A：将数据重写到 EC2 实例上的 Tomcat 既需要大量工作，又意味着退回到服务器管理。
选项 B：将数据库切换到 DynamoDB 并搭配 DAX 集群意味着需要重新设计数据模型和所有查询，且关于 "现有的 DynamoDB API 调用" 的说法与需求相矛盾，因为这里的数据库是 Aurora。
选项 C：SNS 立即向订阅者发送消息，并不缓冲消息：在流量激增期间，第二个函数会遇到完全相同的过载情况，且失败的发送将导致消息丢失。

options.text: Refactor the Lambda function code to Apache Tomcat code that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Connect the database by using native Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) drivers.
Change the platform from Aurora to Amazon DynamoDProvision a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster. Use the DAX client SDK to point the existing DynamoDB API calls at the DAX cluster.

Set up two Lambda functions. Configure one function to receive the information. Configure the other function to load the information into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).

Set up two Lambda functions. Configure one function to receive the information. Configure the other function to load the information into the database. Integrate the Lambda functions by using an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

question_text:
A company needs to review its AWS Cloud deployment to ensure that its Amazon S3 buckets do not have unauthorized configuration changes.
What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this goal?
explanation_en:
该任务是检测存储桶上的未经授权的配置变更。这正是 AWS Config 的职责：它在每次资源变更时捕获资源配置，保留历史记录，并将其与管理规则进行比对（例如 s3-bucket-public-read-prohibited、s3-bucket-versioning-enabled、s3-bucket-ssl-requests-only 等）。在不符合规则时，它可以发出通知或自动修复。需区分：Config 负责状态和合规性检查，CloudTrail 记录是谁调用了哪个 API，GuardDuty 负责威胁检测。
选项 B：Trusted Advisor 提供一系列有限检查的定期建议。它不提供持续的配置监控或变更历史记录。
选项 C：Amazon Inspector 对工作负载进行漏洞扫描；它不检查存储桶配置。
选项 D：对象访问日志显示数据访问情况，而不是存储桶设置的变更。

options.text: Turn on AWS Config with the appropriate rules.
Turn on AWS Trusted Advisor with the appropriate checks.
Turn on Amazon Inspector with the appropriate assessment template.
Turn on Amazon S3 server access logging. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon Cloud Watch Events).

question_text:
A company is launching a new application and will display application metrics on an Amazon CloudWatch dashboard. The company's product manager needs to access this dashboard periodically. The product manager does not have an AWS account. A solutions architect must provide access to the product manager by following the principle of least privilege.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该人员没有 AWS 账户，仅为了查看一个仪表板而创建账户是不必要的：CloudWatch 可以将仪表板共享给外部用户。在控制台中选择 "共享仪表板"，输入电子邮件地址，服务会创建仅限查看该仪表板的独立凭据，并发送一个链接。访问权限仅限于单个资源且为只读——这是最纯粹的最小权限原则。
选项 B：一个拥有 CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess 策略的 IAM 用户会暴露账户中所有指标、日志和仪表板，而不仅仅是所需的内容。它还会为外部人员创建长期有效的凭据。
选项 C：ViewOnlyAccess 策略授予账户中所有服务资源的读取访问权限——范围更广，远非最小权限原则。
选项 D：一个具有浏览器中缓存凭据的跳板主机既不安全又费时：需要搭建服务器、关闭服务器，并通过 RDP 授予访问权限。

options.text: Share the dashboard from the CloudWatch console. Enter the product manager's email address, and complete the sharing steps. Provide a shareable link for the dashboard to the product manager.

Create an IAM user specifically for the product manager. Attach the CloudWatchReadOnlyAccess AWS managed policy to the user. Share the new login credentials with the product manager. Share the browser URL of the correct dashboard with the product manager.

Create an IAM user for the company's employees. Attach the ViewOnlyAccess AWS managed policy to the IAM user. Share the new login credentials with the product manager. Ask the product manager to navigate to the CloudWatch console and locate the dashboard by name in the Dashboards section.

Deploy a bastion server in a public subnet. When the product manager requires access to the dashboard, start the server and share the RDP credentials. On the bastion server, ensure that the browser is configured to open the dashboard URL with cached AWS credentials that have appropriate permissions to view the dashboard.

question_text:
A company is migrating applications to AWS. The applications are deployed in different accounts. The company manages the accounts centrally by using AWS Organizations. The company's security team needs a single sign-on (SSO) solution across all the company's accounts. The company must continue managing the users and groups in its on-premises self-managed Microsoft Active Directory.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
用户和组保留在本地的 Active Directory 中，且需要在组织内的每个账户中进行登录。标准配置：启用 IAM Identity Center（原名 AWS SSO），部署 AWS Managed Microsoft AD，并与本地森林建立信任关系。此处测试的要求是：这种集成需要双向森林信任——Identity Center 必须能够发现用户并对其进行身份验证，而单向信任无法实现这一点。无需信任的替代方案可以是 AD Connector 或外部 SAML 提供商，但这些选项中均未出现。
选项 A：单向信任不足以将 Identity Center 与自管理的 Active Directory 集成：文档明确要求必须使用双向森林信任。
选项 C：目录服务本身仅提供目录功能，但无法实现对组织账户的单点登录——账户访问权限的分配是 Identity Center 的职责。
选项 D：部署一个本地身份提供者是可行的，但要求是继续在现有的 Active Directory 中管理用户，而不是构建一个新的登录系统。

options.text: Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console. Create a one-way forest trust or a one- way domain trust to connect the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.

Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console. Create a two-way forest trust to connect the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory with AWS SSO by using AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory.
Use AWS Directory Service. Create a two-way trust relationship with the company's self-managed Microsoft Active Directory.
Deploy an identity provider (IdP) on premises. Enable AWS Single Sign-On (AWS SSO) from the AWS SSO console.

question_text:
A company provides a Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) service that uses UDP connections. The service consists of Amazon EC2 instances that run in an Auto Scaling group. The company has deployments across multiple AWS Regions.
The company needs to route users to the Region with the lowest latency. The company also needs automated failover between Regions.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
UDP 交通规则排除了 CloudFront 和 Application Load Balancer —— 两者均基于 HTTP 工作。这仅剩下每个区域一个 Network Load Balancer，由 AWS Global Accelerator 面向：它提供静态的任播 IP 地址，将用户路由到 AWS 主干网络中延迟最低的区域，并在区域端点组故障时自动切换流量。故障切换在几秒内完成，且不依赖客户端 DNS 缓存 —— 这与基于 Route 53 的路由相比是一个重要优势。
选项 B：An Application Load Balancer 只处理 HTTP 和 HTTPS，但该服务基于 UDP 运行。
选项 C：CloudFront 不支持 UDP 且无法使用 Route 53 记录作为该类流量的源。基于 DNS 的故障切换也依赖于 TTL 和解析器缓存。
选项 D：负载均衡器的选择都是错误的，加权路由不会选择延迟最低的区域 —— 而且 CloudFront 再次不适用于 UDP。

options.text: Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the NLB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.
Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Use the ALB as an AWS Global Accelerator endpoint in each Region.

Deploy a Network Load Balancer (NLB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 latency record that points to aliases for each NLB. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the latency record as an origin.

Deploy an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and an associated target group. Associate the target group with the Auto Scaling group. Create an Amazon Route 53 weighted record that points to aliases for each ALB. Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution that uses the weighted record as an origin.

question_text:
A development team runs monthly resource-intensive tests on its general purpose Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with Performance Insights enabled. The testing lasts for 48 hours once a month and is the only process that uses the database. The team wants to reduce the cost of running the tests without reducing the compute and memory attributes of the DB instance.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
数据库每月需要运行48小时，且实例类型无法更改。关键细节是：停止的RDS实例会在七天后自动重启，因此单纯"停止实例"一个月是无效的。更经济的做法是取一个快照，删除实例，然后从快照恢复，以备下一轮测试——你仅需为快照存储付费。
选项 A：仅停止实例最多有效七天：七天后AWS会自动重启实例，计费随即恢复。
选项 B：RDS没有计算资源的自动扩展，存储资源仅能向上扩展。
选项 D：缩小实例类型被明确禁止：计算属性不得更改。

options.text: Stop the DB instance when tests are completed. Restart the DB instance when required.
Use an Auto Scaling policy with the DB instance to automatically scale when tests are completed.
Create a snapshot when tests are completed. Terminate the DB instance and restore the snapshot when required.
Modify the DB instance to a low-capacity instance when tests are completed. Modify the DB instance again when required.

question_text:
A company that hosts its web application on AWS wants to ensure all Amazon EC2 instances. Amazon RDS DB instances. and Amazon Redshift clusters are configured with tags. The company wants to minimize the effort of configuring and operating this check.
What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?
explanation_en:
检查所有资源是否携带所需标签应由托管服务负责，而不是自定义代码。AWS Config 的 required-tags 规则指定了哪些标签键是必需的以及适用于哪些资源类型，在每次变更时都会评估这些标签，并保持合规性历史记录。如果需要，该规则可以通过 SSM Automation 触发自动修复。设置只需几分钟，设置完成后即可自动运行。
选项 B：成本探索器可以显示支出，并支持按标签分组，但它不是针对未标记资源的库存工具，且在之后手动为资源添加标签无法扩展。
选项 C：在始终运行的实例上部署自定义代码意味着既需要开发工作，又需要额外的一台机器进行运维。
选项 D：计划任务函数会移除实例，但代码仍需你自行维护：分页、新资源类型、错误处理。一个现成的 Config 规则无需任何开发即可完成这些操作。

options.text: Use AWS Config rules to define and detect resources that are not properly tagged.
Use Cost Explorer to display resources that are not properly tagged. Tag those resources manually.
Write API calls to check all resources for proper tag allocation. Periodically run the code on an EC2 instance.
Write API calls to check all resources for proper tag allocation. Schedule an AWS Lambda function through Amazon CloudWatch to periodically run the code.

question_text:
A development team needs to host a website that will be accessed by other teams. The website contents consist of HTML, CSS, client-side JavaScript, and images.
Which method is the MOST cost-effective for hosting the website?
explanation_en:
内容完全是静态的：HTML、CSS、客户端JavaScript和图片。这样的网站可以直接托管在启用静态网站托管的S3存储桶中——您仅需支付存储和请求费用，根本没有服务器，服务本身会处理扩展问题。
选项 A：Fargate上的容器会持续计费任务运行时间，即使它们没有任何工作可做。
选项 C：EC2实例上的Web服务器意味着持续的每小时费用加上补丁和监控开销。
选项 D：带有Lambda函数来提供静态内容的负载均衡器，意味着负载均衡器的每小时费用以及每次调用的费用，而仅使用存储桶就足以满足需求。

options.text: Containerize the website and host it in AWS Fargate.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket and host the website there.
Deploy a web server on an Amazon EC2 instance to host the website.
Configure an Application Load Balancer with an AWS Lambda target that uses the Express.js framework.

question_text:
A company runs an online marketplace web application on AWS. The application serves hundreds of thousands of users during peak hours. The company needs a scalable, near-real-time solution to share the details of millions of financial transactions with several other internal applications. Transactions also need to be processed to remove sensitive data before being stored in a document database for low-latency retrieval.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
需要可扩展的、接近实时的摄入能力，同时需要移除敏感数据并将其分发到多个内部应用程序。Kinesis Data Streams 消费交易数据并保留这些数据，一个 Lambda 函数会移除敏感字段并将结果写入 DynamoDB 以实现快速访问，其他应用程序可以独立地从同一流中读取数据，每个应用程序都在自己的位置读取。
选项 A：DynamoDB 在写入时没有数据转换规则，且表流并非为数十个独立的历史数据消费者而设计。
选项 B：Firehose 在数据传输时具有数十秒的缓冲，且不允许多个应用程序从各自的位置并发读取流数据。
选项 D：将文件批量写入 S3 并非接近实时的，而重新写入文件会引入数据不一致的风险。

options.text: Store the transactions data into Amazon DynamoDB. Set up a rule in DynamoDB to remove sensitive data from every transaction upon write. Use DynamoDB Streams to share the transactions data with other applications.

Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to store data in Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon S3. Use AWS Lambda integration with Kinesis Data Firehose to remove sensitive data. Other applications can consume the data stored in Amazon S3.

Stream the transactions data into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use AWS Lambda integration to remove sensitive data from every transaction and then store the transactions data in Amazon DynamoDB. Other applications can consume the transactions data off the Kinesis data stream.

Store the batched transactions data in Amazon S3 as files. Use AWS Lambda to process every file and remove sensitive data before updating the files in Amazon S3. The Lambda function then stores the data in Amazon DynamoDB. Other applications can consume transaction files stored in Amazon S3.

question_text:
A company hosts its multi-tier applications on AWS. For compliance, governance, auditing, and security, the company must track configuration changes on its AWS resources and record a history of API calls made to these resources.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
两个不同的问题需要两个不同的服务。AWS Config 跟踪资源上的配置变更：它会记录状态的历史，并让你查看发生了什么变更以及何时发生。AWS CloudTrail 会记录 API 调用的历史：谁执行了哪个操作，以及从哪里发起的。
选项 A：两个服务被互换：CloudTrail 不会记录配置历史，Config 也不会记录 API 调用。
选项 C：Config 是正确的选择，但 CloudWatch 收集指标和日志，而不是 API 调用的历史记录。
选项 D：这里两个部分都是错误的。

options.text: Use AWS CloudTrail to track configuration changes and AWS Config to record API calls.
Use AWS Config to track configuration changes and AWS CloudTrail to record API calls.
Use AWS Config to track configuration changes and Amazon CloudWatch to record API calls.
Use AWS CloudTrail to track configuration changes and Amazon CloudWatch to record API calls.

question_text:
A company is preparing to launch a public-facing web application in the AWS Cloud. The architecture consists of Amazon EC2 instances within a VPC behind an Elastic Load Balancer (ELB). A third-party service is used for the DNS. The company's solutions architect must recommend a solution to detect and protect against large-scale DDoS attacks.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
AWS 提供了两种层级的防护，以应对大规模的 DDoS 攻击。Shield Standard 对所有人免费开放，可抵御常见的网络层和传输层攻击。Shield Advanced 是一项付费订阅服务，可提供对复杂攻击的防护，每天24小时、每周7天的DDoS响应团队支持，攻击期间的扩容成本保护，以及详细的攻击诊断；需要明确将需要防护的资源（此处为负载均衡器）添加到订阅中。由于DNS由第三方提供商负责，Route 53 不属于该架构，需要防护的是负载均衡器。
选项 A：GuardDuty 从日志中检测可疑活动，但不会吸收或缓解 DDoS 流量。
选项 B：Inspector 对实例进行漏洞扫描。它与防范可用性攻击无关。
选项 C：Route 53 在此场景中未使用——DNS 由第三方服务提供，因此需要防护的是 ELB。此外，Shield Standard 已默认启用，无需为其分配任何资源。

options.text: Enable Amazon GuardDuty on the account.
Enable Amazon Inspector on the EC2 instances.
Enable AWS Shield and assign Amazon Route 53 to it.
Enable AWS Shield Advanced and assign the ELB to it.

question_text:
A company is building an application in the AWS Cloud. The application will store data in Amazon S3 buckets in two AWS Regions. The company must use an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt all data that is stored in the S3 buckets. The data in both S3 buckets must be encrypted and decrypted with the same KMS key. The data and the key must be stored in each of the two Regions.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
要求排除所有其他选项的是："两个 S3 存储桶必须使用相同的 KMS 密钥进行加密和解密"，且该密钥必须物理存在于两个区域。一个普通的 KMS 密钥仅限于其所在区域，当对象被复制到另一个区域时，会使用不同的密钥重新加密。唯一能够提供多个区域间相同密钥（相同的密钥 ID 和密钥材料）的机制是多区域 KMS 密钥。在给定的选项中，只有 B 使用了一个。理想的解决方案是结合多区域密钥与 SSE-KMS，但该选项未提供，因此我们选择满足核心要求的选项。
选项 A：SSE-S3 使用 S3 自身管理的密钥进行加密。完全未满足使用客户管理的 KMS 密钥的要求。
选项 C：创建了一个 KMS 密钥，但存储桶配置为 SSE-S3，因此创建的密钥从未被实际使用。该选项自相矛盾。
选项 D：SSE-KMS 配置正确，但存在两个独立的密钥——每个区域一个。在跨区域复制过程中，对象使用源密钥解密，再使用目标区域的密钥重新加密，而要求规定必须在整个流程中使用相同的密钥。

options.text: Create an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure the S3 buckets to use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Configure replication between the S3 buckets.

Create a customer managed multi-Region KMS key. Create an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure replication between the S3 buckets. Configure the application to use the KMS key with client-side encryption.

Create a customer managed KMS key and an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure the S3 buckets to use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Configure replication between the S3 buckets.
Create a customer managed KMS key and an S3 bucket in each Region. Configure the S3 buckets to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Configure replication between the S3 buckets.

question_text:
A company recently launched a variety of new workloads on Amazon EC2 instances in its AWS account. The company needs to create a strategy to access and administer the instances remotely and securely. The company needs to implement a repeatable process that works with native AWS services and follows the AWS Well- Architected Framework.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
该公司需要一种可重复、安全的方式来使用原生 AWS 服务管理实例。AWS Systems Manager Session Manager 正是为此设计的：实例上的代理会向外连接到该服务，因此无需开放端口、堡垒主机或 SSH 密钥；访问权限通过 IAM 策略授予，整个会话都会被记录，并可流式传输到 CloudWatch Logs 或 S3。实例只需要一个附加了 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 策略的角色——这就是答案中所指的"适当的 IAM 角色"。
选项 A：EC2 串行控制台是一种用于排查启动问题的应急工具，而不是日常管理实例群集的方式。
选项 C：使用共享 SSH 密钥的堡垒主机意味着对互联网开放端口、密钥管理的额外开销，以及需要额外运行的服务器。Well-Architected Framework 明确建议放弃这种模式。
选项 D：为每个管理员建立一个 VPN 连接加上直接的 SSH 连接，意味着需要构建基础设施并分发密钥，而不是通过 IAM 策略来管理访问权限。

options.text: Use the EC2 serial console to directly access the terminal interface of each instance for administration.
Attach the appropriate IAM role to each existing instance and new instance. Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to establish a remote SSH session.
Create an administrative SSH key pair. Load the public key into each EC2 instance. Deploy a bastion host in a public subnet to provide a tunnel for administration of each instance.
Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection. Instruct administrators to use their local on-premises machines to connect directly to the instances by using SSH keys across the VPN tunnel.

question_text:
A company is hosting a static website on Amazon S3 and is using Amazon Route 53 for DNS. The website is experiencing increased demand from around the world. The company must decrease latency for users who access the website.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
该网站是静态的，并且托管在 S3 中，因此只需在桶前面配置 CloudFront：内容在世界各地的边缘位置被缓存，延迟降低，且从 CloudFront 转发数据的费用低于直接从 S3 提供服务。一个 Route 53 的别名记录将域名指向分发配置。这是全球分发静态内容的标准且最便宜的模式。
选项 A：每个区域都复制桶意味着需要多次支付存储费用，加上持续的同步开销，且地理路由无法保证接近性。
选项 B：全球加速器不支持 S3 作为端点，且是为加速 TCP 和 UDP 应用程序而设计的，而不是用于提供静态内容。
选项 D：传输加速功能通过边缘位置加快对象上传到桶的速度——它并不向最终用户服务网站，且会增加额外费用。

options.text: Replicate the S3 bucket that contains the website to all AWS Regions. Add Route 53 geolocation routing entries.
Provision accelerators in AWS Global Accelerator. Associate the supplied IP addresses with the S3 bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the IP addresses of the accelerators.
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the S3 bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the CloudFront distribution.
Enable S3 Transfer Acceleration on the bucket. Edit the Route 53 entries to point to the new endpoint.

question_text:
A company maintains a searchable repository of items on its website. The data is stored in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database table that contains more than 10 million rows. The database has 2 TB of General Purpose SSD storage. There are millions of updates against this data every day through the company's website.
The company has noticed that some insert operations are taking 10 seconds or longer. The company has determined that the database storage performance is the problem.
Which solution addresses this performance issue?
explanation_en:
瓶颈被明确指出：在高写入负载下存储性能不足。在此数据量级，通用型 SSD 卷会达到其 I/O 限制，而预留 IOPS 的 SSD 存储允许您指定独立于卷大小的保证 IOPS 数，并提供一致的低延迟。
选项 B：更多内存有助于读取缓存，但插入操作的瓶颈在磁盘，而非内存。
选项 C：burstable 实例类提供的持续性能更差——一旦突发信用额度耗尽，情况只会变得更糟。
选项 D：读取副本会分担读取查询，但问题出在主实例上的插入操作。

options.text: Change the storage type to Provisioned IOPS SSD.
Change the DB instance to a memory optimized instance class.
Change the DB instance to a burstable performance instance class.
Enable Multi-AZ RDS read replicas with MySQL native asynchronous replication.

question_text:
A company has thousands of edge devices that collectively generate 1 TB of status alerts each day. Each alert is approximately 2 KB in size. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to ingest and store the alerts for future analysis.
The company wants a highly available solution. However, the company needs to minimize costs and does not want to manage additional infrastructure. Additionally, the company wants to keep 14 days of data available for immediate analysis and archive any data older than 14 days.
What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
每天一太字节的小型警报，无需自行管理基础设施，且成本极低。Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose 接收数据流，自动扩展，并将数据交付到 S3，无需运行任何服务器，同时一个 S3 生命周期规则在 14 天后将对象转储到 Glacier。过去两周的数据仍可直接在 S3 中进行即时分析。
选项 B：一组实例后置负载均衡器并运行自定义脚本，正是需求所明确排除的额外基础设施。
选项 C：OpenSearch 集群需要持续进行管理和付费，且每天手动创建快照属于手动操作。
选项 D：一个 SQS 队列不是用于分析的存储层，消费者检查消息年龄并据此采取行动既不便捷也不可靠。

options.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.

Launch Amazon EC2 instances across two Availability Zones and place them behind an Elastic Load Balancer to ingest the alerts. Create a script on the EC2 instances that will store the alerts in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set up an S3 Lifecycle configuration to transition data to Amazon S3 Glacier after 14 days.

Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to ingest the alerts. Configure the Kinesis Data Firehose stream to deliver the alerts to an Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster. Set up the Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) cluster to take manual snapshots every day and delete data from the cluster that is older than 14 days.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to ingest the alerts, and set the message retention period to 14 days. Configure consumers to poll the SQS queue, check the age of the message, and analyze the message data as needed. If the message is 14 days old, the consumer should copy the message to an Amazon S3 bucket and delete the message from the SQS queue.

question_text:
A company's application integrates with multiple software-as-a-service (SaaS) sources for data collection. The company runs Amazon EC2 instances to receive the data and to upload the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for analysis. The same EC2 instance that receives and uploads the data also sends a notification to the user when an upload is complete. The company has noticed slow application performance and wants to improve the performance as much as possible.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
这些实例同时执行三项任务：从外部 SaaS 数据源拉取数据、将其上传到 S3，以及发送通知。Amazon AppFlow 是一个用于 SaaS 数据源的托管集成服务：它拉取数据并将其传递到存储桶，过程中不涉及任何单个服务器。完成通知来自 S3 发送的原生事件，该事件被发送到 SNS 主题。这些实例完全消失。
选项 A：自动扩展组可以加快处理速度，但实例及其维护仍然存在——操作负担并未减少。
选项 C：EventBridge 通常无法作为规则目标直接将数据写入 S3 存储桶，且不处理从任意 SaaS 数据源摄入数据。
选项 D：容器仍然是你需要自行管理的计算环境，而 Container Insights 会收集指标——它不会在 S3 上传完成时发出通知。

options.text: Create an Auto Scaling group so that EC2 instances can scale out. Configure an S3 event notification to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.

Create an Amazon AppFlow flow to transfer data between each SaaS source and the S3 bucket. Configure an S3 event notification to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.

Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule for each SaaS source to send output data. Configure the S3 bucket as the rule's target. Create a second EventBridge (Cloud Watch Events) rule to send events when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as the second rule's target.

Create a Docker container to use instead of an EC2 instance. Host the containerized application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon CloudWatch Container Insights to send events to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic when the upload to the S3 bucket is complete.

question_text:
A company runs a highly available image-processing application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single VPC. The EC2 instances run inside several subnets across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances do not communicate with each other. However, the EC2 instances download images from Amazon S3 and upload images to Amazon S3 through a single NAT gateway. The company is concerned about data transfer charges.
What is the MOST cost-effective way for the company to avoid Regional data transfer charges?
explanation_en:
只要流量通过 NAT 网关流向 S3，公司就会产生两笔费用：网关处理的每吉字节流量费用，以及网关运行的每小时费用。一个用于 S3 的 VPC 端点可以消除这两项费用：它在路由表中直接添加一条指向 S3 前缀的路由，流量通过 AWS 内部网络传输，且端点本身以及通过它的数据均不产生费用。通过端点访问同一区域内的 S3 流量完全不计为数据传输费用。相同的技巧在 第 91、497、612 题 中也有体现。
选项 A：每个可用区都配置一个 NAT 网关可以消除跨可用区的传输，但仍然保留主要成本因素——每网关的每小时费用和每吉字节处理费用。网关数量越多，成本越高，而非越低。
选项 B：一个 NAT 实例用普通实例替代了管理型网关：你需要为实例及其流量付费，并且现在需要自行负责其容错性和吞吐量。
选项 D：专用主机是为你的实例预留的物理服务器——涉及许可证和隔离问题。它与数据传输成本无关。

options.text: Launch the NAT gateway in each Availability Zone.
Replace the NAT gateway with a NAT instance.
Deploy a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3.
Provision an EC2 Dedicated Host to run the EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company has an on-premises application that generates a large amount of time-sensitive data that is backed up to Amazon S3. The application has grown and there are user complaints about internet bandwidth limitations. A solutions architect needs to design a long-term solution that allows for both timely backups to Amazon S3 and with minimal impact on internet connectivity for internal users.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
关于内部用户互联网带宽的投诉意味着备份流量和办公流量正在争夺相同的连接。长期解决方案是使用专用的 AWS Direct Connect 连接来传输备份流量：带宽变得可预测，延迟保持稳定，互联网连接得以释放给其他人员使用。同时，也降低了 outbound 数据传输的成本。
选项 A：A VPN 仍然运行在相同的互联网连接上：带宽不会增加，加密会增加开销。一个网关端点也只能从 VPC 内部访问。
选项 C：每日运输 Snowball 设备不符合数据被描述为时间敏感性的要求——交付需要数天时间。
选项 D：这里没有 S3 的限制在起作用；瓶颈是公司自身的连接。提交支持工单不会改变这一点。

options.text: Establish AWS VPN connections and proxy all traffic through a VPC gateway endpoint.
Establish a new AWS Direct Connect connection and direct backup traffic through this new connection.
Order daily AWS Snowball devices. Load the data onto the Snowball devices and return the devices to AWS each day.
Submit a support ticket through the AWS Management Console. Request the removal of S3 service limits from the account.

question_text:
A company has an Amazon S3 bucket that contains critical data. The company must protect the data from accidental deletion.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
S3 中防止意外删除的功能由两层构成。版本控制（A）使删除操作可逆：删除对象时不会直接擦除，而是创建一个删除标记，原版本则保持不变。多因素认证删除（B）为不可逆操作（即永久删除对象版本并禁用版本控制）增加了第二重验证因素，因此即使桶的拥有者（根拥有者）也难以因误操作而执行此操作，且即使凭证被泄露也无法执行此操作。版本控制必须先启用：多因素认证删除只能在启用版本控制的桶上开启。
选项 C：桶策略控制哪些用户可以调用哪些 API 操作。它无法防止拥有合法删除权限的用户因误操作而删除对象，也无法恢复已经被删除的对象。
选项 D：默认加密保护内容不被未经授权的用户查看。它与对象被删除的可能性无关。
选项 E：生命周期规则会根据计划自动删除对象——这与本场景所需的功能完全相反。

options.text: Enable versioning on the S3 bucket.
Enable MFA Delete on the S3 bucket.
Create a bucket policy on the S3 bucket.
Enable default encryption on the S3 bucket.
Create a lifecycle policy for the objects in the S3 bucket.

question_text:
A company has a data ingestion workflow that consists of the following:
• An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for notifications about new data deliveries
• An AWS Lambda function to process the data and record metadata The company observes that the ingestion workflow fails occasionally because of network connectivity issues.
When such a failure occurs, the Lambda function does not ingest the corresponding data unless the company manually reruns the job.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to ensure that the Lambda function ingests all data in the future? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
一个 SNS 主题会立即传递消息，并在几次传递失败后丢弃该消息。为了确保不会丢失任何消息，会在 SNS 和函数之间放置一个 SQS 队列：该队列订阅主题（B），而函数则从队列中读取消息（E）。消息会一直保留在队列中，直到成功处理；如果多次处理失败，则会将其路由到死信队列。
选项 A：Lambda 函数默认已在多个可用区之间运行——无需配置，这与消息丢失无关。
选项 C：更多的 CPU 和内存会加快执行速度，但当发生网络故障时，消息仍然会丢失。
选项 D：预置并发会预先准备好执行环境，但不会提升消息传递的可靠性。

options.text: Deploy the Lambda function in multiple Availability Zones.
Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue, and subscribe it to the SNS topic.
Increase the CPU and memory that are allocated to the Lambda function.
Increase provisioned throughput for the Lambda function.
Modify the Lambda function to read from an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue.

question_text:
A company has an application that provides marketing services to stores. The services are based on previous purchases by store customers. The stores upload transaction data to the company through SFTP, and the data is processed and analyzed to generate new marketing offers. Some of the files can exceed 200 GB in size.
Recently, the company discovered that some of the stores have uploaded files that contain personally identifiable information (PII) that should not have been included. The company wants administrators to be alerted if PII is shared again. The company also wants to automate remediation.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST development effort?
explanation_en:
要求是无需编写自定义检测代码，即可在上传的文件中发现个人身份信息。Amazon Macie 是专为在 S3 对象中查找 PII 而设计的：它对数据进行分类，报告 PII 的类型和位置，并将其发布到 EventBridge，从而可以轻松触发 SNS 通知或自动化修复。无需构建自定义搜索逻辑——因此开发工作量最小。
选项 A：Inspector 会检查工作负载中的漏洞，但不会分析对象内容。生命周期规则也无法根据扫描结果删除对象。
选项 C：编写一个自定义算法来检测函数中的 PII 是这项任务中最耗时的部分——而这正是 Macie 作为托管服务已经处理的内容。
选项 D：相同的自定义检测算法，再加上尝试使用生命周期规则删除对象，而生命周期规则仅基于年龄和前缀进行操作，而非内容。

options.text: Use an Amazon S3 bucket as a secure transfer point. Use Amazon Inspector to scan the objects in the bucket. If objects contain PII, trigger an S3 Lifecycle policy to remove the objects that contain PII.

Use an Amazon S3 bucket as a secure transfer point. Use Amazon Macie to scan the objects in the bucket. If objects contain PII, use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to trigger a notification to the administrators to remove the objects that contain PII.

Implement custom scanning algorithms in an AWS Lambda function. Trigger the function when objects are loaded into the bucket. If objects contain PII, use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to trigger a notification to the administrators to remove the objects that contain PII.

Implement custom scanning algorithms in an AWS Lambda function. Trigger the function when objects are loaded into the bucket. If objects contain PII, use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to trigger a notification to the administrators and trigger an S3 Lifecycle policy to remove the meats that contain PII.

question_text:
A company needs guaranteed Amazon EC2 capacity in three specific Availability Zones in a specific AWS Region for an upcoming event that will last 1 week.
What should the company do to guarantee the EC2 capacity?
explanation_en:
Guaranteed EC2容量是按需容量预留所提供的，且预留始终针对一个特定的可用区。因此，该公司在每个所需的三个可用区中创建一个预留：无论区域整体需求如何，容量在整个事件期间都会被保留。
选项 A：预留实例是一种财务承诺，以换取折扣；除非与特定可用区关联，否则它们不会保证容量。
选项 B：无法为一个区域创建容量预留——它始终适用于一个特定的可用区。
选项 C：即使区级预留实例也是为了长期承诺（一年或三年），这与为期一周的活动相比是不合适的。

options.text: Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region needed.
Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that specifies the Region needed.
Purchase Reserved Instances that specify the Region and three Availability Zones needed.
Create an On-Demand Capacity Reservation that specifies the Region and three Availability Zones needed.

question_text:
A company's website uses an Amazon EC2 instance store for its catalog of items. The company wants to make sure that the catalog is highly available and that the catalog is stored in a durable location.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
一个实例存储是易失性存储：当实例停止时，数据会消失，因此完全没有持久性。目录需要迁移到一种在实例故障时仍能存活，并且可以从多台机器同时访问的存储中——那就是 Amazon EFS：文件系统在可用区之间进行复制，并且可以被所有Web服务器挂载。
选项 A：ElastiCache 是一种内存缓存。它不是持久性存储：在未启用持久化的情况下重启集群会丢失数据。
选项 B：更大的实例仅仅意味着更多的易失性空间——问题不在于容量，而在于数据会随着实例的消失而消失。
选项 C：Glacier Deep Archive 是一种存档，检索时间以小时为单位。一个在每次请求时都被读取的站点目录无法存放在那里。

options.text: Move the catalog to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis.
Deploy a larger EC2 instance with a larger instance store.
Move the catalog from the instance store to Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
Move the catalog to an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.

question_text:
A company stores call transcript files on a monthly basis. Users access the files randomly within 1 year of the call, but users access the files infrequently after 1 year. The company wants to optimize its solution by giving users the ability to query and retrieve files that are less than 1-year-old as quickly as possible. A delay in retrieving older files is acceptable.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
前一年文件访问不规律，之后几乎不再访问，因此存储成本和快速访问最近文件都很重要。S3 Intelligent-Tiering 根据实际访问模式自动在不同存储层级之间移动对象，且无需检索费用，一年后通过生命周期规则将其移动到 S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，此时检索延迟是可以接受的。通过 Athena 查询近期数据，通过 S3 Glacier Select 查询归档数据。
选项 A：Glacier Instant Retrieval 存储成本高于归档层级，且通过标签进行搜索不是查询内容的机制。
选项 C：S3 Standard 存储在前一年由于访问不规律，成本始终高于 Intelligent-Tiering，且存储在同一个 S3 存储桶中的元数据无法提供便捷的搜索。
选项 D：Deep Archive 恢复对象需要数小时，且为元数据单独设置一个 RDS 数据库会增加不必要的成本和操作开销。

options.text: Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval. Query the tags to retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.

Store individual files in Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files that are in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena. Query and retrieve the files that are in S3 Glacier by using S3 Glacier Select.

Store individual files with tags in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Store search metadata for each archive in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval after 1 year. Query and retrieve the files by searching for metadata from Amazon S3.

Store individual files in Amazon S3 Standard storage. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move the files to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Store search metadata in Amazon RDS. Query the files from Amazon RDS. Retrieve the files from S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

question_text:
A company has a production workload that runs on 1,000 Amazon EC2 Linux instances. The workload is powered by third-party software. The company needs to patch the third-party software on all EC2 instances as quickly as possible to remediate a critical security vulnerability.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该软件是第三方软件，因此标准的基础补丁集无法覆盖它——需要运行一个自定义命令。AWS Systems Manager Run Command 可立即在所有选定的实例上执行该命令，无需 SSH 连接，也无需第三方代理，这正是快速修复漏洞所需的功能。
选项 A：Lambda 函数本身不会在实例上执行任何操作——它仍然需要像 Run Command 这样的机制。
选项 B：补丁管理器仅与操作系统更新和受支持的软件包协同工作，无法处理任意第三方软件。
选项 C：维护窗口会将执行推迟到预定时间，但漏洞需要尽快关闭。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
Configure AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
Schedule an AWS Systems Manager maintenance window to apply the patch to all EC2 instances.
Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run a custom command that applies the patch to all EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company is developing an application that provides order shipping statistics for retrieval by a REST API. The company wants to extract the shipping statistics, organize the data into an easy-to-read HTML format, and send the report to several email addresses at the same time every morning.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
该任务分为两个步骤。一个定时的 EventBridge 规则每天触发一次 Lambda 函数，函数调用应用程序的 API 以获取数据（D）。函数随后将数据格式化为 HTML 报告，并通过 Amazon SES 发送给多个收件人（B）。
选项 A：Firehose 将流式数据交付到存储目的地，与生成每日报告无关。
选项 C：AWS Glue 是一个用于处理数据集的 ETL 服务，而不是调用应用程序 REST API 的工具。
选项 E：SNS 发送通知为纯文本，而非 HTML 格式的邮件，且 S3 事件与每日调度无关联。

options.text: Configure the application to send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose.
Use Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to format the data and to send the report by email.
Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Glue job to query the application's API for the data.
Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled event that invokes an AWS Lambda function to query the application's API for the data.
Store the application data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic as an S3 event destination to send the report by email.

question_text:
A company wants to migrate its on-premises application to AWS. The application produces output files that vary in size from tens of gigabytes to hundreds of terabytes. The application data must be stored in a standard file system structure. The company wants a solution that scales automatically. is highly available, and requires minimum operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
定义性要求是"标准文件系统结构"，加上自动扩展和高可用性，且操作极少。Amazon EFS能够自动增长和收缩，数据跨多个可用区存储，并通过NFS挂载到自动扩展组中的每个实例。从几十吉字节到几百太字节的卷容量对它来说都不是问题。
选项 A：S3是对象存储：它缺乏熟悉的目录层次结构和文件操作，因此应用程序必须重写。
选项 B：一个EBS卷连接到单个可用区，通常连接到单个实例：没有共享访问，也没有自动扩展到数百太字节的能力。
选项 D：与前一个选项相同的问题：EBS卷不会在组内的实例之间共享，也无法自动扩展。

options.text: Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Use Amazon S3 for storage.
Migrate the application to run as containers on Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS). Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage.
Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for storage.
Migrate the application to Amazon EC2 instances in a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) for storage.

question_text:
A company needs to store its accounting records in Amazon S3. The records must be immediately accessible for 1 year and then must be archived for an additional 9 years. No one at the company, including administrative users and root users, can be able to delete the records during the entire 10-year period. The records must be stored with maximum resiliency.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
按三个要求来分解。首先，前一年有即时访问权限，之后九年为归档存储：这需要一个生命周期规则，将对象从标准存储类在第一年转移到归档存储类 Glacier Deep Archive。其次，没有人可以删除这些记录，包括管理员和 root 用户：只有 S3 对象锁处于合规模式才能保证这一点，因为治理模式通常可以被持有 s3:BypassGovernanceRetention 权限的任何人绕过。第三，最大容错性：这意味着存储类会在三个可用区之间保留副本，这排除了单可用区的归档存储（One Zone-IA）。满足这三个条件指向选项 C。
选项 A：将所有内容存储在 Glacier 中整个周期违反了前一年即时访问的要求，且访问策略并非真正的保护：任何编写该策略的人都可以随时修改它。
选项 B：管理员或 root 用户可以随时更改 IAM 策略，因此"没有人可以删除"实际上无法保证。仅使用智能分层存储本身也不能禁止删除。
选项 D：治理模式可以被持有绕过权限的用户绕过，且单可用区归档存储（One Zone-IA）在单个可用区中仅存储一个副本——这两个要求都被违反。

options.text: Store the records in S3 Glacier for the entire 10-year period. Use an access control policy to deny deletion of the records for a period of 10 years.
Store the records by using S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Use an IAM policy to deny deletion of the records. After 10 years, change the IAM policy to allow deletion.
Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode for a period of 10 years.
Use an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the records from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 1 year. Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode for a period of 10 years.

question_text:
A company runs multiple Windows workloads on AWS. The company's employees use Windows file shares that are hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The file shares synchronize data between themselves and maintain duplicate copies. The company wants a highly available and durable storage solution that preserves how users currently access the files.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
关键短语是 "保持用户当前访问文件的方式"：用户通过 SMB 协议访问 Windows 文件共享，使用 NTFS 权限，通常配合 Active Directory。只有 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 保留了这种访问方式，而多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置会在第二个可用区中创建一个同步副本，并实现自动故障转移。当两个实例被退役时，它们之间的定制同步机制也随之消失。
选项 A：S3 是通过 API 访问的对象存储：用户必须改变文件处理方式，熟悉的文件共享将消失。
选项 B：S3 File Gateway 提供 SMB 接口，但其背后是对象而非 Windows 文件系统：锁语义和 NTFS 权限将丢失。实例及其维护仍然存在。
选项 D：EFS 是一个使用 NFS 协议的文件系统，Windows 客户端无法原生使用它。

options.text: Migrate all the data to Amazon S3. Set up IAM authentication for users to access files.
Set up an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Mount the S3 File Gateway on the existing EC2 instances.
Extend the file share environment to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to FSx for Windows File Server.
Extend the file share environment to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) with a Multi-AZ configuration. Migrate all the data to Amazon EFS.

question_text:
A solutions architect is developing a VPC architecture that includes multiple subnets. The architecture will host applications that use Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon RDS DB instances. The architecture consists of six subnets in two Availability Zones. Each Availability Zone includes a public subnet, a private subnet, and a dedicated subnet for databases. Only EC2 instances that run in the private subnets can have access to the RDS databases.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
最小权限原则在这里通过安全组实现：数据库的入站规则仅允许分配给私有子网中实例的安全组访问。该规则引用的是安全组而非IP地址，因此无论车队成员如何变化，该规则始终有效，只有这些实例能够连接到数据库。
选项 A：移除指向公共子网CIDR块的路由没有任何作用：VPC内部子网之间的路由始终通过本地路由实现，无法删除。
选项 B：安全组不支持拒绝规则——它们只能允许流量。这样的规则无法创建。
选项 D：对等连接是在VPC之间创建，而不是在同一个VPC内的子网之间创建：VPC内部的连通性已经存在。

options.text: Create a new route table that excludes the route to the public subnets' CIDR blocks. Associate the route table with the database subnets.
Create a security group that denies inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the public subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances.
Create a security group that allows inbound traffic from the security group that is assigned to instances in the private subnets. Attach the security group to the DB instances.
Create a new peering connection between the public subnets and the private subnets. Create a different peering connection between the private subnets and the database subnets.

question_text:
A company has registered its domain name with Amazon Route 53. The company uses Amazon API Gateway in the ca-central-1 Region as a public interface for its backend microservice APIs. Third-party services consume the APIs securely. The company wants to design its API Gateway URL with the company's domain name and corresponding certificate so that the third-party services can use HTTPS.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
对于 API 通过 HTTPS 在公司的自有域名上响应，需要三个条件：API Gateway 中的自定义域名名称、为其配置的证书以及一个 DNS 记录。关键细节是证书的区域：对于区域端点，ACM 证书必须在与 API 相同的区域（此处为 ca-central-1）中签发——仅对于边缘优化端点，才需要在 us-east-1 中签发。一旦证书被附加，Route 53 的别名记录会将域名指向区域 API Gateway 端点。
选项 A：阶段变量将值传递给集成，不会改变 API 可访问的 URL。自定义域名配置为自身的自定义域名资源。
选项 B：对于区域端点，证书必须在相同区域中签发，而不是在 us-east-1 中签发，并且如果没有配置自定义域名，那么别名记录就没有内容可指向。
选项 D：与证书区域的相同错误，加上 A 记录应指向 API Gateway 端点，而不是指向‘公司的域名名称’。

options.text: Create stage variables in API Gateway with Name="Endpoint-URL" and Value="Company Domain Name" to overwrite the default URL. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM).

Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point the alias record to the Regional API Gateway stage endpoint. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region.

Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name.
