Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the same Region. Attach the certificate to the API Gateway endpoint. Configure Route 53 to route traffic to the API Gateway endpoint.

Create a Regional API Gateway endpoint. Associate the API Gateway endpoint with the company's domain name. Import the public certificate associated with the company's domain name into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) in the us-east-1 Region. Attach the certificate to the API Gateway APIs. Create Route 53 DNS records with the company's domain name. Point an A record to the company's domain name.

question_text:
A company is running a popular social media website. The website gives users the ability to upload images to share with other users. The company wants to make sure that the images do not contain inappropriate content. The company needs a solution that minimizes development effort.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该任务是识别图像中的不当内容，且开发工作量最小。Amazon Rekognition具有内置的内容审核功能，因此无需训练，而Amazon Augmented AI则为低置信度预测提供人工审核。
选项 A：Comprehend分析文本，而非图像。
选项 C：SageMaker意味着开发和训练自定义模型——这与要求的最小开发工作量完全相反。
选项 D：在Fargate上部署的自定义模型意味着更多的开发工作，再加上需要管理底层基础设施。

options.text: Use Amazon Comprehend to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions.
Use Amazon Rekognition to detect inappropriate content. Use human review for low-confidence predictions.
Use Amazon SageMaker to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions.
Use AWS Fargate to deploy a custom machine learning model to detect inappropriate content. Use ground truth to label low-confidence predictions.

question_text:
A company wants to run its critical applications in containers to meet requirements for scalability and availability.
The company prefers to focus on maintenance of the critical applications. The company does not want to be responsible for provisioning and managing the underlying infrastructure that runs the containerized workload.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该公司希望专注于其应用程序，而不是容器之下的基础设施。使用 ECS 的 Fargate 启动类型会完全移除节点：您只需描述任务及其所需资源，AWS 就会负责计算、补丁更新和扩展。
选项 A：手动安装 Docker 的实例——维护量最大。
选项 B：ECS 集群中的 EC2 工作节点仍需进行补丁更新、扩展和健康状况监控。
选项 D：使用 ECS 优化的 AMI 可简化设置，但实例本身仍需由公司负责维护。

options.text: Use Amazon EC2 instances, and install Docker on the instances.
Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on Amazon EC2 worker nodes.
Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) on AWS Fargate.
Use Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS)-optimized Amazon Machine Image (AMI).

question_text:
A company hosts more than 300 global websites and applications. The company requires a platform to analyze more than 30 TB of clickstream data each day.
What should a solutions architect do to transmit and process the clickstream data?
explanation_en:
每天三十太字节的点击流数据需要流式摄入后进行分析。Kinesis Data Streams 消费该数据流，Kinesis Data Firehose 将其传输到 S3 上的数据湖，且无需任何管理操作，Redshift 则加载数据以供分析查询。这是一种标准模式，能够随着数据量的增长而扩展。
选项 A：AWS Data Pipeline 是一个过时的批处理调度器，必须创建并付费使用 EMR 集群——两者都更复杂且更昂贵。
选项 B：需要一个自定义的实例集群来摄入数据流，这要求手动扩展、监控和故障处理。
选项 C：CloudFront 将内容分发给用户，它不是用于摄入点击流数据的机制，且使用 Lambda 函数处理每个对象无法替代流式管道。

options.text: Design an AWS Data Pipeline to archive the data to an Amazon S3 bucket and run an Amazon EMR cluster with the data to generate analytics.
Create an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to process the data and send it to an Amazon S3 data lake for Amazon Redshift to use for analysis.
Cache the data to Amazon CloudFront. Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. When an object is added to the S3 bucket. run an AWS Lambda function to process the data for analysis.
Collect the data from Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to transmit the data to an Amazon S3 data lake. Load the data in Amazon Redshift for analysis.

question_text:
A company has a website hosted on AWS. The website is behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) that is configured to handle HTTP and HTTPS separately. The company wants to forward all requests to the website so that the requests will use HTTPS.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
应用负载均衡器可以自行执行重定向：在端口 80 的监听器上创建一个规则，该规则包含向 HTTPS 重定向的动作，通常使用 301 状态码。无需应用层更改，所有流量最终都会通过安全协议到达。
选项 A：一个网络 ACL 只会丢弃 HTTP 流量：用户会收到错误而不是重定向。
选项 B：一个规则 "将 HTTP 替换为 HTTPS 在 URL 中" 描述了相同的重定向，但未说明该规则配置的位置；实现这一功能的标准机制称为监听器规则。
选项 D：网络负载均衡器运行在第 4 层，不会执行 HTTP 重定向。

options.text: Update the ALB's network ACL to accept only HTTPS traffic.
Create a rule that replaces the HTTP in the URL with HTTPS.
Create a listener rule on the ALB to redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS.
Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer configured to use Server Name Indication (SNI).

question_text:
A company is developing a two-tier web application on AWS. The company's developers have deployed the application on an Amazon EC2 instance that connects directly to a backend Amazon RDS database. The company must not hardcode database credentials in the application. The company must also implement a solution to automatically rotate the database credentials on a regular basis.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
要求几乎就是对 Secrets Manager 的字面描述：不要在代码中硬编码密码，并且按照计划自动轮转。密钥以加密形式存储，实例通过其角色获取它（应用程序中不嵌入密钥），而 RDS 的轮转由内置的 AWS 函数处理，该函数会同时更新数据库和密钥中的密码。请注意架构细节：访问权限授予 EC2 角色，而不是授予用户，因此获取的凭据是临时的。
选项 A：实例元数据对机器上的任何进程都是可访问的，不适合用于存储密钥，且你必须自己编写 RDS 的同步密码更新逻辑以及元数据中的更新。
选项 B：一个存储在桶中的配置文件加上一个自定义轮转函数意味着需要编写代码、设定计划以及错误处理，而不是仅靠一个设置。版本控制仅允许回滚到之前的值——它并不能消除开发工作。
选项 D：Parameter Store 存储加密的参数，但它没有 "开启自动轮转" 的开关：轮转必须由你自己编写。

options.text: Store the database credentials in the instance metadata. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and instance metadata at the same time.

Store the database credentials in a configuration file in an encrypted Amazon S3 bucket. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rules to run a scheduled AWS Lambda function that updates the RDS credentials and the credentials in the configuration file at the same time. Use S3 Versioning to ensure the ability to fall back to previous values.
Store the database credentials as a secret in AWS Secrets Manager. Turn on automatic rotation for the secret. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the secret.

Store the database credentials as encrypted parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Turn on automatic rotation for the encrypted parameters. Attach the required permission to the EC2 role to grant access to the encrypted parameters.

question_text:
A company is deploying a new public web application to AWS. The application will run behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The application needs to be encrypted at the edge with an SSL/TLS certificate that is issued by an external certificate authority (CA). The certificate must be rotated each year before the certificate expires.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
证书由外部证书颁发机构签发，因此 ACM 只能导入该证书。ACM 不会自动续订导入的证书——这是证书所有者的责任。因此证书被导入并附加到负载均衡器上，当证书即将过期时，EventBridge 规则会触发通知，以便手动替换证书。
选项 A：仅支持 ACM 自身签发的证书进行自动续订，而需求中要求的是来自外部 CA 的证书。
选项 B：无法将 "密钥材料" 导入 ACM 已签发的证书中：证书要么由 ACM 签发，要么以完整形式导入。
选项 C：私有证书颁发机构签发的证书浏览器不信任：面向公众的网络应用将无法正常工作。

options.text: Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue an SSL/TLS certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.

Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to issue an SSL/TLS certificate. Import the key material from the certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALUse the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.

Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) Private Certificate Authority to issue an SSL/TLS certificate from the root CA. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use the managed renewal feature to automatically rotate the certificate.

Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to import an SSL/TLS certificate. Apply the certificate to the ALB. Use Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to send a notification when the certificate is nearing expiration. Rotate the certificate manually.

question_text:
A company runs its infrastructure on AWS and has a registered base of 700,000 users for its document management application. The company intends to create a product that converts large .pdf files to .jpg image files.
The .pdf files average 5 MB in size. The company needs to store the original files and the converted files. A solutions architect must design a scalable solution to accommodate demand that will grow rapidly over time.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
该工作负载是事件驱动且负载不均衡的：一个文件被上传，然后被转换。最经济的方案是将原始文件和转换结果都存储在 S3 中，当发生 S3 PUT 事件时，触发一个 Lambda 函数来执行转换操作。您仅为实际的毫秒级计算时间以及存储费用付费，没有空闲实例，随着用户基数增长，自动扩展得以实现。
选项 B：DynamoDB 并不适合用于存储文件：项目大小限制为 400 KB，而平均 PDF 文件大小为 5 MB。这种设计无法实现。
选项 C：配备 EBS 存储的实例集群会持续计费，无论负载如何，且随着文件数量增长，EBS 的成本远高于 S3。
选项 D：同样的问题：持续运行的实例加上文件存储成本高于 S3 和 Lambda 的组合，且表述本身存在自相矛盾——它建议将文件同时存储在 EFS 和 EBS 中。

options.text: Save the .pdf files to Amazon S3. Configure an S3 PUT event to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to .jpg format and store them back in Amazon S3.
Save the .pdf files to Amazon DynamoDUse the DynamoDB Streams feature to invoke an AWS Lambda function to convert the files to .jpg format and store them back in DynamoDB.

Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the files to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store.

Upload the .pdf files to an AWS Elastic Beanstalk application that includes Amazon EC2 instances, Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) storage, and an Auto Scaling group. Use a program in the EC2 instances to convert the file to .jpg format. Save the .pdf files and the .jpg files in the EBS store.

question_text:
A company has more than 5 TB of file data on Windows file servers that run on premises. Users and applications interact with the data each day.
The company is moving its Windows workloads to AWS. As the company continues this process, the company requires access to AWS and on-premises file storage with minimum latency. The company needs a solution that minimizes operational overhead and requires no significant changes to the existing file access patterns. The company uses an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection for connectivity to AWS.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
三个约束条件同时成立：来自云环境和本地环境的访问，且延迟最小，管理开销最小，以及"对现有的文件访问模式没有显著改变"。最后一个条件是决定性的：Windows 工作负载使用 SMB 与 NTFS 权限以及 Active Directory，因此目标存储必须是 FSx for Windows File Server，而不是像 S3 这样的对象存储。FSx File Gateway 消除了通过 VPN 带来的本地环境延迟：它被部署在本地，缓存热点文件，并通过 SMB 提供服务，而完整的文件副本则保留在云中的 FSx 中。这形成了配对方案：云环境中的 FSx for Windows File Server 用于云工作负载，本地环境中的 FSx File Gateway 用于本地工作负载。
选项 A：仅使用 FSx 而不使用网关，意味着本地用户通过 Site-to-Site VPN 访问文件。这无法满足延迟最小化的本地环境要求。
选项 B：S3 File Gateway 提供 SMB 接口，但其背后是对象存储，而非 Windows 文件系统：NTFS ACL、Active Directory 集成以及锁语义都会丢失。对于需要在不改变的情况下迁移的 Windows 工作负载而言，这需要进行重大重构。
选项 C：部分工作负载被迁移到直接访问 S3，意味着需要改写为对象 API。题目中明确禁止对文件访问方式做出显著改变。

options.text: Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Move the on-premises file data to FSx for Windows File Server. Reconfigure the workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS.

Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the S3 File Gateway. Reconfigure the on-premises workloads and the cloud workloads to use the S3 File Gateway.

Deploy and configure an Amazon S3 File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to Amazon S3. Reconfigure the workloads to use either Amazon S3 directly or the S3 File Gateway. depending on each workload's location.

Deploy and configure Amazon FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Deploy and configure an Amazon FSx File Gateway on premises. Move the on-premises file data to the FSx File Gateway. Configure the cloud workloads to use FSx for Windows File Server on AWS. Configure the on-premises workloads to use the FSx File Gateway.

question_text:
A hospital recently deployed a RESTful API with Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The hospital uses API Gateway and Lambda to upload reports that are in PDF format and JPEG format. The hospital needs to modify the Lambda code to identify protected health information (PHI) in the reports.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
报告以 PDF 和 JPEG 文件形式到达，因此文本必须首先被提取，然后扫描以查找受保护的健康信息。Amazon Textract 可识别文档和图像中的文本，而 Amazon Comprehend Medical 内置了 PHI 检测功能。无需任何训练——只需在同一个函数中调用两次即可。
选项 A：自定义库意味着需要自行开发和维护文本提取和检测逻辑 — 最大努力。
选项 B：SageMaker 需要训练一个自定义模型，而托管服务已经知道如何查找 PHI。
选项 D：Rekognition 能够识别图像中的文本，但无法解析多页 PDF 文档：这些需要 Textract。

options.text: Use existing Python libraries to extract the text from the reports and to identify the PHI from the extracted text.
Use Amazon Textract to extract the text from the reports. Use Amazon SageMaker to identify the PHI from the extracted text.
Use Amazon Textract to extract the text from the reports. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to identify the PHI from the extracted text.
Use Amazon Rekognition to extract the text from the reports. Use Amazon Comprehend Medical to identify the PHI from the extracted text.

question_text:
A company has an application that generates a large number of files, each approximately 5 MB in size. The files are stored in Amazon S3. Company policy requires the files to be stored for 4 years before they can be deleted.
Immediate accessibility is always required as the files contain critical business data that is not easy to reproduce.
The files are frequently accessed in the first 30 days of the object creation but are rarely accessed after the first 30 days.
Which storage solution is MOST cost-effective?
explanation_en:
按需求拆解。'立即可访问始终是必需的'这一规则排除了 Glacier Flexible Retrieval，因为其检索需要几分钟到几小时。'难以重现'意味着数据不能丢失，这要求一种在三个可用区之间保留副本的存储类别——排除了 One Zone-IA。'在前30天内频繁访问，之后很少访问'正是生命周期规则所设计的模式：前30天使用 Standard，之后转为 Standard-IA。公司政策要求文件在4年后删除，因此规则还需要包含过期操作。务必与问题 第 890 题 对比：该场景相同，但选项中包含 Glacier Instant Retrieval —— 此时正确答案变为该选项。
选项 A：S3 Glacier (Flexible Retrieval) 在启用加急检索时以分钟计，标准检索时以小时计。对持续且立即可访问的需求构成违反。
选项 B：One Zone-IA 在单一可用区中保留一个副本。对于关键数据且难以重现的情况，这种风险是不可接受的，且其相对于 Standard-IA 的节省仅约为 20%。
选项 D：此规则在第四年将文件移至 Glacier 而不是删除。公司政策允许在4年后删除，但在此方案中将无限期支付存储费用。

options.text: Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Glacier 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.
Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days from object creation. Delete the files 4 years after object creation.

Create an S3 bucket lifecycle policy to move files from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) 30 days from object creation. Move the files to S3 Glacier 4 years after object creation.

question_text:
A company hosts an application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes messages from an Amazon SQS queue, writes to an Amazon RDS table, and deletes the message from the queue. Occasional duplicate records are found in the RDS table. The SQS queue does not contain any duplicate messages.
What should a solutions architect do to ensure messages are being processed once only?
explanation_en:
数据库中存在重复项而队列中没有重复项意味着消息的处理时间超过可见超时时间：消息再次变得可见，并被另一个工作节点获取，而第一个节点仍在处理该消息。解决方法是通过调用 ChangeMessageVisibility，将其值设置为大于处理时间的值来增加可见超时时间。
选项 A：新队列不会改变根本原因：可见超时时间将保持不变。
选项 B：权限与重复处理无关。
选项 C：长轮询减少了空响应的数量和请求的成本，但不能防止消息被重新投递。

options.text: Use the CreateQueue API call to create a new queue.
Use the AddPermission API call to add appropriate permissions.
Use the ReceiveMessage API call to set an appropriate wait time.
Use the ChangeMessageVisibility API call to increase the visibility timeout.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing a new hybrid architecture to extend a company's on-premises infrastructure to AWS. The company requires a highly available connection with consistent low latency to an AWS Region. The company needs to minimize costs and is willing to accept slower traffic if the primary connection fails.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
需求始终要求低延迟、高可用性和成本最小化，如果主连接失败，可以接受较慢的流量。这表明直接连接（Direct Connect）是主要链路，因其具有可预测的延迟，而互联网上的VPN作为备份：它启动迅速、成本极低，并且仅在发生故障时才启用。
选项 B：VPN 通过公共互联网运行，其中延迟是不可预测的，而需求要求持续低延迟。
选项 C：第二个 Direct Connect 连接更加可靠，但它将端口成本翻倍，而需求明确允许一个较慢的备份。
选项 D：Direct Connect 没有此类故障切换属性，能够自动创建备用连接。

options.text: Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a VPN connection as a backup if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.
Provision a VPN tunnel connection to a Region for private connectivity. Provision a second VPN tunnel for private connectivity and as a backup if the primary VPN connection fails.
Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Provision a second Direct Connect connection to the same Region as a backup if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.

Provision an AWS Direct Connect connection to a Region. Use the Direct Connect failover attribute from the AWS CLI to automatically create a backup connection if the primary Direct Connect connection fails.

question_text:
A company is running a business-critical web application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The application uses an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database that is deployed in a single Availability Zone. The company wants the application to be highly available with minimum downtime and minimum loss of data.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational effort?
explanation_en:
高可用性要求最小停机时间和最小数据丢失，且操作复杂度最低。对于应用程序，这意味着将自动扩展组跨多个可用区部署；对于数据库，部署具有备用副本的 Aurora（多可用区模式），故障切换在几秒内自动完成且不会丢失数据。RDS Proxy 进一步完善了该设计：它维护连接池，并加速应用程序在故障切换后的恢复。所有这些都属于配置层面，而非从头构建的架构。
选项 A：一个多区域设置配合 Route 53 健康检查操作明显更复杂且成本更高，基于 DNS 的故障切换速度更慢，并依赖解析器缓存。对于‘最低操作复杂度’的要求，这属于过度设计。
选项 C：单个可用区配合每小时快照意味着恢复期间存在停机时间，且最多会导致一小时的数据丢失。
选项 D：将数据写入 S3，然后通过函数将其加载到数据库中，意味着需要重写应用程序，从而导致一致性明显变差。

options.text: Place the EC2 instances in different AWS Regions. Use Amazon Route 53 health checks to redirect traffic. Use Aurora PostgreSQL Cross-Region Replication.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple Availability Zones. Configure the database as Multi-AZ. Configure an Amazon RDS Proxy instance for the database.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to use one Availability Zone. Generate hourly snapshots of the database. Recover the database from the snapshots in the event of a failure.

Configure the Auto Scaling group to use multiple AWS Regions. Write the data from the application to Amazon S3. Use S3 Event Notifications to launch an AWS Lambda function to write the data to the database.

question_text:
A company's HTTP application is behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB). The NLB's target group is configured to use an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with multiple EC2 instances that run the web service.
The company notices that the NLB is not detecting HTTP errors for the application. These errors require a manual restart of the EC2 instances that run the web service. The company needs to improve the application's availability without writing custom scripts or code.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
一个网络负载均衡器工作在第4层，对HTTP响应码一无所知：只要TCP连接建立成功，其健康检查就会通过。而应用负载均衡器可以检查特定的URL和预期的响应码，使用该负载均衡器健康检查的自动伸缩组会自动替换不健康的实例——无需编写任何自定义代码。
选项 A：NLB 支持 HTTP 健康检查，但该需求还要求自动实例替换，而 NLB 本身不会触发这一功能；此外，应用层应用更自然地部署在 ALB 后面。
选项 B：一个重启应用的定时任务脚本，正是需求中明确排除的自定义脚本类型。
选项 D：不健康的主机数量告警仅在第4层健康检查判定实例死亡时触发一次——它永远不会看到HTTP错误。

options.text: Enable HTTP health checks on the NLB, supplying the URL of the company's application.
Add a cron job to the EC2 instances to check the local application's logs once each minute. If HTTP errors are detected. the application will restart.
Replace the NLB with an Application Load Balancer. Enable HTTP health checks by supplying the URL of the company's application. Configure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances.
Create an Amazon Cloud Watch alarm that monitors the UnhealthyHostCount metric for the NLB. Configure an Auto Scaling action to replace unhealthy instances when the alarm is in the ALARM state.

question_text:
A company runs a shopping application that uses Amazon DynamoDB to store customer information. In case of data corruption, a solutions architect needs to design a solution that meets a recovery point objective (RPO) of 15 minutes and a recovery time objective (RTO) of 1 hour.
What should the solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
这涉及的是数据损坏问题，而非区域故障，丢失最多十五分钟的数据是可以接受的。DynamoDB 的时间点恢复功能会持续保留最近35天的备份，并允许您将表恢复到任意秒级，精确到分钟——足以满足恢复点和恢复时间的要求。
选项 A：全局表会复制数据，包括损坏的数据：切换到另一个区域只会返回相同损坏的记录。
选项 C：每日导出的恢复点为一天，远不如所需的十五分钟，从存档中导入需要数小时。
选项 D：DynamoDB 是一个托管服务，没有 EBS 卷：不存在需要快照的表卷。

options.text: Configure DynamoDB global tables. For RPO recovery, point the application to a different AWS Region.
Configure DynamoDB point-in-time recovery. For RPO recovery, restore to the desired point in time.
Export the DynamoDB data to Amazon S3 Glacier on a daily basis. For RPO recovery, import the data from S3 Glacier to DynamoDB.
Schedule Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots for the DynamoDB table every 15 minutes. For RPO recovery, restore the DynamoDB table by using the EBS snapshot.

question_text:
A company runs a photo processing application that needs to frequently upload and download pictures from Amazon S3 buckets that are located in the same AWS Region. A solutions architect has noticed an increased cost in data transfer fees and needs to implement a solution to reduce these costs.
How can the solutions architect meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
数据传输费用产生是因为流量访问 S3 会经过互联网网关或 NAT 网关。S3 网关端点会为服务的前缀添加一条路由，因此流量会保留在 AWS 网络内部，不会产生费用，而端点策略会限制访问到所需的存储桶。由于这些存储桶位于同一区域，因此也不会产生跨区域费用。
选项 A：API Gateway 不是一个可以将访问 S3 的请求路由通过的网络设备：不存在能够指向它的路由表条目。
选项 B：NAT 网关对每处理的吉字节都会收费——这会增加成本而非降低成本，且它没有端点策略。
选项 C：公共子网和互联网网关保持了相同的互联网路径并降低了安全性。

options.text: Deploy Amazon API Gateway into a public subnet and adjust the route table to route S3 calls through it.
Deploy a NAT gateway into a public subnet and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets.
Deploy the application into a public subnet and allow it to route through an internet gateway to access the S3 buckets.
Deploy an S3 VPC gateway endpoint into the VPC and attach an endpoint policy that allows access to the S3 buckets.

question_text:
A company recently launched Linux-based application instances on Amazon EC2 in a private subnet and launched a Linux-based bastion host on an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet of a VPC. A solutions architect needs to connect from the on-premises network, through the company's internet connection, to the bastion host, and to the application servers. The solutions architect must make sure that the security groups of all the EC2 instances will allow that access.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
访问来自企业网络通过互联网，因此堡垒主机必须接受来自公司外部IP范围的连接——这就是入站规则所指定的（C）。私有子网中的应用实例应仅接受来自堡垒主机的SSH连接，而堡垒主机通过其私有地址访问这些实例，因此规则引用了堡垒主机的私有地址（D）。
选项 A：允许堡垒主机接受来自应用实例的入站连接没有意义：连接的方向是相反的。
选项 B：公司内部IP范围在通往互联网的路径上会被翻译：到达堡垒主机的是外部地址，因此该规则永远不会匹配。
选项 E：堡垒主机通过其私有地址访问VPC内的私有实例；其公网地址在该流量中不起任何作用。

options.text: Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the application instances.
Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the internal IP range for the company.
Replace the current security group of the bastion host with one that only allows inbound access from the external IP range for the company.
Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the private IP address of the bastion host.
Replace the current security group of the application instances with one that allows inbound SSH access from only the public IP address of the bastion host.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing a two-tier web application. The application consists of a public-facing web tier hosted on Amazon EC2 in public subnets. The database tier consists of Microsoft SQL Server running on Amazon EC2 in a private subnet. Security is a high priority for the company.
How should security groups be configured in this situation? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
Web 层面向公网，因此其安全组允许来自互联网的端口 443 入站流量（A）。SQL Server 数据库仅接受来自 Web 层的连接，因此其入站规则允许端口 1433，且引用 Web 层的安全组（C）。
选项 B：安全组的出站规则默认允许所有流量，限制 Web 层的出站流量与本要求无关。
选项 D：安全组是状态感知的：数据库的响应流量会自动被允许，因此不需要单独的出站规则。
选项 E：数据库不需要端口 443 的入站流量：对 SQL Server 的连接使用端口 1433，添加不必要的允许违反了最小权限原则。

options.text: Configure the security group for the web tier to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
Configure the security group for the web tier to allow outbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0.
Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound traffic on port 1433 from the security group for the web tier.
Configure the security group for the database tier to allow outbound traffic on ports 443 and 1433 to the security group for the web tier.
Configure the security group for the database tier to allow inbound traffic on ports 443 and 1433 from the security group for the web tier.

question_text:
A company wants to move a multi-tiered application from on premises to the AWS Cloud to improve the application's performance. The application consists of application tiers that communicate with each other by way of RESTful services. Transactions are dropped when one tier becomes overloaded. A solutions architect must design a solution that resolves these issues and modernizes the application.
Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?
explanation_en:
事务在任一层级过载时都会被丢弃，因此需要通过缓冲区将层级解耦，并摆脱对服务器管理的依赖。API Gateway 接收请求，Lambda 函数运行逻辑并自动扩展，而服务之间的 SQS 队列在流量激增时暂存消息，因此不会有任何数据丢失。
选项 B：为峰值负载配置实例并非现代化做法，它只是推迟了问题，最终你仍需为峰值容量支付费用，即使在空闲期间也是如此。
选项 C：SNS 立即传递消息，并不形成队列：没有缓冲机制，主题本身也没有队列长度指标。
选项 D：队列选择是正确的，但 EC2 实例仍需进行管理，且基于‘检测到通信故障’的扩展仅在数据已经丢失之后才反应。

options.text: Use Amazon API Gateway and direct transactions to the AWS Lambda functions as the application layer. Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) as the communication layer between application services.

Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to analyze the application performance history to determine the servers' peak utilization during the performance failures. Increase the size of the application server's Amazon EC2 instances to meet the peak requirements.

Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SNS queue length and scale up and down as required.

Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to handle the messaging between application servers running on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group. Use Amazon CloudWatch to monitor the SQS queue length and scale up when communication failures are detected.

question_text:
A company receives 10 TB of instrumentation data each day from several machines located at a single factory. The data consists of JSON files stored on a storage area network (SAN) in an on-premises data center located within the factory. The company wants to send this data to Amazon S3 where it can be accessed by several additional systems that provide critical near-real-time analytics. A secure transfer is important because the data is considered sensitive.
Which solution offers the MOST reliable data transfer?
explanation_en:
需要传输的是文件（存储在SAN上的JSON文件），并且必须可靠且安全。AWS DataSync 是一个专门用于文件传输的服务：它会验证数据完整性，自动重试失败的传输，加密传输中的数据，并可以按计划运行。通过 Direct Connect 进行传输比通过互联网更可靠和可预测，对于每天10 TB的传输量，稳定的带宽至关重要。
选项 A：相同的 DataSync，但通过公共互联网：带宽会与其他流量共享，延迟会波动，可靠性更低。
选项 C：DMS 迁移数据库，而不是存储在网络附加存储上的文件。它不适合用于JSON文件。
选项 D：专用连接并不能解决根本问题：DMS 仍然不是为从SAN复制文件到S3而设计的。

options.text: AWS DataSync over public internet
AWS DataSync over AWS Direct Connect
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over public internet
AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) over AWS Direct Connect

question_text:
A company needs to configure a real-time data ingestion architecture for its application. The company needs an API, a process that transforms data as the data is streamed, and a storage solution for the data.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
所需的是一个 API、实时数据转换以及存储——且操作开销最小。API Gateway 接收请求并直接写入 Kinesis 数据流，Firehose 读取该流，调用 Lambda 函数对数据进行转换，并将结果交付至 S3。这个设计中没有任何单个服务器。
选项 A：一个作为 API 的 EC2 实例是一台需要维护和扩展的机器。
选项 B：再次是一个需要自行管理的实例，且 Glue 是一个批处理 ETL 服务，不是为摄入实时流而设计的。
选项 D：AWS Glue 不是来自 API Gateway 的流式数据的接收端：不存在这样的集成。

options.text: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance to host an API that sends data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that uses the Kinesis data stream as a data source. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to send the data to Amazon S3.
Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance to host an API that sends data to AWS Glue. Stop source/destination checking on the EC2 instance. Use AWS Glue to transform the data and to send the data to Amazon S3.

Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to send data to an Amazon Kinesis data stream. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream that uses the Kinesis data stream as a data source. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use the Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to send the data to Amazon S3.
Configure an Amazon API Gateway API to send data to AWS Glue. Use AWS Lambda functions to transform the data. Use AWS Glue to send the data to Amazon S3.

question_text:
A company needs to keep user transaction data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company must retain the data for 7 years.
What is the MOST operationally efficient solution that meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
在七年内保留表的副本，最便于集中管理。AWS Backup 支持 DynamoDB，通过策略可设置调度和保留期，将副本存储在自身管理的存储中，并显示作业状态——无需脚本，也无需手动操作。
选项 A：基于时间点的恢复最多保留数据 35 天：无法满足七年的要求。
选项 C：通过控制台创建的按需备份是一种手动操作，且不会导出到存储桶作为生命周期规则可管理的文件。
选项 D：自定义计划函数是代码和维护，而非使用现成的服务。

options.text: Use DynamoDB point-in-time recovery to back up the table continuously.
Use AWS Backup to create backup schedules and retention policies for the table.
Create an on-demand backup of the table by using the DynamoDB console. Store the backup in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set an S3 Lifecycle configuration for the S3 bucket.

Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to back up the table and to store the backup in an Amazon S3 bucket. Set an S3 Lifecycle configuration for the S3 bucket.

question_text:
A company is planning to use an Amazon DynamoDB table for data storage. The company is concerned about cost optimization. The table will not be used on most mornings. In the evenings, the read and write traffic will often be unpredictable. When traffic spikes occur, they will happen very quickly.
What should a solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
表格在长时间内处于空闲状态，且晚间流量不可预测且会迅速激增。按需容量模式能够即时调整吞吐量，并根据实际请求计费，因此空闲时间不会产生费用，且流量激增不会触及预设的容量上限。
选项 B：一个二级索引解决了通过不同键访问数据的问题，与不均匀负载下的成本无关。
选项 C：预设容量自动扩展的响应时间在分钟级别：在非常剧烈的激增情况下，请求会因吞吐量超限而被限流并返回吞吐量超限错误。
选项 D：全局表旨在支持多区域操作，仅简单地将成本翻倍，且预设模式仍无法跟上流量激增。

options.text: Create a DynamoDB table in on-demand capacity mode.
Create a DynamoDB table with a global secondary index.
Create a DynamoDB table with provisioned capacity and auto scaling.
Create a DynamoDB table in provisioned capacity mode, and configure it as a global table.

question_text:
A company recently signed a contract with an AWS Managed Service Provider (MSP) Partner for help with an application migration initiative. A solutions architect needs ta share an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from an existing AWS account with the MSP Partner's AWS account. The AMI is backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) and uses an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key to encrypt EBS volume snapshots.
What is the MOST secure way for the solutions architect to share the AMI with the MSP Partner's AWS account?
explanation_en:
该镜像使用 KMS 密钥进行加密，因此共享它实际上是两个独立的操作。第一步：允许另一个账户启动该镜像——将该账户的账户 ID 添加到 AMI 的 launchPermission（这也授予了对底层 EBS 快照的访问权限）。第二步：允许该相同账户使用用于加密卷的密钥——需要修改 KMS 密钥策略。缺少第二步，合作伙伴将能看到镜像，但无法解密卷。'最安全'的要求意味着仅授予特定账户访问权限，而不是发布镜像。
选项 A：将加密的 AMI 设置为公共会将其暴露给整个世界。即使密钥本身仅授予合作伙伴，这也严重违反了最大安全性的要求。
选项 C：KMS 密钥策略无法'信任另一个密钥'：快照是使用您的密钥加密的，只有该密钥可以解密它们。合作伙伴只有在已获得您密钥的访问权限后，才能使用自己的密钥重新加密副本。
选项 D：将 AMI 导出到另一个账户的存储桶是一种迂回且耗时的路径，而且对于使用 KMS 密钥加密的镜像，导出虚拟机甚至无法实现

options.text: Make the encrypted AMI and snapshots publicly available. Modify the key policy to allow the MSP Partner's AWS account to use the key.
Modify the launchPermission property of the AMI. Share the AMI with the MSP Partner's AWS account only. Modify the key policy to allow the MSP Partner's AWS account to use the key.
Modify the launchPermission property of the AMI. Share the AMI with the MSP Partner's AWS account only. Modify the key policy to trust a new KMS key that is owned by the MSP Partner for encryption.

Export the AMI from the source account to an Amazon S3 bucket in the MSP Partner's AWS account, Encrypt the S3 bucket with a new KMS key that is owned by the MSP Partner. Copy and launch the AMI in the MSP Partner's AWS account.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing the cloud architecture for a new application being deployed on AWS. The process should run in parallel while adding and removing application nodes as needed based on the number of jobs to be processed. The processor application is stateless. The solutions architect must ensure that the application is loosely coupled and the job items are durably stored.
Which design should the solutions architect use?
explanation_en:
作业需要持久存储，处理器需要无状态，且扩展应根据工作量进行调整。SQS 队列保存作业，启动模板中使用包含处理器应用程序的 AMI，自动扩展组根据队列中的消息数量进行增长和缩减——即根据实际的工作量进行调整。
选项 A：SNS 不存储消息：如果此时没有消费者可用，作业将丢失，且基于 CPU 使用率的扩展无法反映队列的大小。
选项 B：队列选择是正确的，但基于网络使用率的扩展仅与待处理作业数量松散相关。
选项 D：SNS 再次无法为作业提供持久存储，且已发布消息的数量无法反映剩余的工作量。

options.text: Create an Amazon SNS topic to send the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch configuration that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch configuration. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on CPU usage.

Create an Amazon SQS queue to hold the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch configuration that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch configuration. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on network usage.

Create an Amazon SQS queue to hold the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch template that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch template. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on the number of items in the SQS queue.

Create an Amazon SNS topic to send the jobs that need to be processed. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that consists of the processor application. Create a launch template that uses the AMI. Create an Auto Scaling group using the launch template. Set the scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group to add and remove nodes based on the number of messages published to the SNS topic.

question_text:
A company hosts its web applications in the AWS Cloud. The company configures Elastic Load Balancers to use certificates that are imported into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). The company's security team must be notified 30 days before the expiration of each certificate.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
ACM 有一个由 AWS Config 管理的规则称为 acm-certificate-expiration-check：当证书（包括导入的证书）即将到期时，在设定的时间窗口内会被标记为不符合要求。EventBridge 捕获该不符合要求的事件，并将通知发送到安全团队的 SNS 主题。
选项 A：ACM 本身没有机制能够按计划发布任意消息到 SNS。
选项 C：Trusted Advisor 仅部分跟踪负载均衡器证书，并且需要 Business 级别支持计划或更高；由 AWS Config 管理的规则是标准且更精确的路径。
选项 D：ACM 确实会生成过期事件，但默认是在距离到期还有 45 天时，且 EventBridge 规则无法配置任意 30 天的阈值——这正是 Config 规则的作用所在。

options.text: Add a rule in ACM to publish a custom message to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic every day, beginning 30 days before any certificate will expire.

Create an AWS Config rule that checks for certificates that will expire within 30 days. Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to invoke a custom alert by way of Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) when AWS Config reports a noncompliant resource.

Use AWS Trusted Advisor to check for certificates that will expire within 30 days. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that is based on Trusted Advisor metrics for check status changes. Configure the alarm to send a custom alert by way of Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).

Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to detect any certificates that will expire within 30 days. Configure the rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to send a custom alert by way of Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).

question_text:
A company's dynamic website is hosted using on-premises servers in the United States. The company is launching its product in Europe, and it wants to optimize site loading times for new European users. The site's backend must remain in the United States. The product is being launched in a few days, and an immediate solution is needed.
What should the solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
后端必须保留在公司的自有数据中心，且需要加速的是欧洲用户的访问，时间仅几天。CloudFront 支持任意自定义源，包括位于 AWS 之外的服务器：请求到达最近的边缘节点，静态内容被缓存，动态内容则通过 AWS 的骨干网络传输至源服务器，并已建立 TLS 连接。无需迁移，配置仅需几小时。
选项 A：将网站迁移到美国的一个实例并不能加快欧洲用户的速度：距离保持不变，且迁移需要时间。
选项 B：该网站是动态的，因此无法托管在 S3 上，跨区域复制只能解决静态内容的问题。
选项 D：地理就近仅决定将用户请求发送到哪个源，但此处只有一个源——位于美国的相同服务器。延迟不会改变。

options.text: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance in us-east-1 and migrate the site to it.
Move the website to Amazon S3. Use Cross-Region Replication between Regions.
Use Amazon CloudFront with a custom origin pointing to the on-premises servers.
Use an Amazon Route 53 geoproximity routing policy pointing to on-premises servers.

question_text:
A company wants to reduce the cost of its existing three-tier web architecture. The web, application, and database servers are running on Amazon EC2 instances for the development, test, and production environments. The EC2 instances average 30% CPU utilization during peak hours and 10% CPU utilization during non-peak hours.
The production EC2 instances run 24 hours a day. The development and test EC2 instances run for at least 8 hours each day. The company plans to implement automation to stop the development and test EC2 instances when they are not in use.
Which EC2 instance purchasing solution will meet the company's requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
生产实例持续运行且可预测——它们最经济地由预留实例覆盖，节省可达72%。开发和测试实例仅运行几小时，并由自动化停止，因此按需定价适合它们：为间歇性工作负载承诺一年并不划算。
选项 A：可中断实例对生产环境存在风险：AWS 可随时收回容量，且为不规则环境预留容量并不经济。
选项 C：Spot Blocks（为固定时长预先购买的Spot容量块）已不再向新客户提供，且这种容量并不适合持续运行的生产环境。
选项 D：全价生产属于过度支付，而为开发环境使用可中断容量则存在中途丢失实例的风险。

options.text: Use Spot Instances for the production EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for the development and test EC2 instances.
Use Reserved Instances for the production EC2 instances. Use On-Demand Instances for the development and test EC2 instances.
Use Spot blocks for the production EC2 instances. Use Reserved Instances for the development and test EC2 instances.
Use On-Demand Instances for the production EC2 instances. Use Spot blocks for the development and test EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company has a production web application in which users upload documents through a web interface or a mobile app. According to a new regulatory requirement. new documents cannot be modified or deleted after they are stored.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
‘不能在存储后被修改或删除’ 描述了 WORM 存储，而在 S3 中由对象锁（Object Lock）实现。它建立在版本控制之上：对象以不可变版本的形式存储，保留期或法律持有（legal hold）会阻止该版本被删除或覆盖。因此，版本控制和对象锁必须同时启用——版本控制作为基础，对象锁作为实际的限制。模式的选择取决于合规要求的严格程度：合规模式，即不允许任何人绕过限制；治理模式，允许特权用户进行操作。
选项 B：生命周期规则会更改存储类别。它不会阻止对象被覆盖或删除。
选项 C：版本控制使删除操作可逆，但并不能阻止删除，而访问控制列表（ACL）是一种过时的权限机制，无法阻止所有者或管理员删除对象。
选项 D：将 EFS 挂载为只读是客户端设置：同一文件系统可以从另一台机器以写入方式挂载。这并非数据不可变性。

options.text: Store the uploaded documents in an Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning and S3 Object Lock enabled.
Store the uploaded documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to archive the documents periodically.
Store the uploaded documents in an Amazon S3 bucket with S3 Versioning enabled. Configure an ACL to restrict all access to read-only.
Store the uploaded documents on an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) volume. Access the data by mounting the volume in read-only mode.

question_text:
A company has several web servers that need to frequently access a common Amazon RDS MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. The company wants a secure method for the web servers to connect to the database while meeting a security requirement to rotate user credentials frequently.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
频繁轮换用户凭证的要求，结合Web服务器的安全密码获取，指向了Secrets Manager。密码使用KMS密钥加密存储，服务器通过实例角色调用GetSecretValue来获取密码，RDS MySQL的轮换由一个受管理的定时函数处理。一个有用的运维细节：在轮换过程中，Secrets Manager会保留标记为AWSCURRENT和AWSPREVIOUS的密钥版本，因此当密码变更的瞬间有请求到达时，不会导致服务中断。
选项 B：Systems Manager中的OpsCenter是一个用于排查运营事件（OpsItems）的工作空间。它不是一个密钥存储服务。
选项 C：S3对象中的密码不会自动轮换：轮换必须通过自定义代码实现，且访问需要手动限制。
选项 D：每个Web服务器的文件系统上的文件意味着每台机器都有一份密钥副本，每次轮换都需要在每台机器上手动重新分发新密码。

options.text: Store the database user credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Grant the necessary IAM permissions to allow the web servers to access AWS Secrets Manager.
Store the database user credentials in AWS Systems Manager OpsCenter. Grant the necessary IAM permissions to allow the web servers to access OpsCenter.
Store the database user credentials in a secure Amazon S3 bucket. Grant the necessary IAM permissions to allow the web servers to retrieve credentials and access the database.

Store the database user credentials in files encrypted with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) on the web server file system. The web server should be able to decrypt the files and access the database.

question_text:
A company hosts an application on AWS Lambda functions that are invoked by an Amazon API Gateway API. The Lambda functions save customer data to an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. Whenever the company upgrades the database, the Lambda functions fail to establish database connections until the upgrade is complete. The result is that customer data is not recorded for some of the event.
A solutions architect needs to design a solution that stores customer data that is created during database upgrades.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
升级期间数据库不可用，且在此期间到达的记录将丢失。缓冲区解决了这个问题：从 API Gateway 调用的函数将客户数据放入一个 SQS FIFO 队列中，另一个单独的函数轮询该队列并将数据写入数据库。在数据库升级期间，消息简单地在队列中累积，待数据库恢复后才被处理；整个过程中的顺序得以保持。
选项 A：RDS Proxy 可以平滑故障切换并管理连接池，但在版本升级期间数据库仍然不可用，因此没有地方可以写入数据。
选项 B：函数内部的重试会遇到函数执行时间限制：升级耗时超过该限制，因此数据无论如何都会丢失。
选项 C：函数的本地存储是临时的，属于特定的执行环境实例：另一个函数调用不会看到它，且一旦该实例消失，它就会消失。

options.text: Provision an Amazon RDS proxy to sit between the Lambda functions and the database. Configure the Lambda functions to connect to the RDS proxy.
Increase the run time of the Lambda functions to the maximum. Create a retry mechanism in the code that stores the customer data in the database.
Persist the customer data to Lambda local storage. Configure new Lambda functions to scan the local storage to save the customer data to the database.
Store the customer data in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Create a new Lambda function that polls the queue and stores the customer data in the database.

question_text:
A survey company has gathered data for several years from areas in the United States. The company hosts the data in an Amazon S3 bucket that is 3 TB in size and growing. The company has started to share the data with a European marketing firm that has S3 buckets. The company wants to ensure that its data transfer costs remain as low as possible.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
S3 的出站数据传输费用由存储桶所有者承担，而这正是需要改变的地方。请求方付费（Requester Pays）将请求和出站传输的费用转移给实际下载数据的方：营销公司使用自己的凭据访问存储桶，并为自己的下载付费。所有者仅需为存储费用付费。一个需要记住的限制是：启用请求方付费后，匿名访问是不可能的——每个请求都必须签名，并包含一个确认接受费用的头部。在 第 960 题 中，同样的答案适用。
选项 B：跨区域复制会使公司为每个对象的跨区域传输和第二个副本的存储费用支付，成本会上升，而不是下降。
选项 C：授予跨账户访问解决了权限问题，但出站传输的账单仍由存储桶所有者承担。
选项 D：存储类别对出站传输定价没有影响，向别人存储桶同步仍然由公司承担传输费用。

options.text: Configure the Requester Pays feature on the company's S3 bucket.
Configure S3 Cross-Region Replication from the company's S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm's S3 buckets.
Configure cross-account access for the marketing firm so that the marketing firm has access to the company's S3 bucket.
Configure the company's S3 bucket to use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Sync the S3 bucket to one of the marketing firm's S3 buckets.

question_text:
A company uses Amazon S3 to store its confidential audit documents. The S3 bucket uses bucket policies to restrict access to audit team IAM user credentials according to the principle of least privilege. Company managers are worried about accidental deletion of documents in the S3 bucket and want a more secure solution.
What should a solutions architect do to secure the audit documents?
explanation_en:
该担忧是具体的——文档的意外删除，而不是数据泄露。这需要可逆性以及第二个因素：版本控制在删除和覆盖时会保留之前的版本（删除会创建一个删除标记），而多因素认证删除（MFA Delete）要求在不可逆操作（如删除特定版本或禁用版本控制）中使用一次性验证码。加密和权限调整无法解决这个问题：任何拥有删除权限的人都可以同样轻松地删除加密对象。
选项 B：控制台登录时启用 MFA 可以保护账户本身。但它无法阻止使用该账户访问密钥发起的 DeleteObject 调用——这正是桶上的 MFA Delete 所设计的用途。
选项 C：生命周期规则适用于存储桶中的对象，而不是 "IAM 账户"，并且它们只能对对象进行转换或过期。它们无法强制执行拒绝。
选项 D：阻止审计团队访问密钥意味着他们无法再读取自己的文档。这并不能防止对象被删除。

options.text: Enable the versioning and MFA Delete features on the S3 bucket.
Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on the IAM user credentials for each audit team IAM user account.
Add an S3 Lifecycle policy to the audit team's IAM user accounts to deny the s3:DeleteObject action during audit dates.
Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to encrypt the S3 bucket and restrict audit team IAM user accounts from accessing the KMS key.

question_text:
A company is using a SQL database to store movie data that is publicly accessible. The database runs on an Amazon RDS Single-AZ DB instance. A script runs queries at random intervals each day to record the number of new movies that have been added to the database. The script must report a final total during business hours.
The company's development team notices that the database performance is inadequate for development tasks when the script is running. A solutions architect must recommend a solution to resolve this issue.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
脚本的查询正在干扰开发人员的工作。读取副本将该负载从主实例移除：脚本仅查询副本，而开发工作仍继续在主数据库上进行。它通过单个操作设置完成，无需更改任何代码。
选项 A：多可用区配置中的备用实例不可用于读取：负载仍将留在主实例上。
选项 C：手动每日导出是手动工作，且数据会过时。
选项 D：查询在随机时间运行并统计新记录：缓存会持续失效，应用程序仍需进行修改。

options.text: Modify the DB instance to be a Multi-AZ deployment.
Create a read replica of the database. Configure the script to query only the read replica.
Instruct the development team to manually export the entries in the database at the end of each day.
Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache the common queries that the script runs against the database.

question_text:
A company has applications that run on Amazon EC2 instances in a VPC. One of the applications needs to call the Amazon S3 API to store and read objects. According to the company's security regulations, no traffic from the applications is allowed to travel across the internet.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该要求是明确的：应用程序的任何流量都不得经过互联网。S3 是一个区域服务，具有公共端点，因此"将存储桶放置在私有子网中"是不可能的——被隐藏的是通往它的路径，而不是存储桶本身。网关端点会在 VPC 的路由表中添加一条指向 S3 前缀的路由，通过 AWS 网络本身：数据包永远不会离开到互联网，实例也不需要公网地址。通过在存储桶策略中使用 aws:SourceVpce 条件，可以进一步限制访问，使得存储桶仅接受通过该端点的请求。
选项 B：S3 存储桶并不位于 VPC 子网内：它是一个区域服务，拥有自己的命名空间。这种配置根本不存在。
选项 C：处于同一区域仅能避免跨区域传输。路径仍然会经过公共 S3 端点。
选项 D：NAT 网关的存在正是为了将流量发送到互联网。这直接违反了该要求。

options.text: Configure an S3 gateway endpoint.
Create an S3 bucket in a private subnet.
Create an S3 bucket in the same AWS Region as the EC2 instances.
Configure a NAT gateway in the same subnet as the EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company is storing sensitive user information in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to provide secure access to this bucket from the application tier running on Amazon EC2 instances inside a VPC.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
两层独立的保护机制。网络层：S3（A）的网关端点将VPC中的流量通过内部AWS网络路由到存储桶，而无需访问互联网。授权层：一个存储桶策略（C），仅允许来自该VPC或通过该端点的请求（使用 aws:SourceVpc 或 aws:SourceVpce 条件），并且仅允许应用程序层级的角色访问。两者共同提供了一条私有路径，并拒绝来自其他任何地方的访问。实例在整个运行过程中均使用角色而非存储的密钥。
选项 B：将包含敏感数据的存储桶设置为公开可访问，与要求完全相反。
选项 D：将IAM用户的密钥复制到实例上，会在磁盘上创建一个长期存在的密钥。正确的做法是使用实例角色和临时凭证。
选项 E：NAT实例会将流量发送到互联网，并引入一个需要维护的节点。端点以私有方式解决了相同的问题，且无需服务器。

options.text: Configure a VPC gateway endpoint for Amazon S3 within the VPC.
Create a bucket policy to make the objects in the S3 bucket public.
Create a bucket policy that limits access to only the application tier running in the VPC.
Create an IAM user with an S3 access policy and copy the IAM credentials to the EC2 instance.
Create a NAT instance and have the EC2 instances use the NAT instance to access the S3 bucket.

question_text:
A company runs an on-premises application that is powered by a MySQL database. The company is migrating the application to AWS to increase the application's elasticity and availability.
The current architecture shows heavy read activity on the database during times of normal operation. Every 4 hours, the company's development team pulls a full export of the production database to populate a database in the staging environment. During this period, users experience unacceptable application latency. The development team is unable to use the staging environment until the procedure completes.
A solutions architect must recommend replacement architecture that alleviates the application latency issue. The replacement architecture also must give the development team the ability to continue using the staging environment without delay.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
问题在于每四小时进行完整导出：它会加载生产数据库，并长时间锁定预生产环境。Aurora 可以使用存储级写时复制几乎瞬间创建数据库克隆，因此克隆在几分钟内即可出现，不会物理复制数据，也不会给源集群增加负载。开发者可以按需获得一个新鲜的副本。
选项 A：一个 mysqldump 导出正是导致负载和延迟的操作。问题依然存在。
选项 C：多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置中的备用实例无法用于读写：不能作为预生产环境使用。
选项 D：再次是完整的导出和恢复：生产环境的负载以及开发者长时间等待的问题依然存在。

options.text: Use Amazon Aurora MySQL with Multi-AZ Aurora Replicas for production. Populate the staging database by implementing a backup and restore process that uses the mysqldump utility.
Use Amazon Aurora MySQL with Multi-AZ Aurora Replicas for production. Use database cloning to create the staging database on-demand.
Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ deployment and read replicas for production. Use the standby instance for the staging database.
Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with a Multi-AZ deployment and read replicas for production. Populate the staging database by implementing a backup and restore process that uses the mysqldump utility.

question_text:
A company is designing an application where users upload small files into Amazon S3. After a user uploads a file, the file requires one-time simple processing to transform the data and save the data in JSON format for later analysis.
Each file must be processed as quickly as possible after it is uploaded. Demand will vary. On some days, users will upload a high number of files. On other days, users will upload a few files or no files.
Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
文件较小，处理过程简单且为一次性操作，需求具有突发性。S3 通知将事件放入 SQS 队列，Lambda 函数读取队列并处理文件，处理结果以 JSON 形式存储在 DynamoDB 中。整个流程都是无服务器的：它能够自动扩展，空闲时成本为零，且几乎不需要运维工作。队列还提供了失败时的重试机制。
选项 A：EMR 集群会为节点运行时间计费，并需要配置——对于逐个处理小文件而言，这种开销是不成比例的。
选项 B：读取队列的 EC2 实例需要进行扩展、打补丁和监控：相比函数，其运维开销更大。
选项 D：EventBridge 和 Kinesis 增加了一个额外层级，而 S3 通知本身已经足够，Aurora 对存储单个 JSON 文档来说是过度设计。

options.text: Configure Amazon EMR to read text files from Amazon S3. Run processing scripts to transform the data. Store the resulting JSON file in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.

Configure Amazon S3 to send an event notification to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use Amazon EC2 instances to read from the queue and process the data. Store the resulting JSON file in Amazon DynamoDB.

Configure Amazon S3 to send an event notification to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Use an AWS Lambda function to read from the queue and process the data. Store the resulting JSON file in Amazon DynamoDB.

Configure Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) to send an event to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams when a new file is uploaded. Use an AWS Lambda function to consume the event from the stream and process the data. Store the resulting JSON file in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.

question_text:
An application allows users at a company's headquarters to access product data. The product data is stored in an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. The operations team has isolated an application performance slowdown and wants to separate read traffic from write traffic. A solutions architect needs to optimize the application's performance quickly.
What should the solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
读写流量需要快速分流，且不能牺牲性能。读副本承担 SELECT 查询，而主实例继续负责写入操作。重要细节：副本必须与源实例拥有相同的计算和存储资源，否则它将开始落后，并自身成为瓶颈。
选项 A：A Multi-AZ 配置不会分流负载：对主实例的读取将继续保持相同的流量。
选项 B：Multi-AZ 备用实例根本不接受请求——无法从它进行读取。
选项 C：一个拥有源实例一半资源的副本无法跟上变更流；复制延迟将增加，数据最终会变得过时。

options.text: Change the existing database to a Multi-AZ deployment. Serve the read requests from the primary Availability Zone.
Change the existing database to a Multi-AZ deployment. Serve the read requests from the secondary Availability Zone.
Create read replicas for the database. Configure the read replicas with half of the compute and storage resources as the source database.
Create read replicas for the database. Configure the read replicas with the same compute and storage resources as the source database.

question_text:
A company has a large Microsoft SharePoint deployment running on-premises that requires Microsoft Windows shared file storage. The company wants to migrate this workload to the AWS Cloud and is considering various storage options. The storage solution must be highly available and integrated with Active Directory for access control.
Which solution will satisfy these requirements?
explanation_en:
SharePoint 需要通过 SMB 协议使用 Windows 共享资源，并且需要 Active Directory 认证 —— 这正是 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 的配置特征。文件系统会加入 AD 域，支持 Windows 访问控制列表和影子副本，并以多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置部署以实现高可用性。
选项 A：EFS 是一个针对 Linux 的 NFS 文件系统；它不支持 SMB，也无法以所需方式与 Active Directory 域集成。
选项 B：文件网关是一种用于从本地网络访问 S3 的混合网关，而不是一个完整的共享存储解决方案，用于已完全迁移到 AWS 的工作负载。
选项 C：目前没有内置方式可以将 S3 存储桶挂载为 Windows 卷，且它无法提供 SharePoint 所需的文件系统语义和锁定功能。

options.text: Configure Amazon EFS storage and set the Active Directory domain for authentication.
Create an SMB file share on an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway in two Availability Zones.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket and configure Microsoft Windows Server to mount it as a volume.
Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system on AWS and set the Active Directory domain for authentication.

question_text:
An image-processing company has a web application that users use to upload images. The application uploads the images into an Amazon S3 bucket. The company has set up S3 event notifications to publish the object creation events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue. The SQS queue serves as the event source for an AWS Lambda function that processes the images and sends the results to users through email.
Users report that they are receiving multiple email messages for every uploaded image. A solutions architect determines that SQS messages are invoking the Lambda function more than once, resulting in multiple email messages.
What should the solutions architect do to resolve this issue with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
重复的邮件意味着消息在函数完成处理之前再次变得可见于队列中。可见性超时需要设置得高于函数超时和批处理窗口超时之和——这样消息就不会被传递给函数的第二个实例。
选项 A：长轮询减少了空响应的数量及其成本，但对消息重发没有影响。
选项 B：使用FIFO队列可以解决这个问题，但切换到FIFO队列会改变队列类型，限制吞吐量，并需要变更——而这个问题可以通过一个设置来解决。
选项 D：在处理消息之前删除消息会导致在任何函数故障时发生数据丢失。

options.text: Set up long polling in the SQS queue by increasing the ReceiveMessage wait time to 30 seconds.
Change the SQS standard queue to an SQS FIFO queue. Use the message deduplication ID to discard duplicate messages.
Increase the visibility timeout in the SQS queue to a value that is greater than the total of the function timeout and the batch window timeout.
Modify the Lambda function to delete each message from the SQS queue immediately after the message is read before processing.

question_text:
A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in an on-premises data center. The company needs the ability to use Lustre clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
关键短语是 Lustre 客户端。唯一提供该协议的完全托管 AWS 服务是 Amazon FSx for Lustre：它提供极高的吞吐量和低延迟，可通过 Direct Connect 或 VPN 从本地网络访问，并完全由 AWS 管理。
选项 A：Storage Gateway 通过 NFS 和 SMB 提供共享；它不支持 Lustre 协议。
选项 B：一个自管理的 Windows 服务器既不是 Lustre 也不是托管服务：必须由用户自行维护。
选项 C：EFS 不支持 Lustre 模式：它是一个 NFS 文件系统。该配置不存在。

options.text: Create an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system, and configure it to support Lustre. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.

question_text:
A company's containerized application runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. The application needs to download security certificates before it can communicate with other business applications. The company wants a highly secure solution to encrypt and decrypt the certificates in near real time. The solution also needs to store data in highly available storage after the data is encrypted.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
要求是实现证书的近实时加密和解密，将结果存储在高可用存储中，并避免操作开销。KMS 将加密操作转化为托管服务：EC2 实例的角色被授予使用密钥的权限，应用程序对数据进行加密（实际中通过 GenerateDataKey 实现的信封加密），并将密文存入 S3，S3 会将对象存储在三个可用区中。无需自定义库，也无需运行密钥服务器。
选项 A：Secrets Manager 是为密钥设计的，而非任意证书文件，且该选项明确要求手动更新——这正是要求中所希望避免的操作开销。
选项 B：使用带有加密库的自定义函数意味着你需要自行负责算法、密钥及其存储。将函数存储在 S3 存储桶中也并非运行该函数的方式。
选项 D：通过 KMS 进行加密是正确选择，但 EBS 卷与单个可用区和单个实例绑定。高可用存储的要求由 S3 满足，而非 EBS。

options.text: Create AWS Secrets Manager secrets for encrypted certificates. Manually update the certificates as needed. Control access to the data by using fine-grained IAM access.
Create an AWS Lambda function that uses the Python cryptography library to receive and perform encryption operations. Store the function in an Amazon S3 bucket.
Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Allow the EC2 role to use the KMS key for encryption operations. Store the encrypted data on Amazon S3.

Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Allow the EC2 role to use the KMS key for encryption operations. Store the encrypted data on Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing a VPC with public and private subnets. The VPC and subnets use IPv4 CIDR blocks. There is one public subnet and one private subnet in each of three Availability Zones (AZs) for high availability. An internet gateway is used to provide internet access for the public subnets. The private subnets require access to the internet to allow Amazon EC2 instances to download software updates.
What should the solutions architect do to enable Internet access for the private subnets?
explanation_en:
私有子网需要向外互联网访问，且解决方案必须具备容错能力。NAT网关是区域级资源，因此在每个可用区的公有子网中创建一个，每个区域的私有路由表将所有非VPC绑定的流量发送到其"自身"的网关。一个区域的故障不会影响其他区域，且不产生跨区域数据传输费用。
选项 B：NAT实例需要部署在公有子网中，而不是私有子网中，且需要手动维护和扩展。
选项 C：一个VPC只能有一个互联网网关，而具有指向它的子网，根据定义是公有子网。
选项 D：仅支持IPv6的出口仅互联网网关，而该场景使用的是IPv4地址块。

options.text: Create three NAT gateways, one for each public subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT gateway in its AZ.
Create three NAT instances, one for each private subnet in each AZ. Create a private route table for each AZ that forwards non-VPC traffic to the NAT instance in its AZ.
Create a second internet gateway on one of the private subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the private internet gateway.
Create an egress-only internet gateway on one of the public subnets. Update the route table for the private subnets that forward non-VPC traffic to the egress-only Internet gateway.

question_text:
A company wants to migrate an on-premises data center to AWS. The data center hosts an SFTP server that stores its data on an NFS-based file system. The server holds 200 GB of data that needs to be transferred. The server must be hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance that uses an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to automate this task? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
该任务是自动化将本地服务器中的数据移动到 EFS。AWS DataSync 原生支持这一功能：在公司的数据中心安装一个代理（B），并获取 SFTP 服务器 NFS 文件系统的访问权限，然后在 DataSync 中配置一个指向该源的存储位置（E）。传输任务随后按计划运行，验证数据完整性，并实现增量同步。
选项 A：EFS 文件系统可以通过其挂载目标从每个可用区访问，因此无需将可用区与实例共置，且这与自动化传输无关。
选项 C：额外的 EBS 卷与要求相矛盾：数据必须最终存储在 EFS 中。
选项 D：使用操作系统命令手动复制与题目所要求的自动化完全相反。

options.text: Launch the EC2 instance into the same Availability Zone as the EFS file system.
Install an AWS DataSync agent in the on-premises data center.
Create a secondary Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume on the EC2 instance for the data.
Manually use an operating system copy command to push the data to the EC2 instance.
Use AWS DataSync to create a suitable location configuration for the on-premises SFTP server.

question_text:
A company has an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs every day at the same time. The job processes XML data that is in an Amazon S3 bucket. New data is added to the S3 bucket every day. A solutions architect notices that AWS Glue is processing all the data during each run.
What should the solutions architect do to prevent AWS Glue from reprocessing old data?
explanation_en:
AWS Glue 会保存上一次成功运行停止的位置标记——这就是一个作业书签。启用书签后，下一次运行只会处理上次运行之后出现的 S3 对象，并且不会重新处理已经处理过的对象。无需删除或重写任何内容；服务本身会跟踪状态。也值得记住的是反面情况：如果作业需要从头开始重新处理所有数据，则可以重置书签（重置作业书签）。
选项 B：处理完成后删除源数据解决了表面症状，但代价是丢失了通常用于重新处理和审计的原始数据。这不是增量处理机制，而是对源数据的破坏。
选项 C：NumberOfWorkers 设置工作节点的数量，从而控制运行速度和成本。它不会改变读取的数据量。
选项 D：FindMatches 是一个机器学习转换操作，用于查找重复记录。它与选择仅读取新文件无关。

options.text: Edit the job to use job bookmarks.
Edit the job to delete data after the data is processed.
Edit the job by setting the NumberOfWorkers field to 1.
Use a FindMatches machine learning (ML) transform.

question_text:
A solutions architect must design a highly available infrastructure for a website. The website is powered by Windows web servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The solutions architect must implement a solution that can mitigate a large-scale DDoS attack that originates from thousands of IP addresses. Downtime is not acceptable for the website.
Which actions should the solutions architect take to protect the website from such an attack? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
两种互补的措施可以应对来自数千个地址的分布式攻击。Shield Advanced (A) 提供对大规模攻击的防护、自动缓解措施、访问DDoS响应团队以及在攻击触发扩展时的成本保护。CloudFront (C) 将入口点转移到一个全球边缘位置网络中，该网络可以吸收流量型攻击并在远离您的实例的位置阻止这些攻击，所有内容——包括动态内容——都必须经过它。这两者结合是满足"不可接受停机时间"这一需求的标准组合。
选项 B：GuardDuty 检测并报告威胁，但不会自动阻止流量。
选项 D：一个自定义解决方案通过将地址添加到网络访问控制列表（ACL）中，无法实现扩展：ACL 对规则数量有硬性限制，而攻击涉及成千上万个不断变化的地址。
选项 E：基于CPU利用率的扩展仅通过增加计算容量来支付攻击成本，且Spot实例也可以随时被收回。

options.text: Use AWS Shield Advanced to stop the DDoS attack.
Configure Amazon GuardDuty to automatically block the attackers.
Configure the website to use Amazon CloudFront for both static and dynamic content.
Use an AWS Lambda function to automatically add attacker IP addresses to VPC network ACLs.
Use EC2 Spot Instances in an Auto Scaling group with a target tracking scaling policy that is set to 80% CPU utilization.

question_text:
A company is preparing to deploy a new serverless workload. A solutions architect must use the principle of least privilege to configure permissions that will be used to run an AWS Lambda function. An Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule will invoke the function.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
外部服务调用函数的权限是通过函数本身的资源策略授予的，而不是通过执行角色：执行角色描述了函数被允许执行的操作，而不是谁被允许调用它。此处的最小权限原则意味着仅允许 lambda:InvokeFunction 和 principal events.amazonaws.com —— 仅 EventBridge 服务，且仅允许调用权限。
选项 A：执行角色授予函数本身权限，并且主语为通配符，这会向任何人开放调用权限。
选项 B：这仍然是一个执行角色而非资源策略，且主语错误：应为 EventBridge 服务调用函数，而不是 Lambda 服务本身。
选项 C：资源策略是正确选择，但操作 lambda:* 授予了远超单次调用的权限——违反了最小权限原则。

options.text: Add an execution role to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and * as the principal.
Add an execution role to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: lambda.amazonaws.com as the principal.
Add a resource-based policy to the function with lambda:* as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the principal.
Add a resource-based policy to the function with lambda:InvokeFunction as the action and Service: events.amazonaws.com as the principal.

question_text:
A company is preparing to store confidential data in Amazon S3. For compliance reasons, the data must be encrypted at rest. Encryption key usage must be logged for auditing purposes. Keys must be rotated every year.
Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?
explanation_en:
三个要求逐一分析。静态加密由每个选项提供。"必须记录加密密钥的使用情况以供审计" 排除了 SSE-S3 和 SSE-C：只有 KMS 密钥的密钥访问在 CloudTrail 中可见，其中每个 Decrypt 和 GenerateDataKey 调用都会被记录，包括访问了哪个对象的用户。"密钥必须每年轮换" 结合 "最操作上高效" 排除了手动轮换：KMS 密钥在启用一个设置后，内置了每 365 天自动轮换功能。这使得 SSE-KMS 具备自动轮换。
选项 A：使用 SSE-C 时，密钥由您持有，并随每个请求发送。AWS 既不记录也不轮换该密钥，所有管理操作都落在应用程序上——这与操作效率相反。
选项 B：SSE-S3 既不提供密钥访问日志，也不提供对轮换计划的控制：服务负责管理密钥，这些操作在 CloudTrail 中不可见。
选项 C：手动轮换满足该要求，但每年都需要人工操作，并需要监督以确保不会被遗忘。自动轮换在无需干预的情况下完成相同功能。

options.text: Server-side encryption with customer-provided keys (SSE-C)
Server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed keys (SSE-S3)
Server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) with manual rotation
Server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS) with automatic rotation

question_text:
A bicycle sharing company is developing a multi-tier architecture to track the location of its bicycles during peak operating hours. The company wants to use these data points in its existing analytics platform. A solutions architect must determine the most viable multi-tier option to support this architecture. The data points must be accessible from the REST API.
Which action meets these requirements for storing and retrieving location data?
explanation_en:
位置数据点必须通过一个 REST API 进行摄入和提供服务，并且基础设施需求最小。API Gateway 提供 REST 接口本身，而 Lambda 函数负责存储和返回数据。这种组合是无服务器的，能够扩展以应对高峰运营时段，并且可以轻松与现有的分析平台集成。
选项 A：Athena 对存储在 S3 中的数据运行查询，但它不是应用程序的 REST 接口。
选项 C：QuickSight 和 Redshift 是一个仪表板和一个分析数据仓库，而不是通过 API 摄入和提供数据点的方式。
选项 D：Kinesis Data Analytics 对数据流进行处理并执行查询，但它不会通过 REST 接口向应用程序提供数据。

options.text: Use Amazon Athena with Amazon S3.
Use Amazon API Gateway with AWS Lambda.
Use Amazon QuickSight with Amazon Redshift.
Use Amazon API Gateway with Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics.

question_text:
A company has an automobile sales website that stores its listings in a database on Amazon RDS. When an automobile is sold, the listing needs to be removed from the website and the data must be sent to multiple target systems.
Which design should a solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
销售活动需要传递到多个独立系统。RDS 发布事件通知到一个 SNS 主题，多个 SQS 队列订阅了该主题——每个系统一个队列。每个系统都会获得自己的副本，可以以自己的节奏进行处理，并在临时不可用时保持存活。Lambda 函数读取队列并更新目标系统。
选项 A：Lambda 函数不会因 RDS 数据库中的行变更而被调用——不存在这样的触发器。
选项 B：同样存在不存在的触发器问题，且 FIFO 队列无法解决向多个接收方的广播发送。
选项 C：方向相反：向多个接收方广播是通过主题实现的，而队列是单消费者目的地。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function triggered when the database on Amazon RDS is updated to send the information to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue for the targets to consume.
Create an AWS Lambda function triggered when the database on Amazon RDS is updated to send the information to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue for the targets to consume.

Subscribe to an RDS event notification and send an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue fanned out to multiple Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.

Subscribe to an RDS event notification and send an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic fanned out to multiple Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues. Use AWS Lambda functions to update the targets.

question_text:
A company needs to store data in Amazon S3 and must prevent the data from being changed. The company wants new objects that are uploaded to Amazon S3 to remain unchangeable for a nonspecific amount of time until the company decides to modify the objects. Only specific users in the company's AWS account can have the ability 10 delete the objects.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
注意措辞：对象必须在一段不确定的时间内保持不变，这意味着持续时间无法预先确定，公司会手动移除保护。保留期并不能描述这种情况——它总是由一个日期或天数来定义。此场景符合法律持有（legal hold）：它会无限期生效，直到被拥有 s3:PutObjectLegalHold 权限的人移除。这也是答案后半部分的来源：这正是被允许移除持有并删除对象的少数人员所获得的权限。
选项 A：S3 Glacier 的 Vault Lock 是较旧的归档服务的机制，应用于整个存储库，一旦锁定即不可变。它不支持公司根据需要灵活解除保护。
选项 B：100年的期限是一个固定时长，而非"直到公司决定"。通过拥有 s3:BypassGovernanceRetention 权限的人可以绕过治理模式。
选项 C：CloudTrail 和从备份中恢复是事后反应。要求是对象在最初就不能被更改。

options.text: Create an S3 Glacier vault. Apply a write-once, read-many (WORM) vault lock policy to the objects.
Create an S3 bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled. Enable versioning. Set a retention period of 100 years. Use governance mode as the S3 bucket’s default retention mode for new objects.
Create an S3 bucket. Use AWS CloudTrail to track any S3 API events that modify the objects. Upon notification, restore the modified objects from any backup versions that the company has.

Create an S3 bucket with S3 Object Lock enabled. Enable versioning. Add a legal hold to the objects. Add the s3:PutObjectLegalHold permission to the IAM policies of users who need to delete the objects.

question_text:
A social media company allows users to upload images to its website. The website runs on Amazon EC2 instances.
During upload requests, the website resizes the images to a standard size and stores the resized images in Amazon S3. Users are experiencing slow upload requests to the website.
The company needs to reduce coupling within the application and improve website performance. A solutions architect must design the most operationally efficient process for image uploads.
Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
原答案：BD；来源修正答案：CD。
浏览器通过 S3 presigned URL 直接上传，可避免 EC2 Web 服务器转发大文件；S3 ObjectCreated 事件触发 Lambda 异步缩放图片，降低耦合并缩短上传请求。来源将原 BD 修正为 CD，有官方功能文档支持。
两个独立的瓶颈被分别解决。上传速度慢是因为字节需要经过Web服务器：一个预签名的URL使浏览器能够将文件直接上传到存储桶（C），从而移除了EC2作为中间环节。图像缩放通过事件解耦：S3的对象事件通知在对象已写入后触发Lambda函数（D），因此用户无需等待处理过程。
选项 A：S3 Glacier是一种归档存储类别：上传到那里并不会加快请求速度，读取需要几分钟到几小时。它与组件解耦无关。
选项 B：Web服务器仍然接收文件并将它转发到S3——字节仍然经过实例，因此上传速度慢的问题依然存在。
选项 E：EventBridge中的定时任务意味着每N分钟批量进行一次图像缩放：图像会出现延迟，且上传事件本身被忽略。在这种场景下，基于事件的模型既更简单又更快。

options.text: Configure the application to upload images to S3 Glacier.
Configure the web server to upload the original images to Amazon S3.
Configure the application to upload images directly from each user's browser to Amazon S3 through the use of a presigned URL
Configure S3 Event Notifications to invoke an AWS Lambda function when an image is uploaded. Use the function to resize the image.
Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule that invokes an AWS Lambda function on a schedule to resize uploaded images.

question_text:
A company recently migrated a message processing system to AWS. The system receives messages into an ActiveMQ queue running on an Amazon EC2 instance. Messages are processed by a consumer application running on Amazon EC2. The consumer application processes the messages and writes results to a MySQL database running on Amazon EC2. The company wants this application to be highly available with low operational complexity.
Which architecture offers the HIGHEST availability?
explanation_en:
这个问题是关于在保证最高可用性的同时保持最低的运营复杂度，因此每个层级都需要迁移到一个受管理的、跨可用区冗余的服务：使用 Amazon MQ 的主/备模式替代自托管的 ActiveMQ，使用 Amazon RDS for MySQL 的多可用区模式替代运行在实例上的数据库，并且——与选项 C 的关键区别在于——在两个可用区中为消费者配置自动扩展组，该组能够自动替换故障实例。
选项 A：所有三个层级仍运行在 EC2 上自托管：没有实例会自动恢复，且 MySQL 复制需要手动维护。
选项 B：消息队列和消费者已实现冗余，但数据库仍运行在 EC2 上且依赖手动复制——这是最薄弱的环节。
选项 C：管理服务的正确组合，但第二个消费者是静态添加的：如果该实例发生故障，没有任何东西会替代它。选项 D 中的自动扩展组会自动完成这一操作。

options.text: Add a second ActiveMQ server to another Availability Zone. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.

Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Replicate the MySQL database to another Availability Zone.

Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an additional consumer EC2 instance in another Availability Zone. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi-AZ enabled.

Use Amazon MQ with active/standby brokers configured across two Availability Zones. Add an Auto Scaling group for the consumer EC2 instances across two Availability Zones. Use Amazon RDS for MySQL with Multi- AZ enabled.

question_text:
A company hosts a containerized web application on a fleet of on-premises servers that process incoming requests. The number of requests is growing quickly. The on-premises servers cannot handle the increased number of requests. The company wants to move the application to AWS with minimum code changes and minimum development effort.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
应用程序已经容器化，代码不能更改，且操作必须最小化。ECS 在 Fargate 上运行现有镜像，无需管理单个服务器，服务自动扩展会根据负载增加任务数量，且应用负载均衡器会分发传入的请求。
选项 B：两台机器具有固定容量且没有自动增长，再加上维护实例的负担。
选项 C：为 Lambda 重写代码与最小化代码变更的要求相矛盾。
选项 D：ParallelCluster 是为高性能计算工作负载设计的，而不是用于处理网页请求。

options.text: Use AWS Fargate on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) to run the containerized web application with Service Auto Scaling. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
Use two Amazon EC2 instances to host the containerized web application. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the incoming requests.
Use AWS Lambda with a new code that uses one of the supported languages. Create multiple Lambda functions to support the load. Use Amazon API Gateway as an entry point to the Lambda functions.
Use a high performance computing (HPC) solution such as AWS ParallelCluster to establish an HPC cluster that can process the incoming requests at the appropriate scale.

question_text:
A company uses 50 TB of data for reporting. The company wants to move this data from on premises to AWS. A custom application in the company’s data center runs a weekly data transformation job. The company plans to pause the application until the data transfer is complete and needs to begin the transfer process as soon as possible.
The data center does not have any available network bandwidth for additional workloads. A solutions architect must transfer the data and must configure the transformation job to continue to run in the AWS Cloud.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
参考答案：C；争议选项：D。
选项 C 将自定义应用程序重写为 Glue 作业，而选项 D 将现有应用程序迁移到 EC2。'最低操作开销' 在这里存在双向性：Glue 不需要管理但要求完全重写，而 D 保持应用程序原样。Snowcone（8/14 TB）无法容纳 50 TB，且 DataSync 需要不可用的带宽
无可用网络带宽时，Snowball Edge 比 DataSync 合适，且 50 TB 超出单台 Snowcone 容量。C 用托管 Glue 降低后续运维，但必须重写自定义转换应用；D 可迁移既有应用到 EC2，但需运维 EC2。题干未说明是否能重写或衡量迁移成本，最少运维不能无条件判定；保留来源 C 并标注争议。
完全没有任何可用带宽用于传输，因此任何基于网络的传输都不可行，必须使用离线设备。50 TB 只能存储在 Snowball Edge 上（约 80 TB 可用容量）；Snowcone 提供 8 TB（HDD）或 14 TB（SSD）。第二个要求是，转换作业一旦进入云端就必须持续运行。关键点是选择 Glue：它是一个托管服务，底层没有基础设施，这通常是考试中对 "最低操作开销" 的解释。争议之处在于，选项 D 保持现有应用程序不变，无需为 Glue 重写，但它会交出 EC2 的管理权。实际规则：当题目说 "最低操作开销"，并把托管服务与自有服务器进行对比时，考试会选择托管服务。
选项 A：DataSync 通过网络传输数据，而场景明确指出数据中心中没有任何免费带宽。答案的前半部分本身就不可能成立。
选项 B：Snowcone 提供 8 TB（HDD）或 14 TB（SSD）——50 TB 物理上无法容纳。此外，设备上运行的应用程序并不能将转换作业移入云端，而这正是题目所要求的。
选项 D：一个强有力的替代方案：应用程序可以迁移而无需重写。但你最终会得到一个 EC2 实例，必须自行打补丁、监控和扩展——比无服务器 Glue 作业拥有更多的操作开销。

options.text: Use AWS DataSync to move the data. Create a custom transformation job by using AWS Glue.
Order an AWS Snowcone device to move the data. Deploy the transformation application to the device.
Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device. Copy the data to the device. Create a custom transformation job by using AWS Glue.
Order an AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized device that includes Amazon EC2 compute. Copy the data to the device. Create a new EC2 instance on AWS to run the transformation application.

question_text:
A company has created an image analysis application in which users can upload photos and add photo frames to their images. The users upload images and metadata to indicate which photo frames they want to add to their images. The application uses a single Amazon EC2 instance and Amazon DynamoDB to store the metadata.
The application is becoming more popular, and the number of users is increasing. The company expects the number of concurrent users to vary significantly depending on the time of day and day of week. The company must ensure that the application can scale to meet the needs of the growing user base.
Which solution meats these requirements?
explanation_en:
用户数量在一天中波动剧烈，因此需要一种能够自动扩展的架构。Lambda负责图像处理，每次上传时被触发，图像本身存储在S3中（对象存储，无限制增长且成本低廉），元数据则保存在DynamoDB中。没有需要手动扩展的单个实例。
选项 A：图像不能存储在DynamoDB中：项目大小限制为400 KB，而照片明显更大。
选项 B：Firehose将流式记录传递到存储目的地，但它不处理图像，也不适合作为图像存储。
选项 D：三个实例是固定容量，无法适应每日波动，且EBS卷既不提供共享访问，也无法应对照片数量增长带来的扩展需求。

options.text: Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store the photos and metadata in DynamoDB.
Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to process the photos and to store the photos and metadata.
Use AWS Lambda to process the photos. Store the photos in Amazon S3. Retain DynamoDB to store the metadata.
Increase the number of EC2 instances to three. Use Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes to store the photos and metadata.

question_text:
A medical records company is hosting an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes customer data files that are stored on Amazon S3.
