The EC2 instances are hosted in public subnets. The EC2 instances access Amazon S3 over the internet, but they do not require any other network access.
A new requirement mandates that the network traffic for file transfers take a private route and not be sent over the internet.
Which change to the network architecture should a solutions architect recommend to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
要求是 S3 的流量不能经过互联网。实例被移动到私有子网中，并为 S3 创建了一个网关端点，在这些子网的路由表中添加了指向该端点的路由。流量保留在 AWS 网络内部，端点没有费用，实例无需其他网络访问，这完全符合所陈述的条件。
选项 A：一个 NAT 网关是通往互联网的路径：这直接违反了要求，并且会为处理流量产生费用。
选项 B：安全组中的前缀列表限制了流量可以到达的位置，但路由本身仍然通过互联网网关进行。
选项 D：直接连接将公司的本地设施与 AWS 相连。实例已经位于 AWS 内部，因此为它们建立专用连接没有意义。

options.text: Create a NAT gateway. Configure the route table for the public subnets to send traffic to Amazon S3 through the NAT gateway.
Configure the security group for the EC2 instances to restrict outbound traffic so that only traffic to the S3 prefix list is permitted.
Move the EC2 instances to private subnets. Create a VPC endpoint for Amazon S3, and link the endpoint to the route table for the private subnets.
Remove the internet gateway from the VPC. Set up an AWS Direct Connect connection, and route traffic to Amazon S3 over the Direct Connect connection.

question_text:
A company uses a popular content management system (CMS) for its corporate website. However, the required patching and maintenance are burdensome. The company is redesigning its website and wants anew solution. The website will be updated four times a year and does not need to have any dynamic content available. The solution must provide high scalability and enhanced security.
Which combination of changes will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
网站每年更新四次，且没有动态内容，因此完全没有必要运行服务器。将静态网站存储在 S3 存储桶中（D）可以消除补丁和维护工作，自动扩展，并且成本极低。在其前放置 CloudFront（A）可提供 HTTPS（使用 ACM 颁发的证书），靠近用户进行缓存，并支持附加 WAF，同时通过 OAC 将存储桶锁定以防止直接访问。这是操作开销最小且可扩展性最高的方案。
选项 B：AWS WAF 可以过滤请求，但并不能提供 HTTPS，也不是 TLS 终止点。该选项在事实上是错误的。
选项 C：使用 Lambda 函数来提供静态内容会增加额外的代码和额外的调用次数，而 S3 可以直接提供这些文件。
选项 E：一组实例后置负载均衡器会带来与公司试图避免的完全相同的运营负担：补丁、扩展和更新。

options.text: Configure Amazon CloudFront in front of the website to use HTTPS functionality.
Deploy an AWS WAF web ACL in front of the website to provide HTTPS functionality.
Create and deploy an AWS Lambda function to manage and serve the website content.
Create the new website and an Amazon S3 bucket. Deploy the website on the S3 bucket with static website hosting enabled.
Create the new website. Deploy the website by using an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer.

question_text:
A company stores its application logs in an Amazon CloudWatch Logs log group. A new policy requires the company to store all application logs in Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) in near-real time.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
CloudWatch Logs 有一个内置的订阅功能，用于将日志数据传递到 OpenSearch Service：该功能在控制台中配置，并以近实时的方式流式传输记录，无需任何自定义代码或中间服务。
选项 B：一个自定义的 Lambda 函数意味着需要维护交付代码、错误处理和重试机制。
选项 C：日志组不能直接作为 Firehose 交付流的源：仍然需要订阅，使得该流成为不必要的额外层。
选项 D：在每个应用服务器上安装代理是最耗时的路径，尤其是因为日志数据已经存在于 CloudWatch Logs 中。

options.text: Configure a CloudWatch Logs subscription to stream the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).
Create an AWS Lambda function. Use the log group to invoke the function to write the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).

Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream. Configure the log group as the delivery streams sources. Configure Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) as the delivery stream's destination.

Install and configure Amazon Kinesis Agent on each application server to deliver the logs to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Configure Kinesis Data Streams to deliver the logs to Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service).

question_text:
A company is building a web-based application running on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones.
The web application will provide access to a repository of text documents totaling about 900 TB in size. The company anticipates that the web application will experience periods of high demand. A solutions architect must ensure that the storage component for the text documents can scale to meet the demand of the application at all times. The company is concerned about the overall cost of the solution.
Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
900 TB 的文本文档，通过 Web 应用访问，存在需求峰值，并明确提出了成本要求。S3 可在无需配置的情况下扩展，每吉字节的成本明显低于文件或块存储，能够处理任意数量的并发请求，并且无需进行容量规划。该应用通过键来检索文档——此处不需要文件语义。
选项 A：EBS 卷与可用区和实例绑定，大小受限，并且成本远高于 S3。该选项无法满足 900 TB 的需求。
选项 B：EFS 在技术上解决了该问题，但每吉字节的成本明显高于 S3，而成本被明确列为决定性因素。
选项 C：OpenSearch 是一个搜索引擎，而非存储解决方案：将 900 TB 的文档存储在其中既不切实际且非常昂贵。

options.text: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
Amazon S3

question_text:
A global company is using Amazon API Gateway to design REST APIs for its loyalty club users in the us-east-1 Region and the ap-southeast-2 Region. A solutions architect must design a solution to protect these API Gateway managed REST APIs across multiple accounts from SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of administrative effort?
explanation_en:
SQL 注入和跨站脚本攻击由 AWS WAF 过滤，但问题询问的是在多个账户和区域中最小化的管理开销。AWS Firewall Manager 允许在组织的管理账户中定义一个 WAF 策略，并自动将其应用到所有匹配的资源，包括在每个账户中新建的资源。Web ACL 本身仍然是区域性的，但由中心化方式进行管理。注意：Firewall Manager 需要 AWS Organizations 和委托管理功能已启用。
选项 A：可以在每个区域和账户中手动配置 WAF，但规则必须在每个位置分别维护——这正是被避免的额外管理开销。
选项 C：AWS Shield 用于抵御 DDoS 攻击，并不过滤 SQL 注入或 XSS。需要使用 WAF 来实现这一点。
选项 D：同样的错误是使用 Shield，且仅保护一个区域，导致其他区域未被过滤。

options.text: Set up AWS WAF in both Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
Set up AWS Firewall Manager in both Regions. Centrally configure AWS WAF rules.
Set up AWS Shield in bath Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.
Set up AWS Shield in one of the Regions. Associate Regional web ACLs with an API stage.

question_text:
A company has implemented a self-managed DNS solution on three Amazon EC2 instances behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in the us-west-2 Region. Most of the company's users are located in the United States and Europe.
The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the solution. The company launches and configures three EC2 instances in the eu-west-1 Region and adds the EC2 instances as targets for a new NLB.
Which solution can the company use to route traffic to all the EC2 instances?
explanation_en:
DNS 服务通过 UDP 协议运行，并位于网络负载均衡器之后，因此无法使用 CloudFront。需要的是 AWS 全球加速器：它提供一对静态的任意播 IP 地址，接收距离用户最近边缘位置的流量，并通过 AWS 核心网络将其传递到最近的健康端点组——在这种情况下，是 us-west-2 或 eu-west-1。如果某个区域发生故障，流量会自动切换，而无需等待 DNS 记录的 TTL 过期。
选项 A：CloudFront 无法处理 UDP 流量，且无法将 DNS 记录作为此类服务的源。
选项 C：在六个实例上使用弹性 IP 地址的方案移除了负载均衡器，并将容错性转移到 DNS 记录上，但 CloudFront 仍然不适用。
选项 D：将 NLBs 替换为 ALBs 无法解决 DNS 问题：ALB 仅支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS。

options.text: Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the two NLBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.
Create a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Create endpoint groups in us-west-2 and eu-west- 1. Add the two NLBs as endpoints for the endpoint groups.

Attach Elastic IP addresses to the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to route requests to one of the six EC2 instances. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution's origin.

Replace the two NLBs with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs). Create an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to route requests to one of the two ALBs. Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Use the Route 53 record as the distribution’s origin.

question_text:
A company is running an online transaction processing (OLTP) workload on AWS. This workload uses an unencrypted Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ deployment. Daily database snapshots are taken from this instance.
What should a solutions architect do to ensure the database and snapshots are always encrypted moving forward?
explanation_en:
关于 RDS 的一个关键点是：无法为已存在的未加密实例开启加密。唯一可行的路径是：先创建一个快照，然后在复制时启用加密（在复制时指定 KMS 密钥），从加密的副本中恢复一个新的实例，再将应用程序切换到该实例。新实例的所有后续快照会自动继承加密。相反的情况也同样不可能：无法解密一个已加密的实例，只能将其中的数据导出。
选项 B：EBS 卷与 RDS 存储无关——该服务会自行管理存储。而此选项所建议的为现有实例开启加密是不可行的。
选项 C：恢复快照始终会创建一个新的数据库实例。RDS 没有方法可以将快照"恢复到现有的实例中。
选项 D：存储在加密桶中的快照副本仅保护该副本本身。数据库本身及其常规快照仍保持未加密。

options.text: Encrypt a copy of the latest DB snapshot. Replace existing DB instance by restoring the encrypted snapshot.
Create a new encrypted Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and copy the snapshots to it. Enable encryption on the DB instance.
Copy the snapshots and enable encryption using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) Restore encrypted snapshot to an existing DB instance.
Copy the snapshots to an Amazon S3 bucket that is encrypted using server-side encryption with AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) managed keys (SSE-KMS).

question_text:
A company wants to build a scalable key management infrastructure to support developers who need to encrypt data in their applications.
What should a solutions architect do to reduce the operational burden?
explanation_en:
该任务是为开发者提供一个托管的密钥基础设施，而无需自行构建。AWS KMS 正是为此设计的：密钥存储在硬件模块中，永远不会以明文形式离开服务，访问权限由密钥策略和 IAM 策略描述，每一次使用都会被记录到 CloudTrail 中，且自动轮换功能只需一个勾选即可实现。应用程序通过信封加密工作：它们请求一个数据密钥，使用该密钥本地加密数据，并将该密钥的加密副本与数据一起存储。
选项 A：多因素认证保护账户登录。它不是密钥管理基础设施，也无法解决应用程序加密数据的问题。
选项 C：ACM 为负载均衡器、CloudFront 和 API Gateway 发行和管理 TLS 证书。它不负责处理应用程序内部数据的加密密钥。
选项 D：IAM 策略限制访问，但单独使用它无法创建、存储或轮换密钥。它补充了 KMS 的功能，而不是替代 KMS。

options.text: Use multi-factor authentication (MFA) to protect the encryption keys.
Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to protect the encryption keys.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to create, store, and assign the encryption keys.
Use an IAM policy to limit the scope of users who have access permissions to protect the encryption keys.

question_text:
A company has a dynamic web application hosted on two Amazon EC2 instances. The company has its own SSL certificate, which is on each instance to perform SSL termination.
There has been an increase in traffic recently, and the operations team determined that SSL encryption and decryption is causing the compute capacity of the web servers to reach their maximum limit.
What should a solutions architect do to increase the application's performance?
explanation_en:
瓶颈在于Web服务器本身的加密。可以通过将TLS终止移至应用负载均衡器来卸载该瓶颈：公司自己的证书导入到ACM中，HTTPS监听器使用该证书。负载均衡器使用其自身资源解密流量，而实例则接收明文HTTP流量，从而释放CPU资源。
选项 A：ACM颁发的证书不能导出并安装到实例上，更重要的是，加密工作仍然会留在服务器上。
选项 B：S3是对象存储；它在TLS终止中不起作用。不存在这样的配置。
选项 C：确实可以通过单独的代理实例来减轻负载，但那是一台独立的机器——需要独立的补丁、扩展，并且会引入一个新的单点故障，取代了托管服务。

options.text: Create a new SSL certificate using AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Install the ACM certificate on each instance.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket Migrate the SSL certificate to the S3 bucket. Configure the EC2 instances to reference the bucket for SSL termination.
Create another EC2 instance as a proxy server. Migrate the SSL certificate to the new instance and configure it to direct connections to the existing EC2 instances.
Import the SSL certificate into AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Create an Application Load Balancer with an HTTPS listener that uses the SSL certificate from ACM.

question_text:
A company has a highly dynamic batch processing job that uses many Amazon EC2 instances to complete it. The job is stateless in nature, can be started and stopped at any given time with no negative impact, and typically takes upwards of 60 minutes total to complete. The company has asked a solutions architect to design a scalable and cost-effective solution that meets the requirements of the job.
What should the solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
该作业是无状态的，可以随时停止并重新启动，且运行时间超过一小时。这是可中断实例的理想配置：最多可享受90%的折扣，且容量回收不会造成损害，因为工作可以简单地重新开始。
选项 B：预留实例意味着在一年或三年期限内有稳定的消耗，而工作负载被描述为高度可变。
选项 C：当中断是可以接受时，按需定价明显更昂贵。
选项 D：该作业运行时间超过一小时，而Lambda函数的执行限制为十五分钟。

options.text: Implement EC2 Spot Instances.
Purchase EC2 Reserved Instances.
Implement EC2 On-Demand Instances.
Implement the processing on AWS Lambda.

question_text:
A company runs its two-tier ecommerce website on AWS. The web tier consists of a load balancer that sends traffic to Amazon EC2 instances. The database tier uses an Amazon RDS DB instance. The EC2 instances and the RDS DB instance should not be exposed to the public internet. The EC2 instances require internet access to complete payment processing of orders through a third-party web service. The application must be highly available.
Which combination of configuration options will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
实例和数据库必须不暴露在互联网上，但实例需要能够向外访问支付服务，且所有组件必须能够抵御一个可用区故障。因此，自动扩展组在私有子网中启动实例，RDS数据库采用多可用区配置，也部署在私有子网中（A）。网络架构包含两个公共子网用于负载均衡器，两个私有子网用于工作负载，以及两个NAT网关——每个可用区一个（E）。
选项 B：一个可从互联网访问的应用负载均衡器必须部署在公共子网中：在私有子网中，它无法接收用户流量。
选项 C：位于公共子网中的实例会暴露在互联网上——这直接违反了要求。
选项 D：一个公共子网和一个私有子网意味着每个层级仅在一个可用区：负载均衡器需要至少两个可用区中的子网，因此无法实现高可用性。

options.text: Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in private subnets. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
Configure a VPC with two private subnets and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the private subnets.
Use an Auto Scaling group to launch the EC2 instances in public subnets across two Availability Zones. Deploy an RDS Multi-AZ DB instance in private subnets.
Configure a VPC with one public subnet, one private subnet, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnet.
Configure a VPC with two public subnets, two private subnets, and two NAT gateways across two Availability Zones. Deploy an Application Load Balancer in the public subnets.

question_text:
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to reduce a company's storage costs. All the company's data is in the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. The company must keep all data for at least 25 years. Data from the most recent 2 years must be highly available and immediately retrievable.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该需求按时间线划分：最近两年的数据需要高可用性和即时检索，而更早的数据只需以尽可能低的成本存活25年。这实际上就是描述了一个生命周期规则：在2年后将数据迁移到S3 Glacier Deep Archive。近期数据保留在Standard存储类别中，而旧数据每月每太字节的成本约为1美元。Deep Archive在标准检索下，对象的返回时间在12小时内，但对于超过两年的数据，并未设定任何访问速度要求。
选项 A：立即迁移到 Deep Archive 违反了核心需求：最后两年的数据必须能够即时获取，而 Deep Archive 只能在数小时后返回对象。
选项 C：Intelligent-Tiering 根据访问缺失情况（90天和180天后）将对象迁移到归档层级，而非基于固定的两年时间周期。一个未被使用但近期的对象会提前被归档，此外你将为每个对象支付长达25年的监控费用。
选项 D：S3 One Zone-IA 将数据存储在单个可用区，而近期数据需要具备高可用性。此处的中间过渡也毫无意义：它以降低成本为代价，牺牲了容错能力。

options.text: Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive immediately.
Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.
Use S3 Intelligent-Tiering. Activate the archiving option to ensure that data is archived in S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
Set up an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately and to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 2 years.

question_text:
A media company is evaluating the possibility of moving its systems to the AWS Cloud. The company needs at least 10 TB of storage with the maximum possible I/O performance for video processing, 300 TB of very durable storage for storing media content, and 900 TB of storage to meet requirements for archival media that is not in use anymore.
Which set of services should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
三个需求，三种不同的存储类型。最大I/O性能要求由实例的本地NVMe磁盘（实例存储）满足，其性能优于任何网络附加卷；数据丢失风险在此处不构成问题，因为这只是处理的临时工作空间。300 TB媒体内容的持久存储使用S3，具备十一九的持久性。不再被访问的900 TB内容归档使用S3 Glacier。
选项 A：EBS卷速度很快，但其性能仍低于实例的本地NVMe磁盘，而需求要求达到最大性能。
选项 B：此处同样存在性能不足的问题，再加上EFS作为媒体内容的持久存储明显比S3更昂贵。
选项 C：使用EFS存储300 TB比S3更昂贵，而直接使用S3存储900 TB归档比Glacier更昂贵：两种替代方案都会使解决方案变差。

options.text: Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
Amazon EBS for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage
Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon EFS for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 for archival storage
Amazon EC2 instance store for maximum performance, Amazon S3 for durable data storage, and Amazon S3 Glacier for archival storage

question_text:
A company wants to run applications in containers in the AWS Cloud. These applications are stateless and can tolerate disruptions within the underlying infrastructure. The company needs a solution that minimizes cost and operational overhead.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
这些应用程序是无状态的，并且能够容忍中断，因此可中断实例非常适用——最多可享受90%的折扣。在容器选项中，EKS管理的节点组将节点配置和补丁操作从团队的工作中移除，并自行处理Spot中断通知，根据需要替换节点。
选项 A：在Spot实例上使用自动扩展组成本较低，但团队需要自行构建容器编排功能——操作开销更大。
选项 C：按需实例明显更昂贵，而需求明确允许中断。
选项 D：管理节点处理非常方便，但按需定价无法降低成本。

options.text: Use Spot Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers.
Use Spot Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.
Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group to run the application containers.
Use On-Demand Instances in an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) managed node group.

question_text:
A company is running a multi-tier web application on premises. The web application is containerized and runs on a number of Linux hosts connected to a PostgreSQL database that contains user records. The operational overhead of maintaining the infrastructure and capacity planning is limiting the company's growth. A solutions architect must improve the application's infrastructure.
Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
问题被直接陈述：基础设施操作和容量规划正在阻碍增长。因此，服务器管理需要被取消。容器迁移到 AWS Fargate 上运行在 ECS 中——完全不需要管理任何节点（E）——而 PostgreSQL 数据库迁移到 Aurora，其中存储能够自动扩展，且 AWS 负责可用性和备份（A）。
选项 B：EC2 实例是相同服务器，只是部署在云端，需要补丁和容量规划：原始问题依然存在。
选项 C：CloudFront 能够加快内容分发，但并不会消除操作负担。
选项 D：缓存可以提升性能，但无法解决所述的基础设施和容量管理问题。

options.text: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora.
Migrate the web application to be hosted on Amazon EC2 instances.
Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the web application content.
Set up Amazon ElastiCache between the web application and the PostgreSQL database.
Migrate the web application to be hosted on AWS Fargate with Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS).

question_text:
An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zonas. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer. The application performs best when the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances is at or near 40%.
What should a solutions architect do to maintain the desired performance across all instances in the group?
explanation_en:
该需求为一个指标设定了目标值——大约40%的CPU利用率。一个目标跟踪策略正是为此设计的：它会自行计算需要增加或减少多少实例，以保持平均利用率维持在指定水平。
选项 A：一个简单的扩展策略在达到阈值时触发，并增加固定数量的实例，而不是旨在维持一个特定值，且在操作之间需要一个冷却期。
选项 C：一个自定义函数通过代码方式改变所需容量，而不是使用现成的机制。
选项 D：计划不会对实际负载做出反应：它无法将利用率维持在40%。

options.text: Use a simple scaling policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
Use a target tracking policy to dynamically scale the Auto Scaling group.
Use an AWS Lambda function ta update the desired Auto Scaling group capacity.
Use scheduled scaling actions to scale up and scale down the Auto Scaling group.

question_text:
A company is developing a file-sharing application that will use an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The company wants to serve all the files through an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The company does not want the files to be accessible through direct navigation to the S3 URL.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
目标是关闭对存储桶的直接访问，并仅保留通过 CloudFront 的一个入口。为此，分发被赋予一个特殊身份：源访问身份（在现代部署中为源访问控制），该身份被指定为存储桶策略中的主体，之后仅授予该身份读取权限。存储桶的公开访问被完全关闭，直接的 S3 对象 URL 已停止工作。然后可以在其上叠加签名 URL，如 第 542、313 题 所示。
选项 A：每个存储桶单独制定策略并不能描述一种机制：关键点不在于策略的数量，而在于它们所命名的主体。如果没有 OAI 或 OAC，策略中就没有任何内容可命名。
选项 B：IAM 用户不会被分配给 CloudFront 分发：该服务不会代表 IAM 用户进行操作。不存在这样的构造。
选项 C：分发 ID 不是 IAM 主体，无法放入 Principal 字段。主体是 OAI，或者对于 OAC，是 cloudfront.amazonaws.com 服务，并附加一个关于分发 ARN 的条件。

options.text: Write individual policies for each S3 bucket to grant read permission for only CloudFront access.
Create an IAM user. Grant the user read permission to objects in the S3 bucket. Assign the user to CloudFront.
Write an S3 bucket policy that assigns the CloudFront distribution ID as the Principal and assigns the target S3 bucket as the Amazon Resource Name (ARN).
Create an origin access identity (OAI). Assign the OAI to the CloudFront distribution. Configure the S3 bucket permissions so that only the OAI has read permission.

question_text:
A company’s website provides users with downloadable historical performance reports. The website needs a solution that will scale to meet the company’s website demands globally. The solution should be cost-effective, limit the provisioning of infrastructure resources, and provide the fastest possible response time.
Which combination should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
报告是静态文件，用户从全球各地下载。将它们存储在 S3 中完全不需要服务器，成本仅为每吉字节几分钱，而 CloudFront 会在边缘位置缓存这些文件，从而提供最快响应时间，并降低出站流量成本。避免配置基础设施、保持成本低廉以及尽可能快速响应的所有要求都得到了满足。
选项 B：Lambda 和 DynamoDB 用于动态逻辑和数据，而此处是提供预先制作好的文件：额外的调用和额外的成本毫无意义。
选项 C：一组实例后置负载均衡器意味着需要配置资源并持续付费，这与要求中避免配置基础设施相矛盾。
选项 D：内部负载均衡器无法从互联网访问，也无法解决在全球范围内提供文件的问题。

options.text: Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3
AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB
Application Load Balancer with Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling
Amazon Route 53 with internal Application Load Balancers

question_text:
A company runs an Oracle database on premises. As part of the company’s migration to AWS, the company wants to upgrade the database to the most recent available version. The company also wants to set up disaster recovery (DR) for the database. The company needs to minimize the operational overhead for normal operations and DR setup. The company also needs to maintain access to the database's underlying operating system.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
关键限制是需要访问数据库底层操作系统，而标准 RDS 并不提供此功能。Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle 保留了托管优势（补丁更新、备份、副本功能），同时提供了对底层系统的访问权限。在发生灾难时，会在另一个区域创建一个只读副本并将其提升为主节点以实现灾难恢复。
选项 A：运行在 EC2 实例上的数据库提供了操作系统访问权限，但所有维护和复制配置则全部由公司自行承担。
选项 B：标准 RDS 不提供操作系统访问权限，且跨区域自动备份的恢复时间远长于副本的恢复时间。
选项 D：仍然没有操作系统访问权限，且另一个可用区中的备用实例并非针对区域级故障的解决方案。

options.text: Migrate the Oracle database to an Amazon EC2 instance. Set up database replication to a different AWS Region.
Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Activate Cross-Region automated backups to replicate the snapshots to another AWS Region.
Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS Custom for Oracle. Create a read replica for the database in another AWS Region.
Migrate the Oracle database to Amazon RDS for Oracle. Create a standby database in another Availability Zone.

question_text:
A company wants to move its application to a serverless solution. The serverless solution needs to analyze existing and new data by using SL. The company stores the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The data requires encryption and must be replicated to a different AWS Region.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
有三个要求：对 S3 中的数据进行无服务器 SQL 分析、加密，以及跨区域复制。在给定的选项中，只有 Amazon Athena 能够以无服务器的方式直接在 S3 对象上运行 SQL，因此所有涉及 RDS 的选项立即被排除。接下来是加密方案的选择：将使用 KMS 密钥加密的对象复制到另一个区域时，需要在该区域中可用的密钥，而多区域 KMS 密钥无需重新加密，也无需额外的策略——一个密钥在两个区域中具有相同的密钥材料。这导致了组合 "SSE-KMS 使用多区域密钥加上 CRR 加上 Athena。"
选项 B：Amazon RDS 是一个数据库服务器，数据需要先加载到其中，而要求是针对已经存在于 S3 中的对象的无服务器解决方案。
选项 C：Athena 是正确选择，但 SSE-S3 意味着密钥完全由服务管理，且在每个区域中独立管理：无法确认或控制复制时所使用的密钥。当加密和跨区域复制同时出现在要求中时，考试期望使用多区域 KMS 密钥。
选项 D：两个问题同时存在：RDS 而不是无服务器分析解决方案，以及 SSE-S3 而不是公司管理的密钥。

options.text: Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region kays (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.

Create a new S3 bucket. Load the data into the new S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with AWS KMS multi-Region keys (SSE-KMS). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.

Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon Athena to query the data.

Load the data into the existing S3 bucket. Use S3 Cross-Region Replication (CRR) to replicate encrypted objects to an S3 bucket in another Region. Use server-side encryption with Amazon S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Use Amazon RDS to query the data.

question_text:
A company runs workloads on AWS. The company needs to connect to a service from an external provider. The service is hosted in the provider's VPC. According to the company’s security team, the connectivity must be private and must be restricted to the target service. The connection must be initiated only from the company’s VPC.
Which solution will mast these requirements?
explanation_en:
连接必须是私有的，仅限于单个目标服务，并且只能由公司侧发起——这正是 AWS PrivateLink 所描述的。提供商将其服务作为网络负载均衡器后方的端点服务发布，公司在其自己的 VPC 中创建一个接口端点，并通过私有地址访问该服务。仅能看到该一个服务，而看不到提供商的整个网络，且连接不能反向发起。
选项 A：VPC 对等连接会连接整个网络：路由会开放对提供商整个地址空间的访问，且连接可以双向进行。无法满足仅限制访问单个服务的要求。
选项 B：虚拟私有网关是 VPN 或 Direct Connect 的连接点；它与 PrivateLink 无关。
选项 C：NAT 网关会将流量发送到互联网，意味着连接不再私有。

options.text: Create a VPC peering connection between the company's VPC and the provider's VPC. Update the route table to connect to the target service.
Ask the provider to create a virtual private gateway in its VPC. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.
Create a NAT gateway in a public subnet of the company’s VPUpdate the route table to connect to the target service.
Ask the provider to create a VPC endpoint for the target service. Use AWS PrivateLink to connect to the target service.

question_text:
A company is migrating its on-premises PostgreSQL database to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. The on-premises database must remain online and accessible during the migration. The Aurora database must remain synchronized with the on-premises database.
Which combination of actions must a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
源和目标都是 PostgreSQL，因此无需转换模式。只需启动一个 AWS DMS 复制服务器（C），并创建一个持续（连续）复制任务（A）：DMS 首先迁移现有数据，然后读取事务日志并应用变更，因此源数据库保持可用，且两个数据库始终保持同步。
选项 B：从备份恢复会提供一个时间点的快照，并不能保持数据库同步，这同样需要停止数据库。
选项 D：当引擎发生变化时，需要使用模式转换工具，例如从 Oracle 转换到 PostgreSQL。在这里，源和目标端的引擎是相同的。
选项 E：一个 EventBridge 规则在进行监控。它不会执行任何迁移或同步操作。

options.text: Create an ongoing replication task.
Create a database backup of the on-premises database.
Create an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication server.
Convert the database schema by using the AWS Schema Conversion Tool (AWS SCT).
Create an Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) rule to monitor the database synchronization.

question_text:
A company uses AWS Organizations to create dedicated AWS accounts for each business unit to manage each business unit's account independently upon request. The root email recipient missed a notification that was sent to the root user email address of one account. The company wants to ensure that all future notifications are not missed. Future notifications must be limited to account administrators.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
需求包含两个部分。通知必须不被遗漏，这意味着每个账户的根邮箱地址不应是个人邮箱，而应是一个由多位管理员共同阅读的分发列表（当某位管理员休假时，该列表依然有效）。通知必须仅发送给管理员，因此分发列表必须狭窄，而不是公司范围内的。第二部分由备用联系人覆盖：每个账户可以拥有独立的账单、运营和安全邮箱地址，AWS 会将类别特定的通知直接发送到这些地址。相关问题 — 第 878 题。
选项 A：将根通知转发给组织中的每一位员工，与将接收者限制在管理员范围的要求相反。
选项 C：将单一人员作为唯一接收者，只是重新创建了原始问题——该人员就是错过通知的人。此外，它还需要手动将通知转发到分组。
选项 D：为每个账户使用相同的根邮箱地址意味着一个业务单元的管理员会看到其他账户的通知，且账户无法按所有权进行分离。

options.text: Configure the company’s email server to forward notification email messages that are sent to the AWS account root user email address to all users in the organization.

Configure all AWS account root user email addresses as distribution lists that go to a few administrators who can respond to alerts. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.
Configure all AWS account root user email messages to be sent to one administrator who is responsible for monitoring alerts and forwarding those alerts to the appropriate groups.

Configure all existing AWS accounts and all newly created accounts to use the same root user email address. Configure AWS account alternate contacts in the AWS Organizations console or programmatically.

question_text:
A company runs its ecommerce application on AWS. Every new order is published as a massage in a RabbitMQ queue that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a single Availability Zone. These messages are processed by a different application that runs on a separate EC2 instance. This application stores the details in a PostgreSQL database on another EC2 instance. All the EC2 instances are in the same Availability Zone.
The company needs to redesign its architecture to provide the highest availability with the least operational overhead.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
每个组件都替换为管理等效组件，并跨两个可用区扩展。RabbitMQ 队列迁移到 Amazon MQ 的主动/备用代理配置中，应用程序在多可用区自动扩展组中运行，PostgreSQL 数据库变为一个在多可用区部署中的 Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL 实例。这提供了最低的操作开销和最高的可用性。
选项 A：在 EC2 自动扩展组中运行 PostgreSQL 不可行——实例之间将没有共享数据。
选项 C：在自动扩展组中使用自管理的 RabbitMQ 代理需要手动配置集群并进行持续维护。
选项 D：该选项同时包含一个自研代理集群和一个在自动扩展组中的数据库——两者要么无法正常工作，要么需要高投入。

options.text: Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database.

Migrate the queue to a redundant pair (active/standby) of RabbitMQ instances on Amazon MQ. Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.

Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Migrate the database to run on a Multi-AZ deployment of Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL.

Create a Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the RabbitMQ queue. Create another Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the application. Create a third Multi-AZ Auto Scaling group for EC2 instances that host the PostgreSQL database

question_text:
A reporting team receives files each day in an Amazon S3 bucket. The reporting team manually reviews and copies the files from this initial S3 bucket to an analysis S3 bucket each day at the same time to use with Amazon QuickSight. Additional teams are starting to send more files in larger sizes to the initial S3 bucket.
The reporting team wants to move the files automatically analysis S3 bucket as the files enter the initial S3 bucket. The reporting team also wants to use AWS Lambda functions to run pattern-matching code on the copied data. In addition, the reporting team wants to send the data files to a pipeline in Amazon SageMaker Pipelines.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
在不同存储桶之间复制由原生 S3 复制功能处理——无需编写自定义函数即可实现。要使单个事件同时转发到两个目标（Lambda 函数和 SageMaker Pipelines 流程），事件需通过 EventBridge 路由：一个 ObjectCreated 规则支持多个目标，而普通的 S3 事件通知仅能为每种事件类型将事件发送到一个目标。
选项 A：无需自定义复制函数是多余的代码，且 S3 事件通知无法将单个事件发送到两种不同目标。
选项 B：EventBridge 是此处的正确选择，但当复制功能已经处理了该功能时，自定义复制函数是多余的。
选项 C：复制功能是此处的正确选择，但普通的 S3 通知无法同时指向一个 Lambda 函数和一个 SageMaker 流程。

options.text: Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.

Create a Lambda function to copy the files to the analysis S3 bucket. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.

Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Create an S3 event notification for the analysis S3 bucket. Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as destinations of the event notification. Configure s3:ObjectCreated:Put as the event type.

Configure S3 replication between the S3 buckets. Configure the analysis S3 bucket to send event notifications to Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events). Configure an ObjectCreated rule in EventBridge (CloudWatch Events). Configure Lambda and SageMaker Pipelines as targets for the rule.

question_text:
A solutions architect needs to help a company optimize the cost of running an application on AWS. The application will use Amazon EC2 instances, AWS Fargate, and AWS Lambda for compute within the architecture.
The EC2 instances will run the data ingestion layer of the application. EC2 usage will be sporadic and unpredictable. Workloads that run on EC2 instances can be interrupted at any time. The application front end will run on Fargate, and Lambda will serve the API layer. The front-end utilization and API layer utilization will be predictable over the course of the next year.
Which combination of purchasing options will provide the MOST cost-effective solution for hosting this application? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
不同的层级需要不同的采购模式。在 EC2 实例上进行的数据摄入是零散的、不可预测的，并且能够容忍中断，这指向使用最多可享受 90% 折扣的 Spot 实例（A）。Fargate 的前端和 Lambda API 层在一年内是可预测的，要同时覆盖这两部分，唯一可行的方式是采用计算节省计划（Compute Savings Plan），该计划适用于 EC2、Fargate 和 Lambda（C）。
选项 B：为能够容忍中断的工作负载使用按需实例是一种显著的超额支付。
选项 D：预留实例假定存在稳定且持续的使用情况，但数据摄入被描述为零散且不可预测。
选项 E：EC2 实例节省计划仅适用于 EC2 实例，不适用于 Fargate 或 Lambda。

options.text: Use Spot Instances for the data ingestion layer
Use On-Demand Instances for the data ingestion layer
Purchase a 1-year Compute Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.
Purchase 1-year All Upfront Reserved instances for the data ingestion layer.
Purchase a 1-year EC2 instance Savings Plan for the front end and API layer.

question_text:
A company runs a web-based portal that provides users with global breaking news, local alerts, and weather updates. The portal delivers each user a personalized view by using mixture of static and dynamic content. Content is served over HTTPS through an API server running on an Amazon EC2 instance behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The company wants the portal to provide this content to its users across the world as quickly as possible.
How should a solutions architect design the application to ensure the LEAST amount of latency for all users?
explanation_en:
CloudFront 加速的不仅仅是可缓存的静态内容。对于个性化动态内容，其性能提升来自于用户与最近的边缘节点建立 TLS 连接之后，请求通过 AWS 优化的骨干网络传输至源站，而该骨干网络的连接已经预热——明显比通过公网连接到远距离区域要快得多。因此，单次部署并让 CloudFront 将所有路径路由至分发网络，即可实现最低延迟，而无需重复构建架构。
选项 B：在不同区域部署两份架构会同时增加成本和复杂性，且基于延迟的路由仍会将用户通过公网连接到远距离区域。
选项 C：直接从负载均衡器提供动态内容，会使远距离用户无法获得 AWS 骨干网络的加速优势——而动态内容恰恰是最容易受到影响的部分。
选项 D：用户的地理位置并不等于最低延迟，再次复制架构会再次增加成本。

options.text: Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve all static and dynamic content by specifying the ALB as an origin.
Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 latency routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.
Deploy the application stack in a single AWS Region. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the static content. Serve the dynamic content directly from the ALB.
Deploy the application stack in two AWS Regions. Use an Amazon Route 53 geolocation routing policy to serve all content from the ALB in the closest Region.

question_text:
A gaming company is designing a highly available architecture. The application runs on a modified Linux kernel and supports only UDP-based traffic. The company needs the front-end tier to provide the best possible user experience. That tier must have low latency, route traffic to the nearest edge location, and provide static IP addresses for entry into the application endpoints.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
三个要求明确指向一个服务。UDP流量排除了Application Load Balancer（ALB）和CloudFront。入口点的静态IP地址仅由AWS Global Accelerator（一对任何cast地址）提供。在最近的边缘位置接收流量并通过AWS骨干网络传输可实现低延迟。Global Accelerator后方是一个网络负载均衡器，工作在第4层，以及一个包含实例的自动扩展组，因为应用程序需要修改的Linux内核，这排除了任何无服务器选项。
选项 A：ALB不支持UDP，且Lambda无法运行需要修改内核的应用程序。
选项 B：CloudFront不提供UDP流量服务，也不提供静态IP地址，而Lambda同样不符合需要修改内核的要求。
选项 D：API Gateway仅支持HTTP和WebSocket，不支持任意UDP流量，且它不提供静态地址。

options.text: Configure Amazon Route 53 to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in AWS Application Auto Scaling.
Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use AWS Lambda for the application in an AWS Application Auto Scaling group.
Configure AWS Global Accelerator to forward requests to a Network Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.
Configure Amazon API Gateway to forward requests to an Application Load Balancer. Use Amazon EC2 instances for the application in an EC2 Auto Scaling group.

question_text:
A company wants to migrate its existing on-premises monolithic application to AWS. The company wants to keep as much of the front-end code and the backend code as possible. However, the company wants to break the application into smaller applications. A different team will manage each application. The company needs a highly scalable solution that minimizes operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
单体应用需要被拆分为多个应用，同时尽可能保留现有代码，且最终结果需要具备可扩展性，并保持最小的操作开销。容器在此场景中最为合适：代码几乎无需修改即可迁移，每个部分都成为独立的 ECS 服务，由各自团队拥有，且应用负载均衡器能够根据路径或头部信息将请求路由到正确的服务。
选项 A：将单体应用迁移到 Lambda 需要大量代码重构，且不自然地支持在团队之间划分工作。
选项 B：Amplify 是为前端构建的，将其与 API Gateway 和 Lambda 配合使用，意味着需要重新编写后端。
选项 C：位于负载均衡器后的实例将单体应用保持为单一单元，且公司仍需负责管理服务器。

options.text: Host the application on AWS Lambda. Integrate the application with Amazon API Gateway.
Host the application with AWS Amplify. Connect the application to an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with AWS Lambda.
Host the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Set up an Application Load Balancer with EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group as targets.
Host the application on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up an Application Load Balancer with Amazon ECS as the target.

question_text:
A company recently started using Amazon Aurora as the data store for its global ecommerce application. When large reports are run, developers report that the ecommerce application is performing poorly. After reviewing metrics in Amazon CloudWatch, a solutions architect finds that the ReadIOPS and CPUUtilizalion metrics are spiking when monthly reports run.
What is the MOST cost-effective solution?
explanation_en:
报表生成造成了巨大的读取负载，干扰了主应用程序。最便宜的解决方案是将报表处理迁移到 Aurora 复制实例：它从相同的共享存储读取，延迟仅为毫秒级，且可以通过单个操作添加。主实例得以释放，唯一增加的成本是额外的一个读取实例。
选项 A：将报表处理迁移到 Redshift 意味着需要一个独立的数据存储、一个加载管道以及一个始终运行的集群——明显更昂贵且更复杂。
选项 C：将主实例扩展到更大的实例类型会持续增加成本，即使峰值负载每月仅出现一次，且无法分离工作负载。
选项 D：Aurora 没有提供 Provisioned IOPS 设置——其存储是共享且由服务本身管理的。

options.text: Migrate the monthly reporting to Amazon Redshift.
Migrate the monthly reporting to an Aurora Replica.
Migrate the Aurora database to a larger instance class.
Increase the Provisioned IOPS on the Aurora instance.

question_text:
A company hosts a website analytics application on a single Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instance. The analytics software is written in PHP and uses a MySQL database. The analytics software, the web server that provides PHP, and the database server are all hosted on the EC2 instance. The application is showing signs of performance degradation during busy times and is presenting 5xx errors. The company needs to make the application scale seamlessly.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
应用程序在单个同时托管Web服务器和数据库的实例上出现瓶颈。最便宜的解决方案是分离各层并实现计算弹性：数据库迁移到一个管理的Aurora MySQL实例，应用程序镜像变为一个启动模板，一个位于应用负载均衡器之后的自动扩展组根据负载动态增加或移除实例，且在实例队列中使用Spot容量可大幅降低计算成本。对于无状态的Web层，Spot实例中断仅通过替换实例即可吸收。
选项 A：两个固定大小的按需实例无法随峰值负载扩展，且成本高于一个基于弹性Spot容量的组。
选项 B：DNS加权路由无法像负载均衡器那样快速检查目标健康状况，且不具备容量扩展能力。
选项 C：将实例类型从由告警触发的函数进行更改属于垂直扩展，伴随重启和停机，而非无缝扩展。

options.text: Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use an Application Load Balancer to distribute the load to each EC2 instance.

Migrate the database to an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Use the AMI to launch a second EC2 On-Demand Instance. Use Amazon Route 53 weighted routing to distribute the load across the two EC2 instances.

Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AWS Lambda function to stop the EC2 instance and change the instance type. Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to invoke the Lambda function when CPU utilization surpasses 75%.

Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB instance. Create an AMI of the web application. Apply the AMI to a launch template. Create an Auto Scaling group with the launch template Configure the launch template to use a Spot Fleet. Attach an Application Load Balancer to the Auto Scaling group.

question_text:
A company runs a stateless web application in production on a group of Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application experiences heavy usage during an 8-hour period each business day. Application usage is moderate and steady overnight. Application usage is low during weekends.
The company wants to minimize its EC2 costs without affecting the availability of the application.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
负载由一个稳定的基线（夜间中等，白天较高）加上一个可变的叠加层组成。基线部分最经济的覆盖方式是使用折扣后的预留实例，而高峰时段的额外容量则通过抢占式实例覆盖：应用程序是无状态的，因此回收部分实例不会影响可用性。
选项 A：完全使用抢占式容量会使基线服务等级面临风险——一次大规模中断将导致应用程序不可用。
选项 C：为基线支付全价在使用量可预测且提前一年可预见的情况下属于过度支付。
选项 D：专用实例成本最高，仅在需要硬件隔离时才需要，而这并不属于当前场景。

options.text: Use Spot Instances for the entire workload.
Use Reserved Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
Use On-Demand Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use Spot Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.
Use Dedicated Instances for the baseline level of usage. Use On-Demand Instances for any additional capacity that the application needs.

question_text:
A company needs to retain application log files for a critical application for 10 years. The application team regularly accesses logs from the past month for troubleshooting, but logs older than 1 month are rarely accessed.
The application generates more than 10 TB of logs per month.
Which storage option meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
每月超过10 TB的日志，保存十年：最便宜的方法是将它们存储为S3对象，并使用生命周期规则将任何超过一个月的旧日志移动到S3 Glacier Deep Archive，这是最便宜的存储类别。最近一个月的日志保持即时可访问。
选项 A：AWS Backup 不管理 S3 对象的存储类别——存储类别之间的转换由生命周期规则处理。
选项 C：将日志存储在 CloudWatch Logs 中比 S3 明显更昂贵，且 AWS Backup 不适用于 CloudWatch Logs。
选项 D：S3 生命周期规则不会作用于存储在 CloudWatch Logs 中的日志——这些日志首先需要被导出。

options.text: Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
Store the logs in Amazon S3. Use S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use AWS Backup to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
Store the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs. Use Amazon S3 Lifecycle policies to move logs more than 1 month old to S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

question_text:
A company has a data ingestion workflow that includes the following components:
An Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic that receives notifications about new data deliveries An AWS Lambda function that processes and stores the data The ingestion workflow occasionally fails because of network connectivity issues. When failure occurs, the corresponding data is not ingested unless the company manually reruns the job.
What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all notifications are eventually processed?
explanation_en:
网络故障会导致函数调用失败，且通知会丢失。对于异步调用，Lambda 有一个可配置的故障目的地：将一个 SQS 队列设置为故障目的地，无法处理的事件会进入该队列，函数稍后会从中获取这些事件。没有任何内容会丢失。
选项 A：Lambda 函数已经跨多个可用区运行——那里无需配置，也无法防止网络故障。
选项 B：更多的内存和 CPU 不会影响连接故障期间事件丢失的问题。
选项 C：增加 SNS 重试次数会降低丢失的可能性，但不能保证不会丢失——一旦重试次数耗尽，消息仍然会丢失。

options.text: Configure the Lambda function for deployment across multiple Availability Zones.
Modify the Lambda function's configuration to increase the CPU and memory allocations for the function.
Configure the SNS topic’s retry strategy to increase both the number of retries and the wait time between retries.
Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as the on-failure destination. Modify the Lambda function to process messages in the queue.

question_text:
A company has a service that produces event data. The company wants to use AWS to process the event data as it is received. The data is written in a specific order that must be maintained throughout processing. The company wants to implement a solution that minimizes operational overhead.
How should a solutions architect accomplish this?
explanation_en:
处理顺序必须得到保持，且操作开销必须最小。一个 SQS FIFO 队列在消息组内保持顺序，并保证精确一次处理，而 Lambda 函数将其作为事件源读取——无需涉及服务器。
选项 B：SNS 不保证向订阅者传递消息的顺序。
选项 C：标准队列可能会重新排序消息，因此严格顺序无法得到保证。
选项 D：一个带有普通队列订阅者的主题也无法保持顺序，且该场景甚至没有描述其处理器。

options.text: Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an AWS Lambda function as a subscriber.
Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) standard queue to hold messages. Set up an AWS Lambda function to process messages from the queue independently.
Create an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to deliver notifications containing payloads to process. Configure an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a subscriber.

question_text:
A company is migrating an application from on-premises servers to Amazon EC2 instances. As part of the migration design requirements, a solutions architect must implement infrastructure metric alarms. The company does not need to take action if CPU utilization increases to more than 50% for a short burst of time. However, if the CPU utilization increases to more than 50% and read IOPS on the disk are high at the same time, the company needs to act as soon as possible. The solutions architect also must reduce false alarms.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
操作仅在两个条件同时成立时才需要 — 高 CPU 利用率和高磁盘读取 IOPS。一个 CloudWatch 复合告警结合多个告警并使用逻辑表达式，仅在它们同时触发时才会触发，这正是消除由短暂峰值引起的误报的关键。
选项 B：仪表板有助于直观查看指标，但不会创建自动通知。
选项 C：Synthetics canaries 从外部检查应用端点的可用性，与实例指标无关。
选项 D：一个常规的 CloudWatch 告警跟踪单一指标 — 你无法在一个告警中设置跨越两个不同指标的条件。

options.text: Create Amazon CloudWatch composite alarms where possible.
Create Amazon CloudWatch dashboards to visualize the metrics and react to issues quickly.
Create Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics canaries to monitor the application and raise an alarm.
Create single Amazon CloudWatch metric alarms with multiple metric thresholds where possible.

question_text:
A company wants to migrate its on-premises data center to AWS. According to the company's compliance requirements, the company can use only the ap-northeast-3 Region. Company administrators are not permitted to connect VPCs to the internet.
Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
有两个要求：仅在 ap-northeast-3 区域中运行，并且阻止 VPC 与互联网连接，且这两个要求必须对所有人生效，包括管理员。这两个要求都通过组织层级的预防性控制措施得到满足。AWS Control Tower 提供了现成的数据驻留控制措施，这些措施会拒绝在其他区域创建资源以及附加互联网网关（A）。同样的结果也可以通过在 AWS Organizations 中手动使用服务控制策略（SCPs）来实现——使用 aws:RequestedRegion 条件，拒绝创建互联网网关和 NAT（C）。关键点是："管理员不允许"这一要求仅能通过 SCPs 满足，因为管理员可以自行修改自己的 IAM 策略。
选项 B：AWS WAF 过滤应用程序的 HTTP 请求，并不控制 VPC 与互联网的连接。此外，也没有 "拒绝区域账户级" 的设置。
选项 D：网络 ACL 可以被更改回来，且管理员可以自行修改自己的 IAM 策略。两者都不是无法从账户内部绕过的预防性限制。
选项 E：AWS Config 仅在事后检测并发出警报。要求是防止这些资源被创建，而不是在事后发现它们。

options.text: Use AWS Control Tower to implement data residency guardrails to deny internet access and deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
Use rules in AWS WAF to prevent internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3 in the AWS account settings.
Use AWS Organizations to configure service control policies (SCPS) that prevent VPCs from gaining internet access. Deny access to all AWS Regions except ap-northeast-3.
Create an outbound rule for the network ACL in each VPC to deny all traffic from 0.0.0.0/0. Create an IAM policy for each user to prevent the use of any AWS Region other than ap-northeast-3.
Use AWS Config to activate managed rules to detect and alert for internet gateways and to detect and alert for new resources deployed outside of ap-northeast-3.

question_text:
A company uses a three-tier web application to provide training to new employees. The application is accessed for only 12 hours every day. The company is using an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance to store information and wants to minimize costs.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
应用程序每天仅被访问12小时，因此数据库在其他12小时不应被计费。停止的RDS实例不会被计费计算费用（仅存储和快照会继续产生费用），而问题的关键在于是什么触发其停止和启动。标准的配对方式是通过EventBridge计划规则调用Lambda函数，该函数调用Stop和Start操作。请注意RDS的限制：停止的实例会在7天后自动重启，因此需要定期停止实例，而这正是此处发生的情况。
选项 A：Session Manager提供对服务器的访问权限，而不是调度功能。角色和信任策略与停止数据库无关。
选项 B：Redis缓存并不能替代数据库——写入操作和临时查询仍然需要一个目标位置。它还引入了一个始终运行的服务，从而增加成本。
选项 C：一个仅用于执行两次API调用的专用EC2实例，仍然需要支付费用并进行维护。无服务器配对方式更便宜且更可靠。

options.text: Configure an IAM policy for AWS Systems Manager Session Manager. Create an IAM role for the policy. Update the trust relationship of the role. Set up automatic start and stop for the DB instance.

Create an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cache cluster that gives users the ability to access the data from the cache when the DB instance is stopped. Invalidate the cache after the DB instance is started.

Launch an Amazon EC2 instance. Create an IAM role that grants access to Amazon RDS. Attach the role to the EC2 instance. Configure a cron job to start and stop the EC2 instance on the desired schedule.

Create AWS Lambda functions to start and stop the DB instance. Create Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events) scheduled rules to invoke the Lambda functions. Configure the Lambda functions as event targets for the rules.

question_text:
A company sells ringtones created from clips of popular songs. The files containing the ringtones are stored in Amazon S3 Standard and are at least 128 KB in size. The company has millions of files, but downloads are infrequent for ringtones older than 90 days. The company needs to save money on storage while keeping the most accessed files readily available for its users.
Which action should the company take to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
访问模式是已知的，并与对象年龄相关：在前90天内下载频繁，之后很少下载。这种已知的模式最经济地通过生命周期规则来描述，而"保持最常访问的文件随时可用"这一要求意味着目标存储类别仍需能够即时提供文件——这就是标准归档（Standard-IA）。文件大小被提及是有原因的：标准归档（Standard-IA）有最低计费对象大小为128 KB，且"至少128 KB"的条件证实了不存在小对象超额计费的问题。
选项 A：将对象直接放入标准归档（Standard-IA）是不划算的——在前90天内它们被频繁下载，而标准归档（Standard-IA）按每GB检索计费。此外，标准归档（Standard-IA）有30天的最低存储时长。
选项 B：智能分层（Intelligent-Tiering）在30天无访问后移动对象，其阈值无法设置为90天。在数百万个文件上，它还会为每个对象每月增加监控费用。
选项 C：S3 Inventory 是存储桶内容的CSV或Parquet报告。它本身不会移动任何对象——移动对象仍需要生命周期规则或批量操作。

options.text: Configure S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage for the initial storage tier of the objects.
Move the files to S3 Intelligent-Tiering and configure it to move objects to a less expensive storage tier after 90 days.
Configure S3 inventory to manage objects and move them to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard- 1A) after 90 days.
Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy that moves the objects from S3 Standard to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-1A) after 90 days.

question_text:
A company needs to save the results from a medical trial to an Amazon S3 repository. The repository must allow a few scientists to add new files and must restrict all other users to read-only access. No users can have the ability to modify or delete any files in the repository. The company must keep every file in the repository for a minimum of 1 year after its creation date.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
三个要求由不同的机制处理，但决定性的是"没有任何用户能够修改或删除任何文件"，并且文件从创建日期起至少保留一年。唯一能够确保管理员或 root 无法绕过的保障是 S3 Object Lock 在合规模式下的 365 天保留期。少数科学家获得写入权限，其他人获得只读权限，这部分通过普通的存储桶策略实现——该要求是独立的，不影响选项的选择。另外请注意区别：保留期与对象版本的创建日期相关联，而法律持有没有到期日期，需通过单独的权限手动移除。
选项 A：治理模式可以常规地通过 s3:BypassGovernanceRetention 权限绕过，且"一年的法律持有"并不是一个真实构造：法律持有没有持续时间，会一直保持直到被手动移除。
选项 C：角色和存储桶策略控制谁可以执行什么操作。编写这些策略的人也可以修改它们，因此它们不提供不可变性。
选项 D：由 Lambda 函数计算的哈希值仅在事后记录对象已被修改的事实。该要求是防止修改，而不是在修改发生后检测它。

options.text: Use S3 Object Lock in governance mode with a legal hold of 1 year.
Use S3 Object Lock in compliance mode with a retention period of 365 days.
Use an IAM role to restrict all users from deleting or changing objects in the S3 bucket. Use an S3 bucket policy to only allow the IAM role.

Configure the S3 bucket to invoke an AWS Lambda function every time an object is added. Configure the function to track the hash of the saved object so that modified objects can be marked accordingly.

question_text:
A large media company hosts a web application on AWS. The company wants to start caching confidential media files so that users around the world will have reliable access to the files. The content is stored in Amazon S3 buckets. The company must deliver the content quickly, regardless of where the requests originate geographically.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
目标是快速将文件交付给全球用户，同时保持内容的机密性。CloudFront 在边缘位置缓存对象，因此请求能够靠近用户被处理，并通过源访问控制限制对存储桶的访问：没有人可以直接访问 S3 —— 文件仅通过分发进行服务，其中可以启用签名 URL 或签名 Cookie。
选项 A：DataSync 在存储系统之间复制数据，不是用于向最终用户交付内容的工具。
选项 B：Global Accelerator 优化应用程序的网络路径，但它不缓存对象，也不将 S3 作为内容源使用。
选项 D：SQS 是一个消息队列，与交付媒体文件无关。

options.text: Use AWS DataSync to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
Deploy AWS Global Accelerator to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.
Deploy Amazon CloudFront to connect the S3 buckets to CloudFront edge servers.
Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to connect the S3 buckets to the web application.

question_text:
A company produces batch data that comes from different databases. The company also produces live stream data from network sensors and application APIs. The company needs to consolidate all the data into one place for business analytics. The company needs to process the incoming data and then stage the data in different Amazon S3 buckets. Teams will later run one-time queries and import the data into a business intelligence tool to show key performance indicators (KPIs).
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
数据既以批处理的形式从数据库中到达，也以流的形式从传感器中到达，所有数据都需要以最小的努力集中到一个地方。AWS Lake Formation中的蓝图描述了常见的数据摄入场景，AWS Glue作业会爬取源数据并将数据以Apache Parquet格式存储到S3中（E）。针对该数据的单次查询通过Athena执行，QuickSight则构建KPI仪表板（A）.
选项 B：Kinesis Data Analytics对流进行实时处理——它不会对已经存储在S3中的数据运行单次查询。
选项 C：为移动单个记录而编写自定义函数意味着需要编写和维护代码，而Redshift在这里是过度设计。
选项 D：JSON在查询成本上不如Parquet，且多个OpenSearch集群是不必要的、昂贵的基础设施。

options.text: Use Amazon Athena for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics for one-time queries. Use Amazon QuickSight to create dashboards for KPIs.
Create custom AWS Lambda functions to move the individual records from the databases to an Amazon Redshift cluster.
Use an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the data into JSON format. Load the data into multiple Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service) clusters.

Use blueprints in AWS Lake Formation to identify the data that can be ingested into a data lake. Use AWS Glue to crawl the source, extract the data, and load the data into Amazon S3 in Apache Parquet format.

question_text:
A company stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster. The company must store all the data for 5 years and must delete all the data after 5 years. The company also must indefinitely keep audit logs of actions that are performed within the database. Currently, the company has automated backups configured for Aurora.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
有两个要求。存储数据五年后删除：Aurora的自动备份最多仅限35天，因此需要使用AWS Backup，制定计划并设置五年保留期（E）。对数据库内执行的操作进行无限期审计日志记录：为集群启用CloudWatch Logs导出，其中日志组的保留时间可设置为永不过期（D）。
选项 A：手动快照是单点时间捕获，不是持续五年的保留策略。
选项 B：Aurora的自动备份没有生命周期策略——其保留时间最多仅限35天。
选项 C：自动备份无法配置五年的保留期——限制是35天。

options.text: Take a manual snapshot of the DB cluster.
Create a lifecycle policy for the automated backups.
Configure automated backup retention for 5 years.
Configure an Amazon CloudWatch Logs export for the DB cluster.
Use AWS Backup to take the backups and to keep the backups for 5 years.

question_text:
A solutions architect is optimizing a website for an upcoming musical event. Videos of the performances will be streamed in real time and then will be available on demand. The event is expected to attract a global online audience.
Which service will improve the performance of both the real-time and on-demand streaming?
explanation_en:
CloudFront 可以加速实时流媒体和点播播放：视频片段（HLS 或 DASH）会被缓存到边缘节点，因此该区域内的数千名观众可以直接从本地获取，而不是从源服务器获取。对于实时活动，这还能保护源服务器免受相同片段大量请求的冲击。其他服务则解决不同的问题：Global Accelerator 可以加速 TCP 和 UDP 应用程序，Route 53 负责 DNS 路由，而 S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以加速向 S3 的上传。
选项 B：Global Accelerator 优化应用程序端点的路径，但它不缓存内容，而缓存正是在大规模视频流媒体场景下带来显著收益的关键因素。
选项 C：Route 53 仅将客户端路由到正确的资源，而不会改变内容分发本身的性能。
选项 D：Transfer Acceleration 加速文件上传到存储桶，而不是将视频传递给观众。

options.text: Amazon CloudFront
AWS Global Accelerator
Amazon Route 53
Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration

question_text:
A company is running a publicly accessible serverless application that uses Amazon API Gateway and AWS Lambda. The application’s traffic recently spiked due to fraudulent requests from botnets.
Which steps should a solutions architect take to block requests from unauthorized users? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
目标是通过两个互补的控制措施，在请求到达 Lambda 之前，在入口点阻止未经授权方的请求。一个带有 API 密钥的使用计划（A）将合法用户与其他所有人区分开来：没有密钥，API Gateway 本身会拒绝请求，这同时也支持配额和限流。AWS WAF（C）会过滤所有到达的内容，无论是否携带密钥：基于 IP 地址、地理区域、针对机器人网络的速率规则，以及管理规则组。两种方案都在函数被调用之前阻止了流量，因此 Lambda 账单不会增长。
选项 B：在函数内部进行过滤意味着你已经为每一次欺诈性请求支付了 Lambda 调用费用，并消耗了其并发资源。过滤必须在入口点进行。
选项 D：私有 API 只能从 VPC 内部访问——公共应用将导致合法用户无法使用。
选项 E：为公共应用的每个访问者创建一个 IAM 角色是不可行的：访问者没有 AWS 账户。

options.text: Create a usage plan with an API key that is shared with genuine users only.
Integrate logic within the Lambda function to ignore the requests from fraudulent IP addresses.
Implement an AWS WAF rule to target malicious requests and trigger actions to filter them out.
Convert the existing public API to a private API. Update the DNS records to redirect users to the new API endpoint.
Create an IAM role for each user attempting to access the API. A user will assume the role when making the API call.

question_text:
An ecommerce company hosts its analytics application in the AWS Cloud. The application generates about 300 MB of data each month. The data is stored in JSON format. The company is evaluating a disaster recovery solution to back up the data. The data must be accessible in milliseconds if it is needed, and the data must be kept for 30 days.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
这个卷非常小 — 每月仅 300 MB — 数据必须保存 30 天，且访问必须在毫秒级别。S3 标准存储类提供即时访问，且在此体积下成本仅几美分，而归档类别的最低存储期限和检索费用在一个月的时间范围内使其经济性极差。
选项 A：OpenSearch 是一个搜索集群，按持续运行的节点收费：对于备份而言成本过高。
选项 B：Glacier 存储更便宜，但检索需要几分钟到几小时，而需求是毫秒级。
选项 D：PostgreSQL 数据库的 RDS 按小时计费，且设计用于查询，而非存储 JSON 文件备份。

options.text: Amazon OpenSearch Service (Amazon Elasticsearch Service)
Amazon S3 Glacier
Amazon S3 Standard
Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL

question_text:
A company has a small Python application that processes JSON documents and outputs the results to an on-premises SQL database. The application runs thousands of times each day. The company wants to move the application to the AWS Cloud. The company needs a highly available solution that maximizes scalability and minimizes operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该应用程序规模较小，每天被触发数千次，每次由文档到达触发。通过 S3 事件通知调用的 Lambda 函数实现了高可用性、可扩展性和接近零运维开销：您仅按实际执行时间付费。处理结果被写入一个受管理的 Aurora DB 集群中。
选项 A：一组实例全天候计费，需要打补丁和扩展，对于每天成千上万次的短时调用来说，这种方案并不合适。
选项 C：EBS 多挂载仅限于单个可用区，并且需要集群感知文件系统：这是所有选项中最为复杂且可扩展性最差的方案。
选项 D：基于 EC2 启动类型的一个 ECS 集群仍然意味着需要管理计算节点，而该工作负载完全适合无服务器、事件驱动的执行模式。

options.text: Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Run the Python code on multiple Amazon EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.

Place the JSON documents in an Amazon S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function that runs the Python code to process the documents as they arrive in the S3 bucket. Store the results in an Amazon Aurora DB cluster.

Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Use the EBS Multi- Attach feature to attach the volume to multiple Amazon EC2 instances. Run the Python code on the EC2 instances to process the documents. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance.

Place the JSON documents in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as messages. Deploy the Python code as a container on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster that is configured with the Amazon EC2 launch type. Use the container to process the SQS messages. Store the results on an Amazon RDS DB instance.

question_text:
A company wants to use high performance computing (HPC) infrastructure on AWS for financial risk modeling. The company’s HPC workloads run on Linux. Each HPC workflow runs on hundreds of Amazon EC2 Spot Instances, is short-lived, and generates thousands of output files that are ultimately stored in persistent storage for analytics and long-term future use.
The company seeks a cloud storage solution that permits the copying of on-premises data to long-term persistent storage to make data available for processing by all EC2 instances. The solution should also be a high performance file system that is integrated with persistent storage to read and write datasets and output files.
Which combination of AWS services meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
需要两个相关组件：一个用于数百个实例的高性能文件系统，以及持久化存储，用于长期保存结果。Amazon FSx for Lustre 可以直接与 S3 集成：一个存储桶与文件系统关联，其对象表现为文件，作业输出会导出回 S3。这是在中断型实例上运行 HPC 工作负载的标准模式——文件系统独立于短暂的实例集群存在。
选项 B：FSx for Windows File Server 使用 SMB 协议，专为 Windows 工作负载设计，而计算任务在 Linux 上运行，需要 Lustre 级别的性能。
选项 C：Glacier 是一种归档存储，检索时间以分钟到小时计，因此无法作为计算任务的运行存储，且 EBS 卷无法在数百个实例之间共享。
选项 D：S3 本身不是文件系统，且一个 gp2 EBS 卷只能附加到单个实例上：数百台机器无法同时使用它。

options.text: Amazon FSx for Lustre integrated with Amazon S3
Amazon FSx for Windows File Server integrated with Amazon S3
Amazon S3 Glacier integrated with Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
Amazon S3 bucket with a VPC endpoint integrated with an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) General Purpose SSD (gp2) volume

question_text:
A company is building a containerized application on premises and decides to move the application to AWS. The application will have thousands of users soon after it is deployed. The company is unsure how to manage the deployment of containers at scale. The company needs to deploy the containerized application in a highly available architecture that minimizes operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
所需的是图像存储、无需管理节点的编排，以及自动扩展。容器镜像存储在 Amazon ECR 中，使用 ECS 集群的 AWS Fargate 启动类型运行容器，无需管理单个实例，且通过目标跟踪策略根据需求自动扩展。高可用性来自将任务分布在多个可用区中。
选项 B：Amazon EC2 启动类型会重新引入节点管理：补丁、扩展和监控工作重新落在团队身上。
选项 C：在 EC2 实例上部署自托管注册表，并根据需要手动启动新实例，是最大操作投入和风险。
选项 D：将容器镜像打包进 AMI 并手动扩展 EC2 实例，意味着完全放弃了容器编排。

options.text: Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the AWS Fargate launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand.

Store container images in an Amazon Elastic Container Registry (Amazon ECR) repository. Use an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Amazon EC2 launch type to run the containers. Use target tracking to scale automatically based on demand.

Store container images in a repository that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance. Run the containers on EC2 instances that are spread across multiple Availability Zones. Monitor the average CPU utilization in Amazon CloudWatch. Launch new EC2 instances as needed.

Create an Amazon EC2 Amazon Machine Image (AMI) that contains the container image. Launch EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon CloudWatch alarm to scale out EC2 instances when the average CPU utilization threshold is breached.

question_text:
A company has two applications: a sender application that sends messages with payloads to be processed and a processing application intended to receive the messages with payloads. The company wants to implement an AWS service to handle messages between the two applications. The sender application can send about 1,000 messages each hour. The messages may take up to 2 days to be processed: If the messages fail to process, they must be retained so that they do not impact the processing of any remaining messages.
Which solution meets these requirements and is the MOST operationally efficient?
explanation_en:
每小时大约一千条消息，处理时间可能长达两天，并且需要确保失败的消息不会影响其余消息 —— 这是 Amazon SQS 队列的经典应用场景。其消息保留期最长可达 14 天，足以覆盖两天的处理窗口，而死信队列会收集那些未能成功处理的消息，而不会阻塞其余消息。
选项 A：一个自管理的 Redis 实例是一台你需要自行操作的机器，再加上你需要自己构建的存储/处理/删除逻辑。
选项 B：Kinesis 是为按顺序进行流式处理而设计的；它没有内置机制来隔离并单独保留单个失败的记录，并且集成 KCL 需要你自己编写消费者代码。
选项 D：SNS 立即发送通知，并不会将消息保留两天：如果订阅者不可用，消息将丢失。

options.text: Set up an Amazon EC2 instance running a Redis database. Configure both applications to use the instance. Store, process, and delete the messages, respectively.
Use an Amazon Kinesis data stream to receive the messages from the sender application. Integrate the processing application with the Kinesis Client Library (KCL).
Integrate the sender and processor applications with an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Configure a dead-letter queue to collect the messages that failed to process.
Subscribe the processing application to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive notifications to process. Integrate the sender application to write to the SNS topic.

question_text:
A solutions architect must design a solution that uses Amazon CloudFront with an Amazon S3 origin to store a static website. The company’s security policy requires that all website traffic be inspected by AWS WAF.
How should the solutions architect comply with these requirements?
explanation_en:
对于所有网站流量要真正经过 WAF 检查，必须满足两个条件。首先，WAF 必须在 CloudFront 分发本身上启用（一个 web ACL）——这样每个请求都会在边缘位置被检查。其次，必须阻止对存储桶的直接访问，否则请求可能会完全绕过 CloudFront 和 WAF；这是通过一个源访问身份（今天是源访问控制）实现的，存储桶策略仅允许从该身份进行读取。
选项 A：AWS WAF 没有可以被引用在存储桶策略中的 ARN 主体：它从未与源进行通信。是 CloudFront 向 S3 发起请求。
选项 B：CloudFront 并不 "将请求转发给 WAF"：一个 web ACL 与分发相关联，并在接触源之前立即检查请求。
选项 C：安全组不适用于 Amazon S3 — 它是一个具有公共 API 的服务。通过限制访问到 CloudFront 的 IP 地址来限制访问并不是这样设计的。

options.text: Configure an S3 bucket policy to accept requests coming from the AWS WAF Amazon Resource Name (ARN) only.
Configure Amazon CloudFront to forward all incoming requests to AWS WAF before requesting content from the S3 origin.
Configure a security group that allows Amazon CloudFront IP addresses to access Amazon S3 only. Associate AWS WAF to CloudFront.
Configure Amazon CloudFront and Amazon S3 to use an origin access identity (OAI) to restrict access to the S3 bucket. Enable AWS WAF on the distribution.

question_text:
Organizers for a global event want to put daily reports online as static HTML pages. The pages are expected to generate millions of views from users around the world. The files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket. A solutions architect has been asked to design an efficient and effective solution.
Which action should the solutions architect take to accomplish this?
explanation_en:
数以百万计的相同静态页面的访问是 CDN 的经典应用场景。CloudFront 以 S3 存储桶作为源站，在边缘位置缓存这些页面，因此绝大多数请求都不会到达存储桶：延迟降低，出站数据传输成本降低，源站负载也降低。存储桶还通过源站访问控制机制被限制，防止直接访问。
选项 A：预签名 URL 是一种用于临时访问私有对象的机制。它并不能加快内容分发，也不适用于公开页面。
选项 B：跨区域复制到每个区域意味着需要为存储支付多个副本的费用，并且需要手动管理路由，而 CDN 缓存以更低的成本实现了相同的效果。
选项 C：Route 53 的地理就近功能将用户分布到多个源站，但在此场景中只有一个源站，且这种路由策略不提供缓存功能。

options.text: Generate presigned URLs for the files.
Use cross-Region replication to all Regions.
Use the geoproximity feature of Amazon Route 53.
Use Amazon CloudFront with the S3 bucket as its origin.

question_text:
A company runs a production application on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The application reads the data from an Amazon SQS queue and processes the messages in parallel. The message volume is unpredictable and often has intermittent traffic. This application should continually process messages without any downtime.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
该应用程序必须持续处理，不能出现任何中断，且流量不可预测且经常间歇性出现。稳定的基线容量由折扣后的预留实例覆盖，而流量峰值则由按需实例处理，但这些按需实例无法收回。可中断容量不适用于此场景："无中断"的要求与随时可能被收回的实例是不兼容的。
选项 A：为整个最大容量使用竞价实例，存在同时被收回的风险，将导致处理中断。
选项 B：全年预留整个最大容量意味着为仅在部分时间需要的容量支付超额费用。
选项 C：虽然更便宜，但竞价实例再次与必须持续处理消息且不能中断的要求相冲突。

options.text: Use Spot Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required.
Use Reserved Instances exclusively to handle the maximum capacity required.
Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use Spot Instances to handle additional capacity.
Use Reserved Instances for the baseline capacity and use On-Demand Instances to handle additional capacity.

question_text:
A security team wants to limit access to specific services or actions in all of the team’s AWS accounts. All accounts belong to a large organization in AWS Organizations. The solution must be scalable and there must be a single point where permissions can be maintained.
What should a solutions architect do to accomplish this?
explanation_en:
目标是，从单一位置对组织中的每个账户限制一组服务和操作，且这种限制无法被本地管理员撤销。这正是服务控制策略（SCP）所实现的：SCP 被附加到组织的根节点（或一个组织单元 OU）上，并为每个成员账户中的每个主体设定权限上限，包括该账户的根用户。需要理解的关键机制是：SCP 从不授予任何权限，它只进行限制。有效的权限是 SCP 与 IAM 策略的交集。
选项 A：AWS 中的 ACL 指的是网络子网访问控制列表，以及一个遗留的 S3 访问机制。两者都无法跨所有账户管理服务级别的权限。
选项 B：安全组用于过滤实例之间的网络流量。它与 API 调用的权限无关。
选项 C：跨账户角色必须在每个账户中创建和维护，且它们无法阻止本地管理员直接操作。不存在单一的控制点。

options.text: Create an ACL to provide access to the services or actions.
Create a security group to allow accounts and attach it to user groups.
Create cross-account roles in each account to deny access to the services or actions.
Create a service control policy in the root organizational unit to deny access to the services or actions.

question_text:
A company is concerned about the security of its public web application due to recent web attacks. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect must reduce the risk of DDoS attacks against the application.
What should the solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
要求是直接的：降低针对 ALB 后方应用的 DDoS 攻击风险。已订阅 AWS Shield Advanced 以保护您希望防护的资源（ALB、CloudFront、Global Accelerator、Route 53、Elastic IP），并提供网络层和应用层的自动缓解措施、访问 DDoS 响应团队以及在遭受攻击期间防止账单激增的成本保护。Shield Standard 已经默认启用，但不具备这些高级功能。
选项 A：Amazon Inspector 扫描实例和镜像以检测漏洞；它没有 "代理" 可附加到负载均衡器，并且无法提供对攻击的防护。
选项 B：Amazon Macie 在 S3 中查找敏感数据。它与 DDoS 防护无关。
选项 D：GuardDuty 检测可疑活动，但它不会吸收攻击流量。

options.text: Add an Amazon Inspector agent to the ALB.
Configure Amazon Macie to prevent attacks.
Enable AWS Shield Advanced to prevent attacks.
Configure Amazon GuardDuty to monitor the ALB.

question_text:
A company’s web application is running on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The company recently changed its policy, which now requires the application to be accessed from one specific country only.
Which configuration will meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
限制访问到一个特定国家是应用层规则，因为国家是通过地理位置数据库从源 IP 地址确定的。AWS WAF 正具有这种能力：地理匹配语句可以阻止或允许来自特定国家的请求，且 Web ACL 被附加到应用负载均衡器上。安全组和网络 ACL 操作于地址范围和端口，对国家一无所知——手动维护一个国家的整个子网列表是不现实的。
选项 A：EC2 实例的安全组接收来自负载均衡器的流量，而不是来自客户端，它基于 CIDR 范围工作，而不是国家。
选项 B：负载均衡器的安全组也基于地址范围工作：在其中列出一个国家的每个子网是不可行的。
选项 D：网络 ACL 是子网级别的地址和端口过滤器，具有规则数量的硬性限制。无法使用它来实现地理封锁。

options.text: Configure the security group for the EC2 instances.
Configure the security group on the Application Load Balancer.
Configure AWS WAF on the Application Load Balancer in a VPC.
Configure the network ACL for the subnet that contains the EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company provides an API to its users that automates inquiries for tax computations based on item prices. The company experiences a larger number of inquiries during the holiday season only that cause slower response times. A solutions architect needs to design a solution that is scalable and elastic.
What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?
explanation_en:
在节假日期间流量急剧上升，其余时间几乎不存在。API Gateway 与 Lambda 函数能够即时扩展，并且仅按实际调用次数计费：无需容量规划，也无需空闲服务器。
选项 A：单个实例完全无法扩展，在节日期间会成为瓶颈。
选项 C：两台机器后置负载均衡器代表固定容量，要么无法处理峰值，要么全年大部分时间处于空闲状态。
选项 D：将 API Gateway 放在实例前面仅增加了一层：计算仍然被单台机器限制。

options.text: Provide an API hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance performs the required computations when the API request is made.
Design a REST API using Amazon API Gateway that accepts the item names. API Gateway passes item names to AWS Lambda for tax computations.
Create an Application Load Balancer that has two Amazon EC2 instances behind it. The EC2 instances will compute the tax on the received item names.
Design a REST API using Amazon API Gateway that connects with an API hosted on an Amazon EC2 instance. API Gateway accepts and passes the item names to the EC2 instance for tax computations.

question_text:
A solutions architect is creating a new Amazon CloudFront distribution for an application. Some of the information submitted by users is sensitive. The application uses HTTPS but needs another layer of security. The sensitive information should.be protected throughout the entire application stack, and access to the information should be restricted to certain applications.
Which action should the solutions architect take?
explanation_en:
HTTPS 仅保护传输中的数据：在负载均衡器和后续栈中，数据会被再次解密。CloudFront 的字段级加密使用公共密钥在边缘位置直接对特定表单字段进行加密，因此敏感值在整个路径中始终保持加密状态，只有持有匹配私钥的应用程序才能解密它们。
选项 A：一个签名 URL 限制了对分发内容的访问，但对用户提交的数据没有任何保护作用。
选项 B：签名 Cookie 解决了相同的内容访问限制问题，与字段级加密无关。
选项 D：协议设置仅提供传输中的加密——这与场景中已存在的加密层相同，且已被认为是不足的。

options.text: Configure a CloudFront signed URL.
Configure a CloudFront signed cookie.
Configure a CloudFront field-level encryption profile.
Configure CloudFront and set the Origin Protocol Policy setting to HTTPS Only for the Viewer Protocol Policy.

question_text:
A gaming company hosts a browser-based application on AWS. The users of the application consume a large number of videos and images that are stored in Amazon S3. This content is the same for all users.
The application has increased in popularity, and millions of users worldwide accessing these media files. The company wants to provide the files to the users while reducing the load on the origin.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
文件对每个用户都相同，受众是全球性的，需要减少源端的负载，并且成本至关重要。CloudFront 位于存储桶前面，会在边缘位置缓存对象，因此绝大多数请求都不会到达 S3：由于流量由 CloudFront 提供服务，源端负载和出站流量成本均降低，因为从 CloudFront 服务的流量比直接从 S3 服务的流量更便宜。
选项 A：全球加速器优化网络路径，但不会缓存对象：源端的负载保持不变。
选项 C：Redis 在单个区域内部存数据，不适用于向全球受众提供大型媒体文件。
选项 D：Memcached 也有同样的缺点：它是一个区域性的内存缓存，而不是内容分发网络。

options.text: Deploy an AWS Global Accelerator accelerator in front of the web servers.
Deploy an Amazon CloudFront web distribution in front of the S3 bucket.
Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis instance in front of the web servers.
Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached instance in front of the web servers.

question_text:
A company has a multi-tier application that runs six front-end web servers in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). A solutions architect needs to modify the infrastructure to be highly available without modifying the application.
Which architecture should the solutions architect choose that provides high availability?
explanation_en:
单个弱点是所有六台机器都位于同一个可用区。只需将自动扩展组跨两个可用区部署，每个可用区部署三台实例即可：负载均衡器已经能够跨多个可用区工作，应用程序无需更改，且单个可用区故障时仍会保留一半的容量。
选项 A：多个区域解决了不同的问题，并需要重建路由和数据复制——超过了实际需求，且会触及应用程序。
选项 C：一个用于在另一个区域快速创建实例的模板是一种恢复计划，而不是高可用性方案。
选项 D：应用负载均衡器已经负责请求的分发；分发算法在单个区域故障时并不能提供帮助。

options.text: Create an Auto Scaling group that uses three instances across each of two Regions.
Modify the Auto Scaling group to use three instances across each of two Availability Zones.
Create an Auto Scaling template that can be used to quickly create more instances in another Region.
Change the ALB in front of the Amazon EC2 instances in a round-robin configuration to balance traffic to the web tier.

question_text:
An ecommerce company has an order-processing application that uses Amazon API Gateway and an AWS Lambda function. The application stores data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database. During a recent sales event, a sudden surge in customer orders occurred. Some customers experienced timeouts, and the application did not process the orders of those customers.
A solutions architect determined that the CPU utilization and memory utilization were high on the database because of a large number of open connections. The solutions architect needs to prevent the timeout errors while making the least possible changes to the application.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
诊断直接在场景中给出：对数据库的连接过多。在流量激增时，Lambda 会启动数百个并发实例，每个实例都打开自己的连接，导致 Aurora 过载。RDS Proxy 维持一个持久连接池，并在函数调用之间复用这些连接——这一变更仅涉及函数所使用的端点地址的替换。
选项 A：预置并发可以加快冷启动，但不会减少连接数量，且全局数据库解决的是一个完全不同的问题——跨区域灾难恢复。
选项 C：只使用只读副本无济于事：问题在于连接，包括写入连接，而 API Gateway 通过查询字符串参数进行路由意味着需要重构应用程序。
选项 D：迁移到 DynamoDB 意味着需要重写数据模型和每个查询，这直接与要求的最小变更相冲突。

options.text: Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function. Modify the database to be a global database in multiple AWS Regions.
Use Amazon RDS Proxy to create a proxy for the database. Modify the Lambda function to use the RDS Proxy endpoint instead of the database endpoint.
Create a read replica for the database in a different AWS Region. Use query string parameters in API Gateway to route traffic to the read replica.
Migrate the data from Aurora PostgreSQL to Amazon DynamoDB by using AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS). Modify the Lambda function to use the DynamoDB table.

question_text:
An application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. The application needs to access an Amazon DynamoDB table.
What is the MOST secure way to access the table while ensuring that the traffic does not leave the AWS network?
explanation_en:
DynamoDB 的私有访问来自于一个网关端点：将服务前缀的路由添加到私有子网的路由表中，流量永远不会离开 AWS 网络，并且端点策略限制了对所需表的访问。端点本身没有费用。
选项 B：NAT 网关会将流量发送到互联网——这违反了必须留在 AWS 网络内的要求，并且会为处理的数据产生费用。
选项 C：NAT 实例位于公共子网中，仍然会将流量路由到互联网；从私有子网也无法正常工作。
选项 D：互联网网关是通往互联网的直接路径——这与要求相反。

options.text: Use a VPC endpoint for DynamoDB.
Use a NAT gateway in a public subnet.
Use a NAT instance in a private subnet.
Use the internet gateway attached to the VPC.

question_text:
An entertainment company is using Amazon DynamoDB to store media metadata. The application is read intensive and experiencing delays.
