options.text: Use Amazon S3 to host the front-end layer. Use AWS Lambda functions for the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use Amazon S3 to store and serve users’ images.

Use load-balanced Multi-AZ AWS Elastic Beanstalk environments for the front-end layer and the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon RDS DB instance with multiple read replicas to serve users’ images.

Use Amazon S3 to host the front-end layer. Use a fleet of EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group for the application layer. Move the database to a memory optimized instance type to store and serve users’ images.

Use load-balanced Multi-AZ AWS Elastic Beanstalk environments for the front-end layer and the application layer. Move the database to an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance. Use Amazon S3 to store and serve users’ images.

question_text:
An application running on an Amazon EC2 instance in VPC-A needs to access files in another EC2 instance in VPC-
B. Both VPCs are in separate AWS accounts. The network administrator needs to design a solution to configure secure access to EC2 instance in VPC-B from VPC-A. The connectivity should not have a single point of failure or bandwidth concerns.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
不同账户之间的网络需要私有连接，且不能存在单点故障，也不能有带宽限制。VPC对等连接满足所有这些需求：它是AWS网络本身的一个托管功能，没有中间设备可能失效，并且没有隧道通常存在的带宽限制。
选项 B：网关端点提供对S3和DynamoDB等服务的访问，而不是对其他账户VPC中的实例的访问。
选项 C：虚拟私有网关是用于将您的本地站点通过VPN或Direct Connect连接起来的接入点——它不用于连接两个VPC。
选项 D：私有虚拟接口属于Direct Connect，是为数据中心的连接创建的，而不是用于两个VPC之间的连接。

options.text: Set up a VPC peering connection between VPC-A and VPC-B.
Set up VPC gateway endpoints for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B.
Attach a virtual private gateway to VPC-B and set up routing from VPC-A.
Create a private virtual interface (VIF) for the EC2 instance running in VPC-B and add appropriate routes from VPC-A.

question_text:
A company wants to experiment with individual AWS accounts for its engineer team. The company wants to be notified as soon as the Amazon EC2 instance usage for a given month exceeds a specific threshold for each account.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
当某个月份的 EC2 使用量超过阈值时，需要发出通知，并且尽可能以最低成本实现。AWS Budgets 正是为此设计的：一个具有月度周期的预算，过滤到 EC2 服务，设置警报阈值，并将通知发送到 SNS 主题。账户中的前两个预算免费，超过部分按每天计费，以美分为单位。Cost Explorer 和 CUR 是分析工具——它们不会在阈值被超过时发送通知。
选项 A：Cost Explorer 可以生成报告，但无法在阈值被超过时发送通知——这才是 Budgets 的用途。
选项 B：同样的错误：Cost Explorer 报告不是一种通知机制。
选项 D：CUR、Athena 和定时查询的组合可以实现，但涉及多个服务、自定义查询，并且需要为扫描付费，而仅使用预算即可完成。

options.text: Use Cost Explorer to create a daily report of costs by service. Filter the report by EC2 instances. Configure Cost Explorer to send an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) notification when a threshold is exceeded.

Use Cost Explorer to create a monthly report of costs by service. Filter the report by EC2 instances. Configure Cost Explorer to send an Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) notification when a threshold is exceeded.

Use AWS Budgets to create a cost budget for each account. Set the period to monthly. Set the scope to EC2 instances. Set an alert threshold for the budget. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive a notification when a threshold is exceeded.

Use AWS Cost and Usage Reports to create a report with hourly granularity. Integrate the report data with Amazon Athena. Use Amazon EventBridge to schedule an Athena query. Configure an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to receive a notification when a threshold is exceeded.

question_text:
A solutions architect needs to design a new microservice for a company’s application. Clients must be able to call an HTTPS endpoint to reach the microservice. The microservice also must use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) to authenticate calls. The solutions architect will write the logic for this microservice by using a single AWS Lambda function that is written in Go 1.x.
Which solution will deploy the function in the MOST operationally efficient way?
explanation_en:
原答案：A；来源修正答案：B。
Lambda Function URL 提供单个函数的 HTTPS 端点，并支持 AWS_IAM 验证；本题没有需要 API Gateway 额外功能的条件，所以 B 比原答案 A 更省运维。
一个用于单个函数的单个 HTTPS 终端点，需要 IAM 认证。这正是 AWS_IAM 认证类型（B）的 Lambda 函数 URL 所提供的：无需额外服务，且终端点与函数一起创建。
选项 A：API Gateway 上的 IAM 认证在技术上是可行的，但它引入了一个必须配置、版本化并付费的服务。需求中并未涉及路由、API 密钥或限流——因此这是一个不必要的层级。
选项 C：Lambda@Edge 需要一个 CloudFront 分发，且认证逻辑必须手动编写——在所有选项中这是最繁琐的工作。
选项 D：CloudFront Functions 在两个方面都失败：它们是轻量级的 JavaScript 函数，用于编辑头部且没有网络访问权限，且它们不支持 AWS_IAM 认证类型。

options.text: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API. Configure the method to use the Lambda function. Enable IAM authentication on the API.
Create a Lambda function URL for the function. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to [email protected] Integrate IAM authentication logic into the [email protected] function.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Deploy the function to CloudFront Functions. Specify AWS_IAM as the authentication type.

question_text:
A company previously migrated its data warehouse solution to AWS. The company also has an AWS Direct Connect connection. Corporate office users query the data warehouse using a visualization tool. The average size of a query returned by the data warehouse is 50 MB and each webpage sent by the visualization tool is approximately 500 KB. Result sets returned by the data warehouse are not cached.
Which solution provides the LOWEST data transfer egress cost for the company?
explanation_en:
费用仅适用于离开 AWS 的流量。如果可视化工具运行在与数据仓库相同的区域，50 MB 的查询结果根本不会离开 AWS —— 只有 500 KB 的网页会流出，数据量减少一百倍。此外，这种出站流量通过 Direct Connect 路由，每吉字节的费率明显低于互联网费率。
选项 A：本地工具会将每个查询的完整 50 MB 结果从 AWS 拉出，并在此基础上叠加最昂贵的互联网费率。这是最差的选项。
选项 B：位置正确且出站流量较小，但互联网流量的成本高于通过 Direct Connect 的流量。
选项 C：连接成本低于互联网，但完整的查询结果仍然会流出 —— 数据量是网页的百倍。

options.text: Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over the internet.
Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse. Access it over the internet.
Host the visualization tool on premises and query the data warehouse directly over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same AWS Region.
Host the visualization tool in the same AWS Region as the data warehouse and access it over a Direct Connect connection at a location in the same Region.

question_text:
An online learning company is migrating to the AWS Cloud. The company maintains its student records in a PostgreSQL database. The company needs a solution in which its data is available and online across multiple AWS Regions at all times.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
explanation_en:
数据必须始终在线，在多个区域中保持可用，且操作开销最小。通过单个操作创建另一个区域中的 RDS 读取副本，持续接收变更，可供查询，并在需要时可提升为独立数据库。
选项 A：在实例上自行管理的 PostgreSQL 集群是维护工作量最大的方案。
选项 B：多可用区（Multi-AZ）操作仅在单个区域内部进行：其他区域中不会有数据。
选项 D：将快照复制到另一个区域并不能提供在线访问：数据库仍需首先从这些快照中恢复。

options.text: Migrate the PostgreSQL database to a PostgreSQL cluster on Amazon EC2 instances.
Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance with the Multi-AZ feature turned on.
Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Create a read replica in another Region.
Migrate the PostgreSQL database to an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. Set up DB snapshots to be copied to another Region.

question_text:
A company hosts its web application on AWS using seven Amazon EC2 instances. The company requires that the IP addresses of all healthy EC2 instances be returned in response to DNS queries.
Which policy should be used to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
要求是将所有健康实例的地址返回到 DNS 响应中。这是多值答案路由策略的作用：Route 53 返回最多八个记录，每个记录都与自身的健康检查相关联，不健康的实例会被排除在响应之外。
选项 A：简单路由策略直接返回记录，不支持健康检查。
选项 B：延迟路由策略会选择一个延迟最低的区域，而不是返回完整的列表。
选项 D：基于地理位置的路由策略根据客户端的位置选择响应，不会返回所有健康地址的列表。

options.text: Simple routing policy
Latency routing policy
Multivalue routing policy
Geolocation routing policy

question_text:
A medical research lab produces data that is related to a new study. The lab wants to make the data available with minimum latency to clinics across the country for their on-premises, file-based applications. The data files are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket that has read-only permissions for each clinic.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
诊所需要基于文件的访问方式来获取存储在 S3 中的数据，并且在本地需要最小延迟。在每个诊所部署了一个文件网关作为虚拟机：它向本地应用程序呈现一个熟悉的 NFS 或 SMB 共享，该共享由 S3 存储桶支持，并且会将频繁读取的文件缓存到本地。应用程序无需更改，延迟由本地缓存控制。
选项 B：DataSync 是用于一次性或周期性传输的工具，而不是持续的文件访问。将整个数据集复制到每个诊所是浪费资源的，并且无法提供单一数据源。
选项 C：一个卷网关通过 iSCSI 提供块卷，而诊所的应用程序是基于文件工作的。
选项 D：一个 EFS 文件系统无法通过互联网在任意本地服务器上挂载：这需要与 VPC 建立私有连接，而这种情况下的延迟将由网络链路决定，而不是由本地缓存控制。

options.text: Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic
Migrate the files to each clinic’s on-premises applications by using AWS DataSync for processing.
Deploy an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway as a virtual machine (VM) on premises at each clinic.
Attach an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system to each clinic’s on-premises servers.

question_text:
A company is using a content management system that runs on a single Amazon EC2 instance. The EC2 instance contains both the web server and the database software. The company must make its website platform highly available and must enable the website to scale to meet user demand.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
各层需要分离，必须具备跨可用区的容错能力，并需要扩展能力。数据库迁移到 Aurora，且在另一个可用区配置读副本，从现有实例创建 AMI，Web 层变为跨两个可用区、位于应用负载均衡器后方的自动伸缩组。一个可用区的故障不会导致应用或数据库中断。
选项 A：所有机器和负载均衡器都位于单个可用区：一个可用区故障会中断整个站点，手动启动实例无法提供扩展能力。
选项 B：副本和第二台机器仍然位于同一个可用区——对它的故障没有容错能力。
选项 D：单独的数据库实例上带有 S3 中的副本，仍存在单点故障，且恢复时间较长，而托管数据库则原生解决了这一问题。

options.text: Move the database to Amazon RDS, and enable automatic backups. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer in the Availability Zone, and set the two instances as targets.

Migrate the database to an Amazon Aurora instance with a read replica in the same Availability Zone as the existing EC2 instance. Manually launch another EC2 instance in the same Availability Zone. Configure an Application Load Balancer, and set the two EC2 instances as targets.

Move the database to Amazon Aurora with a read replica in another Availability Zone. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.

Move the database to a separate EC2 instance, and schedule backups to Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) from the original EC2 instance. Configure an Application Load Balancer in two Availability Zones. Attach an Auto Scaling group that uses the AMI across two Availability Zones.

question_text:
A company is launching an application on AWS. The application uses an Application Load Balancer (ALB) to direct traffic to at least two Amazon EC2 instances in a single target group. The instances are in an Auto Scaling group for each environment. The company requires a development environment and a production environment. The production environment will have periods of high traffic.
Which solution will configure the development environment MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
参考答案：A；争议选项：D。
把开发环境 target group 的目标减为一台并不保证 Auto Scaling group 会停止第二台实例，因此 A 不一定省钱；只降低 ASG maximum 也未明确修改 desired/minimum capacity，D 同样不能保证成本下降。缺少当前容量和缩容约束，保留来源 A 仅供参考。
开发环境的成本由实际运行的实例数量决定，而不是由负载均衡器如何分发请求决定。选项A被解读为‘在开发环境中保留一个实例而不是两个’——将支出减半。这是一个真正存在争议的问题：字面意义上的‘重新配置目标组’并不会改变自动扩展组的期望容量，该组会将第二个实例重新启动。因此部分社区选择D。反对D的论点是：最大值仅是上限；如果开发环境的期望容量为2且从未扩容，降低最大值毫无作用。
选项 B：负载均衡算法将请求分发到已经运行的实例中。它们的数量——以及账单——完全不变。
选项 C：减少实例大小也会影响生产环境，而生产环境预计会经历高流量期。该问题要求仅降低开发环境的成本，而此选项会危及生产环境的性能。
选项 D：如果假设开发环境实际上会扩容，则这是一个强有力的选择。但最大值仅限制峰值：当实例数量稳定在两个时，降低最大值毫无作用，而减少实际目标数量则有效。

options.text: Reconfigure the target group in the development environment to have only one EC2 instance as a target.
Change the ALB balancing algorithm to least outstanding requests.
Reduce the size of the EC2 instances in both environments.
Reduce the maximum number of EC2 instances in the development environment’s Auto Scaling group.

question_text:
A company runs a web application on Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances are in private subnets. A solutions architect implements an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) and specifies the EC2 instances as the target group. However, the internet traffic is not reaching the EC2 instances.
How should the solutions architect reconfigure the architecture to resolve this issue?
explanation_en:
一个面向互联网的负载均衡器必须位于公共子网中：没有公共子网，它就无处接收流量。因此，在每个可用区中创建公共子网，并将其分配给负载均衡器，私有子网中的实例的流量则通过VPC的内部路由进行传输。
选项 A：更改负载均衡器类型没有帮助，NAT网关处理的是出站连接，而不是入站连接。
选项 B：将实例移动到公共子网中会不必要地暴露它们给互联网，并且无法修复负载均衡器的配置。
选项 C：从私有子网到互联网网关的路由会使这些子网变为公共子网，并要求实例拥有公共地址。

options.text: Replace the ALB with a Network Load Balancer. Configure a NAT gateway in a public subnet to allow internet traffic.
Move the EC2 instances to public subnets. Add a rule to the EC2 instances’ security groups to allow outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0.

Update the route tables for the EC2 instances’ subnets to send 0.0.0.0/0 traffic through the internet gateway route. Add a rule to the EC2 instances’ security groups to allow outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0.
Create public subnets in each Availability Zone. Associate the public subnets with the ALB. Update the route tables for the public subnets with a route to the private subnets.

question_text:
A company has deployed a database in Amazon RDS for MySQL. Due to increased transactions, the database support team is reporting slow reads against the DB instance and recommends adding a read replica.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take before implementing this change? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
A read replica for RDS for MySQL 是基于二进制日志构建的，二进制日志仅在启用了自动备份时才会被保留：保留期必须大于零（E）。此外，在创建副本之前，应允许源实例上的长时间事务完成，否则副本创建将会停滞或失败（C）.
选项 A：二进制日志复制不需要单独启用：它通过自动备份被激活。
选项 B：故障切换优先级与多可用区配置相关，与读副本无关。
选项 D：全局表是 DynamoDB 的功能，而不是 RDS for MySQL 的功能。

options.text: Enable binlog replication on the RDS primary node.
Choose a failover priority for the source DB instance.
Allow long-running transactions to complete on the source DB instance.
Create a global table and specify the AWS Regions where the table will be available.
Enable automatic backups on the source instance by setting the backup retention period to a value other than 0.

question_text:
A company runs analytics software on Amazon EC2 instances. The software accepts job requests from users to process data that has been uploaded to Amazon S3. Users report that some submitted data is not being processed Amazon CloudWatch reveals that the EC2 instances have a consistent CPU utilization at or near 100%. The company wants to improve system performance and scale the system based on user load.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
实例的 CPU 使用率达到了 100%，并且部分请求正在丢失——因此需要同时保留请求并扩展处理能力。SQS 队列能够立即接收请求并保持请求直到被处理，而自动扩展组则根据队列长度进行扩展，即完全与实际用户负载保持一致。
选项 A：负载均衡器分发请求，但如果两台机器都过载，请求仍然会丢失，且没有扩展能力。
选项 B：S3 端点会改变网络路径和成本，但不会降低 CPU 负载。
选项 C：更强大的实例是一种需要停机的垂直扩展，随着负载增长，它最终仍会达到其限制。

options.text: Create a copy of the instance. Place all instances behind an Application Load Balancer.
Create an S3 VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Update the software to reference the endpoint.
Stop the EC2 instances. Modify the instance type to one with a more powerful CPU and more memory. Restart the instances.
Route incoming requests to Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS). Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling group based on queue size. Update the software to read from the queue.

question_text:
A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a media application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed.
Which AWS solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
定义性的关键词是 SMB 客户端和‘完全托管解决方案’。这正是 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server：它原生支持 SMB，支持 Windows 访问控制列表和 Active Directory 集成，而 AWS 负责维护、备份和容错。
选项 A：一个卷网关通过 iSCSI 提供块卷，而不是通过 SMB 提供文件共享，且是为混合场景设计的。
选项 B：一个磁带网关模拟磁带库以供备份系统使用——它与应用程序的共享文件访问毫无关系。
选项 C：一个自管理的 Windows 服务器并配置了文件服务器角色，是一台你需要自行修补、扩展和备份的机器——而不是一个托管解决方案。

options.text: Create an AWS Storage Gateway volume gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
Create an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Configure tapes to use Amazon S3. Connect the application server to the tape gateway.
Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.

question_text:
A company’s security team requests that network traffic be captured in VPC Flow Logs. The logs will be frequently accessed for 90 days and then accessed intermittently.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements when configuring the logs?
explanation_en:
流日志在最初90天内需要频繁访问，之后仅偶尔访问——这是S3配合生命周期规则的经典使用场景。日志直接写入存储桶，90天后对象会转为标准低频访问类，存储成本大致降低一半，同时保持相同的即时可用性。
选项 A：可以在CloudWatch Logs中设置保留期，但90天后日志将被简单删除，而需求是需要偶尔访问；CloudWatch的存储成本也更高。
选项 B：Kinesis是用于流式数据传输的工具，而非长期存储，且流的最大保留期有限。
选项 C：CloudTrail记录API调用，无法作为VPC流日志的目标存储。

options.text: Use Amazon CloudWatch as the target. Set the CloudWatch log group with an expiration of 90 days
Use Amazon Kinesis as the target. Configure the Kinesis stream to always retain the logs for 90 days.
Use AWS CloudTrail as the target. Configure CloudTrail to save to an Amazon S3 bucket, and enable S3 Intelligent-Tiering.
Use Amazon S3 as the target. Enable an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition the logs to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 90 days.

question_text:
An Amazon EC2 instance is located in a private subnet in a new VPC. This subnet does not have outbound internet access, but the EC2 instance needs the ability to download monthly security updates from an outside vendor.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
私有子网中的实例需要能够发起 outbound 连接，同时从外部无法访问。在公共子网中创建了一个 NAT 网关，私有子网的路由表将所有 outbound 流量指向该网关。更新可以下载，但来自互联网的 inbound 连接仍然不可能。
选项 A：一条指向互联网网关的路由会使该子网变为公共子网，并要求实例拥有公共 IP 地址——违反了隐私要求。
选项 C：NAT 实例必须位于公共子网中：如果放置在同一个私有子网中，它自身也无法访问互联网。
选项 D：这里混合了两种机制：路由指向互联网网关，且 NAT 实例放置错误——该配置无法正常工作。

options.text: Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route.
Create a NAT gateway, and place it in a public subnet. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT gateway as the default route.
Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the NAT instance as the default route.

Create an internet gateway, and attach it to the VPC. Create a NAT instance, and place it in the same subnet where the EC2 instance is located. Configure the private subnet route table to use the internet gateway as the default route.

question_text:
A solutions architect needs to design a system to store client case files. The files are core company assets and are important. The number of files will grow over time.
The files must be simultaneously accessible from multiple application servers that run on Amazon EC2 instances.
The solution must have built-in redundancy.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
这些文件必须能够同时从多个实例访问，存储卷正在增长，并且需要内置的冗余功能。Amazon EFS 满足所有这三个要求：它可以通过 NFS 协议挂载到任意数量的实例上，能够自动扩展，并且在标准模式下将数据存储在多个可用区之间。
选项 B：一个 EBS 卷通常只附加到一个实例，并且位于单个可用区：没有多个服务器同时访问，也没有内置的跨可用区冗余。
选项 C：Glacier Deep Archive 是一种归档存储，检索时间以小时为单位。应用程序需要访问的运行文件无法存储在其中。
选项 D：AWS Backup 是一个备份服务，而不是应用程序直接读取文件的存储服务。

options.text: Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS)
Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS)
Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive
AWS Backup

question_text:
A company is reviewing a recent migration of a three-tier application to a VPC. The security team discovers that the principle of least privilege is not being applied to Amazon EC2 security group ingress and egress rules between the application tiers.
What should a solutions architect do to correct this issue?
explanation_en:
应用层级之间最小权限的实现是通过引用安全组：入站规则指定了相邻层级安全组的ID。该权限自动扩展到属于该组的实例，并且在实例被替换或扩展时仍持续有效。
选项 A：在安全组规则中无法指定实例ID作为源：这种源类型不存在。
选项 C：整个VPC的CIDR块会授予网络中所有资源的访问权限——这与最小权限原则相反。
选项 D：子网CIDR块比所需范围更广：子网内的任何资源都会获得访问权限，而不仅仅是相邻的应用层级。

options.text: Create security group rules using the instance ID as the source or destination.
Create security group rules using the security group ID as the source or destination.
Create security group rules using the VPC CIDR blocks as the source or destination.
Create security group rules using the subnet CIDR blocks as the source or destination.

question_text:
A company has an ecommerce checkout workflow that writes an order to a database and calls a service to process the payment. Users are experiencing timeouts during the checkout process. When users resubmit the checkout form, multiple unique orders are created for the same desired transaction.
How should a solutions architect refactor this workflow to prevent the creation of multiple orders?
explanation_en:
重复出现是因为表单在超时后被重新提交。订单被存储在数据库中，并将其订单号发送到一个 SQS FIFO 队列：它保证了精确一次处理并保持顺序，因此即使消息到达两次，支付服务也会恰好处理每个订单一次。
选项 A：Firehose 将流传输到存储目的地，并不是支付服务的精确一次队列。
选项 B：CloudTrail 记录对 AWS API 的调用，而不是应用程序内部的请求，并且它没有此类规则。
选项 C：SNS 不保证精确一次交付，也不支持订阅者轮询：消息将会被重复。

options.text: Configure the web application to send an order message to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Set the payment service to retrieve the message from Kinesis Data Firehose and process the order.

Create a rule in AWS CloudTrail to invoke an AWS Lambda function based on the logged application path request. Use Lambda to query the database, call the payment service, and pass in the order information.

Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS). Set the payment service to poll Amazon SNS, retrieve the message, and process the order.

Store the order in the database. Send a message that includes the order number to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the payment service to retrieve the message and process the order. Delete the message from the queue.

question_text:
A solutions architect is implementing a document review application using an Amazon S3 bucket for storage. The solution must prevent accidental deletion of the documents and ensure that all versions of the documents are available. Users must be able to download, modify, and upload documents.
Which combination of actions should be taken to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
要求是微妙的：防止意外删除，保持文档的所有版本可访问，同时仍允许用户下载、修改和上传文档。版本控制（B）既提供了版本历史记录，又实现了删除操作的可逆性。多因素认证删除（D）为不可逆操作——删除特定版本并禁用版本控制——增加了第二重验证因素。两者均不会干扰正常的文档工作流程，与那些简单阻止写入操作的选项不同。
选项 A：只读的ACL会剥夺用户上传和修改文档的能力——这直接违背了任务的要求。
选项 C：桶策略（bucket policy）是附加到桶上的，而不是‘IAM策略’，且没有任何策略能够保留文档的先前版本。版本控制的要求仍然未满足。
选项 E：使用KMS密钥进行加密可以防止未经授权的第三方读取内容。这与意外删除或版本历史无关。

options.text: Enable a read-only bucket ACL.
Enable versioning on the bucket.
Attach an IAM policy to the bucket.
Enable MFA Delete on the bucket.
Encrypt the bucket using AWS KMS.

question_text:
A company is building a solution that will report Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling events across all the applications in an AWS account. The company needs to use a serverless solution to store the EC2 Auto Scaling status data in Amazon S3. The company then will use the data in Amazon S3 to provide near-real-time updates in a dashboard.
The solution must not affect the speed of EC2 instance launches.
How should the company move the data to Amazon S3 to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
扩展状态需要无服务器地收集，并且不能影响实例启动的速度。CloudWatch 指标流持续将指标导出到 Kinesis Data Firehose，然后在近实时情况下将其存储到 S3。机器上无需安装代理，实例启动不会延迟。
选项 B：EMR 集群不是无服务器解决方案，需要管理节点。
选项 C：按计划运行函数会引入延迟，无法实现近实时流式传输。
选项 D：在实例启动时安装代理会延长启动过程，而该要求明确禁止了这一点。

options.text: Use an Amazon CloudWatch metric stream to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
Launch an Amazon EMR cluster to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.
Create an Amazon EventBridge rule to invoke an AWS Lambda function on a schedule. Configure the Lambda function to send the EC2 Auto Scaling status data directly to Amazon S3.

Use a bootstrap script during the launch of an EC2 instance to install Amazon Kinesis Agent. Configure Kinesis Agent to collect the EC2 Auto Scaling status data and send the data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. Store the data in Amazon S3.

question_text:
A company has an application that places hundreds of .csv files into an Amazon S3 bucket every hour. The files are 1 GB in size. Each time a file is uploaded, the company needs to convert the file to Apache Parquet format and place the output file into an S3 bucket.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
每小时处理数百个1 GB文件是一项适合使用现成ETL工具的任务。AWS Glue作业在无需自定义处理代码的情况下执行CSV到Parquet的转换，而当PUT事件触发时，一个Lambda函数简单地启动该作业。无需集群，也无需编写转换逻辑。
选项 A：一个大小为一吉字节的文件无法很好地适应函数的内存和时间限制，且需要编写和维护转换代码。
选项 B：自定义Spark应用程序意味着既需要开发工作，也需要集群管理。
选项 C：通过Athena进行定期查询后跟一个导出是一个复杂且延迟的流程，而ETL作业可以直接完成这一操作。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function to download the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Invoke the Lambda function for each S3 PUT event.

Create an Apache Spark job to read the .csv files, convert the files to Parquet format, and place the output files in an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the Spark job.

Create an AWS Glue table and an AWS Glue crawler for the S3 bucket where the application places the .csv files. Schedule an AWS Lambda function to periodically use Amazon Athena to query the AWS Glue table, convert the query results into Parquet format, and place the output files into an S3 bucket.

Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to convert the .csv files to Parquet format and place the output files into an S3 bucket. Create an AWS Lambda function for each S3 PUT event to invoke the ETL job.

question_text:
A company is implementing new data retention policies for all databases that run on Amazon RDS DB instances.
The company must retain daily backups for a minimum period of 2 years. The backups must be consistent and restorable.
Which solution should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
每日一致的备份需保留两年并具备恢复能力，AWS Backup 会将所有这些功能集中在一个地方：一个备份存储库、一个包含每日计划和两年保留期的计划，以及被分配到该计划的 RDS 实例。备份由 RDS 服务本身创建为一致的快照，而集中化的报告和保留策略消除了手动操作。
选项 B：RDS 自动备份的保留期限制为 35 天，且 Amazon DLM 管理 EBS 快照，而不是 RDS。
选项 C：CloudWatch Logs 中的事务日志不是可恢复的数据库备份：无法从这些日志中恢复实例。
选项 D：DMS 配置的 CDC 任务会将变更流推送到 S3 —— 这不是一致的备份，也不是恢复实例的方法。

options.text: Create a backup vault in AWS Backup to retain RDS backups. Create a new backup plan with a daily schedule and an expiration period of 2 years after creation. Assign the RDS DB instances to the backup plan.

Configure a backup window for the RDS DB instances for daily snapshots. Assign a snapshot retention policy of 2 years to each RDS DB instance. Use Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM) to schedule snapshot deletions.
Configure database transaction logs to be automatically backed up to Amazon CloudWatch Logs with an expiration period of 2 years.

Configure an AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) replication task. Deploy a replication instance, and configure a change data capture (CDC) task to stream database changes to Amazon S3 as the target. Configure S3 Lifecycle policies to delete the snapshots after 2 years.

question_text:
A company’s compliance team needs to move its file shares to AWS. The shares run on a Windows Server SMB file share. A self-managed on-premises Active Directory controls access to the files and folders.
The company wants to use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server as part of the solution. The company must ensure that the on-premises Active Directory groups restrict access to the FSx for Windows File Server SMB compliance shares, folders, and files after the move to AWS. The company has created an FSx for Windows File Server file system.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
FSx for Windows File Server 没有自己的身份系统：文件夹和文件的权限由 Windows ACL 控制，身份来自 Active Directory 域。因此，唯一真正有效的步骤是将文件系统加入到域中（通过其域控制器的自管理 Active Directory）。之后，熟悉的域组将继续以与本地环境相同的方式控制访问。IAM 角色和策略在这里无关紧要：它们控制对 AWS API 的访问，而不是对 SMB 共享内容的访问。
选项 A：AD Connector 是一个用于 WorkSpaces 和 Identity Center 等服务的目录代理。没有域组到 IAM 组的映射，文件权限也不会以这种方式被授予。
选项 B：标签是用于资源追踪的标签。它们与文件系统内部文件夹和文件的访问权限没有任何关系。
选项 C：服务关联角色允许 FSx 服务本身在您的账户中执行操作。它不会限制用户对文件的访问。

options.text: Create an Active Directory Connector to connect to the Active Directory. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
Assign a tag with a Restrict tag key and a Compliance tag value. Map the Active Directory groups to IAM groups to restrict access.
Create an IAM service-linked role that is linked directly to FSx for Windows File Server to restrict access.
Join the file system to the Active Directory to restrict access.

question_text:
A company recently announced the deployment of its retail website to a global audience. The website runs on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Elastic Load Balancer. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones.
The company wants to provide its customers with different versions of content based on the devices that the customers use to access the website.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
任务是为不同的设备提供不同内容版本。CloudFront 配合一个 Lambda@Edge 函数解析 User-Agent 头部，并返回相应的对象变体（C），而分发本身被配置为缓存同一路径的多个版本——通过将设备类型包含在缓存键中（A）。这两者结合既实现了正确的版本选择，也实现了每个变体的缓存。
选项 B：一个网络负载均衡器运行在第4层，不会看到HTTP头部：基于Host的路由对其是不可能的。
选项 D：全球加速器会加快流量路径，但不会根据设备选择内容，而NLB再次无法解析头部。
选项 E：同样的错误：基于路径的路由是应用层负载均衡器的特性，而不是NLB的特性，且无法从路径中推断出设备类型。

options.text: Configure Amazon CloudFront to cache multiple versions of the content.
Configure a host header in a Network Load Balancer to forward traffic to different instances.
Configure a [email protected] function to send specific objects to users based on the User-Agent header.
Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up host-based routing to different EC2 instances.
Configure AWS Global Accelerator. Forward requests to a Network Load Balancer (NLB). Configure the NLB to set up path-based routing to different EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company plans to use Amazon ElastiCache for its multi-tier web application. A solutions architect creates a Cache VPC for the ElastiCache cluster and an App VPC for the application’s Amazon EC2 instances. Both VPCs are in the us-east-1 Region.
The solutions architect must implement a solution to provide the application’s EC2 instances with access to the ElastiCache cluster.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
两个网络位于同一个区域，并且需要低成本连接。VPC对等连接没有按小时计费，也没有处理费用：仅对传输的流量进行计费。在两个路由表中都会添加路由，同时在缓存集群上配置一个入站安全组规则，该规则引用应用程序实例的安全组——这在单个区域内的对等连接中是可行的。
选项 B：一个传输VPC会添加自己的设备或网关，并产生按小时计费——明显比在两个网络之间使用对等连接更昂贵。
选项 C：对等连接本身没有独立的安全组：规则是在资源本身上创建的，即在缓存集群上创建。
选项 D：这里既存在一个不必要的传输VPC，也存在一个不存在的传输网络安全组。

options.text: Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.

Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the ElastiCache cluster's security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.

Create a peering connection between the VPCs. Add a route table entry for the peering connection in both VPCs. Configure an inbound rule for the peering connection’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.

Create a Transit VPC. Update the VPC route tables in the Cache VPC and the App VPC to route traffic through the Transit VPC. Configure an inbound rule for the Transit VPC’s security group to allow inbound connection from the application’s security group.

question_text:
A company is building an application that consists of several microservices. The company has decided to use container technologies to deploy its software on AWS. The company needs a solution that minimizes the amount of ongoing effort for maintenance and scaling. The company cannot manage additional infrastructure.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
不允许额外的基础设施，且必须最小化维护和扩展。创建一个 ECS 集群（A），并使用 Fargate 启动类型启动服务，目标任务数量至少为两个（D）：根本没有节点，任务分布在可用区之间，扩展通过服务策略配置。
选项 B：在自己的实例上部署一个 Kubernetes 控制平面，正是必须避免的基础设施。
选项 C：EC2 启动类型需要管理集群的节点。
选项 E：在 EC2 实例上部署 Kubernetes 工作节点再次意味着你拥有自己的基础设施。

options.text: Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster.
Deploy the Kubernetes control plane on Amazon EC2 instances that span multiple Availability Zones.
Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service with an Amazon EC2 launch type. Specify a desired task number level of greater than or equal to 2.
Deploy an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) service with a Fargate launch type. Specify a desired task number level of greater than or equal to 2.
Deploy Kubernetes worker nodes on Amazon EC2 instances that span multiple Availability Zones. Create a deployment that specifies two or more replicas for each microservice.

question_text:
A company has a web application hosted over 10 Amazon EC2 instances with traffic directed by Amazon Route 53.
The company occasionally experiences a timeout error when attempting to browse the application. The networking team finds that some DNS queries return IP addresses of unhealthy instances, resulting in the timeout error.
What should a solutions architect implement to overcome these timeout errors?
explanation_en:
问题在于 DNS 返回了不健康实例的地址。正确的解决方案是架构层面的：在实例前面部署一个带有健康检查的应用程序负载均衡器，并通过别名记录将 Route 53 指向该负载均衡器。负载均衡器一旦检测到实例不健康，会立即停止向该目标发送请求，而通过 DNS 路由始终依赖于 TTL 和客户端解析器的缓存——即使有健康检查，部分用户仍可能继续获取旧地址。
选项 A：简单路由策略根本不支持健康检查：它会原样返回记录。
选项 B：故障转移路由策略是为一对主备资源设计的，而不是为数十个等权重实例设计的，并且仍然会遇到 DNS 缓存问题。
选项 C：CloudFront 虽然能加快内容分发，但无法解决从轮询中移除不健康实例的问题：CloudFront 本身也需要一个带有健康检查的负载均衡器。

options.text: Create a Route 53 simple routing policy record for each EC2 instance. Associate a health check with each record.
Create a Route 53 failover routing policy record for each EC2 instance. Associate a health check with each record.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with EC2 instances as its origin. Associate a health check with the EC2 instances.
Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a health check in front of the EC2 instances. Route to the ALB from Route 53.

question_text:
A solutions architect needs to design a highly available application consisting of web, application, and database tiers. HTTPS content delivery should be as close to the edge as possible, with the least delivery time.
Which solution meets these requirements and is MOST secure?
explanation_en:
最安全的可行设计：实例位于私有子网中，无法直接从互联网访问，一个公共的应用负载均衡器位于其前，CloudFront 将该负载均衡器作为源，从距离用户最近的边缘位置分发 HTTPS 内容。负载均衡器的安全组也可以被限制，仅允许来自 CloudFront 的流量。
选项 A：实例位于公共子网中，可直接从互联网访问——对于达到相同结果而言，这是不必要的攻击面。
选项 B：将实例作为 CloudFront 的源，绕过负载均衡器，意味着要么将实例暴露在公网，要么最终得到一个无法正常工作的设置；容错能力也丧失了。
选项 D：此处同时存在两种缺陷：使用公共子网以及直接通往实例而非通过负载均衡器。

options.text: Configure a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the public ALB as the origin.

Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.

Configure a public Application Load Balancer (ALB) with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in private subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the public ALB as the origin.

Configure a public Application Load Balancer with multiple redundant Amazon EC2 instances in public subnets. Configure Amazon CloudFront to deliver HTTPS content using the EC2 instances as the origin.

question_text:
A company has a popular gaming platform running on AWS. The application is sensitive to latency because latency can impact the user experience and introduce unfair advantages to some players. The application is deployed in every AWS Region. It runs on Amazon EC2 instances that are part of Auto Scaling groups configured behind Application Load Balancers (ALBs). A solutions architect needs to implement a mechanism to monitor the health of the application and redirect traffic to healthy endpoints.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
该应用程序在每个区域都有部署，对延迟敏感，并需要健康监控以及将流量从故障站点重定向。全球加速器在所需端口上创建一个监听器，每个区域都附加一个端点组，负载均衡器作为端点。加速器持续检查目标健康状况，将每个玩家路由到最近的健康区域，并在几秒内完成流量切换，不受DNS缓存影响。
选项 B：CloudFront 优化了内容缓存，而游戏流量是动态的；它不提供健康检查或快速跨区域故障切换。
选项 C：S3 存储桶无法作为游戏应用程序的源：那里没有逻辑，也没有会话状态。
选项 D：DynamoDB 和 DAX 涉及数据存储，与将流量路由到健康区域无关。

options.text: Configure an accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator. Add a listener for the port that the application listens on, and attach it to a Regional endpoint in each Region. Add the ALB as the endpoint.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and specify the ALB as the origin server. Configure the cache behavior to use origin cache headers. Use AWS Lambda functions to optimize the traffic.
Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution and specify Amazon S3 as the origin server. Configure the cache behavior to use origin cache headers. Use AWS Lambda functions to optimize the traffic.

Configure an Amazon DynamoDB database to serve as the data store for the application. Create a DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) cluster to act as the in-memory cache for DynamoDB hosting the application data.

question_text:
A company has one million users that use its mobile app. The company must analyze the data usage in near-real time. The company also must encrypt the data in near-real time and must store the data in a centralized location in Apache Parquet format for further processing.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
将数据流摄入、加密、以 Parquet 格式写入，并在近实时情况下进行分析，都是必需的，且需要最小的操作开销。Kinesis Data Firehose 本身完成了所有这些操作：它会加密数据、将记录转换为 Parquet 格式，并将数据直接写入 S3，无需管理分片，而 Kinesis Data Analytics 则使用 SQL 查询来运行流分析。
选项 A：Kinesis Data Streams 流本身不会将数据写入 S3，需要管理分片，且需要一个中间函数来复杂化设计。
选项 B：必须创建并付费使用 EMR 集群，且流本身仍然无法将数据直接交付到 S3。
选项 C：选择了 Firehose 是正确的，但使用 EMR 集群进行分析意味着需要管理节点，而不是使用托管服务。

options.text: Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics application to analyze the data. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to send the data to the Kinesis Data Analytics application.
Create an Amazon Kinesis data stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to analyze the data. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to send the data to the EMR cluster.
Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon EMR cluster to analyze the data.
Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery stream to store the data in Amazon S3. Create an Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics application to analyze the data.

question_text:
A gaming company has a web application that displays scores. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The application stores data in an Amazon RDS for MySQL database. Users are starting to experience long delays and interruptions that are caused by database read performance. The company wants to improve the user experience while minimizing changes to the application’s architecture.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
参考答案：B；争议选项：A。
examtopics t1 q268 — RDS Proxy 解决的是连接池问题，而非读取性能；部分社区倾向于选择 ElastiCache
题干明确是数据库读取性能不足，ElastiCache 可缓存重复读取并降低 RDS 读负载；RDS Proxy 主要复用数据库连接，不能单独缓存查询结果或增加实例的读吞吐。来源答案 B 应修正为 A；缓存方案仍需应用使用缓存。
来源答案 B 的原解析（与核查结果冲突，不采纳）：
题干中的限制条件是 '最小化对应用程序架构的改动'。RDS Proxy 以透明方式位于应用程序与数据库之间：仅需修改连接字符串，无需改动代码。它消除了在流量激增期间导致的 '长时间延迟和中断' 的主要原因——即 MySQL 连接的耗尽和重新建立。争议点在于 Proxy 并不会增加读取能力，而题目中提到的是 '数据库读取性能'，这导致部分社区选择 ElastiCache。考试经验法则：抱怨连接和中断问题指向 RDS Proxy；抱怨大量重复读取，且允许修改代码，则指向缓存或读取副本。
来源旧选项 A：一个强有力的替代方案：缓存确实能减轻读取压力。但缓存本身无法独立工作——必须在应用程序中添加缓存旁路逻辑：读取缓存，若未命中则转而访问数据库，写入时需失效缓存。这属于应用程序层面的改动，而题目要求避免此类改动。
来源旧选项 C：迁移到 Lambda 会改变计算层，但数据库本身才是性能瓶颈。读取问题依然完全相同，而架构改动在所有选项中是最显著的。
来源旧选项 D：迁移到 DynamoDB 意味着需要重新设计数据模型和所有查询。对于要求最小化改动的需求而言，这是最大的架构变更。

options.text: Use Amazon ElastiCache in front of the database.
Use RDS Proxy between the application and the database.
Migrate the application from EC2 instances to AWS Lambda.
Migrate the database from Amazon RDS for MySQL to Amazon DynamoDB.

question_text:
An ecommerce company has noticed performance degradation of its Amazon RDS based web application. The performance degradation is attributed to an increase in the number of read-only SQL queries triggered by business analysts. A solutions architect needs to solve the problem with minimal changes to the existing web application.
What should the solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
降级的原因是分析师发起的只读查询。一个读副本将这些查询从主实例上移开：应用程序继续在主实例上运行，分析师连接到副本，且代码变更非常少。
选项 A：DynamoDB需要重写查询，且不适合进行即席分析。
选项 B：ElastiCache是内存缓存；无法在上面运行任意的SQL分析查询。
选项 D：Redshift需要单独的加载管道和一个持续运行的集群：变更和成本显著增加。

options.text: Export the data to Amazon DynamoDB and have the business analysts run their queries.
Load the data into Amazon ElastiCache and have the business analysts run their queries.
Create a read replica of the primary database and have the business analysts run their queries.
Copy the data into an Amazon Redshift cluster and have the business analysts run their queries.

question_text:
A company is using a centralized AWS account to store log data in various Amazon S3 buckets. A solutions architect needs to ensure that the data is encrypted at rest before the data is uploaded to the S3 buckets. The data also must be encrypted in transit.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
区分性的细节是一个单词：数据必须在上传之前被加密。任何服务器端加密（SSE-S3、SSE-KMS、SSE-C）都是在 S3 接收到对象之后才执行的，这意味着在应用程序和 S3 之间的任何中间组件上，数据在传输过程中仍以明文形式存在。只有客户端加密满足这一要求：应用程序本身对对象进行加密，只有密文才会到达 S3。传输过程中的加密由 TLS 提供，S3 默认支持 TLS，且可以通过存储桶策略中的 aws:SecureTransport 条件强制执行。
选项 B：服务器端加密是在服务接收到对象之后由服务执行的。根据定义，'上传前加密'的要求并未被满足。
选项 C：存储桶策略仅强制客户端请求 SSE-S3 —— 即相同的服务器端加密，只是被设为强制执行。加密发生的时机并未改变。
选项 D：使用 KMS 密钥的默认存储桶加密仍然是一个服务器端方案：对象在接收到之后才会被加密。

options.text: Use client-side encryption to encrypt the data that is being uploaded to the S3 buckets.
Use server-side encryption to encrypt the data that is being uploaded to the S3 buckets.
Create bucket policies that require the use of server-side encryption with S3 managed encryption keys (SSE- S3) for S3 uploads.
Enable the security option to encrypt the S3 buckets through the use of a default AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key.

question_text:
A solutions architect observes that a nightly batch processing job is automatically scaled up for 1 hour before the desired Amazon EC2 capacity is reached. The peak capacity is the ‘same every night and the batch jobs always start at 1 AM. The solutions architect needs to find a cost-effective solution that will allow for the desired EC2 capacity to be reached quickly and allow the Auto Scaling group to scale down after the batch jobs are complete.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
峰值在提前知晓：作业始终在凌晨1点开始，每晚所需的容量都相同。计划性扩展在作业开始前提升所需实例数量，因此一小时的等待时间消失，作业完成后，组通过其正常策略自动缩减规模。
选项 A：永久性提升的最小容量意味着全天持续支付空闲实例的费用。
选项 B：最大容量仅设置上限，对扩展速度没有影响。
选项 D：更大的步长会加快增长速度，但扩展仍只在负载出现并被检测到后才开始。

options.text: Increase the minimum capacity for the Auto Scaling group.
Increase the maximum capacity for the Auto Scaling group.
Configure scheduled scaling to scale up to the desired compute level.
Change the scaling policy to add more EC2 instances during each scaling operation.

question_text:
A company serves a dynamic website from a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The website needs to support multiple languages to serve customers around the world. The website’s architecture is running in the us-west-1 Region and is exhibiting high request latency for users that are located in other parts of the world.
The website needs to serve requests quickly and efficiently regardless of a user’s location. However, the company does not want to recreate the existing architecture across multiple Regions.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该架构无法被复制，因此需要加速的是现有的入口点。将负载均衡器作为 CloudFront 的源，即使对于动态内容也能降低延迟：TLS 在最近的边缘位置终止，请求通过 AWS 主干网络传输至区域。一旦在缓存行为设置中将 Accept-Language 头部包含在缓存键中，语言版本就能被正确提供——然后为每种语言维护一个独立的缓存副本。
选项 A：网站是动态的，完全将其迁移到 S3 存储桶意味着需要重写应用程序——需求中并未要求这样做。
选项 C：API Gateway 配合阶段级缓存是在负载均衡器前增加的一层额外结构，既无法提供全球边缘网络，也无法为其他大洲的用户提供延迟优势。
选项 D：在每个区域部署自定义缓存服务器是需要部署和维护的基础设施——这正是该公司不希望实现的多区域设置。

options.text: Replace the existing architecture with a website that is served from an Amazon S3 bucket. Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the S3 bucket as the origin. Set the cache behavior settings to cache based on the Accept-Language request header.
Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the ALB as the origin. Set the cache behavior settings to cache based on the Accept-Language request header.

Create an Amazon API Gateway API that is integrated with the ALB. Configure the API to use the HTTP integration type. Set up an API Gateway stage to enable the API cache based on the Accept-Language request header.

Launch an EC2 instance in each additional Region and configure NGINX to act as a cache server for that Region. Put all the EC2 instances and the ALB behind an Amazon Route 53 record set with a geolocation routing policy.

question_text:
A rapidly growing ecommerce company is running its workloads in a single AWS Region. A solutions architect must create a disaster recovery (DR) strategy that includes a different AWS Region. The company wants its database to be up to date in the DR Region with the least possible latency. The remaining infrastructure in the DR Region needs to run at reduced capacity and must be able to scale up if necessary.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LOWEST recovery time objective (RTO)?
explanation_en:
要求是：第二个区域的数据库必须尽可能保持最新，同时在该区域基础设施以缩减容量运行但已处于可用状态的情况下，必须最小化恢复时间。Aurora 全局数据库在存储层进行数据复制，通常延迟在亚秒级别，而暖备部署意味着第二个区域中的所有组件已经以缩减规模运行，仅需扩容即可。这比从零开始搭建环境要快得多。
选项 A：一个试点部署意味着在灾难发生时必须部署一个关闭或计算量极小的层，导致恢复时间比暖备更长。
选项 C：多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置在单个区域内部运行，并且完全不提供另一个区域的数据副本。
选项 D：同样的错误：多可用区（Multi-AZ）不是跨区域解决方案，无论选择何种备用模式都是如此。

options.text: Use an Amazon Aurora global database with a pilot light deployment.
Use an Amazon Aurora global database with a warm standby deployment.
Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance with a pilot light deployment.
Use an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance with a warm standby deployment.

question_text:
A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to implement a disaster recovery (DR) solution for the application. The DR solution needs to have a recovery time objective (RTO) of less than 4 hours. The DR solution also needs to use the fewest possible AWS resources during normal operations.
Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
explanation_en:
一个小于四小时的RTO允许灾难恢复站点处于离线状态而非运行，并且在正常操作期间资源使用必须最小化。镜像被复制到一个次要区域，整个基础设施在AWS CloudFormation模板中进行描述：在发生灾难时，通过单次操作部署堆栈，使用标准机制而非自定义脚本以维持。
选项 A：自定义函数和部署脚本是需要编写、测试和维护的代码。
选项 C：在第二个区域中持续运行的实例直接违反了最小化资源使用的要求。
选项 D：第二个可用区无法抵御区域级别的故障，并且意味着机器持续运行。

options.text: Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) to back up the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to a secondary AWS Region. Automate infrastructure deployment in the secondary Region by using AWS Lambda and custom scripts.
Create Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) to back up the EC2 instances. Copy the AMIs to a secondary AWS Region. Automate infrastructure deployment in the secondary Region by using AWS CloudFormation.
Launch EC2 instances in a secondary AWS Region. Keep the EC2 instances in the secondary Region active at all times.
Launch EC2 instances in a secondary Availability Zone. Keep the EC2 instances in the secondary Availability Zone active at all times.

question_text:
A company runs an internal browser-based application. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. The Auto Scaling group scales up to 20 instances during work hours, but scales down to 2 instances overnight. Staff are complaining that the application is very slow when the day begins, although it runs well by mid-morning.
How should the scaling be changed to address the staff complaints and keep costs to a minimum?
explanation_en:
早晨的延迟发生是因为该组只有在负载已经出现之后才会做出反应。一个具有较低 CPU 利用率阈值的目标跟踪策略会更早地开始增加容量，而较短的冷却周期则允许实例更频繁地被添加。成本仅在实际负载增加的期间内上升。
选项 A：提前将所需容量设置为 20 意味着即使在尚未需要时也必须支付峰值配置的费用。
选项 B：步进扩展同样可行，但它会增加固定数量的实例，并且不如目标跟踪那样精确地维持目标水平。
选项 D：将最小值硬编码为 20 个实例会阻止该组 ever 缩减，并使该方案成为最昂贵的一个。

options.text: Implement a scheduled action that sets the desired capacity to 20 shortly before the office opens.
Implement a step scaling action triggered at a lower CPU threshold, and decrease the cooldown period.
Implement a target tracking action triggered at a lower CPU threshold, and decrease the cooldown period.
Implement a scheduled action that sets the minimum and maximum capacity to 20 shortly before the office opens.

question_text:
A company has a multi-tier application deployed on several Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group. An Amazon RDS for Oracle instance is the application’ s data layer that uses Oracle-specific PL/SQL functions. Traffic to the application has been steadily increasing. This is causing the EC2 instances to become overloaded and the RDS instance to run out of storage. The Auto Scaling group does not have any scaling metrics and defines the minimum healthy instance count only. The company predicts that traffic will continue to increase at a steady but unpredictable rate before leveling off.
What should a solutions architect do to ensure the system can automatically scale for the increased traffic?
(Choose two.)
explanation_en:
这里存在两个独立的问题，每个问题分别被独立解决。数据库存储空间不足，通过在 RDS 实例上启用存储自动扩展来解决，这样当存储空间填满时卷会自动增长，且不会造成停机（A）。实例负载过重，且自动扩展组完全没有配置任何指标，因此设置了基于平均 CPU 利用率的扩展策略，使实例组能够随着流量增长而扩展（D）.
选项 B：迁移到 Aurora 需要放弃正在使用的 Oracle 特定的 PL/SQL 函数，而场景中明确指出这些函数正在被使用。
选项 C：低存储空间警报仅会通知问题本身，并不会增加任何存储空间。
选项 E：空闲内存不是 CloudWatch 的默认指标——需要通过代理收集——而且作为 Web 层负载的首要指示器，它比 CPU 利用率更弱。

options.text: Configure storage Auto Scaling on the RDS for Oracle instance.
Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora to use Auto Scaling storage.
Configure an alarm on the RDS for Oracle instance for low free storage space.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to use the average CPU as the scaling metric.
Configure the Auto Scaling group to use the average free memory as the scaling metric.

question_text:
A company provides an online service for posting video content and transcoding it for use by any mobile platform.
The application architecture uses Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard to collect and store the videos so that multiple Amazon EC2 Linux instances can access the video content for processing. As the popularity of the service has grown over time, the storage costs have become too expensive.
Which storage solution is MOST cost-effective?
explanation_en:
视频文件是只写一次、处理期间读取的对象，因此将它们存储在像 EFS 这样的文件系统中会很昂贵。将源文件和结果存储在 S3 中，并在转码期间仅将正在处理的文件复制到附加到实例的 EBS 卷上，这样可以消除持久性文件存储的持续成本，且 S3 每吉字节的成本仅为 EFS 的一小部分。
选项 A：文件网关是用于从本地网络访问 S3 的混合网关。将其放置在云实例和存储桶之间是毫无意义的——它只是多了一层额外的开销和成本。
选项 B：卷网关解决了块卷的相同混合问题，同样不适合此场景。
选项 C：存储仍然保留在 EFS 中，因此主要成本驱动因素没有改变，而将结果移动到 EBS 只是增加了额外成本。

options.text: Use AWS Storage Gateway for files to store and process the video content.
Use AWS Storage Gateway for volumes to store and process the video content.
Use Amazon EFS for storing the video content. Once processing is complete, transfer the files to Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS).
Use Amazon S3 for storing the video content. Move the files temporarily over to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume attached to the server for processing.

question_text:
A company wants to create an application to store employee data in a hierarchical structured relationship. The company needs a minimum-latency response to high-traffic queries for the employee data and must protect any sensitive data. The company also needs to receive monthly email messages if any financial information is present in the employee data.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
两个独立的需求。存储具有层次结构的员工数据，并在高负载下保持最低延迟，指向 DynamoDB（B）：分区键和排序键自然映射到层次结构，延迟保持在个位数毫秒级别，且每月导出到 S3 可用于审计。检测财务信息并发送每月通知指向 Amazon Macie（E）：它在 S3 中分类敏感数据，将发现发布到 EventBridge，然后通知通过 SNS 主题的订阅者发出。
选项 A：Redshift 是一个为大型数据集上的复杂查询而构建的分析仓库，而不是用于高流量、低延迟的点查询的来源。
选项 C：将事件发送到 Lambda 函数意味着电子邮件发送和订阅逻辑必须从头构建。SNS 主题无需代码即可完成此操作。
选项 D：Athena 和 QuickSight 提供分析和仪表板，但它们既无法满足快速应用查询的需求，也无法满足财务数据检测的需求。

options.text: Use Amazon Redshift to store the employee data in hierarchies. Unload the data to Amazon S3 every month.
Use Amazon DynamoDB to store the employee data in hierarchies. Export the data to Amazon S3 every month.
Configure Amazon Macie for the AWS account. Integrate Macie with Amazon EventBridge to send monthly events to AWS Lambda.
Use Amazon Athena to analyze the employee data in Amazon S3. Integrate Athena with Amazon QuickSight to publish analysis dashboards and share the dashboards with users.
Configure Amazon Macie for the AWS account. Integrate Macie with Amazon EventBridge to send monthly notifications through an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) subscription.

question_text:
A company has an application that is backed by an Amazon DynamoDB table. The company’s compliance requirements specify that database backups must be taken every month, must be available for 6 months, and must be retained for 7 years.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
AWS Backup 覆盖了所有要求，仅通过一个计划实现：一个每月计划，一个生命周期策略，在六个月后将备份移动到冷存储，并保持七年保留期。无需脚本，也无需手动操作。
选项 B：DynamoDB 的备份无法移动到 S3 存储桶并使用生命周期规则进行管理——它们是服务的内部对象。
选项 C：两个自定义计划脚本是可能的最大开发和维护开销，而一个现成的托管服务已经存在。
选项 D：按需备份命令不接受用于过渡到冷存储或用于删除计划的参数——这些由 AWS Backup 计划定义。

options.text: Create an AWS Backup plan to back up the DynamoDB table on the first day of each month. Specify a lifecycle policy that transitions the backup to cold storage after 6 months. Set the retention period for each backup to 7 years.

Create a DynamoDB on-demand backup of the DynamoDB table on the first day of each month. Transition the backup to Amazon S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval after 6 months. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to delete backups that are older than 7 years.

Use the AWS SDK to develop a script that creates an on-demand backup of the DynamoDB table. Set up an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs the script on the first day of each month. Create a second script that will run on the second day of each month to transition DynamoDB backups that are older than 6 months to cold storage and to delete backups that are older than 7 years.

Use the AWS CLI to create an on-demand backup of the DynamoDB table. Set up an Amazon EventBridge rule that runs the command on the first day of each month with a cron expression. Specify in the command to transition the backups to cold storage after 6 months and to delete the backups after 7 years.

question_text:
A company is using Amazon CloudFront with its website. The company has enabled logging on the CloudFront distribution, and logs are saved in one of the company’s Amazon S3 buckets. The company needs to perform advanced analyses on the logs and build visualizations.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
CloudFront 的日志已经存储在 S3 中，因此最方便的方式是使用 Amazon Athena 中的标准 SQL 进行查询，仅按扫描的字节数计费。Amazon QuickSight 负责构建可视化图表——它将 Athena 作为数据源进行连接，让你能够组装仪表盘和报告，而无需自行搭建任何基础设施。
选项 A：AWS Glue 是一个 ETL 和数据目录服务，而不是可视化工具。
选项 C：DynamoDB 无法对 S3 中的对象执行 SQL 查询——它是一个非关系型存储服务，拥有自己的 API。
选项 D：与 DynamoDB 作为查询引擎的相同错误，尽管可视化选择是正确的。

options.text: Use standard SQL queries in Amazon Athena to analyze the CloudFront logs in the S3 bucket. Visualize the results with AWS Glue.
Use standard SQL queries in Amazon Athena to analyze the CloudFront logs in the S3 bucket. Visualize the results with Amazon QuickSight.
Use standard SQL queries in Amazon DynamoDB to analyze the CloudFront logs in the S3 bucket. Visualize the results with AWS Glue.
Use standard SQL queries in Amazon DynamoDB to analyze the CloudFront logs in the S3 bucket. Visualize the results with Amazon QuickSight.

question_text:
A company runs a fleet of web servers using an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL DB instance. After a routine compliance check, the company sets a standard that requires a recovery point objective (RPO) of less than 1 second for all its production databases.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
一个 RPO 小于一秒意味着几乎零数据丢失，这只有同步复制才能提供。RDS 多可用区（Multi-AZ）会将每个事务同步写入另一个可用区的备用实例，因此故障切换时不会丢失已提交的事务。
选项 B：RDS 数据库实例没有自动实例扩展功能，且单个可用区无法抵御该区域故障。
选项 C：读副本是异步复制的——延迟以秒为单位衡量，无法保证所需的恢复点。
选项 D：DMS CDC 任务也是异步的，其设计目的是用于迁移，而非数据库容错。

options.text: Enable a Multi-AZ deployment for the DB instance.
Enable auto scaling for the DB instance in one Availability Zone.
Configure the DB instance in one Availability Zone, and create multiple read replicas in a separate Availability Zone.
Configure the DB instance in one Availability Zone, and configure AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) change data capture (CDC) tasks.

question_text:
A company runs a web application that is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances in the private subnet of a VPC. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) that extends across the public subnets directs web traffic to the EC2 instances.
The company wants to implement new security measures to restrict inbound traffic from the ALB to the EC2 instances while preventing access from any other source inside or outside the private subnet of the EC2 instances.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
要求是仅允许来自负载均衡器的流量，不允许来自其他任何来源。这是通过引用安全组实现的：实例的入站规则仅允许来自ALB安全组的流量。任何其他来源，无论是子网内部还是外部，都无法连接。
选项 A：无法创建从互联网到实例私有地址的路由，即使可以创建，也会使实例暴露在全世界的访问之下。
选项 C：将实例移动到具有弹性IP地址的公共子网，恰恰相反——它将实例置于互联网上。
选项 D：允许负载均衡器在任何端口上接收任何TCP流量，并不会限制对实例本身的访问，反而会削弱安全态势。

options.text: Configure a route in a route table to direct traffic from the internet to the private IP addresses of the EC2 instances.
Configure the security group for the EC2 instances to only allow traffic that comes from the security group for the ALB.
Move the EC2 instances into the public subnet. Give the EC2 instances a set of Elastic IP addresses.
Configure the security group for the ALB to allow any TCP traffic on any port.

question_text:
A research company runs experiments that are powered by a simulation application and a visualization application.
The simulation application runs on Linux and outputs intermediate data to an NFS share every 5 minutes. The visualization application is a Windows desktop application that displays the simulation output and requires an SMB file system.
The company maintains two synchronized file systems. This strategy is causing data duplication and inefficient resource usage. The company needs to migrate the applications to AWS without making code changes to either application.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
根本原因在于两种不同的协议：Linux 模拟在 NFS 上写入，Windows 可视化在 SMB 上读取，公司被迫维护两个同步副本。Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP 是唯一一个能够在 AWS 文件服务中同时通过 NFS 和 SMB 提供相同数据的服务。应用程序迁移到 EC2 实例时无需代码更改，重复副本也随之消失。
选项 A：Lambda 不适合长时间运行的模拟或 Windows 桌面应用程序，迁移到 S3 意味着需要重写两个应用程序，而这与需求规定相矛盾。
选项 B：FSx File Gateway 是一个混合网关，用于从本地网络访问 FSx，而不是为 AWS 内部工作负载提供共享存储和双协议访问。
选项 C：SQS 仅传递消息，它不提供文件资源——应用程序必须被重写以适配队列。

options.text: Migrate both applications to AWS Lambda. Create an Amazon S3 bucket to exchange data between the applications.
Migrate both applications to Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Configure Amazon FSx File Gateway for storage.

Migrate the simulation application to Linux Amazon EC2 instances. Migrate the visualization application to Windows EC2 instances. Configure Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to exchange data between the applications.
Migrate the simulation application to Linux Amazon EC2 instances. Migrate the visualization application to Windows EC2 instances. Configure Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP for storage.

question_text:
As part of budget planning, management wants a report of AWS billed items listed by user. The data will be used to create department budgets. A solutions architect needs to determine the most efficient way to obtain this report information.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
所需的是按消费者对部门预算进行成本拆分，并且需要快速完成。Cost Explorer 可以帮助您构建按成本分配标签（例如，按所有者或部门）分组的报告，按关联账户分组，按服务分组，以图表形式查看，并导出为 CSV 文件。这是最直接的路径——无需导出，无需 SQL，无需设置存储。
选项 A：Athena 查询成本和使用报告导出，但该导出首先需要启用、生成并连接。这为一个即用型报告增加了额外步骤。
选项 C：账单从账单控制台仪表板显示按服务的总计，但缺少按所有者分组的必要信息，也缺乏灵活的过滤功能。
选项 D：AWS Budgets 在阈值被超过时发送警报，它并非用于构建成本结构报告的工具。

options.text: Run a query with Amazon Athena to generate the report.
Create a report in Cost Explorer and download the report.
Access the bill details from the billing dashboard and download the bill.
Modify a cost budget in AWS Budgets to alert with Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).

question_text:
A company hosts its static website by using Amazon S3. The company wants to add a contact form to its webpage.
The contact form will have dynamic server-side components for users to input their name, email address, phone number, and user message. The company anticipates that there will be fewer than 100 site visits each month.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
每月访问量少于100次时，为持续运行的服务器付费毫无意义。表单通过调用 API Gateway 处理，后端由一个 Lambda 函数负责，该函数通过 Amazon SES 发送邮件。这种组合在空闲时成本为零，且在每月一百次请求时仍处于免费额度范围内。
选项 A：ECS 任务因持续运行而被计费，即使流量几乎为零。
选项 C：Lightsail 实例是固定的月费，而 WorkMail 按邮箱数量计费。
选项 D：持续运行的带有 LAMP 栈的实例还需要维护——这是最昂贵且最耗人力的选项。

options.text: Host a dynamic contact form page in Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS). Set up Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) to connect to any third-party email provider.
Create an Amazon API Gateway endpoint with an AWS Lambda backend that makes a call to Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
Convert the static webpage to dynamic by deploying Amazon Lightsail. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail.

Create a t2.micro Amazon EC2 instance. Deploy a LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP/Perl/Python) stack to host the webpage. Use client-side scripting to build the contact form. Integrate the form with Amazon WorkMail.

question_text:
A company has a static website that is hosted on Amazon CloudFront in front of Amazon S3. The static website uses a database backend. The company notices that the website does not reflect updates that have been made in the website’s Git repository. The company checks the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline between the Git repository and Amazon S3. The company verifies that the webhooks are configured properly and that the CI/CD pipeline is sending messages that indicate successful deployments.
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that displays the updates on the website.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
部署成功且存储桶中的文件已更新，但用户仍看到旧版本——这意味着 CloudFront 正从缓存中提供内容。对象在边缘位置被保留，直到其 TTL 过期，因此每次部署后都需要进行无效化操作，并且最好将此操作集成到相同的交付管道中。
选项 A：负载均衡器将流量分发到实例之间，但该网站是静态的，并且存在于存储桶中——这与过时的缓存无关。
选项 B：数据库前的缓存可以加快查询速度，但它并不是在提供过时的文件——内容分发网络才是。
选项 D：证书验证涉及 TLS，与内容的新鲜度无关。

options.text: Add an Application Load Balancer.
Add Amazon ElastiCache for Redis or Memcached to the database layer of the web application.
Invalidate the CloudFront cache.
Use AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) to validate the website’s SSL certificate.

question_text:
A company wants to migrate a Windows-based application from on premises to the AWS Cloud. The application has three tiers: an application tier, a business tier, and a database tier with Microsoft SQL Server. The company wants to use specific features of SQL Server such as native backups and Data Quality Services. The company also needs to share files for processing between the tiers.
How should a solutions architect design the architecture to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该场景指出，托管服务不提供 SQL Server 的某些功能：原生引擎备份和数据质量服务。因此，数据库必须部署在 EC2 实例上。在 Windows 环境中，各层级之间的共享文件交换由 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server 提供——一个支持 Windows ACL 的 SMB 共享，可从所有三个层级访问。
选项 A：FSx File Gateway 是用于从本地网络访问 FSx 文件系统，但所有层级都已经在 AWS 内部——这只会引入一个不必要的中间层。
选项 C：RDS for SQL Server 既不支持公司所使用的原生备份方式，也不支持数据质量服务——这直接违反了需求。
选项 D：RDS 存在同样的问题，此外，EBS 卷不是多个实例可以共享的文件资源。

options.text: Host all three tiers on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Amazon FSx File Gateway for file sharing between the tiers.
Host all three tiers on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Amazon FSx for Windows File Server for file sharing between the tiers.
Host the application tier and the business tier on Amazon EC2 instances. Host the database tier on Amazon RDS. Use Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) for file sharing between the tiers.

Host the application tier and the business tier on Amazon EC2 instances. Host the database tier on Amazon RDS. Use a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume for file sharing between the tiers.

question_text:
A company is migrating a Linux-based web server group to AWS. The web servers must access files in a shared file store for some content. The company must not make any changes to the application.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
一组 Linux 服务器共享文件访问，无需应用变更，是 Amazon EFS。文件系统通过 NFS 在所有可用区的所有 Web 服务器上挂载，应用程序仍可使用普通路径和文件，存储能够自动扩展。
选项 A：S3 是对象存储，通过 API 访问。要使用它，应用程序必须重写，而这与要求相矛盾。
选项 B：CloudFront 位于 S3 前面，可以加快静态内容的分发，但它仍然无法为服务器提供共享文件系统。
选项 D：一个 EBS 卷只能在单个可用区中挂载，其上的普通文件系统并非为多个服务器同时写入而设计。

options.text: Create an Amazon S3 Standard bucket with access to the web servers.
Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution with an Amazon S3 bucket as the origin.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system on all web servers.
Configure a General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume to all web servers.

question_text:
A company has an AWS Lambda function that needs read access to an Amazon S3 bucket that is located in the same AWS account.
Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST secure manner?
explanation_en:
授予 AWS 中任何计算资源权限的正确方式是使用角色。Lambda 函数获取一个执行角色，将其附加的 IAM 策略授予特定存储桶的 s3:GetObject 和 s3:ListBucket 权限，如果需要，还包含特定前缀。涉及的凭据是临时的：它们由 STS 发出，会自动刷新，并且永远不会被存储在任何地方。题目中的关键短语是 '最安全的方式' —— 在一个角色仅针对单个存储桶和一个角色针对所有存储桶之间，选择前者，因为即使在单个账户内，最小权限原则也适用。
选项 A：一个存储桶策略描述了谁可以访问该资源，但函数仍然需要自己的身份和权限。在单个账户内，这通常通过角色来处理，而不是通过开放存储桶。
选项 C：将访问密钥嵌入函数代码中是一个长期存在的秘密，存储在仓库和部署包中，且无法自动轮换。这是最差的选项。
选项 D：使用角色是正确的做法，但权限被授予了账户中的每个存储桶。这违反了最小权限原则，而题目要求的是最安全的选项。

options.text: Apply an S3 bucket policy that grants read access to the S3 bucket.
Apply an IAM role to the Lambda function. Apply an IAM policy to the role to grant read access to the S3 bucket.
Embed an access key and a secret key in the Lambda function’s code to grant the required IAM permissions for read access to the S3 bucket.
Apply an IAM role to the Lambda function. Apply an IAM policy to the role to grant read access to all S3 buckets in the account.

question_text:
A company hosts a web application on multiple Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group that scales in response to user demand. The company wants to optimize cost savings without making a long-term commitment.
Which EC2 instance purchasing option should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该公司不希望做出长期承诺，因此排除了预留实例和节省计划。这留下了一组混合方案：通过按需实例提供基础保障以确保可用性，同时通过可中断的竞价实例为突发流量提供额外容量，可享受高达90%的折扣。
选项 A：专用实例是成本最高的选项，仅在需要硬件隔离时才必需。
选项 B：仅使用按需实例无法在基础价格之外获得任何节省。
选项 D：预留实例正是该公司希望避免的一年或三年承诺。

options.text: Dedicated Instances only
On-Demand Instances only
A mix of On-Demand Instances and Spot Instances
A mix of On-Demand Instances and Reserved Instances

question_text:
A media company uses Amazon CloudFront for its publicly available streaming video content. The company wants to secure the video content that is hosted in Amazon S3 by controlling who has access. Some of the company’s users are using a custom HTTP client that does not support cookies. Some of the company’s users are unable to change the hardcoded URLs that they are using for access.
Which services or methods will meet these requirements with the LEAST impact to the users? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
该场景隐藏了两个独立的用户限制，每个限制都有其对应的 CloudFront 解决方案。不支持 Cookie 的客户端无法使用签名 Cookie —— 对于这类用户，签名 URL 是合适的，因为签名直接存在于链接中。URL 被硬编码且无法更改的用户无法切换到签名 URL —— 对于这类用户，签名 Cookie 更合适，因为地址保持不变，而签名通过 Cookie 头传递。因此，两种机制都应包含在答案中：每种机制都以最小影响服务于特定用户群体。
选项 C：AWS AppSync 是一个托管的 GraphQL API 服务。它与限制 CloudFront 中内容的访问无关。
选项 D：JWT 本身不是 CloudFront 的授权机制 —— 验证此类令牌需要编写 Lambda@Edge 函数。这属于开发工作，而不是‘最小影响’。
选项 E：Secrets Manager 用于存储应用程序密钥。它不管理视频文件的观众访问权限。

options.text: Signed cookies
Signed URLs
AWS AppSync
JSON Web Token (JWT)
AWS Secrets Manager

question_text:
A company is preparing a new data platform that will ingest real-time streaming data from multiple sources. The company needs to transform the data before writing the data to Amazon S3. The company needs the ability to use SQL to query the transformed data.
Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
需要三项：摄入流式数据、在写入前对其进行转换、以及能够使用 SQL 查询结果。两种可行组合均以 S3 和 Athena 结束。第一种：Kinesis Data Streams 消费数据流，Kinesis Data Analytics 实时进行转换，Firehose 将结果交付至 S3（A）。第二种：Amazon MSK 消费数据流，AWS Glue 执行转换并将数据写入 S3（B）。
选项 C：DMS 将数据从数据库迁出——它无法从多个来源摄入实时数据流。
选项 D：S3 中的数据无法通过 Amazon RDS 查询编辑器进行查询——该工具针对数据库本身工作。
选项 E：与 RDS 查询编辑器相同的问题，该工具无法访问 S3 中的对象。

options.text: Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to transform the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to write the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the transformed data from Amazon S3.

Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to stream the data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data and to write the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the transformed data from Amazon S3.

Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to ingest the data. Use Amazon EMR to transform the data and to write the data to Amazon S3. Use Amazon Athena to query the transformed data from Amazon S3.

Use Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK) to stream the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Analytics to transform the data and to write the data to Amazon S3. Use the Amazon RDS query editor to query the transformed data from Amazon S3.

Use Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to stream the data. Use AWS Glue to transform the data. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to write the data to Amazon S3. Use the Amazon RDS query editor to query the transformed data from Amazon S3.

question_text:
A company has an on-premises volume backup solution that has reached its end of life. The company wants to use AWS as part of a new backup solution and wants to maintain local access to all the data while it is backed up on AWS. The company wants to ensure that the data backed up on AWS is automatically and securely transferred.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
关键要求是保持对所有数据的本地访问，而不仅仅是部分数据。这正是存储网关在存储卷模式下所实现的：整个数据集保留在本地磁盘上，而快照则异步且加密地上传到 S3。备份变得自动进行，访问延迟仍保持在本地。
选项 A：Snowball 是一种一次性传输设备——它没有持久的 S3 终端点可供挂载，也不提供自动、持续的上传。
选项 B：Snowball Edge 也旨在用于一次性传输，不是一个持久的备份解决方案。
选项 C：缓存卷模式仅在本地保留数据的一部分，但要求是需要对整个卷实现本地访问。

options.text: Use AWS Snowball to migrate data out of the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Configure on-premises systems to mount the Snowball S3 endpoint to provide local access to the data.
Use AWS Snowball Edge to migrate data out of the on-premises solution to Amazon S3. Use the Snowball Edge file interface to provide on-premises systems with local access to the data.

Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a cached volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and configure a percentage of data to cache locally. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local access to the data.

Use AWS Storage Gateway and configure a stored volume gateway. Run the Storage Gateway software appliance on premises and map the gateway storage volumes to on-premises storage. Mount the gateway storage volumes to provide local access to the data.

question_text:
An application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances needs to access an Amazon S3 bucket. Traffic must not traverse the internet.
How should a solutions architect configure access to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
有一个要求：流量不得经过互联网。对于 S3，需要使用网关 VPC 终端节点——将指向服务前缀的路由添加到 VPC 的路由表中，流量将保留在 AWS 网络内，并且终端节点本身没有费用。此外，可以通过 aws:SourceVpce 条件将存储桶进行限制，使其仅接受通过该终端节点的请求。相同的技巧在 第 91、480、710 题 中有详细说明。
选项 A：一个 Route 53 私有托管区负责 VPC 内部的名称解析，对通往 S3 的路由没有影响。
选项 C：一个 NAT 网关是通往互联网的路径——它直接违反了该要求，并且会对处理的流量收费。
选项 D：一个 Site-to-Site VPN 将 VPC 连接到外部网络，而不是连接到 S3 服务——不存在这样的构造。

options.text: Create a private hosted zone by using Amazon Route 53.
Set up a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3 in the VPC.
Configure the EC2 instances to use a NAT gateway to access the S3 bucket.
Establish an AWS Site-to-Site VPN connection between the VPC and the S3 bucket.

question_text:
An ecommerce company stores terabytes of customer data in the AWS Cloud. The data contains personally identifiable information (PII). The company wants to use the data in three applications. Only one of the applications needs to process the PII. The PII must be removed before the other two applications process the data.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
这是相同的数据，但不同的应用程序需要不同的数据视图。S3 Object Lambda 可以将函数附加到访问点：在数据返回时实时转换对象，因此两个应用程序获得已移除个人数据的版本，而第三个应用程序则获得原始数据。不会出现额外的数据副本，所有逻辑都包含在单个函数中。
选项 A：一个自定义代理层是一种需要编写、扩展和维护的应用程序。
选项 C：三份太abytes的数据意味着三倍的存储成本以及持续的同步需求。
选项 D：同样的理念，但在 DynamoDB 中，存储太abytes的成本更高，并且需要重新设计数据访问方式。

options.text: Store the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Create a proxy application layer to intercept and process the data that each application requests.
Store the data in an Amazon S3 bucket. Process and transform the data by using S3 Object Lambda before returning the data to the requesting application.
Process the data and store the transformed data in three separate Amazon S3 buckets so that each application has its own custom dataset. Point each application to its respective S3 bucket.
Process the data and store the transformed data in three separate Amazon DynamoDB tables so that each application has its own custom dataset. Point each application to its respective DynamoDB table.

question_text:
A development team has launched a new application that is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances inside a development VPC. A solutions architect needs to create a new VPC in the same account. The new VPC will be peered with the development VPC. The VPC CIDR block for the development VPC is 192.168.0.0/24. The solutions architect needs to create a CIDR block for the new VPC. The CIDR block must be valid for a VPC peering connection to the development VPC.
What is the SMALLEST CIDR block that meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
两个约束条件适用。对等 VPC 的地址范围不能重叠，因此 192.168.0.0/24 及其内部任何内容均无效。且最小允许的 VPC 地址块大小为 /28，因此 /32 掩码在任何情况下都是无效的。在给定的选项中，只有 10.0.1.0/24 剩余。
选项 A：一个 /32 掩码指定单个地址——VPC 无法使用该块创建；最小要求是 /28。
选项 B：该块与现有网络的块完全匹配，地址范围重叠会使对等连接变得不可能。
选项 C：再次是一个 /32 掩码，这对 VPC 来说是无效的，且该地址也位于邻近网络范围之内。

question_text:
A company deploys an application on five Amazon EC2 instances. An Application Load Balancer (ALB) distributes traffic to the instances by using a target group. The average CPU usage on each of the instances is below 10% most of the time, with occasional surges to 65%.
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to automate the scalability of the application. The solution must optimize the cost of the architecture and must ensure that the application has enough CPU resources when surges occur.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
实例已经存在，负载均衡器和目标组也已配置——需要的是自动扩展，而无需过度付费。创建了一个自动扩展组，使用相同的负载均衡器和相同的目标组，并基于平均 CPU 利用率设置目标跟踪策略：在流量激增时容量可增长至 65 百分比，在平静期则会回落到最小值。
选项 A：一个在接收到信号时终止实例的自定义函数无法实现扩容，并绕过了标准的扩展机制。
选项 C：没有设置扩展策略的组仅维持固定的实例数量，不会对流量激增做出反应。
选项 D：在收到邮件后手动更改实例数量并非自动化——而自动化正是所需的功能。

options.text: Create an Amazon CloudWatch alarm that enters the ALARM state when the CPUUtilization metric is less than 20%. Create an AWS Lambda function that the CloudWatch alarm invokes to terminate one of the EC2 instances in the ALB target group.

Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set a target tracking scaling policy that is based on the ASGAverageCPUUtilization metric. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, the maximum instances to 6, and the target value to 50%. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group.

Create an EC2 Auto Scaling group. Select the existing ALB as the load balancer and the existing target group as the target group. Set the minimum instances to 2, the desired capacity to 3, and the maximum instances to 6. Add the EC2 instances to the Auto Scaling group.

Create two Amazon CloudWatch alarms. Configure the first CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization metric is below 20%. Configure the second CloudWatch alarm to enter the ALARM state when the average CPUUtilization matric is above 50%. Configure the alarms to publish to an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to send an email message. After receiving the message, log in to decrease or increase the number of EC2 instances that are running.

question_text:
A company is running a critical business application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. The EC2 instances run in an Auto Scaling group and access an Amazon RDS DB instance.
The design did not pass an operational review because the EC2 instances and the DB instance are all located in a single Availability Zone. A solutions architect must update the design to use a second Availability Zone.
Which solution will make the application highly available?
explanation_en:
一个 AWS 的子网始终属于恰好一个可用区，因此不存在跨越多个可用区的子网。正确的做法是：每个可用区一个子网，自动扩展组将实例分布在两个可用区中，数据库则被配置为多可用区部署，具备同步复制和自动故障切换功能。
选项 A：子网的配置是正确的，但数据库仍然停留在单个可用区——'对每个网络的连接'并不能为其提供容错能力。
选项 B：子网无法跨越两个可用区，数据库再次成为一个单点故障。
选项 D：同样的跨越子网的错误，尽管数据库配置是正确的。

options.text: Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network.

Provision two subnets that extend across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance with connections to each network.
Provision a subnet in each Availability Zone. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.
