Provision a subnet that extends across both Availability Zones. Configure the Auto Scaling group to distribute the EC2 instances across both Availability Zones. Configure the DB instance for Multi-AZ deployment.

question_text:
A research laboratory needs to process approximately 8 TB of data. The laboratory requires sub-millisecond latencies and a minimum throughput of 6 GBps for the storage subsystem. Hundreds of Amazon EC2 instances that run Amazon Linux will distribute and process the data.
Which solution will meet the performance requirements?
explanation_en:
硬性指标已明确指定：亚毫秒级延迟和至少 6 GBps 的吞吐量，同时数百个 Linux 实例在运行。该性能配置与基于持久性 SSD 存储的 Amazon FSx for Lustre 完全匹配——它是唯一能够实现这些指标的选项。源数据存储在 S3 中，并通过导入/导出功能与文件系统关联，这既方便加载数据，也便于保存结果。
选项 A：FSx for NetApp ONTAP 是一种通用文件服务——它并非为每秒数吉字节的吞吐量支持数百个客户端而设计，且其分层策略也会将数据下推到较慢的存储层级。
选项 C：基于 HDD 盘的持久性存储无法实现亚毫秒级延迟：机械硬盘本质上速度较慢。
选项 D：关闭分层可解决一个问题，但 ONTAP 的性能仍无法达到所需指标。

options.text: Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Sat each volume’ tiering policy to ALL. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the fila system on the EC2 instances.

Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent SSD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.

Create an Amazon S3 bucket to store the raw data. Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system that uses persistent HDD storage. Select the option to import data from and export data to Amazon S3. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.
Create an Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP file system. Set each volume’s tiering policy to NONE. Import the raw data into the file system. Mount the file system on the EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company needs to migrate a legacy application from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud because of hardware capacity constraints. The application runs 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The application’s database storage continues to grow over time.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
该应用程序持续全天运行，数据库存储随时间不断增长。对于稳定且恒定的负载，预留实例是成本最低的选择——可享受高达四分之三的按需价格折扣。Aurora还能自动扩展其存储空间，因此无需手动干预来应对增长的存储需求，而Aurora预留实例同样降低了数据层的成本。
选项 A：AWS 可以随时收回 Spot 实例——这对于必须全天候运行的应用来说是不可接受的——且 S3 无法替代关系型数据库。
选项 B：按需 RDS 实例即使负载恒定且可预测，也按全额计费。
选项 D：这里情况正好相反：折扣适用于数据库，但最大的层级——应用程序——仍按全额计费。

options.text: Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Spot Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon S3.
Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS On-Demand Instances.
Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon Aurora Reserved Instances.
Migrate the application layer to Amazon EC2 On-Demand Instances. Migrate the data storage layer to Amazon RDS Reserved Instances.

question_text:
A university research laboratory needs to migrate 30 TB of data from an on-premises Windows file server to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. The laboratory has a 1 Gbps network link that many other departments in the university share.
The laboratory wants to implement a data migration service that will maximize the performance of the data transfer. However, the laboratory needs to be able to control the amount of bandwidth that the service uses to minimize the impact on other departments. The data migration must take place within the next 5 days.
Which AWS solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
三十太字节通过一吉比特链路在满负荷情况下大约需要三天，因此只要链路没有被其他流量完全占用，达到五天窗口是可能的。主要要求是控制带宽使用，而这正是 AWS DataSync 提供的：一个任务可以设置带宽限制，通过并行流传输数据，包含完整性校验，并且可以直接写入 FSx for Windows File Server。
选项 A：Snowcone 只能存储几太字节——30 TB 需要多个设备，运输时间会占用截止期限。
选项 B：FSx File Gateway 提供从本地网络持续访问文件系统的功能，但它不是具备带宽控制的一次性迁移工具。
选项 D：AWS Transfer Family 提供 SFTP、FTPS 和 FTP 服务，通过 S3 和 EFS —— 它既不支持带宽限制的大规模迁移，也无法直接写入 FSx。

options.text: AWS Snowcone
Amazon FSx File Gateway
AWS DataSync
AWS Transfer Family

question_text:
A company wants to create a mobile app that allows users to stream slow-motion video clips on their mobile devices. Currently, the app captures video clips and uploads the video clips in raw format into an Amazon S3 bucket. The app retrieves these video clips directly from the S3 bucket. However, the videos are large in their raw format.
Users are experiencing issues with buffering and playback on mobile devices. The company wants to implement solutions to maximize the performance and scalability of the app while minimizing operational overhead.
Which combination of solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
存在两个独立的问题，每个问题各自独立解决。文件在原始形式下过大——需要转码为适合移动设备的格式和码率，而管理式的 Amazon Elastic Transcoder 正是为此设计（C）。全球各地用户的延迟和缓冲问题通过边缘缓存得到解决，这意味着在存储桶前部署一个 CloudFront 分发（A）。
选项 B：将文件复制到其他区域的存储桶中会增加存储成本，并需要独立的路由逻辑，而 CDN 缓存以更低的成本实现了相同的效果。
选项 D：在本地区域使用自定义实例集群进行内容分发是一种需要维护的基础设施，而不是使用现成的内容分发网络。
选项 E：在自管理的实例上进行转码意味着需要管理实例集群和队列，而不是使用管理式的转码服务。

options.text: Deploy Amazon CloudFront for content delivery and caching.
Use AWS DataSync to replicate the video files across AW'S Regions in other S3 buckets.
Use Amazon Elastic Transcoder to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.
Deploy an Auto Sealing group of Amazon EC2 instances in Local Zones for content delivery and caching.
Deploy an Auto Scaling group of Amazon EC2 instances to convert the video files to more appropriate formats.

question_text:
A company is launching a new application deployed on an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster and is using the Fargate launch type for ECS tasks. The company is monitoring CPU and memory usage because it is expecting high traffic to the application upon its launch. However, the company wants to reduce costs when utilization decreases.
What should a solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
这些任务在 Fargate 上运行，因此完全没有实例需要扩展。服务任务的数量由 AWS Application Auto Scaling 控制：目标跟踪策略维持一个设定的 CPU 或内存利用率水平，在负载高峰时增加任务，在负载低谷时移除任务——自动降低成本。
选项 A：EC2 Auto Scaling 管理实例，而 Fargate 启动类型中并不存在此类实例，基于过去模式的扩展无法响应实际负载。
选项 B：一个根据信号调整服务规模的自定义函数需要编写和维护代码，而内置策略则能实现相同功能。
选项 C：再次，扩展 EC2 实例，而这种架构中并不存在此类实例。

options.text: Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling to scale at certain periods based on previous traffic patterns.
Use an AWS Lambda function to scale Amazon ECS based on metric breaches that trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
Use Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling with simple scaling policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.
Use AWS Application Auto Scaling with target tracking policies to scale when ECS metric breaches trigger an Amazon CloudWatch alarm.

question_text:
A company recently created a disaster recovery site in a different AWS Region. The company needs to transfer large amounts of data back and forth between NFS file systems in the two Regions on a periodic basis.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
在两个区域之间，NFS文件系统间的大规模数据周期性双向传输，是AWS DataSync任务的典型范例。它在AWS内部存储位置之间运行，按计划执行，仅传输变更内容，验证数据完整性，并且无需服务器或脚本。
选项 B：Snowball设备适用于通过弱连接进行的一次性数据传输，而不是用于在AWS区域之间进行定期同步。
选项 C：在实例上部署的自管理SFTP服务器是一种需要持续维护的机器和脚本。
选项 D：DMS迁移的是数据库数据，而不是文件系统内容。

options.text: Use AWS DataSync.
Use AWS Snowball devices.
Set up an SFTP server on Amazon EC2.
Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS).

question_text:
A company is designing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud. The company needs the ability to use SMB clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed.
Which AWS solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
要求很简单且非常明确：支持 SMB 访问，并提供完全托管的解决方案。这就是 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server —— 一个具备原生 SMB、Windows ACL 支持以及 Active Directory 集成的文件系统，全部由 AWS 进行管理。考试中：SMB 映射到 FSx for Windows，NFS 映射到 EFS，通过 API 实现的对象访问映射到 S3，而运行在 EC2 上的自托管文件服务器违反了‘完全托管’的要求。
选项 A：DataSync 用于在存储位置之间移动数据，并不提供可挂载的文件系统。
选项 B：运行在 Windows 实例上的文件服务器需要手动进行补丁更新、备份和扩展。这违反了托管服务的要求。
选项 D：S3 是对象存储，不支持 SMB。一个存储桶只能通过第三方工具挂载，且不具备完整的文件语义。

options.text: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
Create an Amazon EC2 Windows instance. Install and configure a Windows file share role on the instance. Connect the application server to the file share.
Create an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
Create an Amazon S3 bucket. Assign an IAM role to the application to grant access to the S3 bucket. Mount the S3 bucket to the application server.

question_text:
A company wants to run an in-memory database for a latency-sensitive application that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. The application processes more than 100,000 transactions each minute and requires high network throughput. A solutions architect needs to provide a cost-effective network design that minimizes data transfer charges.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
目标是最大化网络吞吐量、最小化延迟和最小化数据传输费用。这一切都来自于将实例放置在集群放置组内的单个可用区中：这些机器最终会位于同一个网络段上，且同一可用区内部使用私有地址的流量不会产生费用。
选项 B：不同可用区意味着跨可用区的数据传输费用和更高的延迟，且分区策略是为在机架间分布实例以实现容错而设计的。
选项 C：再次跨区分布会引入跨可用区的流量，基于网络利用率的扩展无法满足延迟要求。
选项 D：同样的跨可用区费用问题，且阶梯式扩展与网络性能无关。

options.text: Launch all EC2 instances in the same Availability Zone within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with cluster strategy when launching EC2 instances.
Launch all EC2 instances in different Availability Zones within the same AWS Region. Specify a placement group with partition strategy when launching EC2 instances.
Deploy an Auto Scaling group to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones based on a network utilization target.
Deploy an Auto Scaling group with a step scaling policy to launch EC2 instances in different Availability Zones.

question_text:
A company that primarily runs its application servers on premises has decided to migrate to AWS. The company wants to minimize its need to scale its Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) storage on premises.
The company wants only its recently accessed data to remain stored locally.
Which AWS solution should the company use to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
两个词决定了答案。iSCSI 表示块级访问，因此需要使用 Volume Gateway：S3 File Gateway 通过 NFS 和 SMB 提供文件访问，Tape Gateway 模拟磁带库。"仅保留最近访问的数据存储在本地" 指向了卷模式：在缓存卷中，主数据集存储在 AWS 上，而本地端保留热点块的缓存，因此无需扩展本地容量。存储卷则相反——完整副本保留在本地，只有快照会上传到 AWS。
选项 A：S3 File Gateway 通过 NFS 和 SMB 提供文件访问。它不适合通过 iSCSI 工作的应用程序。
选项 B：Tape Gateway 是用于备份的虚拟磁带库。它不是用于应用程序日常运行的存储。
选项 C：存储卷在本地保留数据的完整副本，因此对本地容量的需求保持不变。无法满足"最小化本地存储扩展需求"的要求。

options.text: Amazon S3 File Gateway
AWS Storage Gateway Tape Gateway
AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volumes
AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volumes

question_text:
A company has multiple AWS accounts that use consolidated billing. The company runs several active high performance Amazon RDS for Oracle On-Demand DB instances for 90 days. The company’s finance team has access to AWS Trusted Advisor in the consolidated billing account and all other AWS accounts.
The finance team needs to use the appropriate AWS account to access the Trusted Advisor check recommendations for RDS. The finance team must review the appropriate Trusted Advisor check to reduce RDS costs.
Which combination of steps should the finance team take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
原答案：BD；来源修正答案：BC。
实例被描述为活跃的，因此在这些实例上运行 "空闲数据库实例" 检查（D）将不会有任何结果——它查找的是无连接的数据库。持续运行90天的实例降低成本正是 "Amazon RDS 预留实例优化" 检查（C）的功能，而预留实例建议在付款账户（B）中进行汇总
整合账单的 payer account 可查看 Reserved Instance 优化建议；实例持续运行且仍用 On-Demand，应该检查 RDS Reserved Instance Optimization，不是 Idle DB Instances。来源将 BD 修正为 BC，有官方检查说明支持。
实例持续运行90天，因此节省成本来自于转为预留实例，这正是可信顾问 "Amazon RDS 预留实例优化" 检查所标记的（C）。您需要在汇总账单账户中查看（B）：预留实例建议是在整个组织范围内一次性计算的，而不是在每个单独账户中计算。
选项 A：来自实例运行账户的建议必须逐个账户收集，以这种方式购买预留实例将无法考虑整个组织的联合使用情况。
选项 D："空闲数据库实例" 检查会查找过去几天内无连接的数据库。题目明确指出实例是活跃的，因此该检查不会标记它们。这是来源练习资料答案键中的错误。
选项 E：Redshift 预留节点检查适用于不同的服务，与RDS无关。

options.text: Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the account where the RDS instances are running.
Use the Trusted Advisor recommendations from the consolidated billing account to see all RDS instance checks at the same time.
Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Reserved Instance Optimization.
Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon RDS Idle DB Instances.
Review the Trusted Advisor check for Amazon Redshift Reserved Node Optimization.

question_text:
A solutions architect needs to optimize storage costs. The solutions architect must identify any Amazon S3 buckets that are no longer being accessed or are rarely accessed.
Which solution will accomplish this goal with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
S3 Storage Lens 是一个内置的存储分析仪表盘：它显示所有存储桶的大小和对象数量，且在启用了高级活动指标的情况下，还能显示访问频率。无需进行任何配置或手动分析。
选项 B：标准的 S3 控制台显示存储桶内容，但不显示汇总的访问统计信息。
选项 C：存储桶大小指标反映的是存储容量，而不是访问频率，且需要单独进行分析。
选项 D：在 CloudTrail 中启用对象级事件日志会显著增加日志量，并需要自行编写查询——带来极大的操作开销。

options.text: Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 Storage Lens dashboard for advanced activity metrics.
Analyze bucket access patterns by using the S3 dashboard in the AWS Management Console.
Turn on the Amazon CloudWatch BucketSizeBytes metric for buckets. Analyze bucket access patterns by using the metrics data with Amazon Athena.
Turn on AWS CloudTrail for S3 object monitoring. Analyze bucket access patterns by using CloudTrail logs that are integrated with Amazon CloudWatch Logs.

question_text:
A company sells datasets to customers who do research in artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML). The datasets are large, formatted files that are stored in an Amazon S3 bucket in the us-east-1 Region. The company hosts a web application that the customers use to purchase access to a given dataset. The web application is deployed on multiple Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer. After a purchase is made, customers receive an S3 signed URL that allows access to the files.
The customers are distributed across North America and Europe. The company wants to reduce the cost that is associated with data transfers and wants to maintain or improve performance.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
成本来自从 S3 转移到北美和欧洲客户的数据传输。在存储桶前放置 CloudFront 可以降低成本（CloudFront 的数据传输出率低于 S3 的直接传输速率），同时将文件更靠近用户。访问控制则转移到 CloudFront 签名 URL —— 一旦请求经过分发，S3 签名 URL 就不再适用。
选项 A：传输加速可加快数据上传到存储桶，属于附加费用：成本会增加，而不是减少。
选项 C：使用第二个存储桶进行跨区域复制会为这些大数据集加倍存储成本，并额外收取复制费用。
选项 D：通过公司自己的应用程序代理数据会增加实例负载，保持相同的出站流量，并增加开发工作量。

options.text: Configure S3 Transfer Acceleration on the existing S3 bucket. Direct customer requests to the S3 Transfer Acceleration endpoint. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.
Deploy an Amazon CloudFront distribution with the existing S3 bucket as the origin. Direct customer requests to the CloudFront URL. Switch to CloudFront signed URLs for access control.

Set up a second S3 bucket in the eu-central-1 Region with S3 Cross-Region Replication between the buckets. Direct customer requests to the closest Region. Continue to use S3 signed URLs for access control.

Modify the web application to enable streaming of the datasets to end users. Configure the web application to read the data from the existing S3 bucket. Implement access control directly in the application.

question_text:
A company is using AWS to design a web application that will process insurance quotes. Users will request quotes from the application. Quotes must be separated by quote type, must be responded to within 24 hours, and must not get lost. The solution must maximize operational efficiency and must minimize maintenance.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
请求必须按类型分离，绝不能丢失，并且必须在24小时内以最小的操作开销进行处理。一个SNS主题通过消息过滤将每条消息根据类型属性路由到其对应的SQS队列，且每组后端服务器仅读取其自身的队列。队列最多保留消息14天，因此不会有任何消息丢失。
选项 A：多个Kinesis流需要管理分片并在KCL之上编写自定义代码——操作开销更大。
选项 B：一个SNS主题配有一个订阅函数不会存储消息：如果处理失败，请求将丢失。
选项 D：Firehose和一个OpenSearch集群构成一个分析管道，而不是一个任务队列；通过在索引中搜索消息来处理它们的方式极为不切实际。

options.text: Create multiple Amazon Kinesis data streams based on the quote type. Configure the web application to send messages to the proper data stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to use the Kinesis Client Library (KCL) to pool messages from its own data stream.

Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic for each quote type. Subscribe the Lambda function to its associated SNS topic. Configure the application to publish requests for quotes to the appropriate SNS topic.

Create a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic. Subscribe Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queues to the SNS topic. Configure SNS message filtering to publish messages to the proper SQS queue based on the quote type. Configure each backend application server to use its own SQS queue.

Create multiple Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams based on the quote type to deliver data streams to an Amazon OpenSearch Service cluster. Configure the application to send messages to the proper delivery stream. Configure each backend group of application servers to search for the messages from OpenSearch Service and process them accordingly.

question_text:
A company has an application that runs on several Amazon EC2 instances. Each EC2 instance has multiple Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) data volumes attached to it. The application’s EC2 instance configuration and data need to be backed up nightly. The application also needs to be recoverable in a different AWS Region.
Which solution will meet these requirements in the MOST operationally efficient way?
explanation_en:
实例配置以及每个附加卷上的数据都需要进行备份，并且恢复必须在不同的区域中完成。AWS Backup 可以将 EC2 实例视为单一资源：备份包括实例镜像以及所有附加的卷。已配置一个具有每日计划和跨区域复制规则的备份计划。
选项 A：自定义快照函数意味着你需要维护的代码、计划和错误处理，而且它仍然无法保留实例配置。
选项 C：如果仅将卷添加到计划中，实例配置将不会被备份：你无法将整个实例恢复。
选项 D：复制到不同的可用区并不能防止区域级别的故障，而自定义函数再次意味着额外的操作开销。

options.text: Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application’s EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Region.
Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EC2 instances as resources.
Create a backup plan by using AWS Backup to perform nightly backups. Copy the backups to another Region. Add the application’s EBS volumes as resources.
Write an AWS Lambda function that schedules nightly snapshots of the application's EBS volumes and copies the snapshots to a different Availability Zone.

question_text:
A company is building a mobile app on AWS. The company wants to expand its reach to millions of users. The company needs to build a platform so that authorized users can watch the company’s content on their mobile devices.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
数以百万计的移动用户加上仅允许授权用户访问的需求，指向使用 CloudFront 和签名 URL。在验证用户权限后，应用会生成一个具有有限有效期（可选地绑定到 IP 地址）的签名 URL，内容从最近的边缘节点提供，且存储桶通过源访问控制被限制为直接访问。扩展性则成为 CDN 的职责，而非你的职责。
选项 A：一个公共存储桶意味着对所有人开放访问，这与"授权用户"的要求相矛盾。KMS 密钥本身并不会"流式传输"任何内容——那是加密密钥管理服务的功能。
选项 B：为运行在数以百万计设备上的移动应用建立 IPsec VPN 在技术和组织层面都是不可行的，且无法解决视频分发的问题。
选项 D：客户端 VPN 是为连接员工到企业网络而设计的，而不是为向数以百万计的观众公开分发内容。其成本和复杂性与任务相比严重不匹配。

options.text: Publish content to a public Amazon S3 bucket. Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys to stream content.
Set up IPsec VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.
Use Amazon CloudFront. Provide signed URLs to stream content.
Set up AWS Client VPN between the mobile app and the AWS environment to stream content.

question_text:
A company has an on-premises MySQL database used by the global sales team with infrequent access patterns.
The sales team requires the database to have minimal downtime. A database administrator wants to migrate this database to AWS without selecting a particular instance type in anticipation of more users in the future.
Which service should a solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
关键短语是 "不选择特定的实例类型"。这正是 Aurora Serverless for MySQL 提供的功能：容量以 ACU 范围定义，并自动扩展，包括新用户到达时。访问频率较低，因此在空闲期间花费较少，同时 MySQL 兼容性保持应用程序不变。
选项 A：一个标准的 Aurora 集群需要选择实例类——这与要求直接矛盾。
选项 C：Redshift Spectrum 从 S3 读取数据用于分析，并非事务型 MySQL 数据库。
选项 D：RDS for MySQL 也需要选择实例类，并在负载增长时进行手动扩容。

options.text: Amazon Aurora MySQL
Amazon Aurora Serverless for MySQL
Amazon Redshift Spectrum
Amazon RDS for MySQL

question_text:
A company experienced a breach that affected several applications in its on-premises data center. The attacker took advantage of vulnerabilities in the custom applications that were running on the servers. The company is now migrating its applications to run on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants to implement a solution that actively scans for vulnerabilities on the EC2 instances and sends a report that details the findings.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
要求是针对实例进行漏洞的主动扫描，并提供扫描结果报告——那就是 Amazon Inspector。它通过 SSM agent 进行持续扫描，将已安装的软件包与 CVE 数据库进行匹配，评估每个漏洞的网络可达性，并生成优先级排序的发现结果，这些结果可以导出并分发。需要记住的区别是：Inspector 发现漏洞，GuardDuty 发现入侵迹象，Macie 发现敏感数据，而 Shield 防御 DDoS 攻击。
选项 A：AWS Shield 保护免受可用性攻击，并且完全不进行任何扫描。
选项 B：Macie 在 S3 中查找敏感数据，而不是在实例软件中查找漏洞。
选项 C：GuardDuty 检测可疑活动和入侵迹象，但它不会生成漏洞软件包的列表。

options.text: Deploy AWS Shield to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Create an AWS Lambda function to log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
Deploy Amazon Macie and AWS Lambda functions to scan the EC2 instances for vulnerabilities. Log any findings to AWS CloudTrail.
Turn on Amazon GuardDuty. Deploy the GuardDuty agents to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.
Turn on Amazon Inspector. Deploy the Amazon Inspector agent to the EC2 instances. Configure an AWS Lambda function to automate the generation and distribution of reports that detail the findings.

question_text:
A company uses an Amazon EC2 instance to run a script to poll for and process messages in an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. The company wants to reduce operational costs while maintaining its ability to process a growing number of messages that are added to the queue.
What should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该脚本仅轮询队列并处理消息，但实例却持续被计费。使用 SQS 作为事件源的 Lambda 函数，仅在消息到达时才运行，随着消息数量增长自动扩展，并且仅根据执行时间计费。
选项 A：更大的实例会加快处理速度，但成本会增加，而不是减少。
选项 B：按计划关闭实例会在该时间段内导致消息未被处理，并需要额外的自动化支持。
选项 D：Run Command 可按需运行脚本，但实例仍然需要存在并且需要被计费。

options.text: Increase the size of the EC2 instance to process messages faster.
Use Amazon EventBridge to turn off the EC2 instance when the instance is underutilized.
Migrate the script on the EC2 instance to an AWS Lambda function with the appropriate runtime.
Use AWS Systems Manager Run Command to run the script on demand.

question_text:
A company uses a legacy application to produce data in CSV format. The legacy application stores the output data in Amazon S3. The company is deploying a new commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) application that can perform complex SQL queries to analyze data that is stored in Amazon Redshift and Amazon S3 only. However, the COTS application cannot process the .csv files that the legacy application produces.
The company cannot update the legacy application to produce data in another format. The company needs to implement a solution so that the COTS application can use the data that the legacy application produces.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
该应用程序只能与 Redshift 和 S3 协作，但数据以 CSV 格式到达。一个计划运行的 AWS Glue 作业会读取这些文件，对其进行转换，并将其加载到 Redshift 中——这是一个即用型的 ETL 工具，无需自定义代码，也无需集群管理。
选项 B：在 EC2 实例上运行的自定义脚本意味着需要开发和维护，而且 .sql 文件无论如何都不适合该应用程序。
选项 C：DynamoDB 不在应用程序所支持的数据源范围内：无法对其运行 SQL 查询。
选项 D：每周创建一个 EMR 集群意味着额外的延迟和节点管理，同时成本也会更高。

options.text: Create an AWS Glue extract, transform, and load (ETL) job that runs on a schedule. Configure the ETL job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in Amazon Redshift.
Develop a Python script that runs on Amazon EC2 instances to convert the .csv files to .sql files. Invoke the Python script on a cron schedule to store the output files in Amazon S3.

Create an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB table. Use an S3 event to invoke the Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in the DynamoDB table.

Use Amazon EventBridge to launch an Amazon EMR cluster on a weekly schedule. Configure the EMR cluster to perform an extract, transform, and load (ETL) job to process the .csv files and store the processed data in an Amazon Redshift table.

question_text:
A company recently migrated its entire IT environment to the AWS Cloud. The company discovers that users are provisioning oversized Amazon EC2 instances and modifying security group rules without using the appropriate change control process. A solutions architect must devise a strategy to track and audit these inventory and configuration changes.
Which actions should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
有两个独立的需求，由两个独立的服务满足。AWS CloudTrail 记录谁调用了哪个 API 以及何时调用——例如，谁启动了一个超大实例或修改了安全组规则（A）。AWS Config 跟踪资源的配置历史，并允许您定义合规性规则以标记违规行为——例如，禁止的实例类型或过于宽松的规则（D）。
选项 B：数据生命周期策略管理快照和镜像，而不是变更审计。
选项 C：Trusted Advisor 提供关于账户配置的一般建议，但它不记录变更历史或强制执行合规性规则。
选项 E：CloudFormation 可以部署基础设施，但它不是用于审计或回滚任意变更的工具。

options.text: Enable AWS CloudTrail and use it for auditing.
Use data lifecycle policies for the Amazon EC2 instances.
Enable AWS Trusted Advisor and reference the security dashboard.
Enable AWS Config and create rules for auditing and compliance purposes.
Restore previous resource configurations with an AWS CloudFormation template.

question_text:
A company has hundreds of Amazon EC2 Linux-based instances in the AWS Cloud. Systems administrators have used shared SSH keys to manage the instances. After a recent audit, the company’s security team is mandating the removal of all shared keys. A solutions architect must design a solution that provides secure access to the EC2 instances.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST amount of administrative overhead?
explanation_en:
共享的 SSH 密钥需要在保持访问权限的同时被移除。Session Manager 通过无需单个密钥且无需开放端口的方式实现了这一点：实例上的代理会发起向外连接到服务，权限通过 IAM 策略描述，操作会分配给特定用户，会话会被记录到 CloudWatch Logs 或 S3。实例只需要一个具有 AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore 的角色。管理开销极小：无需跳板机，无需密钥分发，无需地址列表。
选项 B：STS 发出临时的 AWS 凭据，而不是 SSH 密钥。不存在这样的机制。
选项 C：使用共享密钥的跳板机并不能解决问题：共享密钥仍然存在，只是数量更少了。
选项 D：将 Cognito 与自定义密钥生成函数结合是一种围绕密钥构建的自研系统——这正是公司希望消除的内容。

options.text: Use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to connect to the EC2 instances.
Use AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS) to generate one-time SSH keys on demand.
Allow shared SSH access to a set of bastion instances. Configure all other instances to allow only SSH access from the bastion instances.
Use an Amazon Cognito custom authorizer to authenticate users. Invoke an AWS Lambda function to generate a temporary SSH key.

question_text:
A company is using a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances to ingest data from on-premises data sources. The data is in JSON format and ingestion rates can be as high as 1 MB/s. When an EC2 instance is rebooted, the data in-flight is lost. The company’s data science team wants to query ingested data in near-real time.
Which solution provides near-real-time data querying that is scalable with minimal data loss?
explanation_en:
问题在于，实例重启的瞬间数据就会丢失，因为数据仅存在于实例的内存和磁盘中。Kinesis Data Streams 接收记录并将它们存储在流中，且与消费者状态无关，因此重启不会导致任何数据丢失，而 Kinesis Data Analytics 可以让你在接近实时的情况下查询数据。
选项 B：Firehose 缓存数据并以数十秒或更长的延迟将其传递到 Redshift：这已不再是接近实时，且如果源端失败，缓存本身也可能丢失。
选项 C：将摄入的数据存储在实例存储中会保持原始问题：实例重启时所有数据都会消失。
选项 D：EBS 卷和 Redis 频道构成一个自建方案，没有交付保证，也没有方便查询摄入数据的方法。

options.text: Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, Use Kinesis Data Analytics to query the data.
Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon Redshift as the destination. Use Amazon Redshift to query the data.
Store ingested data in an EC2 instance store. Publish data to Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose with Amazon S3 as the destination. Use Amazon Athena to query the data.
Store ingested data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Publish data to Amazon ElastiCache for Redis. Subscribe to the Redis channel to query the data.

question_text: What should a solutions architect do to ensure that all objects uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket are encrypted?
explanation_en:
你需要确保未加密的对象根本不会进入存储桶，而不是在事后才去修复问题。这通过一个存储桶策略来实现，该策略明确拒绝在请求缺少 x-amz-server-side-encryption 头（或其值不符合要求——例如，不是 aws:kms）时执行 s3:PutObject 操作。这个拒绝操作在写入之前触发：客户端会收到 AccessDenied 错误，并必须重新发送包含加密的请求。同时请记住区别：默认加密会加密所有到达的数据，而拒绝策略则明确要求客户端显式请求加密。
选项 A：x-amz-acl 头设置对象的访问控制列表。它与加密无关。
选项 B：同样的问题：private 值限制了谁可以看到对象，但对象仍可能以未加密的方式被写入。
选项 C：aws:SecureTransport 条件要求 TLS，即传输过程中的加密。数据会通过安全连接到达，但仍可能以未加密的形式写入磁盘——这个问题关注的是静态加密。

options.text: Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set.
Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an s3:x-amz-acl header set to private.
Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an aws:SecureTransport header set to true.
Update the bucket policy to deny if the PutObject does not have an x-amz-server-side-encryption header set.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing a multi-tier application for a company. The application's users upload images from a mobile device. The application generates a thumbnail of each image and returns a message to the user to confirm that the image was uploaded successfully.
The thumbnail generation can take up to 60 seconds, but the company wants to provide a faster response time to its users to notify them that the original image was received. The solutions architect must design the application to asynchronously dispatch requests to the different application tiers.
What should the solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
用户需要立即响应，而缩略图生成可能需要长达一分钟。SQS 队列解决了这个问题：应用程序会发布关于新图片的消息并立即确认上传，同时处理器以自己的节奏异步生成缩略图，确保任务不会丢失。
选项 A：一个既生成缩略图又通知用户的函数会在响应路径上留下六十秒的等待时间。
选项 B：Step Functions 负责协调各个步骤，但用户通知仍与生成完成绑定，且该设计更为复杂。
选项 D：SNS 不会存储消息：如果订阅者失败，缩略图生成任务将丢失。

options.text: Write a custom AWS Lambda function to generate the thumbnail and alert the user. Use the image upload process as an event source to invoke the Lambda function.
Create an AWS Step Functions workflow. Configure Step Functions to handle the orchestration between the application tiers and alert the user when thumbnail generation is complete.

Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) message queue. As images are uploaded, place a message on the SQS queue for thumbnail generation. Alert the user through an application message that the image was received.

Create Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notification topics and subscriptions. Use one subscription with the application to generate the thumbnail after the image upload is complete. Use a second subscription to message the user's mobile app by way of a push notification after thumbnail generation is complete.

question_text:
A company’s facility has badge readers at every entrance throughout the building. When badges are scanned, the readers send a message over HTTPS to indicate who attempted to access that particular entrance.
A solutions architect must design a system to process these messages from the sensors. The solution must be highly available, and the results must be made available for the company’s security team to analyze.
Which system architecture should the solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
读者通过 HTTPS 发送消息，因此需要一个管理的 HTTPS 终端点和一个无服务器处理器。API Gateway 接收请求并调用 Lambda 函数，该函数解析消息并将结果写入 DynamoDB —— 这三个组件默认都是高可用的，能够自行扩展，且无需任何管理。DynamoDB 中的数据在需要时可通过导出到 S3 并使用 Athena 提供给安全团队进行分析。
选项 A：单个 EC2 实例是一个单点故障，需要打补丁、扩展和监控。无法满足高可用性要求。
选项 C：Route 53 无法调用 Lambda 函数：它是一个 DNS 服务。客户端和函数之间需要一个 HTTP 终端点，例如 API Gateway。
选项 D：读者发送的是 HTTPS 请求，而不是写入存储桶的文件，并为实现此目的而建立到建筑的 VPN 是过度设计。

options.text: Launch an Amazon EC2 instance to serve as the HTTPS endpoint and to process the messages. Configure the EC2 instance to save the results to an Amazon S3 bucket.
Create an HTTPS endpoint in Amazon API Gateway. Configure the API Gateway endpoint to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.
Use Amazon Route 53 to direct incoming sensor messages to an AWS Lambda function. Configure the Lambda function to process the messages and save the results to an Amazon DynamoDB table.

Create a gateway VPC endpoint for Amazon S3. Configure a Site-to-Site VPN connection from the facility network to the VPC so that sensor data can be written directly to an S3 bucket by way of the VPC endpoint.

question_text:
A company wants to implement a disaster recovery plan for its primary on-premises file storage volume. The file storage volume is mounted from an Internet Small Computer Systems Interface (iSCSI) device on a local storage server. The file storage volume holds hundreds of terabytes (TB) of data.
The company wants to ensure that end users retain immediate access to all file types from the on-premises systems without experiencing latency.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the company's existing infrastructure?
explanation_en:
终端用户必须保持对所有文件类型的即时访问，且无延迟，现有基础设施的变更必须最小化。存储卷网关在存储卷模式下通过相同的iSCSI协议连接到现有的文件服务器，整个数据集保留在本地磁盘上，定时快照发送到AWS。在发生灾难时，快照会恢复到EBS卷并附加到实例上。
选项 A：这涉及将协议切换为NFS并修改应用程序——直接违反了最小变更要求。
选项 B：磁带网关是为备份到虚拟磁带库而设计的，不提供对文件的即时本地访问。
选项 C：缓存卷模式仅在数百太字节中保留10 TB的缓存：对其余数据的访问将通过云端进行，存在明显的延迟。

options.text: Provision an Amazon S3 File Gateway as a virtual machine (VM) that is hosted on premises. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Modify existing applications to access the files through the NFS protocol. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and mount the S3 bucket that contains the files.

Provision an AWS Storage Gateway tape gateway. Use a data backup solution to back up all existing data to a virtual tape library. Configure the data backup solution to run nightly after the initial backup is complete. To recover from a disaster, provision an Amazon EC2 instance and restore the data to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume from the volumes in the virtual tape library.

Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway cached volume. Set the local cache to 10 TB. Mount the Volume Gateway cached volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.

Provision an AWS Storage Gateway Volume Gateway stored volume with the same amount of disk space as the existing file storage volume. Mount the Volume Gateway stored volume to the existing file server by using iSCSI, and copy all files to the storage volume. Configure scheduled snapshots of the storage volume. To recover from a disaster, restore a snapshot to an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume and attach the EBS volume to an Amazon EC2 instance.

question_text:
A company is hosting a web application from an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses Amazon Cognito as an identity provider to authenticate users and return a JSON Web Token (JWT) that provides access to protected resources that are stored in another S3 bucket.
Upon deployment of the application, users report errors and are unable to access the protected content. A solutions architect must resolve this issue by providing proper permissions so that users can access the protected content.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
一个 Cognito 令牌本身不会授予任何 AWS 权限。该流程的工作方式如下：用户在用户池中进行身份验证并收到一个 JWT，然后该令牌在身份池中被交换为临时的 IAM 角色凭证，正是这个角色授予了对受保护存储桶的 s3:GetObject 权限。出现访问错误意味着身份池为已认证用户配置的角色不存在（或配置错误）。请牢记这一区别：用户池负责 "这是谁"，而身份池负责 "给予他们哪些 AWS 权限。"
选项 B：ACL 是一个遗留的 S3 机制，无法根据 Cognito 身份验证结果授予权限。现代方法是使用存储桶策略加上一个用户角色。
选项 C：S3 长期以来就提供了强大的写后读一致性，一致性与访问错误毫无关系。
选项 D：自定义属性映射有助于传递用户信息，但单独来看它不会授予任何 AWS 权限：权限来自身份池所颁发的角色。

options.text: Update the Amazon Cognito identity pool to assume the proper IAM role for access to the protected content.
Update the S3 ACL to allow the application to access the protected content.
Redeploy the application to Amazon S3 to prevent eventually consistent reads in the S3 bucket from affecting the ability of users to access the protected content.
Update the Amazon Cognito pool to use custom attribute mappings within the identity pool and grant users the proper permissions to access the protected content.

question_text:
An image hosting company uploads its large assets to Amazon S3 Standard buckets. The company uses multipart upload in parallel by using S3 APIs and overwrites if the same object is uploaded again. For the first 30 days after upload, the objects will be accessed frequently. The objects will be used less frequently after 30 days, but the access patterns for each object will be inconsistent. The company must optimize its S3 storage costs while maintaining high availability and resiliency of stored assets.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect recommend to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
这里有两个独立的成本项目。第一个是对象本身：在30天之后访问变得稀少但"不一致"，即不可预测，这需要使用 Intelligent-Tiering（A）而不是计费访问检索的类别。第二个是不完整的多部分上传（B）：在并行多部分上传中，已中止操作的部分仍保留在存储桶中，不会出现在对象列表中，且仍按存储费用计费，直到生命周期规则（"AbortIncompleteMultipartUpload"）将其移除。对于大型资产，这种不可见的成本项目有时可能占账单的显著份额。
选项 C：在版本化存储桶中清理过期的删除标记是重要的。该场景描述的是对象的覆盖操作，而删除标记本身不占用任何存储空间——这里没有节省成本。
选项 D：标准-IA计费访问检索费用，且30天后的访问被描述为不一致。每次意外访问都会产生费用，因此在此场景中 Intelligent-Tiering 更具成本效益。
选项 E：单个区域-IA 在一个可用区中存储一个副本，而问题要求保持高可用性和容错能力。

options.text: Move assets to S3 Intelligent-Tiering after 30 days.
Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up incomplete multipart uploads.
Configure an S3 Lifecycle policy to clean up expired object delete markers.
Move assets to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
Move assets to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.

question_text:
A solutions architect must secure a VPC network that hosts Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances contain highly sensitive data and run in a private subnet. According to company policy, the EC2 instances that run in the VPC can access only approved third-party software repositories on the internet for software product updates that use the third party’s URL. Other internet traffic must be blocked.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
该限制以域名（"第三方的URL"）的形式表述，而安全组和网络ACL仅支持地址和端口。AWS Network Firewall能够区分域名：一个状态ful规则配合域名列表，允许流向列出的名称的流量，阻止其他所有流量，且私有子网的流量通过路由表路由至防火墙端点。这是构建基于域名的出口过滤的标准方法。
选项 B：AWS WAF保护传入到您应用程序的HTTP请求，并不过滤实例的出站流量。
选项 C：安全组规则无法指定URL或域名名称——仅能指定CIDR块、前缀列表和其他安全组。
选项 D：负载均衡器将传入请求分发到您的目标。出站互联网流量不会经过它。

options.text: Update the route table for the private subnet to route the outbound traffic to an AWS Network Firewall firewall. Configure domain list rule groups.
Set up an AWS WAF web ACL. Create a custom set of rules that filter traffic requests based on source and destination IP address range sets.
Implement strict inbound security group rules. Configure an outbound rule that allows traffic only to the authorized software repositories on the internet by specifying the URLs.

Configure an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in front of the EC2 instances. Direct all outbound traffic to the ALB. Use a URL-based rule listener in the ALB’s target group for outbound access to the internet.

question_text:
A company is hosting a three-tier ecommerce application in the AWS Cloud. The company hosts the website on Amazon S3 and integrates the website with an API that handles sales requests. The company hosts the API on three Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The API consists of static and dynamic front-end content along with backend workers that process sales requests asynchronously.
The company is expecting a significant and sudden increase in the number of sales requests during events for the launch of new products.
What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure that all the requests are processed successfully?
explanation_en:
预计会出现剧烈且突然的流量激增，所有订单都必须被处理。CloudFront 将静态内容从实例中移除，并将购买请求接收进一个 SQS 队列：该队列能够立即接收请求并将其暂存，直到处理器处理完毕。这样即使实例暂时无法跟上流量，也不会丢失任何请求。
选项 A：手动添加实例无法应对突然的流量激增，且通过 CloudFront 缓存动态内容带来的好处很小。
选项 B：基于网络流量的自动扩展组需要数分钟才能扩容，而在此期间早先到达的请求仍会在过载时被丢弃。
选项 C：位于负载均衡器前的缓存无法帮助写入订单，且 CloudFront 用于动态内容无法解决保留这些订单的问题。

options.text: Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Increase the number of EC2 instances to handle the increase in traffic.
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Place the EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group to launch new instances based on network traffic.
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the dynamic content. Add an Amazon ElastiCache instance in front of the ALB to reduce traffic for the API to handle.
Add an Amazon CloudFront distribution for the static content. Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to receive requests from the website for later processing by the EC2 instances.

question_text:
A security audit reveals that Amazon EC2 instances are not being patched regularly. A solutions architect needs to provide a solution that will run regular security scans across a large fleet of EC2 instances. The solution should also patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule and provide a report of each instance’s patch status.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
这里有两个要求，由两个不同的服务满足。漏洞扫描由 Amazon Inspector 实现：通过 SSM Agent 对实例上的软件包进行持续扫描，并提供优先级结果。定期应用更新并报告补丁状态由 Patch Manager（系统管理服务的一部分）实现：包括补丁基线、维护窗口以及每台实例的合规性报告。这两部分均通过管理实现，无需自定义代码。
选项 A：Macie 分析 S3 中的数据，而每台实例上的 cron 作业是一种手动方案，且没有报告或合规性跟踪。
选项 B：GuardDuty 不会扫描软件包以检测漏洞，而 Session Manager 提供对实例的访问，但不负责补丁管理。
选项 C：Amazon Detective 帮助从日志中调查事件，而不是发现漏洞，而仅靠 EventBridge 的调度本身不会应用任何补丁。

options.text: Set up Amazon Macie to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up a cron job on each EC2 instance to patch the instance on a regular schedule.

Turn on Amazon GuardDuty in the account. Configure GuardDuty to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Session Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.
Set up Amazon Detective to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up an Amazon EventBridge scheduled rule to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.

Turn on Amazon Inspector in the account. Configure Amazon Inspector to scan the EC2 instances for software vulnerabilities. Set up AWS Systems Manager Patch Manager to patch the EC2 instances on a regular schedule.

question_text:
A company is planning to store data on Amazon RDS DB instances. The company must encrypt the data at rest.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
RDS 中静态数据加密在实例创建时（或从加密快照恢复时）被开启，并依赖于一个 KMS 密钥——要么是您自己管理的客户密钥，要么是 AWS 默认密钥。这会同时对磁盘上的数据、自动备份、快照以及读取副本进行加密。请勿将此与传输中加密混淆——传输中加密由数据库的 TLS 连接处理，这是另一项独立事务。
选项 B：Secrets Manager 存储密钥，例如数据库密码。它不提供用于加密 RDS 存储的密钥——这是 KMS 的职责。
选项 C：来自 ACM 的证书为连接提供加密，即保护传输中的数据。它不加密磁盘上的数据。
选项 D：同样存在这个问题，加上 IAM 证书存储是一种过时的机制，现已由 ACM 取代。

options.text: Create a key in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS). Enable encryption for the DB instances.
Create an encryption key. Store the key in AWS Secrets Manager. Use the key to encrypt the DB instances.
Generate a certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.
Generate a certificate in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM). Enable SSL/TLS on the DB instances by using the certificate.

question_text:
A company must migrate 20 TB of data from a data center to the AWS Cloud within 30 days. The company’s network bandwidth is limited to 15 Mbps and cannot exceed 70% utilization.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
这个问题通过算术运算解决。可用带宽是15 Mbps的70%，约为10.5 Mbps，每天大约传输113 GB。以这个速度，二十太字节需要约180天，但截止时间是30天。无论在线方法多方便，都无法在期限内完成，因此剩下的选择是离线传输：Snowball。记住这个经验法则：100 Mbps ≈ 每天1 TB，1 Gbps ≈ 每天10 TB —— 这足以在十秒内排除在线选项。
选项 B：DataSync 通过相同的链路传输数据。它会加快并验证传输过程，但不会改变10.5 Mbps这一底层物理限制。
选项 C：VPN 是相同的链路加上加密的开销。在如此短的截止时间内，其可行性更低。
选项 D：Transfer Acceleration 优化从边缘位置到存储桶的路径，但这里的瓶颈是数据中心自身的上行链路，而加速功能无法触及该瓶颈。

options.text: Use AWS Snowball.
Use AWS DataSync.
Use a secure VPN connection.
Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration.

question_text:
A company needs to provide its employees with secure access to confidential and sensitive files. The company wants to ensure that the files can be accessed only by authorized users. The files must be downloaded securely to the employees’ devices.
The files are stored in an on-premises Windows file server. However, due to an increase in remote usage, the file server is running out of capacity.
.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
文件存储在具有域基础权限的 Windows 共享上，空间即将耗尽，且员工远程工作。迁移到 FSx for Windows File Server 保留了熟悉的 SMB 协议和 NTFS 权限，与现有的 Active Directory 集成保持了相同的授权机制，而 Client VPN 为远程员工提供了安全的进入 VPC 的通道，其中文件系统位于该 VPC 内。下载则通过加密隧道进行，而不是通过开放的互联网。
选项 A：一个位于公共子网中的文件服务器，配备基于 IP 的过滤器，意味着 SMB 暴露在互联网上，并需要手动维护地址列表。这对远程工作来说既不安全也不方便。
选项 C：私有端点只能从 VPC 内部访问，而员工位于其外部，因此他们无法访问该端点。迁移到对象存储也会改变人们习惯的文件操作方式。
选项 D：不存在所谓的 "公共 VPC 端点"。通过 Identity Center 登录并不能解决安全地将文件传递到设备的问题。

options.text: Migrate the file server to an Amazon EC2 instance in a public subnet. Configure the security group to limit inbound traffic to the employees’ IP addresses.
Migrate the files to an Amazon FSx for Windows File Server file system. Integrate the Amazon FSx file system with the on-premises Active Directory. Configure AWS Client VPN.
Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a private VPC endpoint. Create a signed URL to allow download.
Migrate the files to Amazon S3, and create a public VPC endpoint. Allow employees to sign on with AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).

question_text:
A company’s application runs on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The instances run in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. On the first day of every month at midnight, the application becomes much slower when the month-end financial calculation batch runs. This causes the CPU utilization of the EC2 instances to immediately peak to 100%, which disrupts the application.
What should a solutions architect recommend to ensure the application is able to handle the workload and avoid downtime?
explanation_en:
这个峰值是提前已知的：每月第一天的午夜。这意味着实例需要在它开始之前进行扩容，而不是被动响应。自动扩展组的计划型扩展策略会在已知时间之前增加容量，并在之后减少容量，因此 CPU 利用率永远不会被固定在百分之百。
选项 A：CloudFront 缓存内容供用户使用，而负载是由应用程序内部的一个批处理计算生成的。
选项 B：一个基于 CPU 的简单扩展策略仅在利用率已经达到百分之百后才会触发：在新实例启动的几分钟内，应用程序将不可用。
选项 D：缓存会分流读取流量，但这里的峰值负载来自一个计算任务，而不是数据请求。

options.text: Configure an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the ALB.
Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling simple scaling policy based on CPU utilization.
Configure an EC2 Auto Scaling scheduled scaling policy based on the monthly schedule.
Configure Amazon ElastiCache to remove some of the workload from the EC2 instances.

question_text:
A company wants to give a customer the ability to use on-premises Microsoft Active Directory to download files that are stored in Amazon S3. The customer’s application uses an SFTP client to download the files.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead and no changes to the customer’s application?
explanation_en:
存在一个无法更改的 SFTP 客户端，以及用户所在的本地 Active Directory。AWS Transfer Family 可在 S3 存储桶之上提供一个受管理的 SFTP 端点，并能够对外部目录进行身份验证，包括通过 AWS 管理的 Microsoft AD 或自定义身份提供者进行 Active Directory 身份验证。应用程序可以继续通过 SFTP 运行，其底层无需运行任何基础设施。
选项 B：AWS DMS 迁移数据库。它既不提供 SFTP，也不提供文件同步功能。
选项 C：DataSync 按计划复制数据，但不会为客户端提供 SFTP 端点以下载文件。
选项 D：在 Windows 实例上部署一个自定义 SFTP 服务器是一台需要维护、打补丁和扩展的机器。而托管服务则可以在没有服务器的情况下实现相同功能。

options.text: Set up AWS Transfer Family with SFTP for Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
Set up AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to synchronize the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Configure integrated Active Directory authentication.
Set up AWS DataSync to synchronize between the on-premises location and the S3 location by using AWS IAM Identity Center (AWS Single Sign-On).
Set up a Windows Amazon EC2 instance with SFTP to connect the on-premises client with Amazon S3. Integrate AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM).

question_text:
A company is experiencing sudden increases in demand. The company needs to provision large Amazon EC2 instances from an Amazon Machine Image (AMI). The instances will run in an Auto Scaling group. The company needs a solution that provides minimum initialization latency to meet the demand.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
在从镜像启动实例时出现启动延迟，是因为根卷的块在首次访问时从快照中拉取。快速快照恢复恰恰消除了这一点：启用该功能的快照创建的卷在启动时即可达到全性能。由此快照创建的 AMI，且自动伸缩组切换到该 AMI。
选项 A：单独通过快照注册镜像并不会加快初始化过程，且 Step Functions 仅用于协调步骤。
选项 C：Amazon DLM 自动化定时镜像创建，但它不影响首次启动的启动速度。
选项 D：AWS Backup 负责备份，且自动伸缩组的容量限制不是 EventBridge 事件源。

options.text: Use the aws ec2 register-image command to create an AMI from a snapshot. Use AWS Step Functions to replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
Enable Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) fast snapshot restore on a snapshot. Provision an AMI by using the snapshot. Replace the AMI in the Auto Scaling group with the new AMI.
Enable AMI creation and define lifecycle rules in Amazon Data Lifecycle Manager (Amazon DLM). Create an AWS Lambda function that modifies the AMI in the Auto Scaling group.
Use Amazon EventBridge to invoke AWS Backup lifecycle policies that provision AMIs. Configure Auto Scaling group capacity limits as an event source in EventBridge.

question_text:
A company hosts a multi-tier web application that uses an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster for storage. The application tier is hosted on Amazon EC2 instances. The company’s IT security guidelines mandate that the database credentials be encrypted and rotated every 14 days.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement with the LEAST operational effort?
explanation_en:
要求是加密数据库凭据，并每隔14天进行轮换，且操作开销最小。Secrets Manager通过配置实现了这一点：密钥使用与Aurora集群关联的KMS密钥进行加密，轮换计划设置为任意天数——14天被设置为自定义周期。AWS本身为支持的数据库提供了轮换功能，因此无需编写轮换代码。其他每个选项都建议通过自定义代码来实现相同的结果。
选项 B：Parameter Store存储加密后的密码，但轮换必须由你自己在Lambda函数中实现和维护。这比在Secrets Manager中设置轮换周期明显多出工作量。
选项 C：共享文件系统上的一个文件加上自定义轮换函数会增加开发工作量，需要管理文件访问权限，并存在数据库和文件不同步的风险。
选项 D：定期从存储桶下载密码文件意味着应用程序在某个时间段内会使用过时的密码，而且再次需要自定义轮换代码。

options.text: Create a new AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption key. Use AWS Secrets Manager to create a new secret that uses the KMS key with the appropriate credentials. Associate the secret with the Aurora DB cluster. Configure a custom rotation period of 14 days.

Create two parameters in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store: one for the user name as a string parameter and one that uses the SecureString type for the password. Select AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encryption for the password parameter, and load these parameters in the application tier. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the password every 14 days.

Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system. Mount the EFS file system in all EC2 instances of the application tier. Restrict the access to the file on the file system so that the application can read the file and that only super users can modify the file. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the key in Aurora every 14 days and writes new credentials into the file.

Store a file that contains the credentials in an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) encrypted Amazon S3 bucket that the application uses to load the credentials. Download the file to the application regularly to ensure that the correct credentials are used. Implement an AWS Lambda function that rotates the Aurora credentials every 14 days and uploads these credentials to the file in the S3 bucket.

question_text:
A company has deployed a web application on AWS. The company hosts the backend database on Amazon RDS for MySQL with a primary DB instance and five read replicas to support scaling needs. The read replicas must lag no more than 1 second behind the primary DB instance. The database routinely runs scheduled stored procedures.
As traffic on the website increases, the replicas experience additional lag during periods of peak load. A solutions architect must reduce the replication lag as much as possible. The solutions architect must minimize changes to the application code and must minimize ongoing operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
RDS for MySQL 中的副本延迟在负载下增加，因为复制是通过二进制日志进行的，并且在每个副本上独立应用。Aurora 的工作方式不同：副本从相同的共享存储中读取，因此延迟以毫秒为单位衡量，并且几乎与负载无关。Aurora 自动扩展在流量增长时增加副本，存储过程被替换为原生的 Aurora MySQL 函数——应用程序的变更极小。
选项 B：数据库前的缓存需要重写应用程序逻辑，并不能减少副本本身的延迟。
选项 C：自管理的 MySQL 实例意味着最大的操作开销，而复制机制保持不变，延迟也相同。
选项 D：DynamoDB 意味着需要重写数据模型和查询，且 DynamoDB 流不会替代存储过程。

options.text: Migrate the database to Amazon Aurora MySQL. Replace the read replicas with Aurora Replicas, and configure Aurora Auto Scaling. Replace the stored procedures with Aurora MySQL native functions.

Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster in front of the database. Modify the application to check the cache before the application queries the database. Replace the stored procedures with AWS Lambda functions.
Migrate the database to a MySQL database that runs on Amazon EC2 instances. Choose large, compute optimized EC2 instances for all replica nodes. Maintain the stored procedures on the EC2 instances.

Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB. Provision a large number of read capacity units (RCUs) to support the required throughput, and configure on-demand capacity scaling. Replace the stored procedures with DynamoDB streams.

question_text:
A solutions architect must create a disaster recovery (DR) plan for a high-volume software as a service (SaaS) platform. All data for the platform is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL DB cluster.
The DR plan must replicate data to a secondary AWS Region.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
参考答案：D；争议选项：B。
AWS 文档中提到了 Aurora 全球数据库的无实例配置：一个没有实例的备用集群在存储层面进行数据复制，并且成本更低。严格解读，"最经济"更倾向于选项 B；选项 D 的论点是，由于没有实例，备用区域无法立即承担负载。
Aurora Global Database 支持没有 DB instance 的 headless secondary：存储仍持续跨区域复制，但不计收次区域计算费用。题干只要求跨区域复制且最省钱，故 B 比保留次区域实例的原答案 D 更贴切；需要故障转移时再添加实例，恢复时间更长。
来源答案 D 的原解析（与核查结果冲突，不采纳）：
这个问题存在争议。练习资料的答案是选项 D：Aurora 全球数据库在存储层面将数据复制到第二个区域，延迟大约为一秒，并且至少保留一个实例，以便该区域能够立即承担负载。一个强有力的替代方案是选项 B，即无实例配置：AWS 明确文档化了无实例的备用集群，这种配置更便宜，因为您只需为存储和复制付费。严格解读，"最经济"更倾向于选项 B；如果解读为"灾难恢复计划必须能够立即投入使用"，则选项 D 更优。
来源旧选项 A：MySQL 二进制日志复制是跨区域复制 Aurora 的较慢方式，且需要手动维护，而全球数据库则在存储层面完成此操作。
来源旧选项 B：从技术上讲，这种配置是有效的，并且比练习资料答案更便宜，因此该问题被标记为有争议：唯一反对它的理由是，没有实例的区域在灾难发生后无法立即接收流量。
来源旧选项 C：DMS 是一个迁移工具，而不是 Aurora 用于持续跨区域复制的标准机制：它是一个额外组件，自身也可能失效。

options.text: Use MySQL binary log replication to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Provision one DB instance for the Aurora cluster in the secondary Region.
Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. When setup is complete, remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
Use AWS Database Migration Service (AWS DMS) to continuously replicate data to an Aurora cluster in the secondary Region. Remove the DB instance from the secondary Region.
Set up an Aurora global database for the DB cluster. Specify a minimum of one DB instance in the secondary Region.

question_text:
A company has a custom application with embedded credentials that retrieves information from an Amazon RDS MySQL DB instance. Management says the application must be made more secure with the least amount of programming effort.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
题干中的限制条件是 "编程工作量最少"。AWS Secrets Manager 对 RDS MySQL 的支持可以实现自动密码轮换：你只需设置一个计划，AWS 就会提供一个函数来修改数据库密码并更新密钥。应用程序只需调用一次 GetSecretValue 即可，而无需硬编码凭据。这正是正确选项与需要自行编写相同轮换功能的相似选项之间的关键区别。
选项 A：KMS 管理加密密钥，而不是数据库凭据。你无法从 KMS 中加载用户名和密码。
选项 B：该设计是有效的，但自行编写一个自定义轮换函数正是题目要求避免的编程工作量：它需要被编写、测试和维护。
选项 D：Parameter Store 没有内置的轮换机制，因此 "通过 Parameter Store 设置轮换计划" 是不可能的。

options.text: Use AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) to create keys. Configure the application to load the database credentials from AWS KMS. Enable automatic key rotation.

Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Create an AWS Lambda function that rotates the credentials in Secret Manager.

Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Secrets Manager. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Secrets Manager. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Secrets Manager.

Create credentials on the RDS for MySQL database for the application user and store the credentials in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store. Configure the application to load the database credentials from Parameter Store. Set up a credentials rotation schedule for the application user in the RDS for MySQL database using Parameter Store.

question_text:
A media company hosts its website on AWS. The website application’s architecture includes a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB) and a database that is hosted on Amazon Aurora. The company’s cybersecurity team reports that the application is vulnerable to SQL injection.
How should the company resolve this issue?
explanation_en:
SQL 注入是一种发生在 HTTP 请求层面的攻击，由 AWS WAF 在应用前端进行过滤。一个 Web ACL 被附加到应用负载均衡器上，启用了管理规则组（特别是 SQL 数据库规则集），恶意请求在到达实例之前被阻止。这是一种补救控制：同时，代码应被修复以使用参数化查询，但题目要求的具体满足方式是通过 WAF 实现的。
选项 B：ALB 监听器规则根据路径、主机名、头部和方法进行路由，但不会检查请求内容中是否存在注入迹象。
选项 C：Shield Advanced 防御可用性攻击，并不解析 SQL 注入。
选项 D：Inspector 用于发现漏洞并报告漏洞，但它不会过滤流量或阻止任何内容。

options.text: Use AWS WAF in front of the ALB. Associate the appropriate web ACLs with AWS WAF.
Create an ALB listener rule to reply to SQL injections with a fixed response.
Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.
Set up Amazon Inspector to block all SQL injection attempts automatically.

question_text:
A company has an Amazon S3 data lake that is governed by AWS Lake Formation. The company wants to create a visualization in Amazon QuickSight by joining the data in the data lake with operational data that is stored in an Amazon Aurora MySQL database. The company wants to enforce column-level authorization so that the company’s marketing team can access only a subset of columns in the database.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
关键要求是列级访问控制，且操作开销最小。Lake Formation 正好实现了这一点：它维护一个目录，可以在表、列和行级别授予权限，并将这些权限传播到查询它的引擎——主要是 Athena。因此，Aurora 的数据通过 Lake Formation 的蓝图被导入湖中，配置列级权限，QuickSight 通过 Athena 连接，并自动仅看到被允许的列。无需桶策略，也无需为每个团队单独创建数据集。
选项 A：EMR 用于数据导入属于重型设备，且不提供列级访问控制——你必须手动准备单独的提取数据。
选项 B：IAM 策略无法限制 S3 文件中单个列的访问——其粒度是对象和前缀。
选项 C：桶策略甚至无法区分对象内的列。此外，Glue Elastic Views 是一个从未达到一般可用性的服务。

options.text: Use Amazon EMR to ingest the data directly from the database to the QuickSight SPICE engine. Include only the required columns.

Use AWS Glue Studio to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Attach an IAM policy to the QuickSight users to enforce column-level access control. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.

Use AWS Glue Elastic Views to create a materialized view for the database in Amazon S3. Create an S3 bucket policy to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon S3 as the data source in QuickSight.

Use a Lake Formation blueprint to ingest the data from the database to the S3 data lake. Use Lake Formation to enforce column-level access control for the QuickSight users. Use Amazon Athena as the data source in QuickSight.

question_text:
A transaction processing company has weekly scripted batch jobs that run on Amazon EC2 instances. The EC2 instances are in an Auto Scaling group. The number of transactions can vary, but the baseline CPU utilization that is noted on each run is at least 60%. The company needs to provision the capacity 30 minutes before the jobs run.
Currently, engineers complete this task by manually modifying the Auto Scaling group parameters. The company does not have the resources to analyze the required capacity trends for the Auto Scaling group counts. The company needs an automated way to modify the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
这些作业每周运行一次，基础负载是已知的（至少60%），并且没有人员手动分析负载模式。预测性扩展可以自动完成这一点：它基于指标的历史数据构建预测，并提前启动实例，预启动的提前时间明确设定——在这里，设定为作业开始前30分钟。
选项 A：一个动态扩展策略仅在负载出现后才反应：它无法为您提供30分钟的提前时间。
选项 B：定时扩展是可行的，但它需要有人手动确定并维护所需的容量，而场景描述中明确指出没有资源来进行这种分析。
选项 D：由告警触发的自定义函数既增加了额外代码，又是一种事后反应，而不是主动扩展。

options.text: Create a dynamic scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on the CPU utilization metric. Set the target value for the metric to 60%.

Create a scheduled scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Set the appropriate desired capacity, minimum capacity, and maximum capacity. Set the recurrence to weekly. Set the start time to 30 minutes before the batch jobs run.

Create a predictive scaling policy for the Auto Scaling group. Configure the policy to scale based on forecast. Set the scaling metric to CPU utilization. Set the target value for the metric to 60%. In the policy, set the instances to pre-launch 30 minutes before the jobs run.

Create an Amazon EventBridge event to invoke an AWS Lambda function when the CPU utilization metric value for the Auto Scaling group reaches 60%. Configure the Lambda function to increase the Auto Scaling group’s desired capacity and maximum capacity by 20%.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing a company’s disaster recovery (DR) architecture. The company has a MySQL database that runs on an Amazon EC2 instance in a private subnet with scheduled backup. The DR design needs to include multiple AWS Regions.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
灾难恢复设计必须跨越多个 AWS 区域，且操作开销最小。Aurora 全球数据库原生支持这一点：主数据库集群运行在主区域，备用集群运行在灾难恢复区域，复制在存储层发生，通常延迟在亚秒级别，且提升备用集群是一个单操作。自管理的 MySQL 部署及其所有操作负担完全消失。
选项 A：自管理实例配合手动配置的复制意味着工作量最大、风险最高，且故障切换也是手动操作。
选项 B：多可用区配置和不同可用区中的只读副本在单个区域内部运行：未满足多区域的要求。
选项 D：从存储在桶中的备份恢复需要数小时，并需要手动步骤，且数据延迟为备份间隔之间的时间。

options.text: Migrate the MySQL database to multiple EC2 instances. Configure a standby EC2 instance in the DR Region. Turn on replication.
Migrate the MySQL database to Amazon RDS. Use a Multi-AZ deployment. Turn on read replication for the primary DB instance in the different Availability Zones.
Migrate the MySQL database to an Amazon Aurora global database. Host the primary DB cluster in the primary Region. Host the secondary DB cluster in the DR Region.
Store the scheduled backup of the MySQL database in an Amazon S3 bucket that is configured for S3 Cross- Region Replication (CRR). Use the data backup to restore the database in the DR Region.

question_text:
A company has a Java application that uses Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to parse messages. The application cannot parse messages that are larger than 256 KB in size. The company wants to implement a solution to give the application the ability to parse messages as large as 50 MB.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?
explanation_en:
256 KB 的限制是 SQS 服务本身的一个硬性限制，无法更改。标准的解决方法是使用 Java 版本的 Amazon SQS 扩展客户端库：大消息的主体内容存储在 S3 中，仅将对象的引用发送到队列，由该库透明地处理。应用程序代码的改动非常少——你只需要替换为扩展客户端即可。
选项 B：EventBridge 本身有 256 KB 的事件大小限制，因此它无法解决这个问题，而且这意味着需要改变整个消息传递模型。
选项 C：256 KB 的限制是一个硬性服务限制，无法通过配置或支持请求提高。
选项 D：理论上引用存储在 EFS 中的文件是可行的，但你必须自己编写所有关于写入、读取和清理文件的逻辑，而现成的库会为你完成这些操作。

options.text: Use the Amazon SQS Extended Client Library for Java to host messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon S3.
Use Amazon EventBridge to post large messages from the application instead of Amazon SQS.
Change the limit in Amazon SQS to handle messages that are larger than 256 KB.
Store messages that are larger than 256 KB in Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Configure Amazon SQS to reference this location in the messages.

question_text:
A company wants to restrict access to the content of one of its main web applications and to protect the content by using authorization techniques available on AWS. The company wants to implement a serverless architecture and an authentication solution for fewer than 100 users. The solution needs to integrate with the main web application and serve web content globally. The solution must also scale as the company's user base grows while providing the lowest login latency possible.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
用户数量少于100人，采用无服务器架构，实现全球内容分发，并且登录延迟最低。Cognito负责身份验证（在该用户数量下几乎免费），CloudFront从边缘位置提供应用服务，而令牌验证在Lambda@Edge中运行——即在用户连接到的边缘位置执行，无需返回源区域。这正是最小化登录延迟的关键所在。
选项 B：AWS Managed Microsoft AD 是一个目录服务，按小时计费，对于一百名用户来说过于复杂且成本高昂，且ALB无法实现全球内容分发。
选项 C：S3 Transfer Acceleration 可以加快数据上传到存储桶的速度，但并不能加速网站内容的提供，且普通Lambda函数仅在单个区域运行，这会增加延迟。
选项 D：AD目录再次显得过于复杂且昂贵，而Elastic Beanstalk意味着需要服务器——这与无服务器架构背道而驰。

options.text: Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use [email protected] for authorization. Use Amazon CloudFront to serve the web application globally.
Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use an Application Load Balancer to serve the web application globally.
Use Amazon Cognito for authentication. Use AWS Lambda for authorization. Use Amazon S3 Transfer Acceleration to serve the web application globally.
Use AWS Directory Service for Microsoft Active Directory for authentication. Use [email protected] for authorization. Use AWS Elastic Beanstalk to serve the web application globally.

question_text:
A company has an aging network-attached storage (NAS) array in its data center. The NAS array presents SMB shares and NFS shares to client workstations. The company does not want to purchase a new NAS array. The company also does not want to incur the cost of renewing the NAS array’s support contract. Some of the data is accessed frequently, but much of the data is inactive.
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution that migrates the data to Amazon S3, uses S3 Lifecycle policies, and maintains the same look and feel for the client workstations. The solutions architect has identified AWS Storage Gateway as part of the solution.
Which type of storage gateway should the solutions architect provision to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
客户端工作站需要保持相同的外观和感觉，且数据必须移动到 S3 并受到生命周期规则的约束。这就是 Amazon S3 File Gateway：它通过暴露 NFS 和 SMB 共享来实现，同时将每个文件作为存储桶中的对象进行存储，因此生命周期规则可以正常应用，频繁访问的数据会被本地缓存，而工作站不会察觉任何差异。
选项 A：Volume Gateway 通过 iSCSI 提供块卷，并以快照形式存储数据，而不是单独的对象：这种方式无法对用户文件应用生命周期规则，且工作站将失去其熟悉的共享访问。
选项 B：Tape Gateway 模拟虚拟磁带库以供备份软件使用；它与工作站的网络共享没有任何关系。
选项 C：FSx File Gateway 缓存对 FSx 文件系统的访问，而不是 S3，因此在这种设置中没有 S3 生命周期规则。

options.text: Volume Gateway
Tape Gateway
Amazon FSx File Gateway
Amazon S3 File Gateway

question_text:
A company has an application that is running on Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect has standardized the company on a particular instance family and various instance sizes based on the current needs of the company.
The company wants to maximize cost savings for the application over the next 3 years. The company needs to be able to change the instance family and sizes in the next 6 months based on application popularity and usage.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
承诺期为三年，但在六个月之内实例家族和规格可能会发生变化。一个计算节省计划可提供高达66%的折扣，并不绑定于实例家族、规格、区域甚至服务——当您迁移到不同实例、Fargate 或 Lambda 时，折扣仍然有效。
选项 B：EC2 实例节省计划绑定于特定区域内的特定实例家族：更改家族将使折扣失效。
选项 C：区域保留实例锁定特定实例类型和可用区。
选项 D：标准保留实例提供最大的折扣，但不允许更改实例家族。

options.text: Compute Savings Plan
EC2 Instance Savings Plan
Zonal Reserved Instances
Standard Reserved Instances

question_text:
A company collects data from a large number of participants who use wearable devices. The company stores the data in an Amazon DynamoDB table and uses applications to analyze the data. The data workload is constant and predictable. The company wants to stay at or below its forecasted budget for DynamoDB.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
工作负载是恒定且可预测的，并且预算需要得到控制。在定义了读写容量单位的预留模式下，相较于按需模式，在稳定的工作负载下成本更低，并且产生可预测的账单：您支付的是预留容量的费用，而不是按请求计费。
选项 A：标准-IA 表类降低了存储成本，但提高了请求成本——在稳定的工作负载下并不经济——而且这里对"预留容量"的描述也不够准确。
选项 C：按需模式根本不允许您设置容量单位，在稳定的工作负载下其成本高于预留模式。
选项 D：按需模式既不支持指定容量单位，也不支持预留容量——不存在这样的配置。

options.text: Use provisioned mode and DynamoDB Standard-Infrequent Access (DynamoDB Standard-IA). Reserve capacity for the forecasted workload.
Use provisioned mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs).
Use on-demand mode. Set the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) high enough to accommodate changes in the workload.
Use on-demand mode. Specify the read capacity units (RCUs) and write capacity units (WCUs) with reserved capacity.

question_text:
A company stores confidential data in an Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL database in the ap-southeast-3 Region. The database is encrypted with an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. The company was recently acquired and must securely share a backup of the database with the acquiring company’s AWS account in ap-southeast-3.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
快照使用 KMS 密钥进行加密，因此再次共享它需要两个步骤：允许另一个账户使用该密钥（更新密钥策略，并在需要时添加授权），并明确将该快照本身共享给该账户。接收方通常会立即创建快照的副本，并使用自己的密钥重新加密，以避免依赖于你的密钥。一个在考试题目中经常出现的重要限制是：使用默认的 AWS 管理密钥（aws/rds）加密的快照无法共享——只有使用你自行管理的密钥加密的快照才可以共享。
选项 A：你无法将加密的快照复制到未加密的 RDS 实例中——通过这种方式无法解密数据。对于敏感数据，这也会导致安全级别的降低。
选项 C：你无法共享使用 AWS 管理密钥加密的快照，而密钥别名仅仅是一个方便的名称——它不会授予任何人访问权限。
选项 D：你无法将 RDS 快照下载到磁盘——该服务不提供此选项。通过 S3 上传的替代方案更为复杂且安全性较低，不如直接共享快照安全。

options.text: Create a database snapshot. Copy the snapshot to a new unencrypted snapshot. Share the new snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
Create a database snapshot. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key policy. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company’s AWS account.
Create a database snapshot that uses a different AWS managed KMS key. Add the acquiring company’s AWS account to the KMS key alias. Share the snapshot with the acquiring company's AWS account.
Create a database snapshot. Download the database snapshot. Upload the database snapshot to an Amazon S3 bucket. Update the S3 bucket policy to allow access from the acquiring company’s AWS account.

question_text:
A company uses a 100 GB Amazon RDS for Microsoft SQL Server Single-AZ DB instance in the us-east-1 Region to store customer transactions. The company needs high availability and automatic recovery for the DB instance.
The company must also run reports on the RDS database several times a year. The report process causes transactions to take longer than usual to post to the customers’ accounts. The company needs a solution that will improve the performance of the report process.
Which combination of steps will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
RDS for SQL Server 的 Multi-AZ deployment 提供自动故障转移，但其 standby 不接受读取；另建 read replica 可承载偶发报表读取。来源 AC 对应高可用与读负载隔离两项要求，需留意所选 SQL Server 版本和许可对 read replica 的支持。
这里有两个要求。高可用性并具备自动恢复意味着将实例转换为具有同步复制和自动故障切换的多可用区部署（A）。加快报告查询速度而不影响事务意味着在另一个可用区创建只读副本，所有报告查询均指向该副本（C）。
选项 B：从快照恢复会创建一个独立的副本，该副本立即开始过时，并且不提供自动故障切换。
选项 D：RDS Custom 是需要访问底层操作系统时的解决方案；它与可用性和报告无关。
选项 E：RDS Proxy 管理连接池，无法将查询延迟到维护窗口期间。

options.text: Modify the DB instance from a Single-AZ DB instance to a Multi-AZ deployment.
Take a snapshot of the current DB instance. Restore the snapshot to a new RDS deployment in another Availability Zone.
Create a read replica of the DB instance in a different Availability Zone. Point all requests for reports to the read replica.
Migrate the database to RDS Custom.
Use RDS Proxy to limit reporting requests to the maintenance window.

question_text:
A company is moving its data management application to AWS. The company wants to transition to an event-driven architecture. The architecture needs to be more distributed and to use serverless concepts while performing the different aspects of the workflow. The company also wants to minimize operational overhead.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该需求是一个基于无服务器组件、事件驱动且分布式的架构，其操作开销最小。AWS Step Functions将工作流描述为状态机，在每个步骤中调用Lambda函数，并处理错误、重试和分支操作——整个过程无需单个服务器，也无需自定义的编排代码。
选项 A：AWS Glue 是一个用于数据处理的ETL服务，而不是用于任意工作流的编排器。
选项 B：工作流步骤中的EC2实例会带来需要维护的基础设施。
选项 C：EventBridge按计划执行意味着周期性调用，而不是具有状态和分支的事件驱动工作流。

options.text: Build out the workflow in AWS Glue. Use AWS Glue to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.
Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Deploy the application on Amazon EC2 instances. Use Step Functions to invoke the workflow steps on the EC2 instances.
Build out the workflow in Amazon EventBridge. Use EventBridge to invoke AWS Lambda functions on a schedule to process the workflow steps.
Build out the workflow in AWS Step Functions. Use Step Functions to create a state machine. Use the state machine to invoke AWS Lambda functions to process the workflow steps.

question_text:
A company is designing the network for an online multi-player game. The game uses the UDP networking protocol and will be deployed in eight AWS Regions. The network architecture needs to minimize latency and packet loss to give end users a high-quality gaming experience.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
UDP 在八个区域之间传输，要求最小化延迟和数据包丢失。全球加速器在每个区域创建 UDP 监听器和端点组：玩家进入 AWS 网络时，会到达最近的边缘位置，然后通过 AWS 主干网络传输，其丢包率和抖动明显低于公共互联网。任何cast IP 地址保持静态，当某个区域发生故障时，该区域将在几秒内被移出轮询。
选项 A：Transit Gateway 和区域间对等连接将 AWS 网络彼此连接。它们对从玩家到最近区域的路径没有影响。
选项 C：CloudFront 不支持 UDP：它仅支持 HTTP 和 HTTPS。
选项 D：VPC 对等连接提供 AWS 内部的连通性，而不是对外用户访问的改进。对等连接中不存在 "开启 UDP" 的说法。

options.text: Setup a transit gateway in each Region. Create inter-Region peering attachments between each transit gateway.
Set up AWS Global Accelerator with UDP listeners and endpoint groups in each Region.
Set up Amazon CloudFront with UDP turned on. Configure an origin in each Region.
Set up a VPC peering mesh between each Region. Turn on UDP for each VPC.

question_text:
A company hosts a three-tier web application on Amazon EC2 instances in a single Availability Zone. The web application uses a self-managed MySQL database that is hosted on an EC2 instance to store data in an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The MySQL database currently uses a 1 TB Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) EBS volume. The company expects traffic of 1,000 IOPS for both reads and writes at peak traffic.
The company wants to minimize any disruptions, stabilize performance, and reduce costs while retaining the capacity for double the IOPS. The company wants to move the database tier to a fully managed solution that is highly available and fault tolerant.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
峰值流量为 1,000 IOPS，预留两倍空间，即 2,000。一个 1 TB 的 gp2 卷根据每 GB 3 IOPS 的公式可提供 3,000 IOPS，这在容量上留有余量，且成本明显低于 io2。数据库也迁移到基于 MySQL 的 RDS 多可用区（Multi-AZ）管理实例中，这提供了容错能力并消除了管理负担。
选项 A：io2 Block Express 是为每秒数万次操作而设计的，且价格昂贵：当仅需 2,000 IOPS 时，使用它会是浪费。
选项 C：S3 是对象存储——它不能作为数据库使用。
选项 D：两个大型实例以主备模式运行仍是一个自管理数据库，而需求要求的是一个完全管理的解决方案。

options.text: Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with an io2 Block Express EBS volume.
Use a Multi-AZ deployment of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance with a General Purpose SSD (gp2) EBS volume.
Use Amazon S3 Intelligent-Tiering access tiers.
Use two large EC2 instances to host the database in active-passive mode.

question_text:
A company hosts a serverless application on AWS. The application uses Amazon API Gateway, AWS Lambda, and an Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL database. The company notices an increase in application errors that result from database connection timeouts during times of peak traffic or unpredictable traffic. The company needs a solution that reduces the application failures with the least amount of change to the code.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
错误源于连接耗尽：在流量激增时，Lambda 会启动大量并发实例，每个实例都会打开自己的数据库连接。RDS Proxy 会维护一个连接池并复用连接，唯一需要的代码变更就是将连接指向代理端点而不是数据库端点。
选项 A：降低函数的并发允许值会限制应用程序的吞吐量，并导致另一种类型的失败。
选项 C：使用更大的实例类型会提高连接限制，但问题仍会以不可预测的峰值形式出现，且你将持续为此支付费用。
选项 D：迁移到 DynamoDB 意味着需要重写数据模型和查询——代码变更的最大可能量。

options.text: Reduce the Lambda concurrency rate.
Enable RDS Proxy on the RDS DB instance.
Resize the RDS DB instance class to accept more connections.
Migrate the database to Amazon DynamoDB with on-demand scaling.

question_text:
A company is migrating an old application to AWS. The application runs a batch job every hour and is CPU intensive. The batch job takes 15 minutes on average with an on-premises server. The server has 64 virtual CPU (vCPU) and 512 GiB of memory.
Which solution will run the batch job within 15 minutes with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
该作业需要 64 个 vCPU 和 512 GiB 内存，并持续运行 15 分钟 —— 远超 Lambda 的限制，也超出了典型 Fargate 任务的规模。AWS Batch 在 EC2 上会自动选择符合作业需求的实例类型，启动实例，运行计算任务，然后在完成后释放资源 —— 该服务会为您处理队列和调度。
选项 A：Lambda 函数的内存限制约为 10 GB，执行时间限制为 15 分钟 —— 这些需求不符合要求。
选项 B：Fargate 任务的最大规模远低于 64 个 vCPU 和 512 GiB 内存。
选项 C：Lightsail 提供的是小型且固定的配置，不适用于此类工作负载。

options.text: Use AWS Lambda with functional scaling.
Use Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) with AWS Fargate.
Use Amazon Lightsail with AWS Auto Scaling.
Use AWS Batch on Amazon EC2.

question_text:
A company stores its data objects in Amazon S3 Standard storage. A solutions architect has found that 75% of the data is rarely accessed after 30 days. The company needs all the data to remain immediately accessible with the same high availability and resiliency, but the company wants to minimize storage costs.
Which storage solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
短语"相同的高可用性和容错性"解决了选择三个可用区和即时访问的问题，因此决策最终落在标准存储（Standard）与标准低频存储（Standard-IA）之间。年龄则决定了选择：数据中75%在30天后很少被读取，而标准低频存储（Standard-IA）在相同持久性和相同检索速度下大约便宜45%。因此，采用一个生命周期规则，在第30天将对象迁移。
选项 A：S3 Glacier Deep Archive 在小时后才返回对象。这破坏了数据必须立即可访问的要求。
选项 C：S3 One Zone-IA 将数据存储在单个可用区中：可用性为99.5%，而标准低频存储（Standard-IA）为99.9%，失去该可用区意味着数据丢失。这违反了"相同的容错性"要求。
选项 D：此处同样存在单可用区的问题，再加上立即迁移所有数据也会触及仍被频繁读取的25%数据，这些数据将产生检索费用。

options.text: Move the data objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 30 days.
Move the data objects to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days.
Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) after 30 days.
Move the data objects to S3 One Zone-Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA) immediately.

question_text:
A gaming company is moving its public scoreboard from a data center to the AWS Cloud. The company uses Amazon EC2 Windows Server instances behind an Application Load Balancer to host its dynamic application. The company needs a highly available storage solution for the application. The application consists of static files and dynamic server-side code.
Which combination of steps should a solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
应用程序分为两个部分，每个部分都需要独立的存储。静态文件存入 S3，并通过 CloudFront 在边缘位置进行缓存（A）。服务器端代码需要在所有实例之间共享，而这些实例运行 Windows Server —— 这需要一个 SMB 共享，即使用 Amazon FSx for Windows File Server，该共享在每个实例上挂载（D）。
选项 B：ElastiCache 是一个区域内的内存缓存；它不会在边缘位置缓存对象，也不会提供静态文件服务。
选项 C：EFS 使用 NFS 协议，专为 Linux 构建 —— 它不是 Windows 实例的原生访问方式。
选项 E：一个 gp2 卷在单个可用区内部挂载，并且不是设计用于被多个实例同时挂载：没有共享访问，也没有高可用性。

options.text: Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon CloudFront to cache objects at the edge.
Store the static files on Amazon S3. Use Amazon ElastiCache to cache objects at the edge.
