Store the server-side code on Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS). Mount the EFS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
Store the server-side code on Amazon FSx for Windows File Server. Mount the FSx for Windows File Server volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.
Store the server-side code on a General Purpose SSD (gp2) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. Mount the EBS volume on each EC2 instance to share the files.

question_text:
A social media company runs its application on Amazon EC2 instances behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB).
The ALB is the origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. The application has more than a billion images stored in an Amazon S3 bucket and processes thousands of images each second. The company wants to resize the images dynamically and serve appropriate formats to clients.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
在边缘节点实时调整图像大小并转换格式，每秒处理数千个请求，最佳做法是在边缘执行。一个附加到 CloudFront 缓存行为上的 Lambda@Edge 函数，结合图像处理库：它接收请求，生成所需的变体，并返回结果，该结果随后被缓存。无需自行运行服务器。
选项 A：在 EC2 实例上运行的库意味着你需要扩展到每秒数千个请求的实例集群，并进行运维。
选项 B：源请求策略控制哪些头部和参数会转发到源。它不会转换图像。
选项 D：响应头部策略会向响应添加头部，但不会改变内容。

options.text: Install an external image management library on an EC2 instance. Use the image management library to process the images.
Create a CloudFront origin request policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.
Use a [email protected] function with an external image management library. Associate the [email protected] function with the CloudFront behaviors that serve the images.
Create a CloudFront response headers policy. Use the policy to automatically resize images and to serve the appropriate format based on the User-Agent HTTP header in the request.

question_text:
A hospital needs to store patient records in an Amazon S3 bucket. The hospital’s compliance team must ensure that all protected health information (PHI) is encrypted in transit and at rest. The compliance team must administer the encryption key for data at rest.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
需求被分解为三个部分。"传输中加密" 指在存储桶策略中使用 aws:SecureTransport 条件来强制实施 HTTPS（否则 TLS 可用但非强制）。"静态存储加密" 指存储桶的默认加密。"合规团队必须管理加密密钥" 是决定性细节——只有 KMS 密钥可以被管理，因为它具有密钥策略、轮换机制、使用日志以及可撤销的访问权限。SSE-S3 不具备这些功能：服务本身管理这些密钥。
选项 A：无法将 ACM 证书附加到 S3：该服务使用其自身的证书通过 HTTPS 提供数据。这里也没有任何机制来强制实施 TLS。
选项 B：SSE-S3 不允许任何人"管理密钥"：这些密钥不可见，没有策略，也无法被撤销。合规团队的要求未得到满足。
选项 D：Macie 可以发现和分类敏感数据，但不会对其进行加密。静态存储加密的要求未被解决。

options.text: Create a public SSL/TLS certificate in AWS Certificate Manager (ACM). Associate the certificate with Amazon S3. Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.

Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with S3 managed encryption keys (SSE-S3). Assign the compliance team to manage the SSE-S3 keys.

Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Configure default encryption for each S3 bucket to use server-side encryption with AWS KMS keys (SSE-KMS). Assign the compliance team to manage the KMS keys.

Use the aws:SecureTransport condition on S3 bucket policies to allow only encrypted connections over HTTPS (TLS). Use Amazon Macie to protect the sensitive data that is stored in Amazon S3. Assign the compliance team to manage Macie.

question_text:
A company uses Amazon API Gateway to run a private gateway with two REST APIs in the same VPC. The BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service to ensure that enough funds are available before a stock can be purchased. The company has noticed in the VPC flow logs that the BuyStock RESTful web service calls the CheckFunds RESTful web service over the internet instead of through the VPC. A solutions architect must implement a solution so that the APIs communicate through the VPC.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the FEWEST changes to the code?
explanation_en:
API 网关中的私有 API 仅能通过接口端点从 VPC 内部访问：它会创建一个带有私有地址的网络接口和一个 DNS 记录，因此一个服务调用另一个服务是通过私有网络进行的。无需更改代码——只需将 API 的名称解析到私有地址即可。
选项 A：API 密钥与授权相关，对网络路径没有影响。
选项 C：网关端点仅适用于 S3 和 DynamoDB；API 网关没有这种端点类型。
选项 D：服务之间的队列会将交互模型从同步变为异步，这意味着需要重写代码，而且无论如何它都无法修复网络路径。

options.text: Add an X-API-Key header in the HTTP header for authorization.
Use an interface endpoint.
Use a gateway endpoint.
Add an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue between the two REST APIs.

question_text:
A company hosts a multiplayer gaming application on AWS. The company wants the application to read data with sub-millisecond latency and run one-time queries on historical data.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
需求要求实现亚毫秒级读取速度，并对历史数据进行一次性查询，同时保持最低的操作开销。DynamoDB 配合 DAX 缓存可为频繁访问的数据提供微秒级响应时间，内置的表导出功能可将数据移动到 S3，且无需编写任何代码，Athena 可对导出的数据执行一次性查询。
选项 A：RDS 无法提供亚毫秒级响应时间，且需要自定义导出脚本，会增加额外代码的编写和维护工作。
选项 B：直接从 S3 读取需要数十毫秒，从 S3 Glacier Deep Archive 中检索需要数小时——该需求无法满足。
选项 D：Kinesis Data Streams 和 Kinesis Data Firehose 的组合方案可行，但相比内置导出功能多出额外组件，且在没有缓存的情况下无法提供亚毫秒级响应时间。

options.text: Use Amazon RDS for data that is frequently accessed. Run a periodic custom script to export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket.

Store the data directly in an Amazon S3 bucket. Implement an S3 Lifecycle policy to move older data to S3 Glacier Deep Archive for long-term storage. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.

Use Amazon DynamoDB with DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) for data that is frequently accessed. Export the data to an Amazon S3 bucket by using DynamoDB table export. Run one-time queries on the data in Amazon S3 by using Amazon Athena.

Use Amazon DynamoDB for data that is frequently accessed. Turn on streaming to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams. Use Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to read the data from Kinesis Data Streams. Store the records in an Amazon S3 bucket.

question_text:
A company uses a payment processing system that requires messages for a particular payment ID to be received in the same order that they were sent. Otherwise, the payments might be processed incorrectly.
Which actions should a solutions architect take to meet this requirement? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
在单个支付 ID 内部必须保持顺序。两个正确选项都使用该 ID 作为分区键：一个具有支付 ID 作为消息组 ID 的 SQS FIFO 队列在组内保持顺序，并且确保每个消息仅被处理一次（E），而使用相同值作为分区键的 Kinesis 数据流将同一支付的所有记录放入单个分片中，从而保证顺序（B）.
选项 A：A DynamoDB 表存储数据，但它不是具有保证处理顺序的消息队列。
选项 C：Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached 是一个内存缓存，没有数据持久化，也没有顺序保证。
选项 D：标准 SQS 队列可能会以无序方式传递消息，且消息属性对顺序没有影响。

options.text: Write the messages to an Amazon DynamoDB table with the payment ID as the partition key.
Write the messages to an Amazon Kinesis data stream with the payment ID as the partition key.
Write the messages to an Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached cluster with the payment ID as the key.
Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Set the message attribute to use the payment ID.
Write the messages to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queue. Set the message group to use the payment ID.

question_text:
A company is building a game system that needs to send unique events to separate leaderboard, matchmaking, and authentication services concurrently. The company needs an AWS event-driven system that guarantees the order of the events.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
事件必须向多个接收者广播，同时保持顺序。SNS FIFO 主题实现了这一点：它将消息传递给多个订阅者，同时在消息组内保持顺序，并防止重复。
选项 A：EventBridge 事件总线会将事件广播到多个目标，但无法保证交付顺序。
选项 C：标准 SNS 主题同样无法保持消息顺序。
选项 D：SQS FIFO 队列可以保持顺序，但每个队列只有一个消费者，因此无法同时向三个服务广播。

options.text: Amazon EventBridge event bus
Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) FIFO topics
Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) standard topics
Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) FIFO queues

question_text:
A hospital is designing a new application that gathers symptoms from patients. The hospital has decided to use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) and Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) in the architecture.
A solutions architect is reviewing the infrastructure design. Data must be encrypted at rest and in transit. Only authorized personnel of the hospital should be able to access the data.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
数据流经 SNS 和 SQS，因此两个链接都需要保护，而不仅仅是其中一个。使用 AWS KMS 客户端管理密钥为每个组件开启服务器端加密——只有这种密钥类型允许您编辑密钥策略，并限制哪些主体可以加密和解密消息。此外，队列策略（以及主题策略）都设置了 aws:SecureTransport 条件，以确保仅接受 TLS 连接。关键细节是：对 KMS 密钥的访问主要由密钥自身的策略控制——如果没有明确的授权，任何 IAM 策略都无法单独提供访问权限。
选项 A：短语 "默认密钥策略" 指的是 AWS 管理的密钥，其策略无法编辑。这使得无法限制主体集合，而且这里也没有 TLS 要求。
选项 C：同样的问题也适用于 SNS 的默认密钥策略：它无法更改，因此通过这种方式限制访问是不可行的。
选项 E：该选项误解了机制：对 KMS 密钥的访问是通过密钥策略授予的，IAM 策略仅作为补充。仅通过 IAM 策略限制访问，并不能防止账户中其他主体的访问。

options.text: Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.
Turn on server-side encryption on the SNS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals.

Turn on encryption on the SNS components. Update the default key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the topic policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.

Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply a key policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.

Turn on server-side encryption on the SQS components by using an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key. Apply an IAM policy to restrict key usage to a set of authorized principals. Set a condition in the queue policy to allow only encrypted connections over TLS.

question_text:
A company runs a web application that is backed by Amazon RDS. A new database administrator caused data loss by accidentally editing information in a database table. To help recover from this type of incident, the company wants the ability to restore the database to its state from 5 minutes before any change within the last 30 days.
Which feature should the solutions architect include in the design to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
RDS 自动备份提供了在最近30天内任意时间点的恢复能力，精度可达几分钟：它们持续捕获事务日志，并且保留期可配置为最多35天。
选项 A：读副本会复制每一个变更，包括错误的变更，因此错误的数据也会复制到那里。
选项 B：手动快照是离散的时间点；它们不允许你恢复到"某个变更发生前五分钟"。
选项 D：多可用区部署可抵御基础设施故障，但它也会复制错误的变更。

options.text: Read replicas
Manual snapshots
Automated backups
Multi-AZ deployments

question_text:
A company’s web application consists of an Amazon API Gateway API in front of an AWS Lambda function and an Amazon DynamoDB database. The Lambda function handles the business logic, and the DynamoDB table hosts the data. The application uses Amazon Cognito user pools to identify the individual users of the application. A solutions architect needs to update the application so that only users who have a subscription can access premium content.
Which solution will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
订阅者需要在入口点与其他所有人分离，而无需重写业务逻辑。API Gateway 提供了现成的机制来实现这一点：使用带有 API 密钥的使用计划——为每个订阅者颁发一个密钥，并将其绑定到具有配额和限流限制的计划中，且没有有效密钥的请求将被网关本身拒绝。无需对 Lambda 函数或 DynamoDB 表进行任何更改。如果需要根据 Cognito 用户属性来区分访问权限，下一步将是使用 Lambda 授权器，但这意味着需要编写代码。
选项 A：API 缓存和限流管理负载和成本，但它们无法区分订阅者和普通用户。
选项 B：AWS WAF 根据请求属性（如 IP 地址、头部、模式）进行过滤。它不知道用户是否已付费订阅。
选项 C：DynamoDB 项目上的细粒度 IAM 权限在客户端直接使用其凭据访问表时生效。在这里，一个运行在自身角色下的 Lambda 函数位于用户和表之间。

options.text: Enable API caching and throttling on the API Gateway API.
Set up AWS WAF on the API Gateway API. Create a rule to filter users who have a subscription.
Apply fine-grained IAM permissions to the premium content in the DynamoDB table.
Implement API usage plans and API keys to limit the access of users who do not have a subscription.

question_text:
A company is using Amazon Route 53 latency-based routing to route requests to its UDP-based application for users around the world. The application is hosted on redundant servers in the company's on-premises data centers in the United States, Asia, and Europe. The company’s compliance requirements state that the application must be hosted on premises. The company wants to improve the performance and availability of the application.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该应用程序仍位于公司的自有数据中心，使用UDP协议，且需要提升性能和可用性。AWS全球加速器在距离每个用户最近的边缘位置接收流量，通过AWS全球网络骨干进行路由，并可将流量定向至已通过每个区域内的网络负载均衡器（NLB）注册为IP地址目标的本地站点。选择NLB是因为流量使用UDP，而ALB仅支持HTTP。当某个站点发生故障时，故障切换在加速器层面完成，无需等待DNS记录TTL过期。
选项 B：应用负载均衡器不支持UDP，因此无法服务于该应用程序。
选项 C：CloudFront不支持UDP流量，无法将其路由到Route 53记录作为源。
选项 D：这同时包含两个错误：ALB不支持UDP，且CloudFront不适用于此类流量。

options.text: Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the NLBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.

Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. Create an accelerator by using AWS Global Accelerator, and register the ALBs as its endpoints. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the accelerator DNS.

Configure three Network Load Balancers (NLBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three NLBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.

Configure three Application Load Balancers (ALBs) in the three AWS Regions to address the on-premises endpoints. In Route 53, create a latency-based record that points to the three ALBs, and use it as an origin for an Amazon CloudFront distribution. Provide access to the application by using a CNAME that points to the CloudFront DNS.

question_text:
A solutions architect wants all new users to have specific complexity requirements and mandatory rotation periods for IAM user passwords.
What should the solutions architect do to accomplish this?
explanation_en:
在 IAM 中，密码策略在整个账户中仅设置一次：最小长度、必需的字符类型、重复使用预防以及密码过期。不存在针对每个用户的独立密码策略。该设置适用于账户中的所有 IAM 用户，包括新创建的用户，这正是需求所要求的。
选项 B：IAM 没有针对每个用户的密码策略：存在一个适用于整个账户的单一策略。
选项 C：第三方软件不管理 IAM 用户的密码要求——这是由服务本身处理的。
选项 D：对用户创建事件做出响应意味着需要编写代码并存在延迟——到那时密码已经存在。内置设置则主动解决了这一问题。

options.text: Set an overall password policy for the entire AWS account.
Set a password policy for each IAM user in the AWS account.
Use third-party vendor software to set password requirements.
Attach an Amazon CloudWatch rule to the Create_newuser event to set the password with the appropriate requirements.

question_text:
A company has migrated an application to Amazon EC2 Linux instances. One of these EC2 instances runs several 1-hour tasks on a schedule. These tasks were written by different teams and have no common programming language. The company is concerned about performance and scalability while these tasks run on a single instance.
A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to resolve these concerns.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
这些任务使用不同的语言编写，每个任务运行一小时，需要并行执行。AWS Batch 将它们作为容器中的作业运行，自动提供和释放计算能力，管理作业队列和重试，并由 EventBridge 负责调度。语言和运行时环境可以保持其当前状态。
选项 B：AWS App Runner 是为 Web 服务和 API 设计的，而不是用于计划批处理作业。
选项 C：这些任务运行一小时，但 Lambda 函数的最大执行时间为十五分钟；此外，并非所有语言都得到支持。
选项 D：运行同一机器镜像的多个副本并不能解决并行执行不同作业的问题，且实例的维护工作仍然存在。

options.text: Use AWS Batch to run the tasks as jobs. Schedule the jobs by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
Convert the EC2 instance to a container. Use AWS App Runner to create the container on demand to run the tasks as jobs.
Copy the tasks into AWS Lambda functions. Schedule the Lambda functions by using Amazon EventBridge (Amazon CloudWatch Events).
Create an Amazon Machine Image (AMI) of the EC2 instance that runs the tasks. Create an Auto Scaling group with the AMI to run multiple copies of the instance.

question_text:
A company runs a public three-tier web application in a VPC. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. The EC2 instances that run in private subnets need to communicate with a license server over the internet. The company needs a managed solution that minimizes operational maintenance.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
需要一个管理的互联网路径来连接私有子网。在公共子网中创建一个 NAT 网关，私有子网的路由表将所有出站流量发送到该网关。这是一个管理资源：AWS 会自行处理其可用性，并将其扩展到数十吉比特每秒。
选项 A：NAT 实例可以工作，但它是一个普通的 EC2 实例：补丁、监控、扩展和容错都由公司自己负责。
选项 B：在私有子网中放置的 NAT 实例没有互联网访问，根本无法工作。
选项 D：NAT 网关必须位于公共子网中：如果放置在私有子网中，它将无法发送出站流量。

options.text: Provision a NAT instance in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance.
Provision a NAT instance in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT instance.
Provision a NAT gateway in a public subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway.
Provision a NAT gateway in a private subnet. Modify each private subnet's route table with a default route that points to the NAT gateway.

question_text:
A company needs to create an Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) cluster to host a digital media streaming application. The EKS cluster will use a managed node group that is backed by Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes for storage. The company must encrypt all data at rest by using a customer managed key that is stored in AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).
Which combination of actions will meet this requirement with the LEAST operational overhead? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
EKS 节点组的 EBS 卷在组扩展时会自动创建，因此加密必须提前设置，而不是逐卷设置。在区域中默认启用 EBS 加密，并选择客户管理密钥作为默认密钥，意味着每个新卷（包括 EKS 创建的卷）都会使用该密钥进行加密，无需您采取任何操作（C）。第二点是授予创建卷的实体访问密钥的权限：一个具有 KMS 密钥权限的 IAM 角色与集群关联，否则节点将无法启动，因为它们无法访问该密钥（D）。关键洞察：无法为已存在的 EBS 卷启用加密——加密只能在创建时生效。
选项 A：一个执行加密的 Kubernetes 插件是一个额外组件，您必须自行安装、更新和排查问题。这违反了最小操作开销的要求。
选项 B：您无法为已经存在的 EBS 卷启用加密——加密是在创建时设置的。您必须先创建快照，然后以启用加密的方式复制快照，再重建卷。
选项 E：KMS 密钥不能被"存储为 Kubernetes 密钥"——密钥材料永远不会离开服务。您通过其 API 与密钥交互，而不是将密钥复制到各个地方。

options.text: Use a Kubernetes plugin that uses the customer managed key to perform data encryption.
After creation of the EKS cluster, locate the EBS volumes. Enable encryption by using the customer managed key.
Enable EBS encryption by default in the AWS Region where the EKS cluster will be created. Select the customer managed key as the default key.
Create the EKS cluster. Create an IAM role that has a policy that grants permission to the customer managed key. Associate the role with the EKS cluster.
Store the customer managed key as a Kubernetes secret in the EKS cluster. Use the customer managed key to encrypt the EBS volumes.

question_text:
A company wants to migrate an Oracle database to AWS. The database consists of a single table that contains millions of geographic information systems (GIS) images that are high resolution and are identified by a geographic code.
When a natural disaster occurs, tens of thousands of images get updated every few minutes. Each geographic code has a single image or row that is associated with it. The company wants a solution that is highly available and scalable during such events.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
参考答案：D；争议选项：B。
examtopics t1 q372 — 社区意见分歧：B（S3+DynamoDB）成本更低且更具可扩展性；反驳观点是，地理图像无法简化为单一地理编码
高分辨率图片适合放 S3，按地理代码定位图片的元数据可放 DynamoDB，以主键高并发读取并按需扩展；继续运行 Oracle Multi-AZ 的 D 增加数据库运维和费用。题干明确每个代码对应一张图片，没有必须沿用 Oracle 或保存复杂 GIS 查询的要求，来源 D 改为 B。
来源答案 D 的原解析（与核查结果冲突，不采纳）：
两个合理的选择都共享同一个核心理念：高分辨率图像不应存储在数据库行中，而应移动到S3，数据库中仅保留地理编码和引用。关键选项D——元数据保留在RDS多可用区的Oracle关系表中：迁移工作量最小，应用程序仍可继续使用熟悉的模式，且多可用区提供了高可用性。争议是合理的：选项B（S3加DynamoDB）成本更低，并且在处理每分钟数万次更新的突发流量时表现更佳，因为DynamoDB可以水平扩展，而单个RDS实例则不能。选项D的反驳观点是：Oracle许可证和模式得以保留，且“每个地理编码对应一张图像”并不一定意味着整个数据模型简化为简单的键值查找。
来源旧选项 A：将图像本身存储在 Oracle 上的 RDS 行中是成本最高的选项：你需要为高端数据库存储付费，且更新峰值会触及单个实例的 IOPS 限制。
来源旧选项 B：在成本和可扩展性上都是强有力的选择。该选项未被选中是因为迁移问题：DynamoDB 需要重新编写数据访问方式，而题目描述的是迁移现有的 Oracle 模式。
来源旧选项 C：DynamoDB 项目大小限制为 400 KB — 高分辨率图像无法容纳。DAX 也加速了读取，而这里描述的工作负载是写密集型的。

options.text: Store the images and geographic codes in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.
Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Use Amazon DynamoDB with the geographic code as the key and the image S3 URL as the value.
Store the images and geographic codes in an Amazon DynamoDB table. Configure DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) during times of high load.
Store the images in Amazon S3 buckets. Store geographic codes and image S3 URLs in a database table. Use Oracle running on an Amazon RDS Multi-AZ DB instance.

question_text:
A company has an application that collects data from IoT sensors on automobiles. The data is streamed and stored in Amazon S3 through Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose. The data produces trillions of S3 objects each year. Each morning, the company uses the data from the previous 30 days to retrain a suite of machine learning (ML) models.
Four times each year, the company uses the data from the previous 12 months to perform analysis and train other ML models. The data must be available with minimal delay for up to 1 year. After 1 year, the data must be retained for archival purposes.
Which storage solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
这里的访问模式是预先已知的，而非随机的：每天早上会读取过去30天的数据，然后在一年内再被访问四次，一年之后数据仅保留用于归档。已知的访问模式最经济的方式是通过显式的生命周期规则：前30天使用S3标准存储，之后到一年时使用标准归档存储，再之后使用冰川深度归档存储。规模方面也需单独考虑：在万亿级对象的情况下，智能分层会变得昂贵，因为其监控费用是按对象计费的。
选项 A：在万亿级对象上使用智能分层意味着巨大的监控费用，且无法带来任何收益——访问模式在事前已知，完全可以使用一个简单的规则来描述。
选项 B：除了监控费用之外，这里的机制本身也是错误的：智能分层是基于访问缺失才将对象移动到归档层级，而不是基于日历年度，且归档层级需要单独启用。
选项 C：从第一天起使用标准归档存储会最严重地影响高峰期：数据在前30天每天早上被读取，而每一次这样的读取都会被计为归档存储的检索费用。

options.text: Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
Use the S3 Intelligent-Tiering storage class. Configure S3 Intelligent-Tiering to automatically move objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.
Use the S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.

Use the S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to transition objects to S3 Standard- Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA) after 30 days, and then to S3 Glacier Deep Archive after 1 year.

question_text:
A company is running several business applications in three separate VPCs within the us-east-1 Region. The applications must be able to communicate between VPCs. The applications also must be able to consistently send hundreds of gigabytes of data each day to a latency-sensitive application that runs in a single on-premises data center.
A solutions architect needs to design a network connectivity solution that maximizes cost-effectiveness.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
有两个要求：三个 VPC 之间的连通性，以及每天稳定传输数百吉比特到一个对延迟敏感的本地站点。最便宜的方式是使用一个 Direct Connect 连接加上一个 Transit Gateway：每个 VPC 都连接到网关，从而获得与其他 VPC 的连通性，而连接则通过 Direct Connect 网关连接到同一个网关。仅需一个物理连接而不是三个，且无需管理复杂的对等连接网络。
选项 A：三个 Site-to-Site VPN 连接通过互联网运行，因此延迟不可预测，且每天数百吉比特的数据会达到隧道的带宽限制。它们也无法提供 VPC 之间的连通性。
选项 B：在每个 VPC 中运行自己的虚拟设备意味着需要自行处理许可证、维护和扩展——而且仍然通过互联网运行。
选项 C：三个独立的 Direct Connect 连接成本是三倍，而通过 Transit Gateway 的一个连接可以为所有三个 VPC 提供服务。

options.text: Configure three AWS Site-to-Site VPN connections from the data center to AWS. Establish connectivity by configuring one VPN connection for each VPC.
Launch a third-party virtual network appliance in each VPC. Establish an IPsec VPN tunnel between the data center and each virtual appliance.
Set up three AWS Direct Connect connections from the data center to a Direct Connect gateway in us-east-1. Establish connectivity by configuring each VPC to use one of the Direct Connect connections.

Set up one AWS Direct Connect connection from the data center to AWS. Create a transit gateway, and attach each VPC to the transit gateway. Establish connectivity between the Direct Connect connection and the transit gateway.

question_text:
An ecommerce company is building a distributed application that involves several serverless functions and AWS services to complete order-processing tasks. These tasks require manual approvals as part of the workflow. A solutions architect needs to design an architecture for the order-processing application. The solution must be able to combine multiple AWS Lambda functions into responsive serverless applications. The solution also must orchestrate data and services that run on Amazon EC2 instances, containers, or on-premises servers.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
这需要通过手动审批进行编排，将 Lambda 函数与其他资源连接起来——包括 EC2 实例、容器和本地服务器。AWS Step Functions 正是为此而设计：一个具有分支、重试以及等待手动审批回调步骤的状态机，且支持与 Lambda 以及其他服务的集成。
选项 B：AWS Glue 是一个 ETL 服务，而不是具备手动审批步骤的工作流编排器。
选项 C：队列只是传递消息，但它不描述一系列步骤，且没有内置的等待审批功能。
选项 D：通过事件连接的函数可以工作，但你需要自行构建所有状态跟踪、重试逻辑和等待审批的功能。

options.text: Use AWS Step Functions to build the application.
Integrate all the application components in an AWS Glue job.
Use Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) to build the application.
Use AWS Lambda functions and Amazon EventBridge events to build the application.

question_text:
A company has launched an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance. Most of the connections to the database come from serverless applications. Application traffic to the database changes significantly at random intervals. At times of high demand, users report that their applications experience database connection rejection errors.
Which solution will resolve this issue with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
在无服务器应用程序出现峰值时，连接被拒绝的错误是连接耗尽的经典迹象。RDS Proxy 维护一个连接池并重用连接，从而平滑客户端数量的波动，而应用程序只需指向不同的端点。
选项 B：ElastiCache for Memcached 缓存读取操作，对数据库连接数量没有影响，应用程序仍需进行更改。
选项 C：更大的实例类型会提高连接限制，但成本更高，并不能解决在急剧峰值期间的根本原因。
选项 D：多可用区提高了可用性；备用实例不接受连接，因此应用程序没有需要切换的对象。

options.text: Create a proxy in RDS Proxy. Configure the users’ applications to use the DB instance through RDS Proxy.
Deploy Amazon ElastiCache for Memcached between the users’ applications and the DB instance.
Migrate the DB instance to a different instance class that has higher I/O capacity. Configure the users’ applications to use the new DB instance.
Configure Multi-AZ for the DB instance. Configure the users’ applications to switch between the DB instances.

question_text:
A company recently deployed a new auditing system to centralize information about operating system versions, patching, and installed software for Amazon EC2 instances. A solutions architect must ensure all instances provisioned through EC2 Auto Scaling groups successfully send reports to the auditing system as soon as they are launched and terminated.
Which solution achieves these goals MOST efficiently?
explanation_en:
报告必须在实例启动和终止的精确时刻发出。EC2 自动扩展组为此提供了生命周期钩子：实例被置于待启动或待终止状态，执行所需操作，只有在完成之后才完成状态转换。这是唯一可靠的方法，在实例被移除之前发送数据。
选项 A：一个计划函数与启动或终止的时刻没有绑定，且终止的实例无法再被轮询。
选项 C：用户数据仅在首次启动时运行——它不会在实例终止时触发。
选项 D：自动扩展组不会在操作系统内部调用脚本——这正是生命周期钩子存在的目的。

options.text: Use a scheduled AWS Lambda function and run a script remotely on all EC2 instances to send data to the audit system.
Use EC2 Auto Scaling lifecycle hooks to run a custom script to send data to the audit system when instances are launched and terminated.
Use an EC2 Auto Scaling launch configuration to run a custom script through user data to send data to the audit system when instances are launched and terminated.
Run a custom script on the instance operating system to send data to the audit system. Configure the script to be invoked by the EC2 Auto Scaling group when the instance starts and is terminated.

question_text:
A company is developing a real-time multiplayer game that uses UDP for communications between the client and servers in an Auto Scaling group. Spikes in demand are anticipated during the day, so the game server platform must adapt accordingly. Developers want to store gamer scores and other non-relational data in a database solution that will scale without intervention.
Which solution should a solutions architect recommend?
explanation_en:
两个需求对应两个独立的服务。具有尖锐峰值的UDP流量需要在自动扩展组前部署网络负载均衡器：它工作在第4层，支持UDP，并且能够处理数百万个连接而无需预热。无需人工干预即可扩展的非关系型数据（玩家分数、个人资料）需要使用DynamoDB的按需模式：容量会自动调整，无需进行容量规划。
选项 A：Route 53通过DNS分发请求，对连接状态无感知，并存在解析器缓存延迟，而Aurora Serverless是一个关系型数据库，而此处描述的数据是非关系型的。
选项 C：负载均衡器的选择是正确的，但Aurora Global Database仍然是一个关系型存储，专为跨区域复制设计，而不是用于具有自动扩展的非关系型数据。
选项 D：应用负载均衡器不支持UDP，且DynamoDB全局表是为多区域写入设计的，而需求中并未提及此类需求。

options.text: Use Amazon Route 53 for traffic distribution and Amazon Aurora Serverless for data storage.
Use a Network Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon DynamoDB on-demand for data storage.
Use a Network Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon Aurora Global Database for data storage.
Use an Application Load Balancer for traffic distribution and Amazon DynamoDB global tables for data storage.

question_text:
A company hosts a frontend application that uses an Amazon API Gateway API backend that is integrated with AWS Lambda. When the API receives requests, the Lambda function loads many libraries. Then the Lambda function connects to an Amazon RDS database, processes the data, and returns the data to the frontend application. The company wants to ensure that response latency is as low as possible for all its users with the fewest number of changes to the company's operations.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
延迟来自于冷启动：函数每次都会加载大量库。预置并发保持所需数量的实例预先初始化，因此请求会进入一个已经预热的环境。它既不改变代码，也不改变架构——它只是函数上的一个设置。
选项 A：将前端直接连接到数据库并绕过 API 会破坏架构，并要求将数据库公开暴露——这既是一次架构重设计，也存在安全漏洞。
选项 C：仅在 S3 中缓存结果仅对重复且完全相同的查询有帮助，无法解决库加载延迟的问题。
选项 D：更大的数据库会提高连接限制，但函数的初始化时间保持不变。

options.text: Establish a connection between the frontend application and the database to make queries faster by bypassing the API.
Configure provisioned concurrency for the Lambda function that handles the requests.
Cache the results of the queries in Amazon S3 for faster retrieval of similar datasets.
Increase the size of the database to increase the number of connections Lambda can establish at one time.

question_text:
A company is migrating its on-premises workload to the AWS Cloud. The company already uses several Amazon EC2 instances and Amazon RDS DB instances. The company wants a solution that automatically starts and stops the EC2 instances and DB instances outside of business hours. The solution must minimize cost and infrastructure maintenance.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
这取决于在计划时间表上启动和停止资源。Lambda 函数调用必要的 API，EventBridge 根据计划触发它：无需运行服务器，您仅按函数执行的秒数付费，维护工作仅需几行代码。
选项 A：弹性扩容是 Amazon Redshift 的功能，RDS 实例无法缩小到零。
选项 B：第三方 Marketplace 解决方案意味着为两个原生服务已经处理的功能增加了额外成本和供应商依赖。
选项 C：运行 crontab 的单独实例是一台持续运行的机器，需要打补丁和监控——成本更高且维护更复杂。

options.text: Scale the EC2 instances by using elastic resize. Scale the DB instances to zero outside of business hours.
Explore AWS Marketplace for partner solutions that will automatically start and stop the EC2 instances and DB instances on a schedule.
Launch another EC2 instance. Configure a crontab schedule to run shell scripts that will start and stop the existing EC2 instances and DB instances on a schedule.
Create an AWS Lambda function that will start and stop the EC2 instances and DB instances. Configure Amazon EventBridge to invoke the Lambda function on a schedule.

question_text:
A company hosts a three-tier web application that includes a PostgreSQL database. The database stores the metadata from documents. The company searches the metadata for key terms to retrieve documents that the company reviews in a report each month. The documents are stored in Amazon S3. The documents are usually written only once, but they are updated frequently.
The reporting process takes a few hours with the use of relational queries. The reporting process must not prevent any document modifications or the addition of new documents. A solutions architect needs to implement a solution to speed up the reporting process.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of change to the application code?
explanation_en:
报表运行的关联查询需要数小时，且不能干扰新文档的写入操作。Aurora PostgreSQL 与当前数据库兼容，因此仅需少量代码修改，且 Aurora 复制实例从相同的共享存储中读取数据，延迟仅为毫秒级。报表发送到副本实例，而写入操作则继续在主实例上进行。
选项 A：DocumentDB 是兼容 MongoDB 的：关系查询必须完全重写。
选项 C：RDS 多可用区配置中的备用实例不可用于读取——报告无法将其定向到该实例。
选项 D：DynamoDB 不支持关系查询，将文档迁移到那里意味着必须重写应用程序。

options.text: Set up a new Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) cluster that includes a read replica. Scale the read replica to generate the reports.
Set up a new Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL DB cluster that includes an Aurora Replica. Issue queries to the Aurora Replica to generate the reports.
Set up a new Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Configure the reporting module to query the secondary RDS node so that the reporting module does not affect the primary node.
Set up a new Amazon DynamoDB table to store the documents. Use a fixed write capacity to support new document entries. Automatically scale the read capacity to support the reports.

question_text:
A company has a three-tier application on AWS that ingests sensor data from its users’ devices. The traffic flows through a Network Load Balancer (NLB), then to Amazon EC2 instances for the web tier, and finally to EC2 instances for the application tier. The application tier makes calls to a database.
What should a solutions architect do to improve the security of the data in transit?
explanation_en:
要求非常明确——提升传输中的数据安全性，而不是防御攻击或保护静态数据。网络负载均衡器可以终止 TLS：你在负载均衡器上创建一个 TLS 端口监听器，将服务器证书（通常来自 ACM）安装到负载均衡器上，来自设备到 NLB 的流量就会被加密。如果需要，可以进一步加密到实例的段。务必保持清晰区分：TLS 保护传输中的数据，KMS 保护静态数据，而 WAF 和 Shield 用于防御攻击。
选项 B：Shield Advanced 和 WAF 可以防御 DDoS 攻击和常见网络攻击，但它们不提供加密。此外，WAF 无法附加到网络负载均衡器上。
选项 C：将负载均衡器替换为 ALB 加 WAF 再次解决了防御攻击的问题，而不是加密通信通道。单独使用 ALB 并不会加密流量。
选项 D：加密 EBS 卷可以保护实例磁盘上的静态数据。传输中的数据仍然没有得到保护。

options.text: Configure a TLS listener. Deploy the server certificate on the NLB.
Configure AWS Shield Advanced. Enable AWS WAF on the NLB.
Change the load balancer to an Application Load Balancer (ALB). Enable AWS WAF on the ALB.
Encrypt the Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume on the EC2 instances by using AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS).

question_text:
A company is planning to migrate a commercial off-the-shelf application from its on-premises data center to AWS.
The software has a software licensing model using sockets and cores with predictable capacity and uptime requirements. The company wants to use its existing licenses, which were purchased earlier this year.
Which Amazon EC2 pricing option is the MOST cost-effective?
explanation_en:
许可证与插槽和核心绑定，这意味着需要访问物理主机——这就是专用主机，是 EC2 唯一一个暴露并记录服务器物理配置的选项。工作负载具有可预测的容量和可用性，因此预留主机可以获得最大的折扣。
选项 B：专用按需主机满足许可证要求，但为可预测的全天候工作负载支付全额按需费率是不具成本效益的。
选项 C：专用实例仅保证没有其他租户共享底层硬件——它们不暴露主机的插槽和核心，因此无法将许可证映射到这些资源上。
选项 D：相同的许可证限制，再加上没有预留折扣。

options.text: Dedicated Reserved Hosts
Dedicated On-Demand Hosts
Dedicated Reserved Instances
Dedicated On-Demand Instances

question_text:
A company runs an application on Amazon EC2 Linux instances across multiple Availability Zones. The application needs a storage layer that is highly available and Portable Operating System Interface (POSIX)-compliant. The storage layer must provide maximum data durability and must be shareable across the EC2 instances. The data in the storage layer will be accessed frequently for the first 30 days and will be accessed infrequently after that time.
Which solution will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
需要一个符合 POSIX 标准的文件系统，跨不同可用区的实例共享，具备最高持久性且对不常读取的数据成本更低。这就是标准存储类的 EFS，它将数据存储在多个可用区，并结合生命周期策略，将超过 30 天未访问的文件移动到 EFS 标准-低频访问，每吉字节的价格大约降低十倍，同时保持相同的文件系统语义。
选项 A：S3 是一个不支持 POSIX 兼容文件系统的存储服务，且 Glacier 也不提供即时访问功能。
选项 B：S3 Standard-IA 类别成本更低，但根本问题依然存在：对象存储无法满足应用程序需要 POSIX 文件系统的工作场景。
选项 D：One Zone 类别仅将数据存储在单个可用区中，而需求要求具备最大持久性。

options.text: Use the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move infrequently accessed data to S3 Glacier.
Use the Amazon S3 Standard storage class. Create an S3 Lifecycle policy to move infrequently accessed data to S3 Standard-Infrequent Access (S3 Standard-IA).
Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) Standard storage class. Create a lifecycle management policy to move infrequently accessed data to EFS Standard-Infrequent Access (EFS Standard-IA).
Use the Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) One Zone storage class. Create a lifecycle management policy to move infrequently accessed data to EFS One Zone-Infrequent Access (EFS One Zone-IA).

question_text:
A solutions architect is creating a new VPC design. There are two public subnets for the load balancer, two private subnets for web servers, and two private subnets for MySQL. The web servers use only HTTPS. The solutions architect has already created a security group for the load balancer allowing port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Company policy requires that each resource has the least access required to still be able to perform its tasks.
Which additional configuration strategy should the solutions architect use to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
最小权限意味着每个层级仅接受来自其相邻层级的流量。Web 服务器仅允许来自负载均衡器安全组的端口 443，而不是来自整个互联网；MySQL 服务器仅允许来自 Web 服务器安全组的端口 3306。通过引用安全组而非 IP 地址，可以确保在舰队规模扩展时仍能正常工作。
选项 A：在 Web 服务器上直接允许来自 0.0.0.0/0 的端口 443 是不必要的：这样可能会被除负载均衡器之外的其他来源访问。
选项 B：网络访问控制列表（Network ACLs）基于地址和子网工作，无法引用安全组——无法创建这种规则。
选项 D：同样的错误：网络访问控制列表（Network ACLs）无法将安全组作为源或目的地址接受。

options.text: Create a security group for the web servers and allow port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Create a security group for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.
Create a network ACL for the web servers and allow port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Create a network ACL for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.
Create a security group for the web servers and allow port 443 from the load balancer. Create a security group for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.
Create a network ACL for the web servers and allow port 443 from the load balancer. Create a network ACL for the MySQL servers and allow port 3306 from the web servers security group.

question_text:
An ecommerce company is running a multi-tier application on AWS. The front-end and backend tiers both run on Amazon EC2, and the database runs on Amazon RDS for MySQL. The backend tier communicates with the RDS instance. There are frequent calls to return identical datasets from the database that are causing performance slowdowns.
Which action should be taken to improve the performance of the backend?
explanation_en:
问题在于相同的查询频繁重复。一个内存中的 ElastiCache 缓存可以在千分之一秒内返回这样的数据集，并将重复的数据库负载移除——这是针对重复且完全相同的查询的标准解决方案。
选项 A：SNS 是一个通知服务；它不能用于存储数据库查询。
选项 C：一个只读副本会减轻主实例的负载，但它不是缓存：每个查询仍然会完整地运行在数据库上。
选项 D：Firehose 将流式数据传递到存储目的地，与加速读取无关。

options.text: Implement Amazon SNS to store the database calls.
Implement Amazon ElastiCache to cache the large datasets.
Implement an RDS for MySQL read replica to cache database calls.
Implement Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose to stream the calls to the database.

question_text:
A new employee has joined a company as a deployment engineer. The deployment engineer will be using AWS CloudFormation templates to create multiple AWS resources. A solutions architect wants the deployment engineer to perform job activities while following the principle of least privilege.
Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to accomplish this goal? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
为使用 CloudFormation 的工程师配置最小权限是由两个部分构成的。首先：一个专用的 IAM 用户，该用户属于一个组，该组的策略仅允许执行 CloudFormation 操作——该人员本身没有权限直接创建资源（D）。其次：一个独立的服务角色，在部署期间由堆栈假设，用于定义正在创建的资源的具体权限（E）。这样，资源上的权限归属于堆栈，而不是个人，并且可以精确限制为实际所需的内容。
选项 A：根账户在日常操作中绝对不应被使用：它无法通过策略进行限制，也无法在人员之间共享。
选项 B：PowerUsers 为几乎所有服务提供了几乎完全的访问权限，除了 IAM 管理。这种权限范围远超部署堆栈所需的程度。
选项 C：AdministratorAccess 提供对整个账户的完全访问权限——这是对最小权限原则的最大违背。

options.text: Have the deployment engineer use AWS account root user credentials for performing AWS CloudFormation stack operations.
Create a new IAM user for the deployment engineer and add the IAM user to a group that has the PowerUsers IAM policy attached.
Create a new IAM user for the deployment engineer and add the IAM user to a group that has the AdministratorAccess IAM policy attached.
Create a new IAM user for the deployment engineer and add the IAM user to a group that has an IAM policy that allows AWS CloudFormation actions only.
Create an IAM role for the deployment engineer to explicitly define the permissions specific to the AWS CloudFormation stack and launch stacks using that IAM role.

question_text:
A company is deploying a two-tier web application in a VPC. The web tier is using an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group with public subnets that span multiple Availability Zones. The database tier consists of an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in separate private subnets. The web tier requires access to the database to retrieve product information.
The web application is not working as intended. The web application reports that it cannot connect to the database. The database is confirmed to be up and running. All configurations for the network ACLs, security groups, and route tables are still in their default states.
What should a solutions architect recommend to fix the application?
explanation_en:
所有设置都处于默认状态：网络访问控制列表允许所有流量，VPC 内部的本地路由已经存在，但默认安全组不允许来自其他安全组的入站连接。因此，必须在数据库的安全组中添加一条规则，允许来自 Web 层安全组的 MySQL 端口流量。
选项 A：默认网络访问控制列表已经允许所有流量：无需添加任何规则。
选项 B：同一 VPC 内子网之间的路由由本地路由条目自动创建，且无法删除。
选项 C：将各层级拆分为独立的 VPC 并配置 VPC 对等连接是一种过度重构，因为目前仅缺少一条规则。

options.text: Add an explicit rule to the private subnet’s network ACL to allow traffic from the web tier’s EC2 instances.
Add a route in the VPC route table to allow traffic between the web tier’s EC2 instances and the database tier.
Deploy the web tier's EC2 instances and the database tier’s RDS instance into two separate VPCs, and configure VPC peering.
Add an inbound rule to the security group of the database tier’s RDS instance to allow traffic from the web tiers security group.

question_text:
A company has a large dataset for its online advertising business stored in an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in a single Availability Zone. The company wants business reporting queries to run without impacting the write operations to the production DB instance.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
报表查询需要从主实例上移除，以避免干扰写入操作。一个 RDS 读取副本会接收数据的异步副本，并承担全部报表负载，而不会影响主数据库上的写入操作。
选项 B：负载均衡器无法将查询分发到数据库，也不会创建数据的额外副本。
选项 C：更大的实例会提高整体上限，但大量报表仍会与写入操作竞争相同资源。
选项 D：在多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置中的备用实例不会处理查询：它仅用于故障切换。

options.text: Deploy RDS read replicas to process the business reporting queries.
Scale out the DB instance horizontally by placing it behind an Elastic Load Balancer.
Scale up the DB instance to a larger instance type to handle write operations and queries.
Deploy the DB instance in multiple Availability Zones to process the business reporting queries.

question_text:
A company hosts a three-tier ecommerce application on a fleet of Amazon EC2 instances. The instances run in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). All ecommerce data is stored in an Amazon RDS for MariaDB Multi-AZ DB instance.
The company wants to optimize customer session management during transactions. The application must store session data durably.
Which solutions will meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
参考答案：AD；争议选项：BD。
examtopics t1 q390 — 粘性会话不存储数据；ElastiCache Redis 只有在启用持久化时才是持久的；社区中有一部分人倾向于选择 BD
ALB sticky sessions 不存储会话数据，因此来源 AD 的 A 不满足 durable。DynamoDB 可持久保存会话；ElastiCache for Redis 可用副本和备份降低丢失风险，但标准 Redis OSS 集群故障时仍可能丢失最近写入，不能无条件视为严格持久。题目要求两项却缺少明确的第二个必然正确选项；BD 仅为相对接近的参考组合。
来源答案 AD 的原解析（与核查结果冲突，不采纳）：
有一个要求：持久地存储会话数据，以确保在自动扩展组中替换实例时不会丢失客户的购物车。一个持久的外部会话存储意味着 DynamoDB 或 ElastiCache for Redis。来源练习资料 键选择了 AD，而这正是最具争议的地方：粘性会话实际上并不存储任何数据——它们只是将客户端绑定到同一个实例上，当该实例被替换时，会话就会丢失。社区中相当一部分人选择 BD，严格依据题干要求——"持久地存储会话数据"——这确实是更优的答案。请注意：本题的关键不在于键的字母，而在于底层技术——将状态从实例中移出。
来源旧选项 B：从技术上讲，这是所有选项中最强的：DynamoDB 本质上是持久的，数据会跨三个可用区进行复制，并且是 AWS 标准的会话存储方案。来源练习资料 键没有选择它，而这正是争议所在。
来源旧选项 C：Cognito 负责管理用户账户和认证令牌，而不是购物车或交易状态。这是问题中的另一个层面。
来源旧选项 E：Systems Manager Application Manager 是一个用于管理应用程序资源的控制台。它以任何形式都不是用户会话存储方案。

options.text: Turn on the sticky sessions feature (session affinity) on the ALB.
Use an Amazon DynamoDB table to store customer session information.
Deploy an Amazon Cognito user pool to manage user session information.
Deploy an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis cluster to store customer session information.
Use AWS Systems Manager Application Manager in the application to manage user session information.

question_text:
A company needs a backup strategy for its three-tier stateless web application. The web application runs on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group with a dynamic scaling policy that is configured to respond to scaling events. The database tier runs on Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL. The web application does not require temporary local storage on the EC2 instances. The company’s recovery point objective (RPO) is 2 hours.
The backup strategy must maximize scalability and optimize resource utilization for this environment.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
该应用程序是无状态的，不需要临时本地存储，因此对实例卷进行快照是徒劳的——只需保留最新的 AMI，Auto Scaling 组即可从中启动任意数量的实例。两小时的数据恢复点由 RDS 自动备份和时间点恢复功能覆盖。
选项 A：实例卷快照对于无状态应用程序是不必要的，只会消耗资源，且"每两小时数据库快照"会重复 RDS 内置的机制。
选项 B：EBS 快照生命周期策略再次对不需要备份的内容进行备份，且在没有时间点恢复的情况下，两小时的 RPO 无法得到保证。
选项 D：这也会对不必要的实例卷进行快照，浪费资源，尽管该选项后半部分是正确的。

options.text: Take snapshots of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes of the EC2 instances and database every 2 hours to meet the RPO.
Configure a snapshot lifecycle policy to take Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS to meet the RPO.
Retain the latest Amazon Machine Images (AMIs) of the web and application tiers. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery to meet the RPO.
Take snapshots of Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes of the EC2 instances every 2 hours. Enable automated backups in Amazon RDS and use point-in-time recovery to meet the RPO.

question_text:
A company wants to deploy a new public web application on AWS. The application includes a web server tier that uses Amazon EC2 instances. The application also includes a database tier that uses an Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance.
The application must be secure and accessible for global customers that have dynamic IP addresses.
How should a solutions architect configure the security groups to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
客户遍布全球，且拥有动态IP地址，因此无法列出其源地址——Web层必须接受来自0.0.0.0/0的HTTPS请求。然而，数据库则保持严格限制：其安全组允许3306端口的访问并非来自特定IP地址，而是通过引用Web服务器的安全组，因此访问自动适用于当前属于该安全组的实例，并且仅限于这些实例。
选项 B：由于客户IP地址是动态的，无法枚举客户IP地址，全球用户将简单失去访问网站的能力。
选项 C：客户IP地址的错误与之前相同，且数据库通过地址列表开放，而非引用Web服务器的安全组。
选项 D：将3306端口对整个互联网开放，直接违反了安全要求。

options.text: Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the security group of the web servers.

Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from the IP addresses of the customers. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the security group of the web servers.

Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from the IP addresses of the customers. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from the IP addresses of the customers.

Configure the security group for the web servers to allow inbound traffic on port 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. Configure the security group for the DB instance to allow inbound traffic on port 3306 from 0.0.0.0/0.

question_text:
A payment processing company records all voice communication with its customers and stores the audio files in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company needs to capture the text from the audio files. The company must remove from the text any personally identifiable information (PII) that belongs to customers.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
需要两个操作：转录语音并剥离个人数据。Amazon Transcribe 在一个作业中完成这两项操作——它内置了用于转录文本的个人身份信息（PII）自动屏蔽功能。当上传事件触发时，一个 Lambda 函数启动转录作业，输出存储在另一个存储桶中。
选项 A：Kinesis Video Streams 处理实时视频流，而不是已录制的音频文件，且它不执行语音识别。
选项 B：Textract 从文档和图像中提取文本；它无法理解音频。
选项 D：Amazon Connect 是用于实时通话的联络中心，而不是处理已录制文件的批处理工具；自定义构建的 PII 扫描器也极不可靠。

options.text: Process the audio files by using Amazon Kinesis Video Streams. Use an AWS Lambda function to scan for known PII patterns.
When an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket, invoke an AWS Lambda function to start an Amazon Textract task to analyze the call recordings.

Configure an Amazon Transcribe transcription job with PII redaction turned on. When an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket, invoke an AWS Lambda function to start the transcription job. Store the output in a separate S3 bucket.

Create an Amazon Connect contact flow that ingests the audio files with transcription turned on. Embed an AWS Lambda function to scan for known PII patterns. Use Amazon EventBridge to start the contact flow when an audio file is uploaded to the S3 bucket.

question_text:
A company is running a multi-tier ecommerce web application in the AWS Cloud. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances with an Amazon RDS for MySQL Multi-AZ DB instance. Amazon RDS is configured with the latest generation DB instance with 2,000 GB of storage in a General Purpose SSD (gp3) Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volume. The database performance affects the application during periods of high demand.
A database administrator analyzes the logs in Amazon CloudWatch Logs and discovers that the application performance always degrades when the number of read and write IOPS is higher than 20,000.
What should a solutions architect do to improve the application performance?
explanation_en:
该限制是具体的：单个 gp3 卷的最大 IOPS 为 16,000，而应用程序的 IOPS 需求达到 20,000。解决方案是将负载分散到两个 gp3 卷上，并在数据库或文件系统层面进行合并——合并后的限制值翻倍，而每 GB 的成本保持不变。
选项 A：一个磁盘卷的速度是数十倍更慢，因此性能会明显下降。
选项 B：gp3 卷的 IOPS 只能提升到 16,000，低于所需的 20,000，因此限制仍然会被达到。
选项 C：io2 卷确实能提供更多的 IOPS，但其成本显著更高，而两个 gp3 卷以更便宜的方式满足了需求。

options.text: Replace the volume with a magnetic volume.
Increase the number of IOPS on the gp3 volume.
Replace the volume with a Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2) volume.
Replace the 2,000 GB gp3 volume with two 1,000 GB gp3 volumes.

question_text:
An IAM user made several configuration changes to AWS resources in their company's account during a production deployment last week. A solutions architect learned that a couple of security group rules are not configured as desired. The solutions architect wants to confirm which IAM user was responsible for making changes.
Which service should the solutions architect use to find the desired information?
explanation_en:
关于"谁调用了哪个API以及何时调用"的问题，始终由AWS CloudTrail解答：它记录了管理操作API调用，包括调用者的身份、时间、源地址和请求参数，而AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress事件则明确显示了是谁修改了规则。需要记住服务之间的区别：CloudTrail告诉你谁做了什么，Config显示资源的配置状态及其变化过程，GuardDuty检测恶意活动的迹象，而Inspector则发现工作负载中的漏洞。
选项 A：GuardDuty会查找被入侵和可疑行为的迹象。它不是用户操作的日志。
选项 B：Inspector会扫描实例和镜像以检测漏洞和不安全的配置；它不会记录谁修改了资源。
选项 D：AWS Config将显示安全组配置的变更及其变化过程，但关于"哪个用户执行了此操作"的答案存在于CloudTrail中。

options.text: Amazon GuardDuty
Amazon Inspector
AWS CloudTrail
AWS Config

question_text:
A company has implemented a self-managed DNS service on AWS. The solution consists of the following:
• Amazon EC2 instances in different AWS Regions
• Endpoints of a standard accelerator in AWS Global Accelerator The company wants to protect the solution against DDoS attacks.
What should a solutions architect do to meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
你需要保护流量实际到达的点——全球加速器的静态任播地址。AWS Shield Advanced 可以将加速器作为受保护资源，因此你在订阅中添加的是：攻击会在进入实例之前被 AWS 全球网络边缘吸收。请注意，这是一个运行在 UDP 上的 DNS 服务，因此从原理上讲 WAF 不适用——它仅能过滤 HTTP 请求。
选项 B：实例位于加速器之后，不会直接接收流量；需要保护的是入口点。此外，Shield Advanced 保护的是弹性 IP，而不是实例本身。
选项 C：AWS WAF 只能过滤 HTTP 请求，无法附加到全球加速器：对于 DNS 交通而言它是无用的。
选项 D：WAF 无法附加到 EC2 实例上，而且对于 DNS 交通仍然不适用。

options.text: Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the accelerator as a resource to protect.
Subscribe to AWS Shield Advanced. Add the EC2 instances as resources to protect.
Create an AWS WAF web ACL that includes a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the accelerator.
Create an AWS WAF web ACL that includes a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the EC2 instances.

question_text:
An ecommerce company needs to run a scheduled daily job to aggregate and filter sales records for analytics. The company stores the sales records in an Amazon S3 bucket. Each object can be up to 10 GB in size. Based on the number of sales events, the job can take up to an hour to complete. The CPU and memory usage of the job are constant and are known in advance.
A solutions architect needs to minimize the amount of operational effort that is needed for the job to run.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
该作业运行时间最长为一小时，因此Lambda的十五分钟执行限制使其不适用。CPU和内存需求在提前且恒定，这完全符合Fargate上的ECS任务需求：一个由EventBridge规则每日触发的任务会完整运行，且无需维护任何基础设施。
选项 A：Lambda函数的执行时间上限为十五分钟：一个持续一小时的作业会被截断。
选项 B：相同的执行限制，再加上不必要的API Gateway层；此外，通过HTTP API的同步调用受到更严格的限制。
选项 D：EC2启动类型意味着需要持续运行实例组中的实例，即使作业仅每天运行一次，也必须维持该实例。

options.text: Create an AWS Lambda function that has an Amazon EventBridge notification. Schedule the EventBridge event to run once a day.

Create an AWS Lambda function. Create an Amazon API Gateway HTTP API, and integrate the API with the function. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that calls the API and invokes the function.
Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an AWS Fargate launch type. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that launches an ECS task on the cluster to run the job.

Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with an Amazon EC2 launch type and an Auto Scaling group with at least one EC2 instance. Create an Amazon EventBridge scheduled event that launches an ECS task on the cluster to run the job.

question_text:
A company needs to transfer 600 TB of data from its on-premises network-attached storage (NAS) system to the AWS Cloud. The data transfer must be complete within 2 weeks. The data is sensitive and must be encrypted in transit. The company’s internet connection can support an upload speed of 100 Mbps.
Which solution meets these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation_en:
做数学计算：600 TB 的数据以 100 Mbps 的速度传输需要超过一年，但截止期限只有两周。任何依赖现有链路的选项都从数学上被排除。剩下的只有物理设备：多个 Snowball Edge Storage Optimized 设备可以在几天内完成数据传输，使用 AWS KMS 密钥对内容进行加密，并且不消耗任何互联网带宽。更多关于通过网络链路传输数据的信息，请参见 第 215 题。
选项 A：分块上传可以加快单个对象的传输速度，但总带宽保持不变：截止期限仍然无法满足。
选项 B：VPN 仍然依赖相同的 100 Mbps 链路，只是在上面增加了加密开销。
选项 D：一个 10 Gbps 的 Direct Connect 连接在技术上是足够快的，但配置物理链路通常需要数周时间，且其成本相对于一次性的大量数据传输而言，与租用设备进行单次行程相比显得不成比例。

options.text: Use Amazon S3 multi-part upload functionality to transfer the files over HTTPS.
Create a VPN connection between the on-premises NAS system and the nearest AWS Region. Transfer the data over the VPN connection.
Use the AWS Snow Family console to order several AWS Snowball Edge Storage Optimized devices. Use the devices to transfer the data to Amazon S3.
Set up a 10 Gbps AWS Direct Connect connection between the company location and the nearest AWS Region. Transfer the data over a VPN connection into the Region to store the data in Amazon S3.

question_text:
A financial company hosts a web application on AWS. The application uses an Amazon API Gateway Regional API endpoint to give users the ability to retrieve current stock prices. The company’s security team has noticed an increase in the number of API requests. The security team is concerned that HTTP flood attacks might take the application offline.
A solutions architect must design a solution to protect the application from this type of attack.
Which solution meets these requirements with the LEAST operational overhead?
explanation_en:
一个HTTP洪水是指大量形式有效的请求，切断它们的方法是速率限制。AWS WAF 正有针对此场景的速率规则：它在滚动的五分钟窗口内统计每个地址的请求数量，并阻止超过阈值的请求。一个区域性的Web访问控制列表（Web ACL）直接附加到API网关阶段，因此架构中无需增加额外组件——从而实现了最小的运营开销。
选项 A：CloudFront搭配较长的TTL有助于缓存内容的重复请求，但股票报价是动态的，CloudFront本身不提供速率限制。
选项 C：指标和告警会通知人员关于问题，但它们不会阻止任何请求。
选项 D：一个自定义函数来维护每个地址的计数器意味着需要开发工作和必须维护的状态，而不是使用现成的WAF规则。

options.text: Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint with a maximum TTL of 24 hours.
Create a Regional AWS WAF web ACL with a rate-based rule. Associate the web ACL with the API Gateway stage.
Use Amazon CloudWatch metrics to monitor the Count metric and alert the security team when the predefined rate is reached.

Create an Amazon CloudFront distribution with [email protected] in front of the API Gateway Regional API endpoint. Create an AWS Lambda function to block requests from IP addresses that exceed the predefined rate.

question_text:
A meteorological startup company has a custom web application to sell weather data to its users online. The company uses Amazon DynamoDB to store its data and wants to build a new service that sends an alert to the managers of four internal teams every time a new weather event is recorded. The company does not want this new service to affect the performance of the current application.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
explanation_en:
警报需要在每个新记录上触发，且不能影响现有应用程序。DynamoDB Streams 发布表变更的流，一个处理器将消息发送到单个 SNS 主题，而四个团队都订阅该主题。应用程序本身完全不变。
选项 A：DynamoDB 事务保证写入的原子性，并不会通知任何人。
选项 B：这需要修改应用程序，并设置四个主题而不是一个主题——额外的工作和额外的维护。
选项 D：每分钟轮询表中的标志意味着增加了延迟、持续扫描和一个自定义调度器；此外，多个团队无法都订阅到同一个 SQS 队列。

options.text: Use DynamoDB transactions to write new event data to the table. Configure the transactions to notify internal teams.
Have the current application publish a message to four Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topics. Have each team subscribe to one topic.
Enable Amazon DynamoDB Streams on the table. Use triggers to write to a single Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to which the teams can subscribe.

Add a custom attribute to each record to flag new items. Write a cron job that scans the table every minute for items that are new and notifies an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue to which the teams can subscribe.

question_text:
A company wants to use the AWS Cloud to make an existing application highly available and resilient. The current version of the application resides in the company's data center. The application recently experienced data loss after a database server crashed because of an unexpected power outage.
The company needs a solution that avoids any single points of failure. The solution must give the application the ability to scale to meet user demand.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
单点故障是数据库，这是首先要消除的问题。在多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置中，RDS会将数据同步复制到另一个可用区，并自动实现故障切换，因此一个可用区的断电不会导致数据丢失。应用层部署在跨多个可用区的自动扩展组中，这既提供了容错能力，也具备了随需求扩展的能力。
选项 B：单个可用区仍然存在单点故障，且EC2自动恢复功能既不能防止可用区故障，也不能防止实例磁盘数据丢失。
选项 C：读副本是异步操作，且在断电期间需要手动提升，这意味着数据丢失是可能的，且恢复时间较长。
选项 D：多挂载（Multi-Attach）仅在单个可用区内部生效，因此在不同可用区中部署数据库的描述场景是不可行的。

options.text: Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance in a Multi-AZ configuration.
Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group in a single Availability Zone. Deploy the database on an EC2 instance. Enable EC2 Auto Recovery.

Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Use an Amazon RDS DB instance with a read replica in a single Availability Zone. Promote the read replica to replace the primary DB instance if the primary DB instance fails.

Deploy the application servers by using Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group across multiple Availability Zones. Deploy the primary and secondary database servers on EC2 instances across multiple Availability Zones. Use Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Multi-Attach to create shared storage between the instances.

question_text:
A company needs to ingest and handle large amounts of streaming data that its application generates. The application runs on Amazon EC2 instances and sends data to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, which is configured with default settings. Every other day, the application consumes the data and writes the data to an Amazon S3 bucket for business intelligence (BI) processing. The company observes that Amazon S3 is not receiving all the data that the application sends to Kinesis Data Streams.
What should a solutions architect do to resolve this issue?
explanation_en:
应用程序仅每两天拉取一次数据，但 Kinesis 流默认保留记录 24 小时——任何比消费者到达时间更早的数据都会被丢弃。延长保留期（在标准模式下最多可达 7 天，使用扩展保留可更长时间）足以阻止数据丢失。
选项 B：Kinesis 生产者库提高了写入效率，但对已经写入的数据保留时长没有影响。
选项 C：分片不足会表现为写入失败，但在这里写入成功，数据在读取时丢失。
选项 D：S3 版本控制会保留已上传到 S3 的对象的版本，但对已经从流中删除的数据没有任何保存作用。

options.text: Update the Kinesis Data Streams default settings by modifying the data retention period.
Update the application to use the Kinesis Producer Library (KPL) to send the data to Kinesis Data Streams.
Update the number of Kinesis shards to handle the throughput of the data that is sent to Kinesis Data Streams.
Turn on S3 Versioning within the S3 bucket to preserve every version of every object that is ingested in the S3 bucket.

question_text:
A developer has an application that uses an AWS Lambda function to upload files to Amazon S3 and needs the required permissions to perform the task. The developer already has an IAM user with valid IAM credentials required for Amazon S3.
What should a solutions architect do to grant the permissions?
explanation_en:
Lambda函数通过执行角色获取其权限：该角色被分配给函数，并将所需的权限策略（例如，对特定存储桶的s3:PutObject操作）附加到该角色上。在运行时，函数会自动获取该角色的临时凭证，因此无需在代码中存储任何内容。这里的现有IAM用户只是一个干扰项：将个人密钥放入服务代码中是一种反模式。不要混淆Lambda的两种策略——执行角色定义了函数可以执行的操作，而基于资源的策略定义了谁可以调用该函数。
选项 A：函数的资源策略定义了哪些服务和账户被允许调用它。它并不授予写入S3的权限。
选项 B：使用现有用户的密钥对请求进行签名意味着将长期存在的密钥嵌入到函数代码中。这虽然可行，但违背了公认的最佳实践，并未解决权限管理问题。
选项 C：一个新的用户及其密钥是同样的错误：将长期凭证存放在代码中，而不是从角色获取临时凭证。

options.text: Add required IAM permissions in the resource policy of the Lambda function.
Create a signed request using the existing IAM credentials in the Lambda function.
Create a new IAM user and use the existing IAM credentials in the Lambda function.
Create an IAM execution role with the required permissions and attach the IAM role to the Lambda function.

question_text:
A company has deployed a serverless application that invokes an AWS Lambda function when new documents are uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. The application uses the Lambda function to process the documents. After a recent marketing campaign, the company noticed that the application did not process many of the documents.
What should a solutions architect do to improve the architecture of this application?
explanation_en:
在流量激增期间，直接从 S3 调用函数会遇到函数的并发限制，多余的事件会被丢失，因为异步调用具有有限的重试次数。一个 SQS 队列会接收每一个事件，将其暂存，并以函数能够处理的速度将其传递给函数——没有文档会被丢弃。
选项 A：15分钟的运行超时时间在事件从未到达函数的最初阶段时并无帮助。
选项 B：复制会将对象复制到另一个存储桶中，但不会执行任何处理操作，也不会保留事件。
选项 C：第二个函数不会提高账户的整体并发限制，也不会提供缓冲功能，且无法通过这种方式对 Lambda 调用进行负载均衡。

options.text: Set the Lambda function's runtime timeout value to 15 minutes.
Configure an S3 bucket replication policy. Stage the documents in the S3 bucket for later processing.
Deploy an additional Lambda function. Load balance the processing of the documents across the two Lambda functions.
Create an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue. Send the requests to the queue. Configure the queue as an event source for Lambda.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing the architecture for a software demonstration environment. The environment will run on Amazon EC2 instances in an Auto Scaling group behind an Application Load Balancer (ALB). The system will experience significant increases in traffic during working hours but is not required to operate on weekends.
Which combination of actions should the solutions architect take to ensure that the system can scale to meet demand? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
工作时间负载上升，周末则完全消失。在工作日，基于平均 CPU 利用率的靶向跟踪扩展策略非常合适——容量随实际需求变化（D）。在周末，计划扩展会将自动扩展组的最小、期望和最大容量设置为零，然后在每周开始时恢复之前的值（E）。
选项 A：应用程序负载均衡器作为托管服务会自动扩展；其容量无需且不需要配置。
选项 B：互联网网关是逻辑构造，没有吞吐量限制，因此没有需要扩展的内容。
选项 C：跨多个区域部署解决了全球可用性问题，而非日内负载波动，且成本显著更高。

options.text: Use AWS Auto Scaling to adjust the ALB capacity based on request rate.
Use AWS Auto Scaling to scale the capacity of the VPC internet gateway.
Launch the EC2 instances in multiple AWS Regions to distribute the load across Regions.
Use a target tracking scaling policy to scale the Auto Scaling group based on instance CPU utilization.
Use scheduled scaling to change the Auto Scaling group minimum, maximum, and desired capacity to zero for weekends. Revert to the default values at the start of the week.

question_text:
A solutions architect is designing a two-tiered architecture that includes a public subnet and a database subnet.
The web servers in the public subnet must be open to the internet on port 443. The Amazon RDS for MySQL DB instance in the database subnet must be accessible only to the web servers on port 3306.
Which combination of steps should the solutions architect take to meet these requirements? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
两层架构基于安全组构建：Web服务器开放端口443以供整个互联网访问，因为公共网站需要接收访客（C）；数据库通过引用Web服务器的安全组来允许端口3306——这样访问权限仅授予那些实例，无论其地址如何，而不会授予任何人其他访问权限。
选项 A：网络ACL在子网级别上运行，并且此处不需要；禁止端口3306的出站流量会破坏Web服务器与数据库的连接。
选项 B：通过子网的地址范围允许流量会使数据库对子网内任何资源开放，而不仅仅是Web服务器。
选项 E：安全组没有拒绝规则——只有明确允许的内容才被允许——因此无法创建这样的规则。

options.text: Create a network ACL for the public subnet. Add a rule to deny outbound traffic to 0.0.0.0/0 on port 3306.
Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to allow traffic from the public subnet CIDR block on port 3306.
Create a security group for the web servers in the public subnet. Add a rule to allow traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443.
Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to allow traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.
Create a security group for the DB instance. Add a rule to deny all traffic except traffic from the web servers’ security group on port 3306.

question_text:
A company is implementing a shared storage solution for a gaming application that is hosted in the AWS Cloud.
The company needs the ability to use Lustre clients to access data. The solution must be fully managed.
Which solution meets these requirements?
explanation_en:
再次强调的关键短语是 Lustre 客户端。在 AWS 中，唯一一个支持该协议的托管文件系统是 Amazon FSx for Lustre。它能够提供亚毫秒级的延迟和每秒吉字节的吞吐量，而所有操作工作均由 AWS 负责。类似的操作流程在 第 99 题 中也有说明。
选项 A：DataSync 用于在存储系统之间移动数据，并不会创建可挂载的文件系统。
选项 B：Storage Gateway 通过 NFS 和 SMB 提供资源；它不支持 Lustre 协议。
选项 C：EFS 没有支持 Lustre 的模式——不存在这样的配置。

options.text: Create an AWS DataSync task that shares the data as a mountable file system. Mount the file system to the application server.
Create an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Create a file share that uses the required client protocol. Connect the application server to the file share.
Create an Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS) file system, and configure it to support Lustre. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.
Create an Amazon FSx for Lustre file system. Attach the file system to the origin server. Connect the application server to the file system.

question_text:
A company runs an application that receives data from thousands of geographically dispersed remote devices that use UDP. The application processes the data immediately and sends a message back to the device if necessary. No data is stored.
The company needs a solution that minimizes latency for the data transmission from the devices. The solution also must provide rapid failover to another AWS Region.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
UDP 传输、最小延迟以及快速故障转移至每个区域的网络负载均衡器，由全球加速器实现。加速器在最近的边缘位置接收数据包，通过 AWS 全球网络骨干进行路由，并在几秒内切换到健康的区域，不依赖 DNS 缓存。通过 Fargate 上的 ECS 实现无服务器处理，作为负载均衡器的目标。应用负载均衡器在此场景中是不合适的——它不支持 UDP。
选项 A：通过 Route 53 的故障转移速度较慢，因为存在 TTL 和解析器缓存，且网络负载均衡器无法将 Lambda 函数作为目标。
选项 C：应用负载均衡器不支持 UDP：设备根本无法发送数据。
选项 D：应用负载均衡器不适合 UDP，且基于 DNS 的故障转移无法提供快速、高可用的切换。

options.text: Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the two Regions. Configure the NLB to invoke an AWS Lambda function to process the data.

Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in each of the two Regions as an endpoint. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the NLProcess the data in Amazon ECS.

Use AWS Global Accelerator. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each of the two Regions as an endpoint. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the ALB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.

Configure an Amazon Route 53 failover routing policy. Create an Application Load Balancer (ALB) in each of the two Regions. Create an Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) cluster with the Fargate launch type. Create an ECS service on the cluster. Set the ECS service as the target for the ALB. Process the data in Amazon ECS.

question_text:
A solutions architect must migrate a Windows Internet Information Services (IIS) web application to AWS. The application currently relies on a file share hosted in the user's on-premises network-attached storage (NAS). The solutions architect has proposed migrating the IIS web servers to Amazon EC2 instances in multiple Availability Zones that are connected to the storage solution, and configuring an Elastic Load Balancer attached to the instances.
Which replacement to the on-premises file share is MOST resilient and durable?
explanation_en:
IIS应用程序运行在Windows系统上，并通过SMB协议访问网络共享。最健壮且持久的替代方案是Amazon FSx for Windows File Server的多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置：数据在可用区之间同步复制，支持Windows ACLs和Active Directory，每个可用区中的实例都可挂载相同的文件共享。
选项 A：RDS是一种关系型数据库；它无法作为文件共享使用。
选项 B：Storage Gateway是为混合场景设计的，并依赖于本地虚拟机，而该虚拟机本身成为一个单点故障。对于完全迁移到AWS的工作负载，它并不需要。
选项 D：EFS使用NFS协议：对于运行在Windows上的IIS应用程序来说，这不是原生的访问方式，并且不支持Windows ACLs。

options.text: Migrate the file share to Amazon RDS.
Migrate the file share to AWS Storage Gateway.
Migrate the file share to Amazon FSx for Windows File Server.
Migrate the file share to Amazon Elastic File System (Amazon EFS).

question_text:
A company is deploying a new application on Amazon EC2 instances. The application writes data to Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) volumes. The company needs to ensure that all data that is written to the EBS volumes is encrypted at rest.
Which solution will meet this requirement?
explanation_en:
对于 EBS 卷，加密在创建时设置，并覆盖磁盘上的数据、卷与实例之间传输的数据、快照以及从这些快照创建的卷。对于现有的未加密卷，无法开启加密——相反，你需要先取一个快照，复制该快照时指定一个 KMS 密钥，然后从加密的副本创建一个新的卷。因此，正确的做法是在创建卷时就将其设置为加密；在账户层面，这可以通过 EC2 的 "EBS 默认加密" 设置方便地强制执行。
选项 A：一个 IAM 角色描述了主体被允许执行的操作。它没有属性可以 "加密卷"，也不会影响卷的创建方式。
选项 C：标签只是一个用于跟踪和搜索的标签。单独使用它不会开启任何功能；最多你可以基于它构建策略，但卷不会因为标签而被加密。
选项 D：KMS 密钥策略定义了谁可以使用该密钥——它不会强制在整个账户范围内对卷进行加密。加密的强制执行是通过默认的 EBS 加密设置或包含 ec2:Encrypted 条件的 SCP 策略完成的。

options.text: Create an IAM role that specifies EBS encryption. Attach the role to the EC2 instances.
Create the EBS volumes as encrypted volumes. Attach the EBS volumes to the EC2 instances.
Create an EC2 instance tag that has a key of Encrypt and a value of True. Tag all instances that require encryption at the EBS level.
Create an AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) key policy that enforces EBS encryption in the account. Ensure that the key policy is active.

question_text:
A company has a web application with sporadic usage patterns. There is heavy usage at the beginning of each month, moderate usage at the start of each week, and unpredictable usage during the week. The application consists of a web server and a MySQL database server running inside the data center. The company would like to move the application to the AWS Cloud, and needs to select a cost-effective database platform that will not require database modifications.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
负载突发不可预测，数据库无法更改，且成本至关重要。与 MySQL 兼容的 Aurora Serverless 正是解决此问题的最佳方案：应用程序无需修改即可运行，容量会自动扩展以应对每月和每周开始时的流量高峰，然后在低负载期间自动缩减，因此公司无需持续支付高峰容量的费用。
选项 A：DynamoDB 是一个非关系型存储：查询和数据模型需要被重写。
选项 B：RDS for MySQL 需要选择一个针对峰值负载的实例类，并持续支付该实例的费用，即使没有实际负载也是如此。
选项 D：关系型数据库无法通过 EC2 自动伸缩组进行扩展：新实例不会共享底层数据。

options.text: Amazon DynamoDB
Amazon RDS for MySQL
MySQL-compatible Amazon Aurora Serverless
MySQL deployed on Amazon EC2 in an Auto Scaling group

question_text:
An image-hosting company stores its objects in Amazon S3 buckets. The company wants to avoid accidental exposure of the objects in the S3 buckets to the public. All S3 objects in the entire AWS account need to remain private.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
要求是，整个账户中的任何对象都绝不能变为公开，即使有人误配置了策略。第一层是账户级别的 S3 阻止公开访问：它会覆盖任何公共 ACL 或存储桶策略，无论其内容如何。第二层是一个 SCP，它拒绝 s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock 操作（以及禁用单个存储桶上的阻止设置），因此无法从账户内部关闭该设置。这是一种预防性保护，而不是事后检测。
选项 A：GuardDuty 分析威胁和可疑活动，但不会监控存储桶策略或将其回滚。
选项 B：Trusted Advisor 在事后发现公开存储桶并发送通知，而修复仍需手动操作。在此期间，数据可能会暴露。
选项 C：Resource Access Manager 在账户间共享资源，并与发现公开存储桶无关。

options.text: Use Amazon GuardDuty to monitor S3 bucket policies. Create an automatic remediation action rule that uses an AWS Lambda function to remediate any change that makes the objects public.

Use AWS Trusted Advisor to find publicly accessible S3 buckets. Configure email notifications in Trusted Advisor when a change is detected. Manually change the S3 bucket policy if it allows public access.

Use AWS Resource Access Manager to find publicly accessible S3 buckets. Use Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) to invoke an AWS Lambda function when a change is detected. Deploy a Lambda function that programmatically remediates the change.

Use the S3 Block Public Access feature on the account level. Use AWS Organizations to create a service control policy (SCP) that prevents IAM users from changing the setting. Apply the SCP to the account.

question_text:
An ecommerce company is experiencing an increase in user traffic. The company’s store is deployed on Amazon EC2 instances as a two-tier web application consisting of a web tier and a separate database tier. As traffic increases, the company notices that the architecture is causing significant delays in sending timely marketing and order confirmation email to users. The company wants to reduce the time it spends resolving complex email delivery issues and minimize operational overhead.
What should a solutions architect do to meet these requirements?
explanation_en:
问题在于邮件交付，公司希望停止处理其复杂性。Amazon SES 是一个托管的邮件服务：发件人声誉、交付队列、拒收和投诉均由服务处理——应用程序只需调用 API。
选项 A：专用的邮件级 EC2 实例将所有交付复杂性留在公司身上，并增加了更多基础设施。
选项 C：SNS 向订阅者发送通知，但它并不是一个完整的面向客户的邮件发送工具：没有模板，没有声誉管理。
选项 D：与选项 A 相同，只是增加了 Auto Scaling：操作开销不会减少，反而增加。

options.text: Create a separate application tier using EC2 instances dedicated to email processing.
Configure the web instance to send email through Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES).
Configure the web instance to send email through Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS).
Create a separate application tier using EC2 instances dedicated to email processing. Place the instances in an Auto Scaling group.

question_text:
A company has a business system that generates hundreds of reports each day. The business system saves the reports to a network share in CSV format. The company needs to store this data in the AWS Cloud in near-real time for analysis.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the LEAST administrative overhead?
explanation_en:
业务系统只能将数据写入网络共享目录，无法进行修改，且数据需要在近实时地传输到云端。S3 File Gateway 正是提供了这种网络共享目录，但将其保存的每个文件都会异步转换为 S3 对象——本质上是实时完成，且无需编写任何自动化代码。系统只需指向新的共享目录即可。
选项 A：每天执行一次的任务并非近实时：报告需要等到当天结束才处理。
选项 C：调用 DataSync API 的自定义应用程序需要编写和维护代码，而网关则无需任何代码即可完成相同功能。
选项 D：监控新文件并通过 SFTP 上传的脚本再次是自定义自动化，其自身存在故障和重试管理的问题。

options.text: Use AWS DataSync to transfer the files to Amazon S3. Create a scheduled task that runs at the end of each day.
Create an Amazon S3 File Gateway. Update the business system to use a new network share from the S3 File Gateway.
Use AWS DataSync to transfer the files to Amazon S3. Create an application that uses the DataSync API in the automation workflow.
Deploy an AWS Transfer for SFTP endpoint. Create a script that checks for new files on the network share and uploads the new files by using SFTP.

question_text:
A company is storing petabytes of data in Amazon S3 Standard. The data is stored in multiple S3 buckets and is accessed with varying frequency. The company does not know access patterns for all the data. The company needs to implement a solution for each S3 bucket to optimize the cost of S3 usage.
Which solution will meet these requirements with the MOST operational efficiency?
explanation_en:
当访问模式未知时，判别器是 "MOST operational efficiency"。Intelligent-Tiering 无需分析也无需手动决策：它会自行监控每个对象的访问情况，并在各层级之间移动对象，且不产生检索费用。每个存储桶只需一个生命周期规则即可管理数个拍字节的数据。请注意限制条件：小于 128 KB 的对象永远不会移动到归档层级，并始终按频繁访问层级计费。
选项 B：存储类分析仅生成一份报告。基于其结果移动数个拍字节的对象必须手动完成，且每次访问模式改变都需要重复操作——这是所有选项中操作开销最大的。
选项 C：Glacier Instant Retrieval 提供即时访问，但会产生明显的检索费用，并且具有 90 天的最低存储期限。其中部分拍字节数据被频繁读取，对于这些数据，其成本最终高于 Standard。
选项 D：一个 Zone-IA 将容错性降低到单个区域，并收取检索费用——对于访问模式未知的数据，这是一个糟糕的选择。

options.text: Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 Intelligent- Tiering.
Use the S3 storage class analysis tool to determine the correct tier for each object in the S3 bucket. Move each object to the identified storage tier.
Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval.
Create an S3 Lifecycle configuration with a rule to transition the objects in the S3 bucket to S3 One Zone- Infrequent Access (S3 One Zone-IA).

question_text:
A rapidly growing global ecommerce company is hosting its web application on AWS. The web application includes static content and dynamic content. The website stores online transaction processing (OLTP) data in an Amazon RDS database The website’s users are experiencing slow page loads.
Which combination of actions should a solutions architect take to resolve this issue? (Choose two.)
explanation_en:
页面加载缓慢来源于两个方面。CloudFront 加速静态内容和部分动态内容：内容在边缘位置被缓存，请求通过 AWS 主干网络（B）传输到区域。RDS 的只读副本分担了数据库的负载，吸收读取查询，从而释放主实例用于事务处理（D）
选项 A：Redshift 是一个分析型数据仓库，与交易型网站的页面加载速度无关。
选项 C：动态内容按定义无法托管在 S3 中：它由应用程序生成。
选项 E：多可用区（Multi-AZ）配置提高了可用性，但备用实例不处理请求，因此不会提升性能。

options.text: Configure an Amazon Redshift cluster.
Set up an Amazon CloudFront distribution.
Host the dynamic web content in Amazon S3.
Create a read replica for the RDS DB instance.
Configure a Multi-AZ deployment for the RDS DB instance.

question_text:
A company uses Amazon EC2 instances and AWS Lambda functions to run its application. The company has VPCs with public subnets and private subnets in its AWS account. The EC2 instances run in a private subnet in one of the VPCs. The Lambda functions need direct network access to the EC2 instances for the application to work.
The application will run for at least 1 year. The company expects the number of Lambda functions that the application uses to increase during that time. The company wants to maximize its savings on all application resources and to keep network latency between the services low.
Which solution will meet these requirements?
